pmid-23176153.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old nulliparous woman with a dysgerminoma of the right ovary coexisting with a synchronous left tubal pregnancy. She underwent right adnexectomy and left linear salpingostomy. She later conceived spontaneously before chemotherapy was started, carried the intrauterine pregnancy to term, and had another normal pregnancy. She remained well without chemotherapy. The authors note the diagnostic and therapeutic challenges of combining an ovarian tumor with an ectopic pregnancy and state that they found no similar cases in the literature.

pmid-23185165.summary_ja: 60歳女性が腹痛、体重減少、高カルシウム血症（15.0 mg/dl）で受診し、PTHrP産生が確認された。両側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う悪性ブレンナー腫瘍が見つかり、子宮全摘・両側卵管卵巣摘出術後にカルシウムは正常化した。悪性ブレンナー腫瘍に伴う高カルシウム血症の初報告である。
pmid-23185165.summary_en: This case report describes a 60-year-old woman with abdominal pain, weight loss and hypercalcemia (serum calcium 15.0 mg/dl) driven by PTHrP production. Imaging suggested bilateral mature cystic teratomas, and total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy revealed a malignant Brenner tumor associated with a mature cystic teratoma. Calcium normalised after surgery, and the authors describe this as the first reported hypercalcemia linked to a malignant Brenner tumor. They review the four mechanisms of malignancy-associated hypercalcemia and stress close perioperative calcium monitoring.

pmid-23185794.summary_ja: 過去20年間に妊孕性温存治療を受けた悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍145例を後方視的に解析した。5年生存率は90.3%で、主な予後因子はFIGO病期と標準的な化学療法だった。化学療法は月経、妊娠、出産に影響せず、35児が出生した。FIGO病期にかかわらず妊孕性温存治療を検討すべきと結論している。
pmid-23185794.summary_en: This retrospective study analysed 145 women treated with fertility-preserving management for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors over 20 years, with a median follow-up of 9.5 years. The five-year overall survival was 90.3%, and the main prognostic factors were FIGO stage and standard chemotherapy. Histological type, surgery type and chemotherapy regimen did not significantly affect survival. Chemotherapy did not affect menses, pregnancy or offspring, and 35 babies were delivered. The authors conclude that fertility-preserving treatment should be considered regardless of FIGO stage.

pmid-23189072.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例272例と対照382例を用いた症例対照研究である。身長の最高四分位の人は、精巣がんのリスクが約2.2倍であった。セミノーマでは182cm超の男性で関連が強かった。BMIは組織型を問わず逆相関を示した。小児期の栄養や思春期のホルモンが関与する可能性があると考察している。
pmid-23189072.summary_en: This case-control study of 272 testicular cancer cases and 382 controls examined whether height, weight and body mass index influence the risk of testicular germ cell tumors. Men in the highest height quartile had more than twice the odds of TGCT, and the association was strongest for seminoma, where very tall men (over 182 cm) showed significantly increased risk. BMI was inversely associated with TGCT in both histological subgroups. The authors suggest that childhood nutrition and pubertal hormones may explain these findings and call for further study of postnatal exposures.

pmid-23192513.summary_ja: 22歳男性の右肺中葉に生じた成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）の症例報告である。肺原発の奇形腫は稀で、性腺やほかの性腺外原発を除外する必要がある。臨床、画像、病理所見を提示し、文献を概説している。肺奇形腫は上葉に多い傾向があるが、その理由は不明である。
pmid-23192513.summary_en: This case report describes a mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) arising in the right middle lobe of the lung in a 22-year-old man. Intrapulmonary teratomas are rare, usually seen in the mediastinum, and diagnosis requires excluding gonadal and other extragonadal primaries. The authors present the clinical, radiological and histopathological features and review the relevant literature. Lung teratomas commonly involve the upper lobe for reasons that remain unknown.

pmid-23194133.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の23歳男性が、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる化学療法の2日目に可逆性後頭葉白質脳症症候群(PRES)を発症した。シスプラチンを一時休薬しエトポシドを継続したところ、神経症状は完全に消失した。その後シスプラチンを再投与しても再発はなく、寛解に至った。シスプラチン関連PRES後の再投与に成功した初の報告である。
pmid-23194133.summary_en: A 23-year-old man with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumor developed posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES) on day 2 of cisplatin and etoposide chemotherapy. Cisplatin was withheld for two days while etoposide continued, and his neurological symptoms resolved completely. Cisplatin was then re-administered without recurrence of PRES, and he achieved remission. The authors report this as the first documented successful cisplatin re-challenge after cisplatin-associated PRES, suggesting re-treatment may be an option when platinum-based therapy is the only hope for cure.

pmid-23196490.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎に関連する腫瘍について概説している。腫瘍合併率は2008年の60%から2011年には42%へ低下し、18歳未満および男性では合併が少ない傾向があった。卵巣奇形腫のほか、精巣胚細胞腫瘍などの腫瘍も関連する。子宮癌肉腫を合併した65歳女性例も報告されている。悪性腫瘍を伴う脳炎の予後は関連腫瘍の予後に左右される可能性がある。
pmid-23196490.summary_en: This review summarizes tumors associated with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. The tumor-associated proportion fell from 60% in 2008 to 42% in 2011, and was lower in patients under 18 and in males. Besides ovarian teratoma, associated tumors include testicular germ cell tumors and other malignancies. The authors also describe a 65-year-old woman with uterine carcinosarcoma with neuroendocrine differentiation who developed this encephalitis. They conclude that the prognosis of encephalitis with malignancy may depend on the prognosis of the associated tumor.

pmid-23196491.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の発症における卵巣奇形腫の役割を検討するため、脳炎を伴う例と伴わない例、正常卵巣を病理組織学的に評価した。ヒトおよびウシの卵母細胞の細胞質にNR2Bエピトープの強い発現が認められた。神経組織の量や炎症細胞浸潤に両群間の有意差はなかった。神経組織に富む奇形腫は、難治性脳炎のリスクを高める可能性がある。
pmid-23196491.summary_en: To clarify the role of ovarian teratomas in anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, the authors histopathologically examined ovarian teratomas with and without encephalitis and normal ovaries. Strong NR2B epitope expression was found in oocyte cytoplasm from human and bovine ovaries, and neural tissue in teratomas showed NR2B immunoreactivity, mainly in mature neurons. No significant difference in neural tissue amount or inflammatory infiltration was found between teratoma groups. The authors suggest that teratomas rich in neural tissue may increase the risk of intractable encephalitis after prodromal infection.

pmid-23197969.summary_ja: 血精症は原因不明と考えられることが多いが、本症例では陰嚢診察と超音波検査で精巣腫瘍が見つかり、セミノーマであった。血精症患者では、精巣悪性腫瘍を見落とさないために陰嚢診察と必要に応じた超音波検査を行うべきである。
pmid-23197969.summary_en: A patient presented with hemospermia, which is often considered idiopathic. Scrotal examination and ultrasonography revealed a testicular tumor, which was identified as seminoma. The case highlights that patients presenting with hemospermia should undergo scrotal examination and, when indicated, ultrasound, to avoid missing a testicular malignancy. Although hemospermia is commonly regarded as benign, this report shows it can be the first sign of a testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-23198376.summary_ja: 17歳男性が、小児期から徐々に増大する左殿部の疼痛を伴う腫瘤を主訴に受診した。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では主に脂肪と大腸を含む境界明瞭な軟部腫瘤が認められた。腫瘍と尾骨を完全切除し、病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。成人での仙尾部奇形腫の報告は稀である。
pmid-23198376.summary_en: A 17-year-old male presented with a painful left buttock mass that had been gradually growing since childhood. MRI showed a well-defined soft-tissue mass containing mainly fat and large intestine. Complete excision of the tumor and coccyx was performed. Gross and histologic examination confirmed a mature teratoma. The authors note that sacrococcygeal teratoma is rarely reported in adults, and this case adds to the limited data on late-presenting sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-23205081.summary_ja: 中国の単施設で巨大卵巣奇形腫330例(腫瘍径15cm超)を検討した報告。開腹群は緊急手術例が多く、腹腔鏡群では偶発的な嚢胞破裂が多かった(31.5%対19.6%)。著者らは、一塊での摘出と腫瘤破裂の回避のために開腹切除が望ましい可能性を指摘し、術前診断には画像所見の理解が有用だとしている。
pmid-23205081.summary_en: This review of 330 patients with giant ovarian teratomas (diameter over 15 cm) at a Chinese hospital compared laparotomy with laparoscopy. Emergency cases were more common in the laparotomy group, while accidental cyst rupture occurred more often with laparoscopy (31.5% vs 19.6%). The authors suggest laparotomic en bloc resection may be preferable for giant teratomas, and that familiarity with characteristic imaging features aids preoperative diagnosis.

pmid-23205135.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞株を用い、TGF-β1が細胞の浸潤能に及ぼす影響を検討した基礎研究。TGF-β1はTβR I・TβR II・Smad4の発現を低下させる一方、MMP-9とTIMP-1の発現を上昇させ、浸潤能を高めた。絨毛癌の浸潤機構の理解につながる知見である。
pmid-23205135.summary_en: Using the JEG-3 placental choriocarcinoma cell line, the authors examined how TGF-β1 affects cell invasion. TGF-β1 increased invasiveness while reducing expression of TGF-β receptors I and II and Smad4, and raising levels of MMP-9 and TIMP-1. The findings suggest TGF-β1 signaling may help drive trophoblastic invasion, with implications for understanding the invasive biology of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-23214338.summary_ja: 80歳女性が急性腹症で受診し、20cmの卵巣嚢胞性腫瘤に対して左卵管卵巣摘出術が行われた。組織学的に、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の高分化型扁平上皮癌と診断された。周囲の扁平上皮には異形成も認められた。奇形腫の悪性転化の形態学的・臨床病理学的特徴を考察し、本症は稀で、多くは偶発的所見であると述べている。
pmid-23214338.summary_en: An 80-year-old woman with acute abdomen underwent left salpingo-oophorectomy for a 20 cm cystic ovarian mass. Histology showed well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma, with dysplasia in the surrounding squamous epithelium. The authors review the morphologic and clinicopathologic features of malignant transformation in teratoma, noting that such squamous carcinoma is rare and often an incidental finding.

pmid-23216975.summary_ja: 49歳女性が左卵巣腫瘍に対して手術を受けた。病理組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と、腸型腺癌の領域が認められた。術後5年時点で無病生存中である。奇形腫の悪性転化は1〜2%とされ、消化管型腺癌は扁平上皮癌に比べ極めて稀であると述べている。文献レビューも併せて示している。
pmid-23216975.summary_en: A 49-year-old woman underwent surgery for a left ovarian tumor. Histology showed a mature cystic teratoma with hair shafts and a squamous layer, and a separate area of intestinal-type adenocarcinoma. Five years after surgery she remained alive without disease. The authors note malignant transformation occurs in 1-2% of mature cystic teratomas, and that gastrointestinal-type adenocarcinoma is extremely rare compared with squamous carcinoma.

pmid-23248427.summary_ja: 縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍と腎奇形、特に馬蹄腎が併存したまれな症例を総説的に検討した。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と馬蹄腎はいずれも胚発生期の細胞の異常な移動に由来すると考えられ、両者の起源の関連が論じられている。この併存例は治療上の課題であり、起源の議論から治療、フォローアップまでを扱っている。
pmid-23248427.summary_en: This case review discusses the unusual coexistence of a mediastinal germ cell tumour and a renal anomaly, particularly horseshoe kidney. Extragonadal germ cell tumours and horseshoe kidney are both thought to arise from abnormal migration of germline-associated cells during embryogenesis, which links their origin. The authors note that this combination poses therapeutic challenges and cover issues ranging from origin and treatment to follow-up.

pmid-23248619.summary_ja: ペンシルベニア大学のゲノムワイド関連解析の137例の部分集団において、シスプラチン代謝経路の遺伝子GSTP1、COMT、TPMTの変異を、シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者で検討した。COMT近傍でARVCFのイントロン内にあるSNP(rs2073743)は、初回化学療法後の難治性疾患と関連し、劣性遺伝モデルではGG遺伝子型のリスクが著しく高かった。神経障害、耳毒性、無増悪生存期間、全生存期間との関連は認められなかった。著者らは、本研究結果は仮説生成的であり、検証が必要であると述べている。
pmid-23248619.summary_en: In a 137-patient subset of a University of Pennsylvania genome-wide association study, the authors examined variants in GSTP1, COMT and TPMT, genes in the cisplatin metabolism pathway, in patients with testicular germ cell tumour treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. One SNP (rs2073743) near COMT, within an intron of ARVCF, was associated with refractory disease after first-line chemotherapy, and the GG genotype carried a markedly higher risk under recessive inheritance. No associations were found with neuropathy, ototoxicity, progression-free or overall survival. The authors describe the findings as hypothesis-generating and in need of validation.

pmid-23250246.summary_ja: モロッコの小児病院で2000年から2008年にかけて卵巣腫瘍の治療を受けた2歳から15歳の女児18例の後方視的検討である。初診時の主訴は腹痛が最も多く、腫瘍の77%は胚細胞腫瘍で、その大半は奇形腫であり、多くは良性であった。最も多い術式は片側卵管卵巣摘出術であった。悪性腫瘍の7例のうち3例は術後化学療法を受けた。治療抵抗性や死亡例はなく、転帰は概ね良好であった。著者らは、妊孕性を保つため保存的手術を推奨している。
pmid-23250246.summary_en: This retrospective review of 18 girls aged 2 to 15 years treated for ovarian tumours at a Moroccan children's hospital between 2000 and 2008 found abdominal pain to be the most common presentation. Seventy-seven percent of tumours were germ cell tumours, mostly teratomas, and most were benign. Unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy was the commonest operation. Seven patients had malignant tumours, and three of them received postoperative chemotherapy. Outcomes were good, with no treatment resistance or deaths. The authors advocate conservative surgery to preserve fertility.

pmid-23251575.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞成分である胎児性癌の細胞株5種を用い、シスプラチンによる鎖間架橋を修復する能力を検討した。相同組換え修復の低下が認められ、PARP阻害薬単剤に感受性を示した。PARP阻害は、耐性の強い細胞株でシスプラチンへの反応を増強した。シスプラチン耐性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を克服する治療戦略として示唆される。
pmid-23251575.summary_en: The authors examined five embryonal carcinoma cell lines, the stem-cell component of testicular germ cell tumours, for their ability to repair cisplatin-induced interstrand crosslinks. The lines showed impaired or reduced homologous recombination, indicated by fewer RAD51 foci and a GFP-reporter assay. Consistent with this deficiency, they were sensitive to PARP inhibitor monotherapy, and sensitivity correlated with PARP1 expression and activity. PARP inhibition also enhanced cisplatin response in the most resistant lines, suggesting a way to overcome cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-23256061.summary_ja: 30歳女性の左臀部の腫脹と痛みを報告する。超音波検査とMRIで、内部に多数の結節を含む嚢胞性腫瘤が認められた。切除と病理組織学的検査により臀部奇形腫と確認された。成人の臀部奇形腫は極めてまれである。厚壁の嚢胞性腫瘤に充実性結節や脂肪を伴う場合は奇形腫を示唆すると述べ、適時の完全切除により予後は良好としている。
pmid-23256061.summary_en: A 30-year-old woman presented with two weeks of left hip swelling and pain. Ultrasonography showed a subcutaneous cystic mass with echogenic spots, and MRI revealed a heart-shaped left buttock mass containing 'pomegranate seed' inclusions that were hyperintense on diffusion-weighted imaging. Complete resection and histopathology confirmed a buttock teratoma containing sebum-like material and hair. The authors note that adult buttock teratomas are extremely rare, that thick-walled cystic masses with nodules or fat suggest teratoma on imaging, and that timely resection gives a good prognosis.

pmid-23269339.summary_ja: 35歳男性の後腹膜腫瘍症例。神経原性腫瘍が疑われ切除したところ、病理はセミノーマであった。超音波検査で精巣に病変が見つかり、両側精巣摘除術を施行したが、残存瘢痕と胚細胞腫瘍の微小病変のみで、burned-out現象と判断された。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を疑うと、精巣摘除術の後に全身化学療法を行う治療方針へ変わることを示した報告。
pmid-23269339.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with a retroperitoneal mass initially suspected to be a neurogenic tumor. Pathology of the resected mass showed seminoma, and subsequent scrotal ultrasonography revealed testicular microcalcifications and hypoechoic lesions. Bilateral orchiectomy found only residual scar and focal germ cell neoplasia, consistent with the burned-out phenomenon. The authors conclude that suspecting an extragonadal germ cell tumor with burned-out phenomenon changes management: orchiectomy first, then systemic chemotherapy, with surgery reserved for residual malignant tissue.

pmid-23293749.summary_ja: 進行卵巣胎児性癌の患者から採取した標本で、多能性幹細胞クローンを同定・解析した研究。TRA-1-60、SSEA-4、Oct4A、Nanogが発現し、胚性幹細胞や精巣胎児性癌と類似していた。胚様体を形成し三胚葉へ分化した。分子プロファイルは診断の精緻化や個別化治療に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-23293749.summary_en: This study identifies pluripotent stem cell clones within pure ovarian embryonal carcinomas from patients with advanced disease. Cells showed strong surface TRA-1-60 and SSEA-4 and high Oct4A and Nanog expression, similar to embryonic stem cells and testicular embryonal carcinoma. The ovarian embryonal carcinoma cells formed embryoid bodies capable of differentiating into all three germ layers and into muscle, epithelial, and neuronal cells. The authors suggest these molecular profiles could refine diagnosis and support biomarker-targeted, personalized therapy.

pmid-23293755.summary_ja: 膵臓と左腎の間に生じた後腹膜嚢胞性腫瘤で、神経節神経芽腫を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。遠位膵切除、脾摘、左副腎摘除を伴う一塊切除を施行。充実成分の神経節神経芽腫が皮様組織と密接に関連し、悪性転化を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。奇形腫内発生の神経節神経芽腫として初の報告。
pmid-23293755.summary_en: This case report describes ganglioneuroblastoma arising within a retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma in a patient with a cystic mass between the pancreas and left kidney. En-bloc resection with distal pancreatectomy, splenectomy, and left adrenalectomy was performed. Histology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma, with the solid component showing ganglioneuroblastoma intimately associated with dermoid tissue, classified as mature cystic teratoma with malignant transformation. The authors report it as the first such case described.

pmid-23295293.summary_ja: WT1遺伝子変異によりFrasier症候群と診断された4例の報告。2例で両側性の性腺腫瘍を発症し、1例は両側ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を伴った。46,XY症例では性腺腫瘍のリスクが高く、選択的な両側性性腺摘除が推奨される。ネフローゼ症候群や思春期遅延などの非典型的な表現型を示した。
pmid-23295293.summary_en: This report describes four patients with Frasier syndrome, identified by WT1 mutations, with gonadal dysgenesis and nephropathy. One patient had horseshoe kidney and bilateral dysgerminoma; two others developed bilateral gonadal tumors. Presentations included steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome, delayed puberty, and primary amenorrhea. The authors note that 46,XY patients have a higher risk of gonadoblastoma and recommend elective bilateral gonadectomy and molecular WT1 screening for diagnosis.

pmid-23296381.summary_ja: 低腫瘍量の病期II セミノーマ15例にPEB2サイクルを施行した後方視的単施設症例集積。発熱性好中球減少症はなく、リンパ節は有意に縮小した。中央値60か月の観察で再発やセミノーマによる死亡はなく、二次悪性腫瘍は1例のみであった。治療負担軽減の可能性があるが、前向き試験での検証が必要とされる。
pmid-23296381.summary_en: This retrospective single-center case series evaluated 15 patients with low-volume stage II seminoma treated with two cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin (PEB), either by patient preference or institutional practice. Chemotherapy was well tolerated, with no febrile neutropenia, and lymph node size fell significantly after treatment. With median follow-up of 60 months, no patients relapsed or died from seminoma, and one developed a second malignancy. The authors suggest this may reduce treatment burden but require prospective confirmation.

pmid-23300844.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞様細胞である胎児性癌細胞は、低用量の5-アザデオキシシチジンに高い感受性を示す。NT2/D1細胞では、DNA損傷とp53活性化が生じ、NANOGやSOX2などの多能性遺伝子が抑制され、RIN1やSOX15などの腫瘍抑制候補遺伝子が脱メチル化される。これらの作用は主にDNMT3Bの高発現に依存する。
pmid-23300844.summary_en: Human embryonal carcinoma cells, the stem cells of nonseminoma testicular germ cell tumors, are hypersensitive to low-dose 5-aza-deoxycytidine. Using NT2/D1 cells, the authors show that low-dose treatment causes DNA damage, activates p53, represses pluripotency genes such as NANOG and SOX2, and demethylates promoters of candidate tumor suppressors including RIN1 and SOX15. These effects largely depend on high DNMT3B levels. The findings suggest that low-dose 5-aza could be a therapeutic strategy for tumors sustained by embryonic stem-like cells.

pmid-23306744.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、新たに糖尿病と診断され、経過観察中に無症状の後腹膜腫瘤が見つかった30歳男性を記述している。CTでは、腸間膜静脈を圧排する低吸収で石灰化を伴う腫瘤が認められた。腫瘤の大きさと悪性の可能性から切除が行われた。膵臓の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫はきわめてまれであり、確定診断は術中に行われた。著者らは、膵臓への近接性を考慮すると膵頭十二指腸切除術(Whipple手術)が最も適切であり、術前に組織学的診断は確立されていなかったと結論づけている。
pmid-23306744.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with newly diagnosed diabetes and an asymptomatic retropancreatic mass found during follow-up. CT showed a hypodense, calcified mass displacing the mesenteric veins. Because of its size and the possibility of malignancy, the mass was resected. Mature cystic teratomas of the pancreas are extremely rare, and the definitive diagnosis was made intraoperatively. The authors conclude that a Whipple procedure is the most appropriate approach given the mass's proximity to the pancreas, although the histological diagnosis was not established preoperatively.

pmid-23316407.summary_ja: 皮膚硬化、多発筋痛、好酸球増多、結節性再生性過形成を呈した患者で、精巣セミノーマと関連する傍腫瘍性皮膚筋炎が明らかになった。精巣がんに関連する傍腫瘍性皮膚筋炎は極めてまれである。皮膚・全身症状が潜在性胚細胞腫瘍の初発症状となりうることを示す。
pmid-23316407.summary_en: This report describes a patient whose skin tightening, polymyalgia, hypereosinophilia, and nodular regenerative hyperplasia revealed a testicular seminoma with associated paraneoplastic dermatomyositis. Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis linked to testicular cancer is extremely rare. The case highlights that cutaneous and systemic findings can be the first presentation of an occult germ cell tumor. Recognizing this association may prompt earlier testicular evaluation in patients with unexplained inflammatory myopathy-like symptoms.

pmid-23320213.summary_ja: 52歳の閉経前女性が7cmの右付属器腫瘤と不正出血で受診した。全摘術と両側付属器摘出術を含む手術が行われた。病理組織学的に卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌と診断された。病期にかかわらず化学療法が必要とされ、カルボプラチンとパクリタキセルの追加投与が計画された。
pmid-23320213.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old premenopausal woman with vaginal bleeding and a 7 cm right adnexal mass. She underwent total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy, pelvic lymphadenectomy, and debulking. Histopathology revealed squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma is rare, and its prognosis depends on surgical stage. The authors note that chemotherapy should be given regardless of stage and planned second-cycle carboplatin and paclitaxel.

pmid-23320215.summary_ja: 出生前超音波で頸部奇形腫と診断された胎児の症例報告です。腫瘍が気道を圧迫したため、胎盤循環を保ったまま子宮外での生存性を確保するEXITを実施し、気道を確保しました。胎児頸部の超音波評価は気道と消化管の把握に重要であり、早期診断が計画的な分娩と外科治療につながると述べています。
pmid-23320215.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus diagnosed with a cervical teratoma by prenatal ultrasound. The tumor compressed the airway, so the team performed ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) to secure airway control while maintaining placental support and extrauterine viability. The authors emphasize that fetal neck ultrasonography is essential for assessing the airway and digestive tract, and that early recognition of such masses allows planned delivery and surgical management.

pmid-23324369.summary_ja: 急性虫垂炎の疑いで手術された22歳男性で、腹腔内に転位した精巣捻転が判明しました。精巣と虫垂の両方が切除され、病理検査で精巣のセミノーマと正常虫垂が確認されました。まれな病態の診断と治療の原則を概説し、急性虫垂炎の鑑別診断として腫瘍性精巣捻転を考慮すべきと述べています。
pmid-23324369.summary_en: A 22-year-old man was operated on for suspected acute appendicitis, but surgery revealed intra-abdominal torsion of a testis. Both the testis and the appendix were removed. Histopathology showed seminoma of the testis with a normal appendix. The report reviews this rare condition and the principles of its diagnosis and treatment, and emphasizes that neoplastic testicular torsion should be considered in the differential diagnosis of acute appendicitis.

pmid-23326728.summary_ja: 左卵巣奇形腫がS状結腸へ自然破裂した症例報告です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は卵巣腫瘍の10〜20%を占め若年者に最も多い腫瘍ですが、自然破裂はまれです。腸管への進展を伴う卵巣奇形腫の非典型的な臨床像とその管理上の意義を示しています。
pmid-23326728.summary_en: This case report describes a left ovarian teratoma that spontaneously ruptured into the sigmoid colon. Mature cystic teratomas account for 10-20% of ovarian neoplasms and are the most common tumor in younger patients, but spontaneous rupture is rare. The report highlights this unusual presentation and its clinical significance for the management of ovarian teratomas with intestinal involvement.

pmid-23327057.summary_ja: 28例の卵巣類皮様嚢胞（表皮嚢腫）を15年間にわたり後方視的に検討し、類皮嚢腫（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）との鑑別点を示した論文です。表皮嚢腫は類皮嚢腫より小型で高齢女性に多く見られました。奇形腫の最大17%に表皮成分が含まれることがあります。多くは保存的手術で治療され、フォローアップ期間中の再発はありませんでした。
pmid-23327057.summary_en: This 15-year retrospective study of 28 histologically confirmed epidermoid ovarian cysts examines how to distinguish them from dermoid cysts, which are mature cystic teratomas. Epidermoid cysts were smaller and occurred in older women than dermoid cysts. Up to 17% of teratomas may contain epidermoid components. Most patients were managed conservatively, with no recurrence during follow-up, and the authors propose a new pathologic classification.

pmid-23327068.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化を術前に予測できるかを検討した論文です。悪性2例と良性76例を比較したところ、悪性例は大きく（平均130mm）、血清SCCが高値で、MRIで充実性かつ造影される成分を認めました。100mm超の腫瘍、充実性の造影病変、血清SCCとCA19-9の測定を推奨しています。
pmid-23327068.summary_en: This study examines whether malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma can be predicted before surgery. It compares two malignant cases with 76 benign cases. Malignant tumors were larger, with mean diameters of 130 mm versus 73.6 mm, and had higher serum SCC levels, solid masses, and contrast enhancement on pelvic MRI. The authors recommend checking tumors larger than 100 mm, solid enhancing masses on MRI, and serum SCC and CA19-9 levels.

pmid-23327071.summary_ja: Carney複合を有する17歳女性の卵巣成熟奇形腫の症例報告です。経腟超音波とMRIで付属器腫瘤と腹水が確認され、悪性変化が疑われました。FIGO分類に沿って子宮付属器摘出と病期分類のための開腹術を実施しました。術後は腹水や痛みが消失し、CA-125も基準値内に戻りました。
pmid-23327071.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old with Carney complex and a teratoma maturum ovarii. The adnexal mass with ascites, detected by transvaginal ultrasound and MRI, suggested malignant change. The patient underwent surgery with staging laparotomy under FIGO guidelines. Postoperatively the patient recovered well, ascites and pain resolved, and CA-125 levels returned to the reference range.

pmid-23328171.summary_ja: 2009年版精巣がん診療ガイドラインの32のCQを検証したシンポジウム報告。病期I、進行がん、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の3領域について、補助化学療法、救援化学療法、残存腫瘍に対する低侵襲手術などの治療戦略を臨床例とともに検討している。
pmid-23328171.summary_en: This Japanese symposium report validates the 2009 Japanese Testicular Cancer Clinical Practice Guidelines through 32 clinical questions. It covers three areas. For stage I disease, single-agent carboplatin adjuvant therapy is discussed for seminoma, and vascular invasion guides risk-based choices for nonseminoma. For advanced disease, high-dose chemotherapy, salvage chemotherapy for residual tumors, and minimally invasive surgery for residual masses are reviewed. Extragonadal germ cell tumors, which can be cured with multimodal therapy, are also covered, including endoscopic ultrasound-guided biopsy.

pmid-23328172.summary_ja: 病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍の補助療法を総説した。精巣摘除術のみで多くは治癒するが一部は再発する。セミノーマでは放射線療法やカルボプラチン、非セミノーマでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清や化学療法が選択肢となり、最新文献に基づいて再発抑制と有害事象の軽減を目指した管理のコンセンサスを更新している。
pmid-23328172.summary_en: This review addresses adjuvant management of stage I testicular germ cell tumors. Most are cured by orchiectomy alone, but some recur. Strategies differ for seminoma and nonseminoma. Seminoma options include radiotherapy or one to two courses of carboplatin. Nonseminoma options include retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or one to two courses of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy. The authors review recent literature on these adjuvant approaches, aiming to reduce recurrence while limiting adverse events, and they update the consensus for management.

pmid-23328176.summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍の化学療法後の残存腫瘍の管理を論じた総説。純粋セミノーマでは残存腫瘍は経過観察され、非セミノーマでは多くの症例で切除が行われる。日本泌尿器科学会のガイドラインに基づき、後腹膜残存腫瘍切除の適応と手術手技を検討している。
pmid-23328176.summary_en: This Japanese review discusses management of residual tumors after chemotherapy in metastatic testicular tumors. Treatment follows International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group risk stratification and cisplatin-based chemotherapy. For pure seminoma, residual masses are usually observed without resection, whereas residual masses in nonseminomatous tumors are usually resected. The paper reviews Japanese Urological Association guidelines and discusses the indications and surgical techniques for retroperitoneal residual tumor resection after chemotherapy.

pmid-23330025.summary_ja: 50歳男性の両側同時性精母細胞性セミノーマの症例報告。精母細胞性セミノーマは精巣に限局し予後良好な稀な胚細胞腫瘍である。左右の精巣摘除術を行い、病理組織学的および免疫組織化学的に診断された。文献上の報告は5例のみで、日本を除くアジアでは初の症例とされる。
pmid-23330025.summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old man with bilateral synchronous spermatocytic seminoma, a rare germ cell tumor confined to the testis with a good prognosis. Left radical orchiectomy was performed first. After intraoperative frozen section confirmed a neoplastic process, right radical orchiectomy was performed. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed the diagnosis in both testes. Only five prior cases of bilateral synchronous spermatocytic seminoma have been reported in the literature, and this is described as the first such case from Asia outside Japan.

pmid-23341810.summary_ja: 35歳男性の大網原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。当初は免疫組織化学から原発不明がんと考えられたが、血清α-フェトプロテインの著明な上昇と生検標本の再評価により卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。免疫組織化学は診断に有用だが、臨床所見と形態学的所見を併せて解釈すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-23341810.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with a primary yolk sac tumor of the omentum, reported as the first such adult male case. Initially considered a carcinoma of unknown primary with colorectal features based on immunohistochemistry, the tumor was reclassified after serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated to 7,144 ng/ml. Re-review of the biopsy showed microcystic or reticular patterns and Schiller-Duval bodies. The authors emphasize that immunohistochemistry is valuable for subtyping but must be interpreted alongside clinical and morphologic findings.

pmid-23385676.summary_ja: ナイジェリアの病院で43例の妊娠性絨毛癌を後方視的に病理組織学的に検討した研究。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の37.7%を占め、膣出血で発症することが多かった。出血、壊死、多形性などが主な特徴で、健康教育と早期発見の重要性を強調している。
pmid-23385676.summary_en: This Nigerian histopathological review analyzed 43 cases of gestational choriocarcinoma, a malignant form of gestational trophoblastic disease, from a teaching hospital in Zaria. Gestational choriocarcinoma accounted for 4.9% of products of conception and 37.7% of gestational trophoblastic disease. Most patients were in their third and fourth decades, with vaginal bleeding as the leading presentation. Hemorrhage, necrosis, diamorphic appearance, and pleomorphism were the most common features. The authors stress health education and early detection.

pmid-23417418.summary_ja: 腹膜神経膠腫症（GP）は、腹膜や腹部リンパ節に成熟したアストログリア結節が広がる良性の病態で、多くは卵巣奇形腫に伴います。本総説は、奇形腫からの未熟神経細胞の播種と、腹膜幹細胞からの化生という二つの発生機序を、病理所見やヘテロ接合性解析をもとに検討しています。大部分の症例では播種説がより妥当とされています。
pmid-23417418.summary_en: This review examines gliomatosis peritonei (GP), a benign condition of widespread mature astroglial nodules in the peritoneum and abdominal lymph nodes, most often associated with ovarian teratoma. It discusses two proposed mechanisms: direct seeding of immature neural cells from the primary teratoma followed by differentiation, and metaplasia from peritoneal stem cells. Clinicopathologic features, SOX2 expression, and heterozygosity analysis are used to support each mechanism, with the implantation theory considered more probable in most cases.

pmid-23423470.summary_ja: 停留精巣の既往と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連について、35件の疫学論文と未発表データを統合したメタ解析です。既往のある群ではリスクが約4倍（RR 4.1）でした。両側性、同側の片側性、治療の遅れ、セミノーマ組織型で関連が強く、精巣固定術後もリスクが残ることから、患者と家族への説明の重要性が示されています。
pmid-23423470.summary_en: This comprehensive meta-analysis of 35 epidemiologic articles and one unpublished dataset quantifies the association between cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumors. A history of cryptorchidism was associated with a fourfold increased risk (RR 4.1). Subgroup analyses identified stronger associations with bilateral cryptorchidism, ipsilateral unilateral cryptorchidism, delayed orchidopexy, diagnosis before 1970, and seminoma histology. The authors recommend that patients and caregivers be informed of persistent risk after orchidopexy regardless of repair age or laterality.

pmid-23424965.summary_ja: 卵巣非妊娠性絨毛癌に対する左付属器摘出の3か月後に、後腹膜で未分化癌と絨毛癌転移を生じた20歳の症例報告です。血清hCGは38 mIU/Lでした。メトトレキサート系化学療法と腫瘍切除を行いましたが、S状結腸破裂を伴いました。患者は化学療法を拒否し、術後1か月で死亡しています。非妊娠性転移性絨毛癌の予後不良性が示されています。
pmid-23424965.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old patient who developed a retroperitoneal tumor with anaplastic carcinoma and choriocarcinoma metastases three months after left adnexectomy for an ovarian non-gestational choriocarcinoma. Serum hCG was 38 mIU/L. The patient received methotrexate-based chemotherapy and underwent tumor excision complicated by sigmoid colon rupture. Histology of the resected mass showed anaplastic carcinoma without choriocarcinoma. The patient declined further chemotherapy and died one month after surgery, illustrating the poor prognosis of rapidly spreading non-gestational metastatic choriocarcinoma.

pmid-23427758.summary_ja: 左精巣捻転が疑われた38歳の症例で、徒手整復後約1か月して精巣固定術を希望されました。術中生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、根治的精巣摘除術と化学療法4コースを行いました。12か月のフォローアップで再発は認められていません。陰嚢内精巣の捻転を伴う癌は文献上8例目とされています。
pmid-23427758.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old patient with suspected left testicular torsion, which was manually derotated with immediate pain relief. About a month later the patient requested orchidopexy, and intraoperative biopsy revealed a yolk sac tumor. A radical inguinal orchiectomy with hemiscrotal excision was performed, followed by four cycles of chemotherapy. No recurrence was seen at 12 months of follow-up. The authors note that only seven prior cases of intrascrotal testicular torsion with cancer have been reported, making this the eighth.

pmid-23449985.summary_ja: 急速に増大した若年男性の精母細胞性セミノーマの症例です。病理組織学的検査では、精巣網と精巣上体に浸潤する横紋筋肉腫様成分が認められました。肉腫様分化を伴うと攻撃的な挙動と転移能を示すため、この成分の正確な同定が治療方針の決定に重要であると強調しています。文献レビューも併記されています。
pmid-23449985.summary_en: This case report describes a young male patient with spermatocytic seminoma whose tumor enlarged rapidly. Histopathology revealed a rhabdomyosarcomatous component infiltrating the rete testis and epididymis alongside a well-circumscribed spermatocytic seminoma. The authors emphasize that sarcomatous differentiation in spermatocytic seminoma confers aggressive behavior and metastatic potential, so identifying this component is essential because management differs. The report includes a review of the literature on this rare variant.

pmid-23455797.summary_ja: 14歳男性の右半胸部腫瘤。初回の病理組織学的所見は血管性腫瘍を示唆したが、腋窩転移の細胞診と免疫組織化学から混合型胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。縦隔腫瘤の再切片作製では奇形腫成分を主体とする限局性の生存腫瘍を認めた。他院での化学療法歴があり、血管増殖は化学療法後変化、または抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍成分である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-23455797.summary_en: A 14-year-old boy presented with a right hemithoracic mass that initially looked like a vascular neoplasm on histopathology. Cytology and immunohistochemistry of an axillary metastasis indicated metastatic mixed germ cell tumor. Extensive re-sectioning of the mediastinal mass revealed focal viable tumor, mainly teratomatous. History disclosed prior chemotherapy at another hospital. The florid vascular proliferation was likely a postchemotherapy change or a chemoresistant germ cell tumor component.

pmid-23478733.summary_ja: 原発性無月経と高ゴナドトロピン血症を示す46,XYの20歳女性。骨盤内の巨大腫瘤を切除し、ディスジャーミノーマと右性腺の性腺芽腫を認めた。Swyer症候群と診断し、Y染色体物質を有する異形成性性腺における性腺芽腫のリスクについて文献的に考察している。
pmid-23478733.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman with primary amenorrhea, abdominal distension, and elevated gonadotropins was found to have a 46,XY karyotype. Pelvic CT showed a large mass without visible gonads. Resection with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy revealed a dysgerminoma, and the right gonad harbored a gonadoblastoma. The authors diagnosed Swyer syndrome and reviewed the literature on gonadoblastoma risk in dysgenetic gonads, particularly when Y-chromosome material is present.

pmid-23525369.summary_ja: 57歳女性の胃腺癌と絨毛癌の合併例。β-hCG陽性およびcErbB2過剰発現を認め、肝多発転移を伴っていた。トラスツズマブと化学療法により完全奏効を得た。稀な疾患のため病理組織学的検査が診断に必須であり、cErbB2過剰発現例ではトラスツズマブが有効となり得ると報告している。
pmid-23525369.summary_en: A 57-year-old woman with weight loss and abdominal pain had gastric adenocarcinoma coexisting with choriocarcinoma, confirmed histopathologically. Immunohistochemistry was positive for beta-hCG and showed cErbB2 overexpression. Staging revealed multiple liver metastases. Treatment with trastuzumab combined with chemotherapy achieved a complete response. The authors emphasize that diagnosis requires pathological examination and that trastuzumab may be effective when cErbB2 protein is overexpressed.

pmid-23540174.summary_ja: 甲状腺組織とカルチノイド組織が混在する稀な卵巣奇形腫の一型、ストルマ型カルチノイドの2例を報告。卵巣奇形腫の約5%を占め、多くは成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生する。閉経前後の女性に多く、腫瘤触知または偶発的に発見される。カルチノイド型の4亜型と臨床的特徴を概説している。
pmid-23540174.summary_en: Two patients with primary ovarian strumal carcinoid, a rare carcinoid-type ovarian teratoma composed of thyroid and carcinoid tissue, are described. Such tumors account for about 5% of ovarian teratomas and often arise within mature cystic teratomas. Most patients are peri- or postmenopausal, presenting with an enlarging mass or incidentally. The article reviews the four carcinoid-type variants, insular, trabecular, strumal, and mucinous, noting carcinoid syndrome in a third of insular cases.

pmid-23654019.summary_ja: 24歳男性の血精液症。同側の精巣腫瘍、骨盤内異所性精巣、精嚢血腫を同時に認めた。精巣腫瘍切除と右精嚢摘出術を施行し、精巣セミノーマと診断された。標準プロトコルに従い腹部への放射線療法を施行し、術後10年で疾患の再発は認められていない。
pmid-23654019.summary_en: A 24-year-old man presented with hemospermia and was found to have a simultaneous ipsilateral testicular tumor, pelvic ectopic testis, and hematovesicula seminalis. He underwent removal of the testicular tumor and right vesiculectomy. Histopathology confirmed testicular seminoma, with a dilated seminal vesicle containing hemorrhagic fluid and chronic inflammation. Abdominal radiotherapy followed per standard protocol, and there was no disease recurrence at 10 years.

pmid-23730078.summary_ja: 本報告は、頭頸部の稀な部位に生じ奇形腫の6%未満を占める先天性顔面奇形腫の新生児例を記述している。腫瘍は外科的に管理され、術後2年のフォローアップで患者に再発は認められなかった。性腺外部位に生じた奇形腫の単一症例報告であり、胚細胞腫瘍の範囲に含まれる。
pmid-23730078.summary_en: This report describes a newborn with a congenital facial teratoma, a rare head and neck location that accounts for under 6% of teratomas. The tumour was managed surgically, and the patient showed no recurrence at two years of postoperative follow-up. It is a single case report of a teratoma arising in an extragonadal site, so it falls within the scope of germ cell tumors.

pmid-23770875.summary_ja: 妊娠24週で診断された大型の口腔・咽頭奇形腫に対し、マレーシアで初めて行われたEXIT手技の報告。妊娠33週で娩出後に気道を確保し、口蓋腫瘤の口外部分を切除した。生後22日目に口腔内奇形腫を完全切除した。出生前超音波検査と多職種連携の重要性を示している。
pmid-23770875.summary_en: The authors describe the first ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure performed in Malaysia for a large oropharyngeal teratoma diagnosed antenatally at 24 weeks. The fetus was delivered at 33 weeks and intubated, securing the airway before the extraoral part of the palatal mass was resected. Complete resection of the intraoral teratoma was achieved on day 22 of life. The report highlights the value of antenatal ultrasonography and multidisciplinary planning for airway-threatening teratomas.

pmid-23788863.summary_ja: 1979〜2004年に精巣摘除後の病期Iセミノーマ292例を対象とし、補助化学療法、放射線療法、サーベイランスを比較した。全生存期間(全生存率)は5年で100%であった。サーベイランス群の再発率が高く、補助治療の必要性が示唆された。再発例はすべて化学療法で救済された。
pmid-23788863.summary_en: This review of 292 men with stage I seminoma treated after orchidectomy between 1979 and 2004 compared adjuvant chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and surveillance. Five-year overall survival was 100%, and relapse-free survival was 95.1% overall. Five-year relapse-free survival was 97.2% with chemotherapy, 94.6% with radiotherapy, and 31.4% under surveillance. All relapses were salvaged with chemotherapy, supporting adjuvant treatment.

pmid-23833507.summary_ja: 10歳男児の右上顎に生じた大型の先天性奇形腫の症例報告。全身麻酔下で切除された。病理組織学的に胚の三胚葉すべての成分を示し、主に線維組織から成っていた。術後2年間再発は認められなかった。
pmid-23833507.summary_en: This report describes a 10-year-old boy with a large congenital teratoma of the right maxilla, a rare site. The mass was excised under general anaesthesia. Histopathology showed all three embryonic germ layers, mainly fibrous tissue. Although malignancy has been described in adults, this tumour was benign. No recurrence was seen after two years, and the postoperative course was uneventful.

pmid-23855083.summary_ja: パキスタンの施設で2009年に診断された妊娠性絨毛性疾患39例を後方視的に検討した。胞状奇胎が84.6%、絨毛癌が12.8%を占めた。低経産で社会経済的に低い階層の女性に多く、受診時には進行していることが多かった。吸引掻爬術が主な治療で、化学療法を受けた患者もいた。
pmid-23855083.summary_en: This retrospective descriptive study from a Pakistani institute reviewed 39 gestational trophoblastic disease cases in 2009, about 29% of female genital tract neoplasms seen. Hydatidiform mole comprised 84.6% and choriocarcinoma 12.8%. Most patients were low-parous women of lower socioeconomic status who often presented late. Most underwent suction evacuation, and some received chemotherapy.

pmid-23961001.summary_ja: 26歳男性が非裂孔原性網膜剥離で受診し、無症候性の左精巣絨毛癌が判明した。化学療法で完全寛解を得たが視力は回復しなかった。眼転移は視力喪失のリスクが高く、早期発見と治療が重要である。若年男性の眼転移では精巣原発を考慮すべきである。
pmid-23961001.summary_en: A 26-year-old man presented with a non-rhegmatogenous retinal detachment and was found to have an occult left testicular choriocarcinoma. Chemotherapy achieved complete remission, but vision did not recover. The report underlines that intraocular metastasis carries substantial risk of visual loss and that early detection improves tumour control and visual outcome. Clinicians should consider a testicular primary in young men with ocular metastasis.

pmid-24371634.summary_ja: 33歳女性が正常分娩後に絨毛癌と診断され、その新生児も同じ疾患と診断された症例報告です。腫瘍が胎盤を介して母体から乳児へ播種(経胎盤播種)したと考えられ、母児ともに進行した病変を認めました。母体が絨毛癌の場合は新生児の評価が重要であることを示唆する、まれな経過の貴重な報告です。
pmid-24371634.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman diagnosed with choriocarcinoma after a normal delivery, and her newborn son, who was diagnosed with the same disease. The authors describe transplacental dissemination of the tumor from mother to infant, with advanced disease present in both. The report highlights the rare possibility of congenital transmission of choriocarcinoma and the need for close evaluation of neonates born to mothers with this malignancy.

pmid-24592044.summary_ja: 妊娠後に外陰・膣の腫脹のみを呈した転移性絨毛癌の2症例の報告です。いずれもバルトリン腺嚢胞や外陰血腫として誤診され、治療が遅れました。血清β-hCGに基づき診断され、併用化学療法で一時的な反応を示したものの、1例は治療の遵守が困難で死亡しました。妊娠後の外陰膣腫脹では本疾患も考慮すべきと述べています。
pmid-24592044.summary_en: This report describes two women with metastatic choriocarcinoma that presented only as vulvovaginal swelling after pregnancy. Both were initially misdiagnosed as a Bartholin cyst or vulvar hematoma, delaying treatment. Unresponsiveness to standard therapy prompted evaluation, and the diagnosis was confirmed using serum beta-hCG levels. Combination chemotherapy produced initial responses in both, but one patient died due to poor treatment compliance. The authors emphasize considering metastatic choriocarcinoma in any recent vulvovaginal swelling following pregnancy.

pmid-24669660.summary_ja: 慢性精巣痛に対して副睾丸部分摘出術を受けた症例の報告です。切除標本で副睾丸病変として現れた精巣がんが判明しました。若年男性では精巣悪性腫瘍が良性の副睾丸疾患に似ることがあり、良性疾患を想定した手術後に診断される場合があると示しています。持続する陰嚢症状の慎重な評価が重要です。
pmid-24669660.summary_en: This report describes a young man with chronic testicular pain who underwent partial epididymectomy. Examination of the removed tissue revealed testicular cancer presenting as an epididymal lesion, an unusual manifestation. The case highlights that testicular malignancy can mimic benign epididymal disease in young males and may be identified only after surgery performed for presumed benign causes. Careful evaluation of persistent scrotal symptoms is therefore important.

pmid-24765472.summary_ja: 成人男性で自然発症の血腹症を呈し、肝腫瘍破裂に対して緊急手術を受けた原発性肝絨毛癌の症例報告です。手術標本と剖検で確定し、患者は術後10日目に死亡しました。成人の報告例はまれで、インド亜大陸からの初報告とされています。自然発症血腹症の鑑別診断に本疾患を含めるべきと述べています。
pmid-24765472.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old man who presented with haemoperitoneum from a ruptured hepatic tumor and underwent emergency left lateral segmentectomy. He died on postoperative day 10. Surgical and autopsy findings confirmed primary hepatic choriocarcinoma, an extremely rare entity with only seven previously reported adult cases. The authors describe this as the first such case from the Indian subcontinent and review the relevant literature. Primary hepatic choriocarcinoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of spontaneous haemoperitoneum.

pmid-24960782.summary_ja: 56歳女性の舌の腫脹が奇形腫と診断された症例報告です。口腔内の奇形腫は極めてまれで、通常は口腔底の正中部に発生し、舌自体に生じることは少ないとされます。性腺外のまれな部位の症例として臨床像を報告しており、口腔内奇形腫に関する限られた文献に寄与します。
pmid-24960782.summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old woman with a swelling of the tongue diagnosed as teratoma. Oral cavity teratomas are extremely rare and usually arise in the midline floor of the mouth, while involvement of the tongue proper is infrequent. The authors present this unusual extragonadal location to document its clinical presentation. The report contributes to the limited literature on teratomas occurring in the oral cavity.

pmid-25134187.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫がhCGを産生し、子宮外妊娠と疑われた症例報告です。卵巣奇形腫の摘出後、4週間以内に血清hCGは陰性化しました。良性卵巣奇形腫がhCGを分泌することはまれですが、高hCG血症の鑑別診断に含めるべきと述べています。緊急手術に至る可能性がある点にも注意が必要です。
pmid-25134187.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman with amenorrhea and markedly elevated serum hCG three years after tubal ligation. Ultrasound did not show an intrauterine pregnancy, and laparoscopy revealed an 11-cm benign mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary, with no ectopic pregnancy seen. After surgical removal, serum hCG normalized within four weeks. The authors conclude that benign mature ovarian teratomas, though rarely, can secrete hCG and should be included in the differential diagnosis of suspected ectopic pregnancy.

pmid-25389742.summary_ja: 両肺に転移した絨毛癌の既往がある43歳男性で、片眼に出血性網膜剥離を生じた症例報告です。MRIで脈絡膜転移と視神経・視神経鞘の炎症像を認め、後頭葉と前頭葉にも出血性転移がありました。脈絡膜転移に視神経病変を合併した初の症例とされ、広範な中枢神経系病変の精査を推奨しています。
pmid-25389742.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old man with choriocarcinoma metastatic to both lungs who developed a hemorrhagic retinal detachment in one eye. Magnetic resonance imaging showed a choroidal metastasis with concurrent optic nerve and sheath inflammation, and additional hemorrhagic metastases were found in the occipital and frontal lobes. The authors describe the first reported case of choroidal metastasis with concurrent optic nerve involvement and recommend investigating widespread central nervous system involvement in such cases.

pmid-25390951.summary_ja: 病期I期のセミノーマを有する43歳男性で、かすみ目から癌関連網膜症と診断された症例報告です。血清中に網膜特異的な41kDa抗体が検出されました。原発巣の早期切除、ステロイド、免疫グロブリン静注により視機能は安定しました。セミノーマによる癌関連網膜症の初報告で、早期の腫瘍切除が進行抑制に寄与する可能性を示しています。
pmid-25390951.summary_en: This report describes a 43-year-old man with stage 1 seminoma who presented with blurred vision and was diagnosed with cancer-associated retinopathy. Fundus examination and electroretinograms showed retinal abnormalities, and serum analysis revealed a 41-kDa anti-retinal antibody. Visual function remained stable after removal of the primary tumor, steroid treatment, and intravenous immunoglobulin. The authors describe this as the first reported case of cancer-associated retinopathy caused by seminoma, suggesting early tumor removal may limit progression.

pmid-26023387.summary_ja: 生後3日の男児が腹部膨満と上腹部腫瘤による呼吸困難で受診した。開腹術で大弯側の胃後下壁から生じた多嚢胞性腫瘤を切除し、胃を修復した。病理組織学的検査で成熟胃奇形腫と確定した。胃奇形腫は極めて稀な腫瘍であり、新生児では特に稀である。完全切除により治療が完結した。
pmid-26023387.summary_en: A 3-day-old male neonate presented with abdominal distension and a large upper-abdominal mass causing respiratory difficulty. Exploratory laparotomy revealed a multicystic mass arising from the posterior-inferior gastric wall along the greater curvature, which was excised with gastric repair. Histopathology confirmed a mature gastric teratoma, a rare neoplasm. The report highlights that gastric teratomas are extremely uncommon, particularly in neonates, and that complete surgical excision provides definitive management.

pmid-26023400.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された2週齢新生児の左後腹膜の胎児内胎児(FIF)の症例で、同側の精巣萎縮を伴っていた。FIFと後腹膜奇形腫の鑑別点を比較し、FIFの発生起源に関する諸説を整理した。萎縮精巣とFIFの因果関係についても考察している。後腹膜におけるFIFと奇形腫の診断上の重なりを示す症例である。
pmid-26023400.summary_en: A neonate with a prenatally diagnosed fetus-in-fetu (FIF) in the left retroperitoneum at 2 weeks of age, associated with ipsilateral testicular atrophy. The authors compare features that differentiate FIF from retroperitoneal teratoma and review theories of FIF origin. They also discuss whether the atrophic testis is causally related to the FIF. The case highlights the diagnostic overlap between FIF and retroperitoneal teratoma.

pmid-26388921.summary_ja: 妊娠10週で卵巣嚢胞摘出術を受けた35歳女性で、奇形腫に発生した濾胞癌(卵巣甲状腺腫)と診断された。甲状腺全摘と放射性ヨウ素療法後、10か月後にサイログロブリンが上昇し、肝転移と腹膜播種が判明した。減量手術と追加の放射性ヨウ素療法で治療され、値は正常化した。血清サイログロブリンの綿密なフォローアップが重要である。
pmid-26388921.summary_en: A 35-year-old pregnant woman underwent right ovarian cystectomy at 10 weeks' gestation. Histopathology showed follicular carcinoma arising in a teratoma (struma ovarii). After total thyroidectomy and radioiodine therapy, serum thyroglobulin rose markedly ten months later. Imaging revealed liver metastases and peritoneal seeding, which were treated with debulking surgery and adjuvant radioiodine therapy, and thyroglobulin normalized. The report emphasizes close follow-up of serum thyroglobulin in such patients.

pmid-27582872.summary_ja: 妊娠23週の初産婦に縦隔ディスジャーミノーマが見つかり、BEP療法を施行した。好中球減少と胎児発育不全のため31週で分娩となった。化学療法後に腫瘍は縮小したが、産後の放射線療法後に病勢が悪化した。縦隔と卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍は異なるため、卵巣例の成績は外挿できないと指摘している。
pmid-27582872.summary_en: A 26-year-old primigravida at 23 weeks' gestation presented with a substernal mass, diagnosed by fine-needle aspiration as mediastinal dysgerminoma. She received weekly bleomycin and three-weekly cisplatin and etoposide (BEP). Neutropenia required colony-stimulating factor, and fetal growth restriction prompted delivery at 31 weeks. The tumor regressed after chemotherapy, but disease worsened after postnatal radiotherapy. The authors note that mediastinal and ovarian germ cell tumors differ, so ovarian outcome data cannot be extrapolated, and BEP safety for the fetus is unestablished.

pmid-28191138.summary_ja: ネパール農村部で発見された、8cmを超える症状を伴う片側性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の2症例の報告です。超音波所見(類皮プラグ、類皮メッシュ、脂肪-液体レベル、「氷山の一角」徴候)から卵巣類皮嚢腫を診断し、手術で毛髪、歯、脂肪、皮膚組織が確認されました。資源の限られた環境でも超音波検査が確定診断に有用であることを示しています。
pmid-28191138.summary_en: This case report describes two perimenopausal women in rural Nepal with symptomatic unilateral cystic ovarian teratomas larger than 8 cm. The authors review the typical sonographic features of ovarian dermoid cysts, including the dermoid plug, dermoid mesh, fat-fluid level, and 'tip of the iceberg' sign. Intratumoral hair, teeth, fat, and skin found at surgery confirmed the ultrasound-based diagnosis. The report highlights how ultrasonography can support a confident diagnosis even in resource-limited settings.

pmid-28352404.summary_ja: 成人に発生する成熟型心臓奇形腫について述べた論文です。症状は腫瘍の部位に依存し、多くは心膜内に生じます。心筋内病変はさらに稀です。診断と治療は画像検査と外科的切除後の病理診断に基づき、完全切除された症例の予後は良好であるため、合併症予防のために完全切除が推奨されています。
pmid-28352404.summary_en: This paper discusses mature cardiac teratoma in an adult, an uncommon finding in which symptoms depend on tumor location, most often intrapericardial. The authors note that intramyocardial lesions are rarer still. Diagnosis and management rely on imaging and pathological examination after surgical excision. Prognosis after complete surgical excision is generally very good, and complete excision is preferred to prevent complications.

pmid-28509065.summary_ja: 腎移植後28か月で新たに発生し、当初は移植後リンパ増殖性疾患(PTLD)と診断された縦隔セミノーマの症例報告です。臓器移植後の胚細胞腫瘍の報告は少なく、移植後の縦隔セミノーマの報告は初めてとされています。免疫抑制療法中の移植患者に生じた縦隔腫瘍では、PTLD以外の疾患も鑑別診断に含めるべきだと指摘しています。
pmid-28509065.summary_en: This case report describes a mediastinal seminoma that developed de novo 28 months after renal transplantation and was initially diagnosed as post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder (PTLD). The authors note that germ cell tumors after organ transplantation are rarely reported, and that mediastinal seminoma had not been described in this setting before. They emphasize considering non-PTLD diagnoses in the differential diagnosis of mediastinal tumors arising in transplant recipients on immunosuppression.

pmid-29147295.summary_ja: 消化管出血と閉塞で受診し、後腹膜を起源とする消化管の胚細胞腫瘍の2症例の報告です。いずれも若年患者で、予後は良好でした。正中部の構造物に生じやすい性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の文献を概観し、消化管胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀で、病因や臨床経過は十分に解明されていないと指摘しています。
pmid-29147295.summary_en: This report describes two young patients with germ cell tumors in the gastrointestinal tract, both presenting with gastrointestinal bleeding and obstruction and traced to a retroperitoneal origin. Both had good outcomes. The authors review the literature on extragonadal GCTs, which typically arise along midline structures such as the retroperitoneum and mediastinum, and note that gastrointestinal GCTs are very uncommon, with poorly understood etiology and clinical course.

pmid-29539371.summary_ja: カタルーニャの後期ローマ時代の考古学遺跡で発見された、30〜40歳女性の遺骨から回収された骨盤内石灰化の古病理学的報告です。考古学的文脈では骨盤石灰化の鑑別診断が困難ですが、位置、肉眼所見、歯と小骨片の存在から卵巣奇形腫と同定されました。同定は肉眼観察とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)に基づいています。
pmid-29539371.summary_en: This paleopathology paper reports an unusual pelvic calcification recovered from the skeletal remains of a 30-40-year-old woman at a late Roman archaeological site in Catalonia. Differential diagnoses for pelvic calcifications are difficult in archaeological contexts, but the precise location, gross features, and presence of teeth and a small bone led the authors to identify the finding as an ovarian teratoma. The identification was based on gross observation and computed tomography (CT).

pmid-21316891.summary_ja: 超音波で腫瘍が疑われた胎児18例の出生前MRIを後方視的に評価した研究。奇形腫(頭頸部、心臓、仙尾部)を含む多様な腫瘍が対象で、全体の72%に腫瘍関連の合併症がみられた。超音波で得られない情報をMRIが加え、診断の多くは病理と一致した。周産期管理に重要な情報を与えうる。
pmid-21316891.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated prenatal MRI in 18 fetuses with tumors suspected on ultrasound. Of the tumors, 13 were benign and 5 malignant, including head-neck, cardiac and sacrococcygeal teratomas, rhabdomyomas, neuroblastomas and a hepatoblastoma. MRI added diagnostic information beyond ultrasound in half the cases, and matched histology in most cases where it was available. Tumor-related complications were present in 72% of fetuses, and MRI may provide important information for perinatal management.

pmid-21603898.summary_ja: 生後3か月半の男児の右後腹膜腫瘤が胎児内胎児と診断された症例報告である。超音波検査と三次元再構成を含むコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)により、術前に脊椎や長管骨を描出できた。病理学的には皮膚、軟骨、骨、腸管などが認められた。著者らは、胎児内胎児は奇形腫とは病理学的に異なる点が多いと述べ、画像所見が診断の鍵になると強調している。
pmid-21603898.summary_en: This case report describes a 3.5-month-old boy with a large right retroperitoneal mass that proved to be fetus in fetu, an incompletely developed fetus within a sac. Ultrasonography and CT, including three-dimensional reconstruction, helped identify the vertebral column and long bones before surgery. Microscopy revealed skin, cartilage, bone, and intestine. The authors emphasize imaging clues for diagnosis and note that fetus in fetu differs pathologically from teratoma.

pmid-21631153.summary_ja: マウスiPS細胞を長期分化させても、未分化な細胞が少数残存し、繰り返し単離・増殖できることを示した研究です。この残存細胞はin vivoで奇形腫を形成し、移植治療における腫瘍形成リスクとなることを示しています。
pmid-21631153.summary_en: This mouse study examines whether residual undifferentiated cells persist in iPS cell cultures after prolonged differentiation in vitro or in vivo. The authors show that a small population of undifferentiated iPS cells can be repeatedly isolated and expanded, and that these residual cells form teratomas in vivo. They conclude that residual pluripotent cells pose a tumorigenic risk for transplantation-based regenerative therapies and that improving reprogramming alone may not solve this problem.

pmid-21883539.summary_ja: 卵巣病変584例に対する超音波ガイド下穿刺吸引細胞診の後方視的検討。悪性診断の特異度は98.0%と高いが、判定不能例により感度は制限される。胚細胞腫瘍は一部の症例として含まれ、組織型の細分類には経験が必要と結論している。特異度と陽性的中率が高く有用な診断手法である一方、検体不適正例の扱いが課題である。
pmid-21883539.summary_en: This retrospective cytology study reviews 584 ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration cases of ovarian lesions. FNAC showed high specificity (98.0%) and positive predictive value for malignancy, though sensitivity was limited by inconclusive or inadequate aspirates (73.7% when these were counted as false negatives). Germ cell tumors, including mature cystic teratomas and mixed germ cell tumors, form a small part of the concordant and discordant cases, and subtyping accuracy remains challenging.

pmid-22055682.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔非胸腺性腫瘍21例で、18F-FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の集積を免疫組織化学的バイオマーカーと比較した。奇形腫やセミノーマを含む一方、囊胞や神経節神経腫では集積が認められなかった。FDG集積はGlut1、HIF-1α、EGFR、p-Akt、p-S6Kおよび腫瘍径と相関した。生殖細胞腫瘍は一部症例にすぎない。
pmid-22055682.summary_en: This study examined 18F-FDG PET uptake in 21 patients with primary non-thymic mediastinal neoplasms, relating uptake to immunohistochemical markers (Glut1, HIF-1α, VEGF, EGFR, Akt/mTOR, p53). Histologies included schwannoma, teratoma, seminoma, sarcoma, and others. FDG uptake correlated with Glut1, HIF-1α, EGFR, p-Akt, p-S6K and tumor size. Cysts and ganglioneuroma lacked uptake and biomarker expression. Glucose metabolism, hypoxia, and upstream HIF-1α pathway components were found to determine FDG uptake.

pmid-22070471.summary_ja: 大きな卵巣腫瘍（最大径15cm以上、悪性の可能性が低いもの）に対する腹腔鏡手術を後方視的に52例で検討した。開腹移行や周術期合併症はなく、手術時間の中央値は80分、入院期間は3日であった。組織学的には粘液性嚢胞腺腫が最多で、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は9例であった。適切な症例選択と術者の経験があれば実施可能で効率的と結論づけている。
pmid-22070471.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 52 women who underwent laparoscopic surgery for large ovarian tumors (15 cm or larger) with a low possibility of malignancy. No conversions to laparotomy or perioperative complications occurred, with median operating time of 80 minutes and median hospital stay of 3 days. Histology included mucinous cystadenoma and mature cystic teratoma (n=9), among others. The authors conclude that laparoscopic management is feasible and efficient with appropriate patient selection and surgeon experience.

pmid-22101319.summary_ja: 高度糖鎖付加型hCG、hCGβ、高度糖鎖付加型hCGβの作用を7種の細胞株で比較した。絨毛癌株(Jar、JEG-3)と胚細胞腫瘍株(NTERA)を含む。3種はいずれも細胞増殖を促し、ほぼ互換的に作用した。共通の機序としてTGFβ受容体を介するアポトーシス抑制が示唆されている。
pmid-22101319.summary_en: Hyperglycosylated hCG, hCGβ, and hyperglycosylated hCGβ were tested on seven cell lines, including two choriocarcinoma lines (Jar and JEG-3), a germ cell cancer line (NTERA), bladder carcinoma lines, and endometrial carcinoma lines. All three forms promoted cell growth in a largely interchangeable manner. The authors propose that these hCG-related forms share a mechanism, antagonizing apoptosis via TGFβ receptors, across the cancers studied.

pmid-22155245.summary_ja: ヒト着床前胚において、MAGEA1などのがん・生殖系列遺伝子がいつサイレンシングされるかを検討しています。胚盤胞期に転写が急減し、胚盤胞の幹細胞で抑制されることが示唆されました。胎児性癌細胞を胚盤胞由来幹細胞の悪性モデルとして用い、MAGEA1の能動的な抑制とde novoメチル化を確認しています。DNMT3AとDNMT3Bもこの過程に寄与していました。
pmid-22155245.summary_en: This study examines when cancer-germline genes such as MAGEA1 acquire silencing in human preimplantation embryos. Transcription rises up to the morula stage and falls sharply in blastocysts, suggesting silencing occurs in blastocyst stem cells. Using embryonal carcinoma cells as a malignant surrogate for blastocyst-derived stem cells, the authors show active repression and de novo methylation of MAGEA1, with DNMT3A and DNMT3B contributing. The findings link de novo methylation to programmed silencing of these genes.

pmid-22160855.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NT2をレチノイン酸で分化誘導し、接着培養と非接着培養でOct4調節領域のヒストン修飾を比較しています。3日後には、特に近位プロモーター領域で脱アセチル化とH3K9メチル化が増加しました。接着培養ではH3K9メチル化が近位エンハンサーでより強く、Oct4発現の差と一致しました。培養条件がOct4のエピジェネティック制御に影響することを示しています。
pmid-22160855.summary_en: This study induced differentiation of the human embryonal carcinoma line NT2 under adherent and non-adherent conditions and compared histone modifications at the Oct4 regulatory region. After three days, repressive marks of hypoacetylation and H3K9 methylation accumulated, especially at the proximal promoter. H3K9 methylation was stronger in the proximal enhancer of adherent cells than in suspension cells, matching differences in Oct4 expression. The results show that culture conditions affect epigenetic regulation of Oct4.

pmid-22221422.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株であるP19細胞において、メチル基転移酵素阻害剤AdOxの遺伝子発現への影響を検討した。AdOx処理により多能性関連遺伝子ネットワークが乱れ、初期発生遺伝子の抑制が解除された。nanogとoct3/4は異なる機序で制御され、ヒストンメチル化が多能性維持に関与すると結論している。腫瘍そのものの研究ではなく、多能性研究のモデル細胞として用いられている。
pmid-22221422.summary_en: In P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, the methyltransferase inhibitor AdOx disrupted the pluripotency-related gene network and released early developmental genes from repression. AdOx had opposing effects on nanog and oct3/4, with reduced repressive histone marks only at nanog. The authors conclude that key pluripotency genes are regulated by distinct mechanisms, including histone methylation. The embryonal carcinoma line serves as a pluripotency model rather than a tumor study.

pmid-22222866.summary_ja: 付属器腫瘤の超音波評価で生じうる診断の過大・過小評価の落とし穴を解説する総説である。正常卵巣の生理、出血性卵巣嚢腫、子宮内膜症性嚢胞、嚢胞性奇形腫などが対象となっている。これらの所見を理解することで、不要な検査や手術、誤診を避けられる。嚢胞性奇形腫は多数の病変の一つであり、主題ではない。
pmid-22222866.summary_en: This review describes pitfalls in sonographic evaluation of adnexal masses that can lead to over- or undercalling. Normal ovarian physiology, hemorrhagic cysts, endometriomas, cystic teratomas, extraovarian cystic masses, and exophytic uterine masses are discussed. Recognizing these mimics helps imagers avoid unnecessary anxiety, testing, and surgery, and prevents misdiagnosis. Cystic teratoma is one of several entities covered rather than the main focus.

pmid-22244390.summary_ja: 高リスク肺腫瘤または血管腫瘍の胎児を対象に、出生前予測因子を後方視的に検討した。肺腫瘤では水腫と異常心エコー所見の併存が死亡の最良の予測因子であった。血管腫瘍（仙尾部・頸部奇形腫を含む）では、高拍出性循環を伴う水腫が転帰と胎児手術の必要性を最もよく予測した。奇形腫は血管腫瘍の一部として解析されており、主題は肺腫瘤と血管腫瘍全体である。
pmid-22244390.summary_en: This retrospective study examined prenatal predictors of outcome and need for fetal surgery in fetuses with high-risk lung masses or vascular tumors. Among 24 fetuses with lung masses, hydrops occurred in 46%, and hydrops with an abnormal echocardiogram carried poor survival without surgery. Among 21 vascular tumors, including sacrococcygeal and cervical teratomas, hydrops with high-output physiology best predicted demise and need for surgery. Abnormal echocardiography with hydrops emerged as the strongest predictor for lung masses.

pmid-22264903.summary_ja: 妊娠中の付属器腫瘤の画像所見を概説し、一次評価としての超音波検査と、精査における磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の役割を示した。MRIで脂肪成分を確認することは奇形腫の診断に有用である。妊娠特有の病変を含む鑑別診断が論じられ、奇形腫は扱われる病変の一つである。
pmid-22264903.summary_en: This review describes imaging features of adnexal masses in pregnant patients, emphasizing sonography as first-line and MRI for further evaluation. MRI detection of fat is useful in diagnosing teratoma. Characteristic findings of nonneoplastic and neoplastic ovarian lesions are discussed, along with features distinguishing benign from malignant neoplasms. Pregnancy-specific conditions such as hyperreactio luteinalis and luteomas are included in the differential diagnosis. Teratoma is one of several lesions covered.

pmid-22285004.summary_ja: まれな原発性良性・悪性卵巣腫瘍の横断画像検査の所見をまとめた総説。一部には典型的な画像所見があるが、報告が少なく十分に記載されていない。非特異的な症状で受診する患者の診療には、これらの疾患の知識が重要と述べている。胚細胞腫瘍を対象とするかは抄録からは判断できない。
pmid-22285004.summary_en: This review addresses rare primary benign and malignant ovarian tumors and their cross-sectional imaging features. Although some lesions show characteristic imaging findings, their rarity means these features are poorly described in the literature. The authors emphasize knowledge of these entities for managing patients who present with nonspecific symptoms. The abstract does not specify whether germ cell tumors are included.

pmid-22348496.summary_ja: 台湾の一施設で18歳未満の付属器捻転を示した21例を後方視的に解析した。腹痛が全例にみられ、診断が遅れる傾向があった。卵巣嚢腫の多くは類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)であった。女児の下腹部痛の鑑別診断として捻転を考慮し、早期の腹腔鏡手術により卵巣温存が期待できると結論づけている。
pmid-22348496.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 21 patients under 18 years with adnexal torsion at a Taiwanese medical center. Abdominal pain was universal, and diagnosis was often delayed. Ovarian cysts were found in 16 patients, most often dermoid cysts (mature teratomas). Pathology showed eight dermoid cysts, two cystadenomas, one follicular cyst, eight simple cysts, and one malignant adult granulosa cell tumor. The authors conclude that adnexal torsion should be considered in the differential diagnosis of lower abdominal pain in girls, that sonography helps diagnosis, and that early laparoscopy may preserve a viable ovary.

pmid-22366467.summary_ja: 3施設で10年間に直腸後腔腫瘍の切除を受けた93例の後方視的研究です。経仙骨、経腹、併用の各アプローチを検討しました。病変の77.4%は良性で、類皮嚢腫、奇形腫、神経線維腫などが含まれました。悪性例には悪性奇形腫を含むリンパ腫などがあり、合併症は16.1%に認められました。骨盤解剖の深い理解と骨盤内手術の技量が治療成功に必要と結論づけています。
pmid-22366467.summary_en: This retrospective review of 93 patients who underwent resection of retrorectal tumors across three institutions over ten years describes surgical approaches, including transsacral, transabdominal and combined methods. Most lesions (77.4%) were benign, including dermoid cysts, teratomas, and neurofibromas. Malignant cases included lymphomas and malignant teratomas. Complications occurred in 16.1% of patients. The authors conclude that successful treatment requires detailed knowledge of pelvic anatomy and expertise in pelvic surgery.

pmid-22378194.summary_ja: 胎児性癌幹細胞P19を用い、多能性維持因子Nanogの下流標的をマイクロアレイで網羅的に同定した。Nanogのノックダウンと過剰発現で多能性マーカーやp53・細胞周期関連遺伝子の発現が変化した。主題は幹細胞生物学であり、腫瘍は実験モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-22378194.summary_en: The authors used P19 embryonal carcinoma stem cells to identify downstream targets of Nanog, a transcription factor that maintains pluripotency. Microarray profiling after Nanog siRNA knockdown, verified by Nanog overexpression, revealed altered expression of pluripotency markers, p53 and cell cycle genes, and cyclins. The study describes molecules that may regulate self-renewal in P19 cells. The work is framed mainly as stem cell biology, with the carcinoma line serving as the experimental model.

pmid-22390258.summary_ja: 直腸後腔腫瘍40例(成人30例、小児10例)の後ろ向き解析です。成人では脊索腫と転移が多く、小児では奇形腫が最も多い腫瘍でした。全体の小児死亡率は20%、成人の1年・5年死亡率は23.8%と38.1%でした。複雑な疾患であるため専門家による治療が必要とされています。
pmid-22390258.summary_en: This retrospective study of 40 patients with retrorectal tumours, including 30 adults and 10 children, reviews presentation, surgical approach, pathology, recurrence and survival. In adults, most tumours were malignant, with chordoma and metastases most common. In children, teratoma was the most frequent tumour, and all children were operated upon. Overall mortality was 20% in the pediatric group. Adult 1- and 5-year mortality was 23.8% and 38.1%. The authors stress management by experts.

pmid-22394988.summary_ja: 1997〜2011年に先天性縦隔腫瘤の手術を受けた24例を検討した施設研究。内訳は気管支原性嚢胞、奇形腫5例、リンパ管腫などであった。出生前診断例では人工呼吸期間と在院日数が短く、早期管理が可能であった。生後約1歳前の早期切除は良好な転帰と低い侵襲に関連すると報告されている。
pmid-22394988.summary_en: This institutional review of 24 children operated on for congenital mediastinal masses between 1997 and 2011 compared outcomes in patients diagnosed prenatally with those diagnosed after birth. Pathology included bronchogenic cysts, foregut malformations, teratomas, lymphangiomas and a haemangioma; five of the 24 were teratomas. Prenatal diagnosis allowed earlier management, with shorter ventilation and hospital stay. Early resection before about one year of age was associated with excellent outcomes and less morbidity.

pmid-22414093.summary_ja: 非血液疾患33例(胚細胞腫瘍11例を含む)を対象に、欧州の名義使用プログラムでプレリキサホルによる造血幹細胞動員の成績を検討した。85%の症例で十分量のCD34+細胞を採取でき、19例が移植に進んだ。胚細胞腫瘍は複数の疾患のうちの一群にとどまる。
pmid-22414093.summary_en: This European named patient program analyzed stem cell mobilization with plerixafor plus G-CSF, or with chemotherapy and G-CSF, in 33 patients with nonhematologic diseases who had previously failed mobilization. The cohort included germ cell tumor (11), Ewing sarcoma, Wiskott-Aldrich disease, neuroblastoma and other diagnoses. Of the patients, 85% collected at least 2×10^6/kg CD34+ cells, and 19 proceeded to transplantation with timely engraftment. The authors conclude that plerixafor appears safe and effective in these patients. Germ cell tumor patients form only one subgroup among several diagnoses.

pmid-22431292.summary_ja: 骨肉腫、神経芽腫、肝芽腫、胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチンを投与された小児102例を後方視的に検討した。42%が聴力障害を、28%が中等度から重度の聴覚毒性を生じた。男児、診断時の低年齢、累積投与量が危険因子であった。胚細胞腫瘍は4疾患の一つで、個別の結果は報告されていない。
pmid-22431292.summary_en: This retrospective chart review of 102 children treated with cisplatin for osteosarcoma, neuroblastoma, hepatoblastoma, or germ cell tumor examined ototoxicity using the Brock scale. Forty-two percent developed hearing loss, and 28% had moderate to severe ototoxicity. Male sex, younger age at diagnosis, and higher cumulative cisplatin dose were associated with greater severity. Germ cell tumor is one of four diagnostic groups, and results are not reported separately for it. The authors conclude that sex, cumulative dose, and very young age are important biomarkers of cisplatin ototoxicity.

pmid-22446105.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞とES細胞において、POU5F1がETS2を介してヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のCGAサブユニット遺伝子を抑制する機構を示した研究。POU5F1はETS2のプロモーター結合を妨げる。ES細胞が分化しPOU5F1が減少すると、ETS2とDLX3が結合し遺伝子が発現する。多能性の維持と栄養膜系譜の成立への関与が示唆される。
pmid-22446105.summary_en: This study shows that POU5F1 represses the human chorionic gonadotropin CGA subunit gene by binding ETS2, blocking its access to the CGA promoter in choriocarcinoma cells and embryonic stem cells. Mutating a POU5F1 site reduced basal promoter activity through overlap with a DLX3 site, and DLX3 cooperated strongly with ETS2. In embryonic stem cells, the silencing lifts as POU5F1 falls and differentiation begins. The authors propose a squelching mechanism that may relate to pluripotency maintenance and trophoblast lineage emergence.

pmid-22461508.summary_ja: 同系マウスモデルで未分化胚性幹細胞を移植し、宿主の微小環境が奇形腫の開始と増殖を駆動することを示した。移植後に動員された骨髄由来マクロファージはM2型・血管新生型に分化し、MIFやVEGFを産生した。宿主側のMIF欠失またはMIF阻害は奇形腫形成を抑制した。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく、マウスの実験的奇形腫モデルに関する研究である。
pmid-22461508.summary_en: Using undifferentiated mouse embryonic stem cells in a syngeneic transplantation model, the authors show that the host microenvironment drives teratoma initiation and growth. Bone marrow-derived macrophages recruited after transplantation adopted an M2/angiogenic phenotype and produced MIF, VEGF and MMP9. Host-specific MIF deletion or pharmacologic inhibition reduced angiogenesis and teratoma development. The work is a murine experimental model of teratoma rather than clinical germ cell tumor.

pmid-22480685.summary_ja: 抗がん剤リダマイシンが、マウスP19胎児性癌細胞の神経分化を誘導する機構を検討した。リダマイシンはOct4を低下させ、p21プロモーターへのOct4結合を抑えることでp21転写を活性化する。Oct4のノックダウンは神経様分化を誘導し、過剰発現はこれを阻害した。がん細胞の分化誘導機構を示すが、臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を対象とはしていない。
pmid-22480685.summary_en: This study examines how the anticancer drug lidamycin, at 0.01 nM, induces neural differentiation in mouse P19 embryonal carcinoma cells. Lidamycin reduced Oct4 and increased p21 transcription by suppressing Oct4 binding to the p21 promoter. Knockdown of Oct4 induced neuron-like differentiation, while Oct4 overexpression blocked it. The authors propose that lidamycin promotes cancer cell differentiation through Oct4 inhibition. The work uses a mouse cell line rather than clinical germ cell tumor samples.

pmid-22491947.summary_ja: マウス生殖幹細胞培養系を用い、FGF2がMAP2K1–MAPK1/3シグナルを介して精原幹細胞の自己複製を促進することを示した。活性化Map2k1やBcl6bの発現により、FGF2非依存的な増殖が可能となった。Bcl6b発現細胞を不妊マウスの精巣へ移植すると胚細胞腫瘍が形成され、過剰な自己複製シグナルが腫瘍化を引き起こしうることが示唆された。
pmid-22491947.summary_en: This study examines how FGF2 sustains self-renewal of mouse spermatogonial stem cells in germline stem cell cultures. FGF2 and GDNF induced MAPK1/3 phosphorylation, and inhibiting MAP2K1 reduced proliferation. Activated Map2k1 upregulated Etv5 and Bcl6b and enabled FGF2-independent growth. When Bcl6b-expressing cells were transplanted into infertile mouse testes, a germ cell tumor formed, suggesting that excessive self-renewal signaling can drive tumorigenic conversion.

pmid-22525672.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌（EC）細胞株F9を用いた研究で、Dab2のp96アイソフォームがGATA-4を活性化し、レチノイン酸非存在下でも胚体外内胚葉への分化を誘導することを示したものである。p96はGATA-4を正のフィードバックで制御する。臨床の腫瘍を対象とした研究ではなく、細胞モデルを用いた発生生物学的研究である。
pmid-22525672.summary_en: F9 murine embryonal carcinoma cells differentiate toward extra-embryonic endoderm upon retinoic acid treatment, inducing Disabled-2 (Dab2) isoforms. This study shows that overexpression of the p96 Dab2 isoform induces this differentiation without retinoic acid by activating GATA-4. The authors also show p96 regulates GATA-4 through a positive feedback loop, in contrast to the feed-forward loop used by GATA factors to induce Dab2. The work is a developmental signaling study using a cell line model, not a clinical tumor study.

pmid-22553996.summary_ja: 縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン療法と自家造血幹細胞移植の後に末期腎不全となった15歳の患者が、ドナーの造血細胞と腎臓の同時移植を受けた。非骨髄破壊的前処置とアロ反応性T細胞の除去により移植免疫寛容を誘導し、32か月間免疫抑制剤なしで良好な腎機能を維持した。
pmid-22553996.summary_en: A 15-year-old with end-stage renal disease after cisplatin therapy and autologous HSCT for a mediastinal germ cell tumor received a combined donor hematopoietic cell and kidney transplant. Tolerance was induced by non-myeloablative conditioning with total lymphoid irradiation, alemtuzumab, and post-transplant cyclophosphamide to deplete alloreactive T cells. The patient achieved mixed, then full, donor chimerism and maintained kidney function without rejection for 32 months off all immunosuppression.

pmid-22568098.summary_ja: 本総説は、著者らが開発した新規バイオマーカー(RB1CC1、RecQ、DNMT3L)を概説している。精巣胚細胞腫瘍では、胎児特異的メチル基転移酵素様蛋白DNMT3Lが胎児性癌のマーカーとして利用されている。DNMT3Lは治療標的としての可能性も示唆されている。
pmid-22568098.summary_en: This review summarizes several novel clinicopathological biomarkers developed by the authors for cancer diagnosis and therapy. RB1CC1 (FIP200) serves as a prognostic marker in breast and salivary cancers, and RECQL1 and WRN helicases are highly expressed in head and neck squamous cell carcinomas, where their silencing suppresses tumor growth in preclinical models. In testicular germ cell tumors, DNMT3L, a fetal-specific methyltransferase-like protein, is expressed and has been used as a marker of human embryonal carcinoma, with possible relevance as a therapeutic target. The authors suggest these biomarkers may support personalized cancer medicine.

pmid-22581778.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9を用いて、ヒストン脱メチル化酵素Kdm3aが壁側内胚葉様細胞への分化に必須であることを示した。Kdm3aはDab2などの内胚葉分化マスター遺伝子を制御する。Dab2単独では分化を十分に誘導できず、Kdm3aの機能が必要であった。臨床的な腫瘍の検討を含まない基礎研究である。
pmid-22581778.summary_en: The authors show that the histone demethylase Kdm3a is required for F9 embryonal carcinoma cells to differentiate into parietal endoderm-like cells. Kdm3a regulates a set of endoderm master genes, including Dab2, Pdlim4 and FoxQ1, and its H3K9me2 demethylase activity correlates with their expression. Dab2 depletion also blocked full differentiation, but Dab2 overexpression could not rescue Kdm3a knockdown, indicating that Dab2 is necessary but not sufficient. This is basic epigenetic research using an embryonal carcinoma cell line as a model, without a clinical or tumor-patient component.

pmid-22665008.summary_ja: 後頭部の頭頸部腫瘤を有する新生児症例で、脳瘤に似た外観を呈し、病理組織学的にはGrade II〜IIIの未熟奇形腫と診断された。症例のフォローアップと治療を報告している。頭蓋内病変との連続性は抄録からは不明であり、中枢神経系胚細胞腫瘍の範疇に該当するかは判断できない。
pmid-22665008.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a craniocervical mass at the back of the head, resembling an encephalocele and pathologically diagnosed as a grade II-III immature teratoma. The authors detail the follow-up and treatment of the infant. Teratomas are described as rare congenital tumors occurring in the sacrococcygeal region, intracranial compartment, and head and neck. The abstract does not clarify whether the lesion has intracranial extension, which determines whether it falls within central nervous system germ cell tumors.

pmid-22745243.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞と初代胎盤細胞を用い、アスコルビン酸がSVCT2を介してβhCG産生を誘導する機序を解析した研究です。Sp1とTFAP2Aが転写因子として関与することが示されています。主題は胎盤の内分泌機能であり、絨毛癌細胞株は実験モデルとして用いられているにすぎません。
pmid-22745243.summary_en: Using JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells and primary human cytotrophoblasts, the authors show that ascorbic acid, taken up via SVCT2, induces βhCG mRNA expression and hormone production. Reporter and knockdown experiments identify Sp1 and TFAP2A as the transcription factors mediating this effect. The study focuses on placental endocrine regulation rather than tumor biology; the choriocarcinoma line serves as an experimental model, so its relevance to GCT or gestational disease is indirect.

pmid-22753283.summary_ja: 胚性癌細胞株P19においてFABP3を過剰発現させると、ATP産生の低下、ミトコンドリア膜電位の著明な低下、ミトコンドリア動態の不均衡、活性酸素種の増加が生じた。これらのミトコンドリア障害がアポトーシスを促進すると結論されている。P19は細胞モデルとして用いられており、臨床の胚細胞腫瘍は直接検討されていない。
pmid-22753283.summary_en: P19 embryonal carcinoma cells overexpressing FABP3 showed reduced ATP production, a marked loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, altered mitochondrial dynamics and increased reactive oxygen species, without a significant decrease in mtDNA copy number. The authors conclude that FABP3-induced mitochondrial dysfunction contributes to apoptosis in these cells. P19 is used as a cell model, and clinical germ cell tumours are not examined directly.

pmid-22768158.summary_ja: 非標的型GC-MSにより、ヒト胚性幹細胞と胎児性癌細胞株NTERA2の代謝プロファイルを比較しています。共通する代謝物と細胞種特異的な代謝物が示されました。OCT4を減少させると酸化的リン酸化が活性化し、多能性と自己複製の代謝マーカーの候補が提示されています。
pmid-22768158.summary_en: Untargeted GC-MS metabolomics was used to compare human embryonic stem cells (H9) with embryonal carcinoma cells (NTERA2). Some metabolites were shared, reflecting self-renewal, while others differed between the two cell types. Combined metabolomic and microarray analysis of OCT4-depleted hESCs suggested Warburg-type glycolysis in pluripotent cells, with OXPHOS activation upon differentiation. The authors propose metabolic markers of self-renewal and pluripotency. Embryonal carcinoma cells serve mainly as a comparator for pluripotent stem cell metabolism.

pmid-22790298.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘤32例を対象に、3テスラMRIでIDEAL法と従来法を比較した後方視的研究です。脂肪抑制はIDEAL法で有意に優れ、奇形腫15例では信号コントラストも向上しました。卵巣腫瘤全体の画質改善が示されましたが、奇形腫は一部の対象です。
pmid-22790298.summary_en: This retrospective study compared 3D gradient-echo T1-weighted IDEAL water-fat separation sequences with conventional sequences at 3T for imaging 32 women with ovarian masses. Fat suppression was significantly superior with IDEAL, and contrast within teratomas (n=15) was higher on fat-suppressed images. SNR and fat detection were comparable between techniques. The authors concluded that IDEAL improved image quality for ovarian mass evaluation, with teratomas as one subgroup of the lesions studied.

pmid-22879958.summary_ja: 高齢男性（平均73.3歳）の正常精巣を、精母細胞性セミノーマ用に最適化された免疫染色パネルで解析した研究である。FGFR3やリン酸化AKTの染色が変化した精細管が認められ、精原細胞がシグナル特性の異なるクローンモザイクを形成すると示唆された。父親年齢効果変異の成因を説明する「selfish spermatogonial selection」仮説を支持する知見である。
pmid-22879958.summary_en: This study uses an immunohistochemical panel originally optimized for spermatocytic seminoma to examine normal testes from elderly men (mean age 73.3 years). The authors identify small cellular aggregations and, less commonly, seminiferous tubules with altered staining for FGFR3 and phosphorylated AKT. These findings suggest that spermatogonia in older men form clonal mosaics with altered signaling. The results support the concept of selfish spermatogonial selection, which may underlie paternal age-effect mutations in congenital disorders such as Apert syndrome and achondroplasia.

pmid-22935307.summary_ja: 両側の類皮嚢腫を伴う腹腔妊娠疑いの症例報告である。単孔式腹腔鏡手術で左卵巣類皮嚢腫と寄生性類皮嚢腫を切除し、拡散強調磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で同定した腹腔内妊娠組織も摘出した。術後はメトトレキサートによる化学療法を受け、経過は順調であった。稀な併存例に対する低侵襲な治療が報告の要点である。
pmid-22935307.summary_en: A 26-year-old primigravida with suspected ectopic pregnancy had bilateral dermoid cysts and a serum hCG of 3812 mIU/mL. Laparoendoscopic single-site surgery was performed. The team removed a left ovarian dermoid cyst and a parasitic dermoid cyst attached to the cul-de-sac peritoneum. An early abdominal pregnancy implanted in the right pararectal space was identified with diffusion-weighted MRI guidance and excised. Systemic methotrexate was administered postoperatively, and recovery was uneventful. The report highlights preoperative diagnosis and minimally invasive management of a rare combined presentation.

pmid-22952907.summary_ja: 本研究は、栄養膜細胞モデルとして広く用いられるヒト絨毛癌由来JEG-3細胞を用い、脂質輸送蛋白StarD7の機能を検討した。StarD7をノックダウンするとABCG2発現、増殖、遊走が低下し、βhCGやsyncytin-1などの分化マーカーは増加した。絨毛癌そのものではなく、栄養膜細胞の生理機能を調べるための細胞モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-22952907.summary_en: This study examines StarD7, a START-domain lipid transfer protein, in JEG-3 human choriocarcinoma cells, a widely used trophoblast model. Knocking down StarD7 reduced ABCG2 transporter expression, phospholipid synthesis, proliferation and cell migration, while increasing differentiation markers such as βhCG and syncytin-1. Desmosome formation between cells also decreased. The findings suggest StarD7 regulates multidrug transporter levels and trophoblast differentiation. The choriocarcinoma line serves mainly as a physiological model rather than as a study of the tumor.

pmid-22953303.summary_ja: 生後4か月の男児が腹部腫瘤で受診し、胎児内胎児と診断された症例報告である。胎児内胎児は一卵性双胎の一方が宿主内に包み込まれる稀な発生異常である。画像検査で疑われ、手術で上腹部後腹膜に羊膜様膜に包まれた胎児を認め切除した。術後経過は良好であった。
pmid-22953303.summary_en: This case report describes a 4-month-old boy with an abdominal mass that was identified as fetus in fetu, a rare developmental aberration in which a partially developed monozygotic fetus is enclosed within a host. Imaging suggested the diagnosis, and surgery revealed a fetus enclosed in an amnion-like membrane in the upper retroperitoneum, which was excised. The infant recovered well after surgery. The authors present the case as an uncommon retroperitoneal presentation of this developmental anomaly.

pmid-22962430.summary_ja: 非糖尿病の68歳女性が卵巣腫瘍に伴う著しい血糖変動を呈した症例である。腫瘍が産生する過剰なソマトスタチンがインスリンや対抗調節ホルモンを抑制したと考えられた。卵巣摘出術後に血糖およびホルモン値は正常化した。組織学的には、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と、ソマトスタチン陽性の間質カルチノイドからなる腫瘍であった。
pmid-22962430.summary_en: This report describes a 68-year-old nondiabetic woman with an ovarian tumor and severe fluctuations in blood glucose.
