pmid-21256573.summary_en: This two-center review of 13 pediatric females with gonad-related conditions describes ovarian lesions that pediatric urologists may encounter. Nearly half were referred for presumed urological conditions later found to be ovarian in origin. Histologies included mature teratoma, streak gonad, and hemorrhagic cyst, with two potentially malignant tumors: immature teratoma and juvenile granulosa cell tumor. Tumor markers were normal in all six patients tested. The authors emphasize that management of pediatric ovarian cysts and masses is controversial and that urologists should understand its diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-21256579.summary_ja: 1979年から2008年に治療した悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の女性40例を後方視的に検討しました。組織型は未熟奇形腫が最多でした。妊孕性温存手術を受けた22例のうち、連絡が取れた妊娠希望例の多くが自然妊娠し、14例が生児を得ました。全例で化学療法後1年以内に月経周期が正常化し、全生存期間(全生存率)は100%でした。妊孕性温存手術と補助化学療法の妊孕性や月経への影響は小さいと結論づけています。
pmid-21256579.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 40 women treated for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors between 1979 and 2008. Immature teratoma was the most common subtype, followed by dysgerminoma and yolk sac tumor. Twenty-two patients underwent fertility-sparing surgery, most receiving adjuvant chemotherapy. Among those desiring pregnancy who were contacted, most conceived spontaneously, yielding 14 live births. All patients regained normal menstrual cycles within one year of chemotherapy. Overall survival was 100%, and the authors conclude that fertility-sparing surgery with adjuvant chemotherapy had little effect on fertility or menses.

pmid-21257242.summary_ja: 妊娠9週の自然流産後に高血圧とネフローゼ症候群を呈した42歳女性の症例報告です。子宮摘出後に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断され、化学療法で良好に治療されました。腎生検では、血栓様構造物による毛細血管閉塞を伴う非典型的な血栓性微小血管症を認めました。腎病変の病態機序を考察しています。
pmid-21257242.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman with hypertension and nephrotic syndrome after a spontaneous incomplete abortion at nine weeks of pregnancy. A uterine placental site trophoblastic tumor was diagnosed after hysterectomy and treated successfully with chemotherapy. Kidney biopsy revealed an unusual thrombotic microangiopathy with thrombus-like capillary occlusion and immune deposits. The differential diagnosis included preeclamptic nephropathy, Waldenström disease, and lupus-related glomerulonephritis. The authors review the pathogenic mechanisms underlying this renal involvement.

pmid-21263100.summary_ja: 婦人科腫瘍学研究グループ(GOG)によるランダム化第III相試験で、低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の初回治療として、週1回のメトトレキサート筋注と隔週のダクチノマイシン静注を比較しました。完全寛解率はダクチノマイシンが70%、メトトレキサートが53%で、ダクチノマイシンが有意に優れていました。WHOリスクスコア5～6や絨毛癌では効果が低下しました。両治療法とも忍容性は良好でした。
pmid-21263100.summary_en: This Gynecologic Oncology Group randomized phase III trial compared weekly intramuscular methotrexate with biweekly intravenous dactinomycin for primary treatment of low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Among 216 eligible women, dactinomycin achieved a higher complete response rate (70% vs 53%). Both regimens were less effective in patients with WHO risk score 5 or 6 or with choriocarcinoma, with complete response rates of 9% and 42%. Recurrences were rare, and both regimens were well tolerated. The authors conclude that biweekly dactinomycin yields a higher complete response rate than weekly methotrexate in low-risk GTN.

pmid-21268265.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫から単離した間葉系幹細胞様細胞を正常卵巣由来細胞と比較したプロテオーム解析である。奇形腫由来細胞は増殖能・コロニー形成能・血管新生能が高く、GSTM2が強く発現していた。GSTM2の過剰発現はp38 MAPKの低下とAKT・survivinの活性化に関連しており、奇形腫の増殖機構への関与が示唆された。
pmid-21268265.summary_en: This proteomic study compared mesenchymal stem-like cells isolated from ovarian teratoma tissue with those from normal ovary. Both cell types expressed OCT4 and NANOG, but teratoma-derived cells showed higher proliferation, colony formation, and angiogenic capacity. Among 17 proteins with over eightfold expression change, glutathione S-transferase M2 (GSTM2) was strongly upregulated in teratoma cells. GSTM2 overexpression was associated with reduced p38 MAPK signaling and activation of AKT and survivin, suggesting a role in regulating survival genes that may contribute to teratoma growth.

pmid-21269611.summary_ja: 40歳女性の右付属器充実性腫瘤を腹腔鏡下に切除した悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告である。術後1年間は追加治療なしでフォローアップされた。術前診断の困難さ、複雑な卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断への卵巣甲状腺腫の組み入れの重要性、甲状腺全摘術と131I療法を含む治療選択肢について文献レビューを踏まえて論じている。
pmid-21269611.summary_en: This case study reports a 40-year-old woman with an incidentally detected solid right adnexal mass that was later diagnosed as malignant struma ovarii, a rare mature teratoma dominated by thyroid tissue. The tumor was removed laparoscopically, and she had no further treatment during one year of follow-up. The authors review the literature, emphasizing that preoperative diagnosis is difficult, that struma ovarii belongs in the differential diagnosis of complex ovarian masses, and that standard treatment remains undefined, with thyroidectomy and iodine-131 therapy as options.

pmid-21270422.summary_ja: 28日間の反復投与毒性試験中に、12週齢Swiss Albinoマウスの精巣に自然発生した非転移性の腫瘍を報告している。腫瘍は胎児性癌と奇形腫からなり、骨格筋や皮脂腺などの成熟組織成分を含んでいた。本系統における自然発生精巣奇形癌の初報告であり、組織形態学的特徴が詳細に示されている。
pmid-21270422.summary_en: This report describes a spontaneous unilateral testicular tumor found in a 12-week-old Swiss Albino mouse during a 28-day toxicity study. The lesion nearly replaced the left testis and comprised embryonal carcinoma and teratoma, including primitive embryonal cells, skeletal muscle, sebaceous glands, keratinized epithelium, and ciliated epithelium. The tumor was non-metastatic. The authors detail its histomorphology and note that it is the first reported spontaneous testicular teratocarcinoma in this mouse strain.

pmid-21277010.summary_ja: MITOグループによる後方視的研究で、IA期純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫26例を検討した。完全な病期分類を受けたのはわずか5例であり、再発は不完全な病期分類の群のみで11.5%に発生した。全例が救済療法で治癒し、中央値100か月の追跡で無病生存が確認された。完全な病期分類を伴う温存手術が標準であり、化学療法は再発時に限定すべきとしている。
pmid-21277010.summary_en: This MITO group retrospective study reviewed 26 patients with stage IA pure ovarian dysgerminoma, of whom only five had complete surgical staging. Recurrence occurred in 11.5% of patients, all in those with incomplete staging, while none of the seven patients given adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed. All relapses were salvaged. With a median follow-up of 100 months, all patients were alive without disease. The authors conclude that prognosis is excellent, that complete staging with fertility-sparing surgery is the standard, and that chemotherapy is best reserved for relapse.

pmid-21278491.summary_ja: 思春期後の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を免疫組織化学染色で解析し、エストロゲン受容体GPR30の発現を検討した研究です。管内胚細胞腫瘍、セミノーマ、胎児性癌では高発現し、奇形腫では低発現でした。ウェスタンブロットでも同様の結果が確認されました。GPR30は治療標的になりうると著者らは示唆しています。
pmid-21278491.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined GPR30, a G protein-coupled estrogen receptor, in post-pubertal testicular germ cell tumors, including 30 seminomas, 5 teratomas, 12 embryonal carcinomas and 20 intratubular germ cell tumors. GPR30 was strongly expressed in intratubular germ cell tumors, seminomas and embryonal carcinomas, but weakly in teratomas, and Western blotting confirmed these findings. Expression was also examined in the GC1 spermatogonia line and the TCam-2 seminoma line. The authors suggest GPR30 may be a therapeutic target, and that specific inhibitors could block highly proliferative neoplastic germ cells.

pmid-21282539.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの術後補助療法として、単回カルボプラチンと放射線療法を比較したランダム化試験の長期成績です。5年再発フリー率は両群で同等で、カルボプラチンの非劣性が確認されました。対側の胚細胞腫瘍はカルボプラチン群で有意に少なく、治療前の高いFSH値が危険因子でした。
pmid-21282539.summary_en: This randomized trial, MRC TE19/EORTC 30982, compared single-dose carboplatin with radiotherapy as adjuvant treatment for stage I seminoma. With median follow-up of 6.5 years, 5-year relapse-free rates were 94.7% with carboplatin and 96.0% with radiotherapy, confirming noninferiority. Patients receiving at least 99% of the target carboplatin dose had better relapse-free rates. Contralateral germ cell tumors were significantly reduced with carboplatin (2 versus 15 cases), and elevated pretreatment FSH was a strong predictor of contralateral tumor. The authors conclude single-dose carboplatin is noninferior and reduces second germ cell tumor risk.

pmid-21284721.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、子宮内で診断されたグレードIIの未熟な心膜内奇形腫を有する新生児について述べたものである。腫瘤は出生後に完全に切除された。腫瘤の大きさ、部位および心膜液貯留による心血管系および呼吸器系の障害のリスクがあったにもかかわらず、切除は成功した。組織像は概ね成熟していたが、未熟な成分については連続的なαフェトプロテイン測定による長期フォローアップが必要であった。患者は生後10か月の時点で再発は認められなかった。著者らは、心膜奇形腫に対する完全な外科的切除と長期にわたる監視の重要性を強調している。
pmid-21284721.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a grade II immature intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed in utero. The mass was completely resected after birth despite the risk of cardiovascular and respiratory compromise from its size, location and pericardial effusion. Although histology was largely mature, the immature components required long-term follow-up with serial alpha-fetoprotein measurements. The patient was free of recurrence at 10 months of age. The authors emphasize complete surgical removal and extended surveillance for pericardial teratomas.

pmid-21288558.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発巣と転移巣計184例を対象に、LIN28の免疫染色を検討した。胚細胞腫瘍の多くで強い陽性を示し、非胚細胞腫瘍での陽性例は少なかった。卵黄嚢腫瘍ではOCT4より有用であり、SALL4と同程度の診断的有用性を持つが、SALL4を上回る利点はないと結論された。
pmid-21288558.summary_en: This study evaluated LIN28 immunohistochemistry as a diagnostic marker in 103 primary and 81 metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, including intratubular germ cell neoplasia, seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, teratomas and choriocarcinomas. LIN28 showed strong staining in nearly all intratubular neoplasias, embryonal carcinomas and yolk sac tumors, and in all classic seminomas, with minimal staining in 327 non-germ cell tumors. Its sensitivity was comparable to SALL4 and superior to OCT4 for yolk sac tumors, supporting LIN28 as a useful diagnostic marker, though it offered no advantage over SALL4.

pmid-21292069.summary_ja: 頸部奇形腫により気道閉塞が疑われた胎児に対し、EXIT下で気管切開を行った症例である。胎児頭皮電極を用いて連続的に心拍を監視し、臍帯圧迫による徐脈に迅速に対応できた。気道障害を伴う胎児腫瘍のEXITにおいて、有用な監視手段であると報告している。
pmid-21292069.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with a cervical teratoma causing suspected airway obstruction, managed by tracheostomy under ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT). A fetal scalp electrode was placed for continuous heart rate monitoring, enabling prompt response to bradycardia caused by cord compression. The authors conclude that the scalp electrode is a useful tool for fetal monitoring during EXIT procedures for airway-compromising fetal tumors.

pmid-21293285.summary_ja: 再発性成熟卵巣奇形腫の患者で、子宮内膜腺癌に対する子宮摘出術時に腹膜神経膠腫症、悪性転化を伴う子宮内膜症、カルチノイド腫瘍が同時に認められた症例である。腹膜幹細胞の化生が複数の病変の発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。同時性婦人科腫瘍や転移性疾患が疑われる症例の評価に重要な知見である。
pmid-21293285.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with recurrent mature ovarian teratoma who was found at hysterectomy for endometrial adenocarcinoma to have gliomatosis peritonei, endometriosis with malignant transformation, and a carcinoid tumor. The authors note this combination has not been reported previously. They propose that metaplasia of peritoneal stem cells may explain both endometriosis and gliomatosis peritonei, and that aberrant differentiation of these cells may occur more widely. The findings are relevant to evaluating synchronous gynecologic tumors or presumed metastatic disease.

pmid-21293290.summary_ja: 非妊娠性の絨毛癌および類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍成分を併せ持つ子宮内膜類内膜癌の稀な症例である。分子遺伝学的解析により、類内膜癌から栄養膜腫瘍への克隆進化が確認された。がん幹細胞が異常な分化を獲得する機序や、成人腫瘍で栄養膜分化を誘導する分子機構の解明に示唆を与える報告である。
pmid-21293290.summary_en: This report describes a rare uterine endometrioid carcinoma containing a nongestational trophoblastic component, composed of both choriocarcinoma and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Molecular genetic analysis demonstrated clonal evolution from the endometrioid carcinoma to the trophoblastic tumor, indicating that the trophoblastic component arose from the same tumor clone. The findings have diagnostic and biological implications, suggesting how cancer stem cells may adopt aberrant differentiation programs and what molecular switches might initiate trophoblastic differentiation in adult tumors.

pmid-21300926.summary_ja: SEERデータを用いた27,948例の集団ベース研究で、精巣がん特異的死亡の予後因子を検討した。40歳以上での診断は、セミノーマと非セミノーマの双方で死亡リスクを約2倍にし、転移性疾患で最も顕著だった。非セミノーマでは、未婚、低い社会経済的地位、非白人も死亡リスクを高めた。後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行わないことは死亡リスクの大幅な上昇と関連した。
pmid-21300926.summary_en: This population-based SEER study of 27,948 men with testicular cancer examined predictors of cancer-specific mortality. Diagnosis at age 40 or older doubled mortality for both seminoma and nonseminoma, and was most marked in metastatic disease. Unmarried status, lower socioeconomic status, and nonwhite race were also associated with higher risk among patients with nonseminoma. Omission of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was associated with a sevenfold increase in death. The authors call for research into interventions to reduce these disparities.

pmid-21301051.summary_ja: 両側同時性セミノーマを有する25歳男性の症例報告である。両側根治的精巣摘除術と術後の腰大動脈領域への放射線療法を施行し、1年以上無病で経過したが、テストステロン補充に依存している。両側性腫瘍の頻度、不妊、心理的負担を文献的に考察し、選択例では精巣温存手術の可能性にも言及している。
pmid-21301051.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with synchronous bilateral seminoma and azoospermia, treated with bilateral radical orchiectomy and adjuvant para-aortic radiotherapy. He remained disease-free more than a year later but depends on testosterone replacement. The authors review the 2-3% incidence of bilateral testicular tumors and the infertility and psychological burden of orchiectomy. They note testis-sparing surgery as an option in selected patients, and scrotal radiotherapy for carcinoma in situ in remaining testicular tissue. The authors conclude that bilateral orchiectomy remains the standard, with partial orchiectomy considered in selected cases.

pmid-21304588.summary_ja: Pten欠損マウス胚性幹細胞の分化過程で、奇形腫を形成する攻撃的な胎児性癌細胞が少数出現することを示した。その機序は、Nanogの抑制不全による生存と自己複製の増加である。幹細胞治療における腫瘍化リスクの理解に加え、胎児性癌と奇形腫形成の生物学に関する知見をもたらす。
pmid-21304588.summary_en: This murine study shows that Pten loss in pluripotent stem cells causes the emergence of a small population of aggressive, teratoma-initiating embryonic carcinoma cells during in vitro differentiation. The remaining 90-95% of differentiated cells were non-tumorigenic. The authors show that these embryonic carcinoma cells persist through increased survival and self-renewal due to failure to repress Nanog. The work addresses tumor initiation risk in stem cell-based therapies and provides mechanistic insight into embryonal carcinoma biology and teratoma formation.

pmid-21305635.summary_ja: 11施設の後方視的研究で、卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ21例の臨床経過と超音波所見を検討した。多くは血流豊富な充実性で分葉状の付属器腫瘤を呈し、中央値年齢は20歳であった。症状は疼痛や腹部膨満などだった。20～30歳女性で大きく分葉状の充実性血流豊富な付属器腫瘤を認めた場合、本症を疑うべきと結論した。
pmid-21305635.summary_en: This retrospective multicenter study describes the clinical and ultrasound features of 21 women with ovarian dysgerminoma, most of whom were around 20 years old. Most tumors were highly vascularized, solid, and lobulated adnexal masses with heterogeneous echogenicity. Presenting symptoms included pain, bloating, and menstrual disorders, and most cases were pure dysgerminomas. The authors use IOTA terminology and pattern recognition to characterize the tumors. They conclude that a large solid, lobulated, vascular adnexal mass in a woman aged 20 to 30 should raise suspicion of dysgerminoma.

pmid-21316095.summary_ja: 小児の副腎に原発した成熟奇形腫の1例の症例報告と文献レビューです。副腎奇形腫は極めて稀で、画像検査により診断されました。早期診断と外科的切除が治療上重要であり、術後化学療法の要否は治療結果により決まるとしています。予後予測が困難なため、長期の綿密なフォローアップを推奨しています。
pmid-21316095.summary_en: A child presented with a primary mature teratoma arising in the adrenal gland, an extremely rare site for such tumors. Diagnosis relied on radiologic examination. The authors stress early diagnosis and surgical resection as key to effective treatment, with postoperative chemotherapy depending on the outcome. Because prognosis is hard to predict, close lifelong follow-up is recommended. The article also reviews published data on adrenal mature teratomas.

pmid-21317810.summary_ja: 生後9か月の女児に発生した原発性横隔膜卵黄嚢腫瘍について、症例報告と文献レビューを行った論文です。カルボプラチンを含むレジメンにより腫瘍が縮小し、その後完全切除が行われました。治療終了8か月後も無病の状態を維持しています。既報の英語文献4例もあわせて検討されています。
pmid-21317810.summary_en: The authors report a primary yolk sac tumor of the diaphragm in a 9-month-old girl, an extremely rare site in children. Carboplatin-containing chemotherapy reduced tumor size, after which total resection was performed. The patient remained disease-free eight months after completing treatment. The report also reviews four previously published English-language cases of diaphragmatic yolk sac tumor, placing this case in the context of the limited literature.

pmid-21318640.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の3症例（卵巣奇形腫を有する若年女性、報告例中最高齢の症例、腫瘍を認めない若年男性）を報告し、文献をレビューした論文です。本症は成熟卵巣奇形腫と関連することが多く、十分に認識されていない病態です。支持療法、多職種による管理、免疫調節療法の必要性を強調しています。
pmid-21318640.summary_en: This paper reports three contrasting patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis: a young woman with an ovarian teratoma, the oldest case reported to date, and a young man without an identifiable tumor. It reviews the differential diagnosis, investigations, and treatment options for this under-recognized, immune-mediated syndrome, which is commonly associated with mature ovarian teratomas. The authors advocate supportive care, multidisciplinary involvement, and immune-modulating therapies, and stress the need for high diagnostic suspicion.

pmid-21323965.summary_ja: 凍結切片上で直接酵素的アルカリホスファターゼ反応(dAP)を行い、精巣の上皮内癌、セミノーマ、胎児性癌を術中に診断する方法を検証した研究です。1500例の4093検体で評価し、これらの腫瘍はいずれも陽性を示しました。パラフィン切片の病理診断と一致しました。精巣温存手術での有用性が期待されています。
pmid-21323965.summary_en: This study evaluated a rapid intraoperative test using direct enzymatic alkaline phosphatase (dAP) activity on frozen sections to diagnose testicular carcinoma in situ, seminoma, and embryonal carcinoma. Across 4093 frozen samples from 1500 patients, dAP staining was positive in all CIS, seminoma, and embryonal carcinoma cases, and variable in differentiated non-seminomas, while most other testicular lesions and normal tissue were negative. Results matched H&E and immunohistochemistry on paraffin sections. The authors conclude the test is reproducible and easy to use, valuable for testis-sparing surgery.

pmid-21325635.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患および絨毛癌でPAK4が過剰発現することを示した研究です。hCGとPI3K/PKB経路がPAK4の発現と活性化を調節していました。絨毛癌細胞株において、PAK4は増殖、遊走、浸潤を促進し、MT1-MMPの転写を制御していました。
pmid-21325635.summary_en: This study shows that PAK4 is overexpressed in gestational trophoblastic disease, including choriocarcinoma, and in choriocarcinoma cell lines. hCG and PI3K/PKB signaling regulate PAK4 expression and activation. In JEG3 and JAR choriocarcinoma cells, PAK4 overexpression increased proliferation, migration, and invasion, while knockdown reduced them, with changes in CDK6, MT1-MMP, and p16. PAK4 was found to transcriptionally regulate MT1-MMP, and its expression correlated with the proliferation marker MCM7.

pmid-21330840.summary_ja: 本研究は、悪性転化した胞状奇胎と良性の完全胞状奇胎をプロテオーム解析で比較した。18種のタンパク質に発現差を認め、そのうちCLIC1を検証した。CLIC1は絨毛癌および悪性転化した胞状奇胎で高発現であり、予後バイオマーカーの候補として提案された。ただし各群3例と症例数が少ない点に留意が必要である。
pmid-21330840.summary_en: This proteomic study compared protein profiles of complete hydatidiform moles that did or did not undergo malignant transformation. Eighteen proteins were differentially expressed, and chloride intracellular channel protein 1 (CLIC1) was selected for validation. CLIC1 expression was higher in choriocarcinoma than in complete moles and was also elevated in malignant-transformed moles compared with non-transformed moles. The authors propose CLIC1 as a potential prognostic biomarker for hydatidiform moles at risk of malignant transformation, although each group contained only three samples.

pmid-21331529.summary_ja: NMDA受容体抗体脳炎の総説である。当初は卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性現象として報告されたが、多くは腫瘍を伴わず、男性や小児も発症することが示されている。早期診断と免疫療法、必要に応じた腫瘍摘出が回復を促す。抗体価は臨床重症度と相関し、海馬ニューロンのNMDA受容体を減少させることから、直接的な病原性が示唆されている。
pmid-21331529.summary_en: This article reviews NMDA receptor antibody encephalitis, an immunotherapy-responsive encephalitis first described as a paraneoplastic phenomenon in young women with ovarian teratomas. The authors note that most patients, especially children, have no tumor, and that males can also be affected. Early diagnosis, immunotherapy, and tumor removal when relevant all promote recovery. Antibody levels correlate with clinical severity and reduce NMDA receptors on hippocampal neurons, supporting direct pathogenicity.

pmid-21331937.summary_ja: 精巣がんにおける陽電子放射断層撮影（PET）の役割を解説した章である。原発巣の画像診断にはコンピュータ断層撮影（CT）が第一選択であり、FDG-PETは化学療法後の残存腫瘤評価、特にセミノーマで有用とされる。非セミノーマでは成熟奇形腫による偽陰性が問題となる。3cmを超えるセミノーマ残存病変で再発予測に最も優れ、PET-CTがPET単独より優れるという証拠はまだない。
pmid-21331937.summary_en: This chapter reviews the role of PET in testicular cancer, which is divided into seminomatous and nonseminomatous tumors. F-18 FDG PET is not used for primary tumor imaging, where CT is preferred, but it is valuable for assessing residual masses after chemotherapy, especially in pure seminoma. In nonseminomatous tumors it is limited by false-negative results in mature teratoma. FDG-PET best predicts relapse in seminoma residuals larger than 3 cm, and PET-CT has not been shown to be superior to PET alone.

pmid-21334049.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の術前評価における造影超音波検査（CEUS）の実現可能性を検討した研究である。51例中50例で造影効果を確認でき、早期の過剰造影は腫瘍性病変に対して陽性的中率97.4%を示した。非腫瘍性病変では8例中7例で過剰造影を認めなかった。小型の精巣内腫瘤の評価において、従来の超音波検査の限界を補う可能性が示された。
pmid-21334049.summary_en: This feasibility study evaluated contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) with SonoVue in 51 patients with testicular masses before surgery. Contrast enhancement was visible in 50 of 51 patients. Early hyperenhancement had a positive predictive value of 97.4% for neoplasia and was absent in 7 of 8 nonneoplastic lesions. The authors conclude that CEUS visualizes testicular microvasculature and may aid preoperative assessment of small intratesticular masses where color-coded ultrasound is limited.

pmid-21339268.summary_ja: 15歳女児の抗NMDA受容体脳炎で、発作時に心静止を伴う側頭葉発作を生じた症例報告。骨盤超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で卵巣奇形腫を認め、外科的切除後に精神症状は改善した。フェノバルビタールにもかかわらず徐脈が持続し、ペースメーカーを要した。小児例では心臓の監視が重要と強調している。
pmid-21339268.summary_en: A 15-year-old girl with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis developed focal seizures with ictal asystole, a potentially fatal complication not previously described in this disorder. An ovarian teratoma was found on pelvic ultrasound and CT, and its surgical resection was followed by neuropsychiatric improvement. Bradycardia persisted despite phenobarbital, requiring demand pacemaker placement. Immunotherapy with intravenous immunoglobulin was also given. The authors emphasize careful cardiac monitoring in pediatric patients with this disorder.

pmid-21344217.summary_ja: 2002年から2010年に仙尾部奇形腫19例を後方矢状アプローチのみで切除した単施設の報告。17例で完全切除が得られ、2例は局所進展により残存病変があった。創部離開は4例に生じたが自然治癒した。大きな腫瘤も切除可能で、臀溝は保たれ整容性は良好だった。
pmid-21344217.summary_en: Nineteen sacrococcygeal teratomas were resected exclusively via a posterior sagittal approach between 2002 and 2010. Patients were positioned in knee-chest, with elliptical incision, coccygectomy and layered closure. Complete resection was achieved in 17 patients, while two had residual disease from local extension. Minor wound dehiscence healed spontaneously in four. Even very large masses could be excised, and cosmetic results with preserved gluteal folds were satisfactory. The authors conclude this approach is feasible with good access and cosmetic outcomes.

pmid-21345404.summary_ja: 子宮内膜に原発した稀な卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告と文献レビュー。両側卵管卵巣摘出を伴わない単純子宮全摘術の後、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン療法を3コース施行した。胚細胞腫瘍の稀な発生部位として、付属器を温存する子宮全摘と標準的な化学療法の組み合わせを示している。
pmid-21345404.summary_en: A rare primary yolk sac tumor arising in the endometrium is described. Treatment consisted of simple total hysterectomy without bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, followed by three cycles of the bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin regimen. The case report is accompanied by a review of the literature on this unusual site of origin. The report underlines that this site can be managed with hysterectomy that preserves the adnexa, followed by standard germ cell chemotherapy.

pmid-21347634.summary_ja: 学際的作業部会が、早期精巣セミノーマ（病期I～IIA/B）治療後のフォローアップに関するエビデンスを、放射線腫瘍学的側面に焦点を当てて検討した。病期Iでは、積極的監視、補助的カルボプラチン、放射線療法がいずれも同等に受け入れられているが、それぞれ再発パターンが異なる。再発は通常2～6年以内に起こる。定期的なCTフォローアップで検出される再発は少なく、3～4か月ごとの定期検査は支持されない。著者らは、二次性悪性腫瘍のリスクを抑えるため、放射線を用いる画像検査の制限的な使用を推奨している。
pmid-21347634.summary_en: An interdisciplinary working group reviewed evidence on follow-up after early-stage testicular seminoma (stages I to IIA/B), focusing on radiooncological aspects. Active surveillance, adjuvant carboplatin, and radiotherapy are equally accepted for stage I, each with different relapse patterns. Relapses usually occur within two to six years. Routine CT follow-up detects few recurrences, so routine scans every 3 to 4 months are not supported. The authors recommend restrictive use of radiation-emitting imaging to limit secondary malignancy risk.

pmid-21347845.summary_ja: 本研究はマウスの変異系統MommeR1で転写因子Foxo3aのミスセンス変異を同定し、その変異が雌の加齢性不妊と奇形腫の発生に関与することを示した。ホモ接合体の約6分の1の雌に奇形腫が生じ、排卵卵子にも異常が認められた。著者らは奇形腫発生の研究モデルとして有用であり、Foxo3aを単為生殖や卵巣癌と結びつけるものだと述べている。
pmid-21347845.summary_en: This mouse study identifies a missense mutation in the transcription factor Foxo3a in the MommeR1 line, which shows female-specific, age-associated infertility. Compound heterozygote complementation confirmed Foxo3a as causative. About one in six female homozygotes developed teratomas, a phenotype absent in Foxo3a-null mice, and their ovulated oocytes showed multiple abnormalities. The authors propose this model for investigating teratocarcinogenesis and linking Foxo3a to parthenogenesis and ovarian cancer.

pmid-21352709.summary_ja: 若年女性の下腹部痛で受診した2症例において、卵巣奇形腫が当初虫垂炎と誤診された経緯を報告している。若年女性では婦人科疾患と腸疾患の鑑別が重要であり、検査所見は特異度が低く、超音波検査やCTにも限界があると指摘する。急性腹痛の正確な評価には外科医の経験が最も重要だと強調している。
pmid-21352709.summary_en: This report presents two young women with lower abdominal pain whose ovarian teratomas were initially misdiagnosed as appendicitis. The authors note that in young women, gynecologic conditions must be distinguished from bowel disease, that laboratory tests lack specificity, and that ultrasonography and CT have limitations. They emphasize that surgical experience is the most important factor in correctly evaluating acute abdominal pain.

pmid-21355679.summary_ja: 2歳男児で、左根治的精巣摘除術を受けた2か月後に精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の馬尾転移が判明した症例を報告している。CTとMRIで脊椎および馬尾の病変が確認された。胚細胞腫瘍の脊椎転移は極めてまれであり、小児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の馬尾転移の初報告だと述べている。
pmid-21355679.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy who developed cauda equina metastasis from a testicular yolk sac tumor, diagnosed two months after left radical orchiectomy. CT and MRI showed spinal and cauda equina involvement. Spinal metastasis of germ cell tumors is extremely rare, and the authors state this is the first reported case of testicular yolk sac tumor metastasis to the cauda equina in a child.

pmid-21355958.summary_ja: 74歳男性の胃癌に絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分が併存した症例報告である。11cmの潰瘍を伴う出血性腫瘍で、各成分はCEA、hCGのβサブユニット、AFPに免疫反応性を示した。胚細胞腫瘍成分を伴う胃癌はまれで、絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍を併せ持つ胃癌の報告は本例が2例目とされる。
pmid-21355958.summary_en: This case report describes a 74-year-old man with gastric adenocarcinoma containing concurrent choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor components. The 11 cm ulcerated hemorrhagic tumor showed intermingled components immunoreactive for CEA, hCG beta-subunit, and AFP respectively. The authors note germ cell tumor components in gastric cancer are uncommon and that this is only the second reported case combining choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor components.

pmid-21362294.summary_ja: 35歳女性の急性右下腹部痛に対し腹腔鏡下嚢胞摘出術を行ったところ、単一卵巣に子宮内膜症と良性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）が併存していた症例報告である。Endobagの使用や大きな卵巣腫瘤への腹腔鏡手術の利点を述べている。このような併存はまれであり、誤診防止のため外科医の経験とフォローアップが重要だとしている。
pmid-21362294.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman with acute right lower abdominal pain in whom laparoscopic cystectomy of a single ovary revealed coexisting endometriosis and a benign mature teratoma (dermoid cyst). The authors describe the use of an Endobag for specimen retrieval, discuss laparoscopic approaches for large ovarian masses, and stress that such coexistence is rare, requiring careful follow-up and surgical experience to avoid misdiagnosis.

pmid-21370434.summary_ja: 1992年から2006年にパリの小児病院で治療された卵巣奇形腫の小児30例を後方視的に検討した。全体の42%の腫瘍で卵巣温存手術が行われた。対側卵巣に新たな卵巣奇形腫が発生した症例は4例で、いずれも卵巣温存手術で管理された。局在性の成熟奇形腫で条件を満たす症例に限定することで、腫瘍学的予後を損なわずに妊孕性を温存できる可能性が示された。長期フォローアップの重要性も強調されている。
pmid-21370434.summary_en: This retrospective study from a Paris pediatric hospital (1992 to 2006) included 30 children with ovarian teratoma. Ovarian-sparing surgery was performed for 15 tumors (42% overall). Four patients developed teratoma in the contralateral ovary, all managed with ovarian-sparing surgery. One child with bilateral synchronous tumors underwent oophorectomy three years later for recurrence. The authors recommend ovarian-sparing surgery for localized mature teratoma meeting strict criteria, while emphasizing that long-term follow-up is crucial.

pmid-21376111.summary_ja: 精巣原発セミノーマ25例を対象に、高解像度SNPアレイでコピー数多型とヘテロ接合性の消失を解析した。既報のゲノム変化を確認するとともに、増幅や相同性欠失を含む8つの新規ゲノム異常を同定した。早期と進行期の比較では、進行と関連するコピー数多型が見つかった。発現解析との相関も示され、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症機序の理解に寄与すると考えられる。
pmid-21376111.summary_en: This study performed genome-wide copy number and loss-of-heterozygosity analysis of 25 primary testicular seminomas using high-resolution SNP arrays. It confirmed several previously reported alterations and identified eight novel changes, including amplifications and homozygous deletions. Comparing early and late stage tumors revealed copy number variations associated with progression. Copy number findings correlated with expression data and quantitative PCR, providing insight into the pathogenesis of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-21376186.summary_ja: 乳児期の巨大後腹膜奇形腫に対し、副腎上および副腎下の大静脈を腎静脈開口部を含めて選択的に切除した手術を報告する。画像検査と開腹時に圧排された腹部静脈を評価し、血管損傷を避けた。腎静脈の側副血行路を慎重に温存することで、出血や腎機能障害のリスクを抑えられる可能性がある。適切に選ばれた症例では、忍容性の高い先制的な血管管理の選択肢となり得る。
pmid-21376186.summary_en: This report describes elective excision of a giant retroperitoneal teratoma in infancy using suprarenal and infrarenal cavectomy, including both renal vein ostia. Preoperative imaging and laparotomy were used to identify displaced abdominal veins and avoid inadvertent vessel injury. The authors describe the technique as aiming to prevent major bleeding, renal disturbance and recurrence while preserving renal venous collaterals. In selected cases, such preemptive vascular management may be a well-tolerated option for reducing surgical complication risk.

pmid-21376212.summary_ja: 妊娠32週の胎児が巨大仙尾部奇形腫により心血管系の不安定性を来した症例を報告する。緊急帝王切開後、テフロン付きマットレス縫合によるダメージコントロール手術で腫瘍内出血を制御した。1週間後に全身状態を安定させ、骨盤部を含めた腫瘍を段階的に待機的切除した。生後30日目に退院し、30か月齢でも良好な経過をたどっている。巨大仙尾部奇形腫においてダメージコントロール手術が有用であることを示す。
pmid-21376212.summary_en: A fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma developed high-output cardiovascular instability at 32 weeks' gestation. After urgent cesarean delivery, a damage-control operation using Teflon-pledgeted mattress sutures controlled bleeding into the tumor. One week later, after resuscitation and stabilization, a staged elective complete resection including the pelvic portion was performed. The infant was discharged on postoperative day 30 and was doing well at 30 months of age. The case underscores the value of damage-control surgery in massive sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-21377010.summary_ja: 化学療法後の残存頸部腫瘤切除を受けた41例を検討した。組織学的には奇形腫が56.1%、線維化が34.2%、生存腫瘍が7.3%であった。頸部と後腹膜リンパ節郭清の組織所見は22.5%で不一致であった。頸部に再発例はなく、腹膜外で生存腫瘍が残存した例では予後が不良であった。残存頸部腫瘤の切除は局所制御と長期的な病勢制御に寄与すると結論づけられた。
pmid-21377010.summary_en: This study reviewed 41 patients who underwent resection of residual neck masses after chemotherapy for germ cell tumors, among 968 postchemotherapy RPLNDs performed at one institution from 1987 to 2008. Histology showed teratoma in 56%, fibrosis in 34%, and viable germ cell tumor in 7%. Histologic discordance between neck and RPLND specimens occurred in 22.5%. At median follow-up of 49.5 months, no neck recurrences occurred, while patients with viable cancer at extraretroperitoneal sites had poorer survival. The authors recommend resecting residual neck masses for local control.

pmid-21377742.summary_ja: 出生前超音波検査で口腔内腫瘤と診断された女児に対し、計画的なEXIT手術で気道を確保した症例を報告する。エピグナトス奇形腫は生後3日目に切除された。出生前画像診断とEXIT手術の発展により、この疾患をもつ新生児の生存例は増加している。気道障害が懸念される場合には、多職種による連携と確定治療に向けた十分な精査が重要である。
pmid-21377742.summary_en: A female infant was diagnosed prenatally with an oral mass on ultrasound and underwent a planned EXIT procedure to secure the airway. The epignathus teratoma was excised at 3 days of age. The authors note improved survival of neonates with epignathus teratomas over the past decade, owing to better prenatal imaging and the development of the EXIT procedure. The case emphasizes that a multidisciplinary approach is essential when prenatal diagnosis raises concern for airway compromise, with thorough workup needed for definitive management.

pmid-21378019.summary_ja: 29歳の男性が胸痛を主訴として受診した。初回CTでは、左前縦隔に脂肪を含む嚢胞性腫瘍があり、胸水と下葉の浸潤影を伴っていた。肺炎、胸膜炎および奇形腫破裂が考えられ、抗菌薬が投与された。18時間後の再検CTで腫瘍に隣接する胸壁軟部組織の増大がみられ、破裂奇形腫と確定診断された。直ちに切除が行われた。病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫であり、胸水中のリパーゼ高値により破裂が確認された。術後経過は順調であった。
pmid-21378019.summary_en: A 29-year-old man presented with chest pain, and initial CT showed a fat-containing cystic tumor in the left anterior mediastinum with pleural effusion and lower-lobe consolidation. Pneumonia, pleuritis and ruptured teratoma were considered, and antibiotics were started. A repeat CT 18 hours later showed increased chest wall soft tissue adjacent to the tumor, establishing the diagnosis of ruptured teratoma. Immediate resection was performed. Histology showed mature teratoma, and high pleural fluid lipase confirmed rupture. The postoperative course was uneventful.

pmid-21381029.summary_ja: 本研究では、ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるエストロゲン受容体βと転写共役因子PATZ1を検討した。ERβの発現は、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、混合型胚細胞腫瘍で著しく低下しているが、奇形腫では高値を維持していた。セミノーマでは、ERβの発現低下がPATZ1の核からの局在異常と関連していた。cAMPはPATZ1の移行とERβの発現を調節し、その効果は抗エストロゲン剤ICI 182,780によって打ち消された。これらの知見は、エストロゲンシグナル伝達と精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生との間の機序的関連を示唆している。
pmid-21381029.summary_en: This study examines the estrogen receptor-β (ERβ) and transcriptional co-regulator PATZ1 in human testicular germ cell tumors. ERβ expression is markedly reduced in seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, and mixed germ cell tumors, but remains high in teratomas. In seminomas, decreased ERβ is associated with delocalization of PATZ1 from the nucleus. cAMP regulates PATZ1 translocation and ERβ expression, and this effect is counteracted by the antiestrogen ICI 182,780. The findings suggest a mechanistic link between estrogen signaling and testicular germ cell tumorigenesis.

pmid-21383636.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の16歳男性が、精巣摘除術の後にブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法を受けました。初回化学療法後に精神病を発症し、がんの診断や治療によるストレス、家族などの心理社会的要因、既往の外傷性脳損傷、ステロイド投与など多因子が関与したと考察されています。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療中に精神症状が起こりうることを示した症例です。
pmid-21383636.summary_en: The authors describe a 16-year-old male with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis, treated with orchiectomy followed by bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy. After the first chemotherapy cycle, he developed new-onset psychosis. The authors attribute it to multifactorial causes, including cancer-related stress, family and psychosocial stressors, prior traumatic brain injury, and corticosteroid medication. The case highlights that psychiatric reactions can complicate testicular germ cell tumor treatment and should be recognized and managed.

pmid-21383689.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍においてdynamin 3遺伝子内の領域が高メチル化され、miR-199a-5p/3pの発現が抑制され、その程度が悪性度と相関することを示しています。精巣がん細胞へのmiR-199a再発現は増殖・遊走・浸潤・転移を抑制しました。胎児性癌抗原であるPODXLがmiR-199a-5pの標的として同定され、悪性精巣腫瘍で過剰発現していました。
pmid-21383689.summary_en: This study shows that hypermethylation of an intronic region in the dynamin 3 locus silences miR-199a-5p/3p in testicular tumors, and this correlates with malignancy. Re-expressing miR-199a in testicular cancer cells suppressed growth, migration, invasion, and metastasis. The authors identify podocalyxin-like protein 1 (PODXL), an embryonal carcinoma antigen, as a direct target of miR-199a-5p, and PODXL is overexpressed in malignant testicular tumors. PODXL depletion reduced invasion. The authors propose DNA methylation, miR-199a dysregulation, and PODXL as key factors in testicular tumor malignancy.

pmid-21383853.summary_ja: 抗β-hCG抗体を結合させた磁性Fe3O4-デキストランナノ粒子を、絨毛癌を標的とする遺伝子ベクターとして開発しました。粒子径は約75.5nmで、37.5μg/mL未満では細胞毒性がなく、DNAを結合・保護し、リポソームより高効率に遺伝子を導入しました。ヌードマウスの移植絨毛癌腫瘍や絨毛癌細胞に集積することが示されています。
pmid-21383853.summary_en: The authors synthesized magnetic Fe3O4-dextran nanoparticles conjugated to anti-β-hCG antibody as a gene vector targeting choriocarcinoma. The particles were about 75.5 nm in diameter, showed no cytotoxicity below 37.5 μg/mL, bound DNA, and protected it from DNase I. They transfected reporter genes more efficiently than liposomes and concentrated in choriocarcinoma cells and transplanted tumors in nude mice. The results suggest a secure, effective, choriocarcinoma-specific targeting vector for gene delivery.

pmid-21384681.summary_ja: 胸痛のある18歳男性で、前縦隔腫瘍と血清AFP高値が認められました。PETでは縦隔腫瘍に強い集積があり、精巣には異常集積はありませんでした。生検で未熟な軟骨様組織を含む壊死組織が確認され、縦隔原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断されています。BEP療法4コースでAFPと腫瘍は縮小し、切除後の病理では生存腫瘍細胞はなく、9か月以上再発はありません。
pmid-21384681.summary_en: The authors report an 18-year-old man with an anterior mediastinal tumor and elevated serum AFP. FDG-PET showed intense uptake in the mediastinal mass, with no uptake in the testes. Needle biopsy revealed necrotic tissue containing immature cartilage-like elements, leading to a diagnosis of mixed germ cell tumor of mediastinal origin. Four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin reduced AFP and tumor size. Complete resection after chemotherapy showed no viable cells, and there was no recurrence for more than nine months.

pmid-21385659.summary_ja: 右下腹部痛、嘔気、発熱、食欲不振を訴えた5歳女児の症例です。診察と腹部CTから虫垂炎と診断されましたが、手術で嚢胞性奇形腫を伴う急性卵巣捻転と確定しました。小児の卵巣捻転は穿孔性虫垂炎と類似し、診断が遅れると卵巣機能を失うおそれがあるため、救急外来での注意が強調されています。
pmid-21385659.summary_en: The authors describe a 5-year-old girl who presented to the emergency department with right lower abdominal pain, nausea, fever, and anorexia. She was initially diagnosed with appendicitis based on examination and abdominal CT. At surgery, the final diagnosis was acute ovarian torsion complicated by a cystic teratoma. The report emphasizes that pediatric ovarian torsion can mimic perforated appendicitis and should be considered promptly to preserve ovarian function.

pmid-21387328.summary_ja: 妊娠12週1日の頸部透明帯計測時に、仙尾部奇形腫を疑う仙骨前部腫瘤が発見されました。二次元超音波で診断可能で、三次元超音波はより分かりやすい画像を提供し、両親への出生前カウンセリングに役立ちました。胎児の剖検で2型の良性未熟奇形腫と確定しています。妊娠初期での仙尾部奇形腫の診断例として示されています。
pmid-21387328.summary_en: The authors report a presacral mass detected during first-trimester nuchal translucency measurement at 12+1 weeks of gestation, suggestive of sacrococcygeal teratoma. Two-dimensional ultrasound made the diagnosis possible, and three-dimensional ultrasound provided more recognizable images that aided prenatal counseling for the parents. Postmortem examination of the fetus confirmed a type 2 benign immature teratoma. The case shows that sacrococcygeal teratoma can be diagnosed in the first trimester and that 3D imaging supports counseling.

pmid-21387329.summary_ja: 本症例は、妊娠16週の胎児に持続的な開口が見られたことから疑われ、20週で診断された頭蓋内進展を伴う口腔奇形腫(エピグナトゥス)の報告です。死後MRIと病理検査で、両側脳室拡大、脳梁欠損、神経上皮性頭蓋内嚢胞が確認されました。原発は口腔であり中枢神経系ではないため、胚細胞腫瘍の症例として扱います。関連文献もレビューされています。
pmid-21387329.summary_en: This case report describes an epignathus, an oral teratoma with intracranial extension, first suspected at 16 weeks' gestation from a persistently open fetal mouth and confirmed at 20 weeks. Postmortem MRI and pathology showed an oral teratoma with bilateral ventricular dilatation, corpus callosum agenesis, and a neuroepithelial intracranial cyst. The authors review the literature on this rare anomaly. The primary tumor arose in the oral cavity, not the central nervous system.

pmid-21389861.summary_ja: 57歳女性が腹痛、嘔吐、腸閉塞で受診し、CTでニボー形成が確認されました。手術で回腸末端のカルチノイド腫瘍と右卵巣類皮嚢腫が同時に見つかり、右半結腸切除と卵巣摘出が行われました。小腸カルチノイドと卵巣類皮嚢腫の併存は、英語文献で報告がない初の症例とされています。
pmid-21389861.summary_en: A 57-year-old woman presented with abdominal pain, vomiting, and bowel obstruction. CT showed hydroaeric levels, and surgery revealed a terminal ileal carcinoid tumor alongside a right ovarian dermoid cyst. She underwent right hemicolectomy and oophorectomy. The authors report the first described coexistence of small intestinal carcinoid and ovarian dermoid cyst, noting that no prior English literature reports this association.

pmid-21393898.summary_ja: 43歳男性が2年半にわたる精巣腫瘤で精巣摘除術を受けました。組織学的に、未分化肉腫成分を伴う精母細胞性セミノーマと診断されました。9か月後に陰嚢内腫瘤の再発と両側肺転移が生じています。肉腫成分への変化が、通常は緩徐な経過をとるセミノーマの予後を大きく変えうることが示されています。
pmid-21393898.summary_en: A 43-year-old man with a testicular mass for two and a half years underwent orchidectomy. Histology showed spermatocytic seminoma with an undifferentiated sarcomatous component, a combination associated with aggressive behavior. Nine months later, he developed a recurrent scrotal mass and bilateral pulmonary metastases. The report highlights how sarcomatous transformation can change the prognosis of an otherwise indolent spermatocytic seminoma.

pmid-21394177.summary_ja: 本総説は、精巣超音波検査で偶然に見つかることの多い精巣微小石灰化と、精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)および未分類型管内胚細胞腫瘍との関連を扱っている。精巣微小石灰化は精巣異形成症候群の特徴であり、TGCTと共通する遺伝的基盤があることを論じている。著者らは、健康な人、TGCT患者、異形成症候群の患者それぞれにおいて、精巣微小石灰化が精巣生検の判断にどう影響するかを検討し、依然として残る臨床上のジレンマを指摘している。
pmid-21394177.summary_en: This review covers testicular microlithiasis, an incidental finding on testicular ultrasound, and its association with testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) and intratubular germ cell neoplasia of unclassified type. It discusses TM as a feature of testicular dysgenesis syndrome and the genetic basis shared with TGCT. The authors examine how TM affects testicular biopsy decisions in healthy individuals, TGCT patients, and those with dysgenesis syndrome, noting persistent clinical dilemmas.

pmid-21395467.summary_ja: スウェーデンの登録データを用いて、1973〜2004年の胞状奇胎3,844例を解析しました。発生率は出生1,000件あたり1.2で、期間中に増加していました。20歳未満と39歳超で高く、二峰性の分布を示しています。奇胎後の絨毛癌は1.3%で、既往のない女性(0.005%)より高率でした。
pmid-21395467.summary_en: A Swedish registry study analyzed 3,844 hydatidiform mole cases from 1973 to 2004, finding an incidence of 1.2 per 1,000 deliveries that increased over time. The incidence was bimodal, peaking in women under 20 and over 39. Choriocarcinoma occurred in 1.3% of women after a molar pregnancy versus 0.005% without one, and 37% of registered choriocarcinoma cases followed a molar pregnancy. About 17% of molar cases were missing from the cancer register.

pmid-21402494.summary_ja: 46,XY純粋性腺異形成に伴うディスジャーミノーマ6例の症例集積である。診断時年齢の中央値は11歳で、全例に性腺芽腫の病巣を認めた。AFPは正常、LDHは高値、hCGは正常から中等度であったが、1例は絨毛癌成分を伴う混合型でhCGが高値であった。FSHは著明に高値であった。思春期遅延、中等度のhCG、高FSHは術前の核型検査の契機となるとしている。
pmid-21402494.summary_en: This six-patient case series reviews dysgerminoma arising in 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis. Patients were diagnosed at a median age of 11 years, with delayed or absent puberty, gonadoblastoma foci in all cases, normal AFP, high LDH, and moderate hCG. One mixed tumor had a choriocarcinoma component with high hCG. FSH was markedly elevated. The authors propose that delayed puberty, moderate hCG, and high FSH should prompt karyotype analysis before surgery in suspected ovarian tumors.

pmid-21403518.summary_ja: 14例の同側精巣セミノーマを対象に、免疫組織化学と直接シーケンスによりKITおよびPDGFRAの変異と発現を検討した。KIT変異は36%に認められ、エクソン17のコドン816付近に集中した。KIT変異陽性例では発現が強かった。PDGFRA変異は認められなかった。精巣セミノーマの一部にKIT変異が見られることが示された。
pmid-21403518.summary_en: The study examined KIT and PDGFRA mutations and protein expression in 14 ipsilateral testicular seminomas using immunohistochemistry and direct sequencing. KIT mutations were found in 36% of cases, clustering around codon 816 of exon 17, and KIT expression was stronger in mutation-positive tumors. No PDGFRA mutations were detected, though PDGFRA protein was weakly expressed in most cases. The findings suggest KIT mutations are a feature of a subset of testicular seminomas.

pmid-21404199.summary_ja: イランで初めてとなる病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞精巣腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の症例集積である。19例の平均手術時間は340分で、2例が開腹移行した。42%でリンパ節転移を認め、一部は奇形腫であった。平均47か月のフォローアップで2例に再発を認めたが、全身転移はなかった。腹腔鏡下手術は開腹手術と同等の腫瘍学的成績が期待できるとしている。
pmid-21404199.summary_en: This report describes the first Iranian case series of laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testis tumors in 19 patients. Mean operation time was 340 minutes, and 2 cases were converted to open surgery. Lymph node involvement was found in 42%, including teratoma in some. Over a mean follow-up of 47 months, recurrence occurred in 2 patients, and no systemic metastasis developed. The authors conclude laparoscopic RPLND offers oncologic outcomes comparable to open surgery.

pmid-21404205.summary_ja: 陰嚢腫脹を訴えた120例を対象とした前向き症例集積研究で、カラードプラ超音波検査の診断精度を最終診断と比較した。精巣炎、精巣捻転、精索静脈瘤、水瘤の診断精度は高かった。精巣悪性腫瘍と診断された16例中14例が確認され、精巣炎と診断された1例はセミノーマであった。全体の感度は98%、特異度は66.7%であった。
pmid-21404205.summary_en: This prospective case series of 120 patients with scrotal swelling assessed color Doppler ultrasonography against final diagnoses. CDUS was highly accurate for epididymitis, torsion, varicocele and hydrocele. Among 16 cases diagnosed as testicular malignancy, 14 were confirmed, and one orchitis case was a seminoma. Overall sensitivity was 98% and specificity 66.7%. The authors conclude CDUS is a reliable tool that aids diagnosis of testicular tumors and reduces unnecessary exploration.

pmid-21412759.summary_ja: SEERデータを用い、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で積極的監視を選んだ群と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた群の二次悪性腫瘍リスクを比較した。全体では有意な増加は見られなかったが、45歳超で郭清を見送った患者では非外科的管理が独立した予測因子であった。監視中の画像検査による放射線被ばくや化学療法が、長期的な健康リスクに影響する可能性がある。
pmid-21412759.summary_en: Using SEER data, this study compared second malignancy risk among testicular cancer survivors with clinical stage I NSGCT who chose active surveillance versus those who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. No overall increase was found, but in men over 45 who forewent RPLND, nonsurgical management was an independent predictor of second malignancy. The authors estimated excess cases per 10,000 patients at 5, 10, and 15 years. They conclude that foregoing RPLND may carry greater long-term health risks, potentially related to imaging radiation and chemotherapy.

pmid-21413852.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの10例で、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)に基づく従来型放射線療法と骨髄温存型強度変調放射線療法(BMS-IMRT)の治療計画を比較した。標的の被覆は両法で同等であり、従来法がわずかに優れていた。BMS-IMRTは活動性骨髄の平均線量を5.2Gy有意に低下させ、腸、胃、膵臓の線量も減少させた。急性および長期毒性や二次がんのリスク低減が期待される。
pmid-21413852.summary_en: This treatment planning study compared conventional CT-based radiotherapy with bone marrow-sparing intensity-modulated radiation therapy (BMS-IMRT) in 10 patients with Stage I seminoma, aiming to deliver 20 Gy to para-aortic nodes. Target coverage was similar, with conventional planning slightly better. BMS-IMRT significantly reduced mean dose to active bone marrow by 5.2 Gy and lowered dose-volume parameters for bowel, stomach, and pancreas. The authors conclude that BMS-IMRT could reduce acute and long-term toxicity and the risk of secondary cancers.

pmid-21415659.summary_ja: 下垂体重複、鼻咽頭奇形腫、口蓋裂、視床下部過誤腫を併発した患者の症例を報告し、その外科的管理について述べている。鼻咽頭奇形腫が下垂体重複や口蓋裂の原因であるのか、あるいは脊索突起の原発性重複に由来するのかが議論されている。奇形腫は性腺外に発生したもので、中枢神経系の原発性胚細胞腫瘍ではない。
pmid-21415659.summary_en: This clinical report describes a patient with pituitary gland duplication accompanied by a nasopharyngeal teratoma, cleft palate, and hypothalamic hamartoma, and details the surgical management. The authors discuss whether the nasopharyngeal teratoma causes the pituitary duplication and cleft palate or whether all malformations arise from a primary duplication of the notochordal process. Various theories are presented, but the exact cause remains unresolved. The teratoma is extragonadal and not a primary central nervous system germ cell tumor.

pmid-21415749.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後の外科的管理について、手術の適応と議論の残る点を総説している。画像上の完全奏効が得られた患者の約30%で、後腹膜に生存がんや奇形腫が存在していた。化学療法を初回に受けた転移性非セミノーマでは、両側神経温存型の後腹膜リンパ節郭清が治療の第一選択とされる。残存病変のすべての部位の外科的切除が重要である。
pmid-21415749.summary_en: This review summarizes the surgical management of metastatic testicular germ cell tumors after chemotherapy, focusing on indications for surgery and controversies. Nearly 30% of patients with a complete radiographic response harbor viable cancer or teratoma in the retroperitoneum. Bilateral nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection is considered the preferred approach for metastatic nonseminoma treated initially with chemotherapy. The authors conclude that surgical resection of all residual disease sites remains essential to multidisciplinary care.

pmid-21418397.summary_ja: 49歳男性の縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例で、高分化腺癌と多形癌を含み、G-CSFの上昇と白血球増多を伴っていた。免疫組織化学的に両癌成分がG-CSFとIL-6受容体を産生し、活性化STAT3も発現していた。全身症状出現後6か月で患者は死亡しており、早期診断と完全切除の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-21418397.summary_en: This case report describes a 49-year-old man with a mediastinal mature cystic teratoma containing well-differentiated adenocarcinoma and pleomorphic carcinoma, presenting with elevated G-CSF and leukocytosis. Immunohistochemistry showed both carcinoma components produced G-CSF and IL-6 receptor, and activated STAT3 was expressed. The tumor was diagnosed as a G-CSF- and IL-6R-producing mature cystic teratoma with somatic-type malignancy. The patient died six months after systemic symptoms developed, and the authors emphasize early diagnosis and complete resection.

pmid-21418398.summary_ja: 17歳女性の後腹膜原発ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例報告。副腎腫瘍様の10cm大の腫瘤として発見され、切除標本の組織像と胚細胞系免疫表現型から診断された。術後6か月の超音波検査、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)で卵巣病変は認めず、性腺外原発と判断された。補助化学療法後も残存病変が疑われ、文献的考察を加えている。
pmid-21418398.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old girl with a primary retroperitoneal dysgerminoma that initially presented as a 10 cm adrenal-region mass. Histology and germ cell immunophenotype confirmed dysgerminoma. Ultrasonography, CT, and PET over six months showed no ovarian lesion, supporting a primary extragonadal origin. After adjuvant chemotherapy, a residual lesion was suspicious. The paper also reviews primary extragonadal germ cell tumors, which are rare and mostly nonseminomatous in young men.

pmid-21420231.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対し、ロボット支援腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した連続3例の初期経験。改変テンプレート神経温存法で施行し、平均年齢31歳、出血量150〜200ml、手術時間150〜240分、在院日数2日で周術期合併症はなかった。症例数が限られるため、大規模症例での長期フォローアップが必要とされる。
pmid-21420231.summary_en: This report presents the first series of three consecutive patients undergoing robot-assisted laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer. A modified template nerve-sparing approach was used. Mean age was 31 years, blood loss 150-200 ml, operative time 150-240 min, and hospital stay 2 days, with no perioperative complications. The authors note this is limited early experience and call for long-term follow-up in larger cohorts.

pmid-21421533.summary_ja: 放射線療法を受けた病期I精巣セミノーマ患者10例を対象に、末梢リンパ球の染色体異常解析でゲノム損傷の消失過程を追跡した研究。治療終了から7年後も環状染色体と二動原体染色体の頻度はベースラインより有意に高値のままであり、ゲノム不安定性の持続が示された。二次性腫瘍のリスク評価や放射線防護の基礎データとしての意義が述べられている。
pmid-21421533.summary_en: This long-term follow-up study assessed how genome damage from radiotherapy is eliminated in ten men with stage I testicular seminoma. Peripheral lymphocyte DNA damage was measured by chromosome aberration assay. Seven years after radiotherapy ended, ring and dicentric chromosome frequencies remained significantly higher than baseline, indicating persistent genome instability. The authors suggest such data may inform secondary neoplasia risk assessment and radiation protection protocols.

pmid-21421720.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣がん患者10例に対し、精巣内へ99mTcナノコロイドを注入してセンチネルリンパ節を同定した研究。SPECT/CTで後腹膜のセンチネルリンパ節の位置を正確に把握し、腹腔鏡手術中はポータブルγカメラでリアルタイムに誘導した。26個を摘出し、転移は1個に認められた。中央値21か月のフォローアップ期間中、転移のないセンチネルリンパ節の症例で再発は認めなかった。
pmid-21421720.summary_en: Ten patients with clinical stage I testicular cancer underwent sentinel node mapping with technetium-99m nanocolloid injected into the testis, followed by SPECT/CT and real-time guidance with a portable gamma camera during laparoscopic surgery. SPECT/CT accurately localized retroperitoneal sentinel nodes in all patients. Twenty-six nodes were removed, and one contained metastasis. No recurrences occurred in tumor-free sentinel node patients over a median 21-month follow-up. The portable camera identified about 20% additional nodes.

pmid-21422687.summary_ja: 経皮生検とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値から原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された43歳男性の症例報告。化学療法後にAFPは正常化したが腫瘤は増大し、気管圧迫のため人工呼吸管理とステント留置を要した。追加の化学療法3コース後に切除され、成熟奇形腫の病理像を示した。growing teratoma syndromeの稀な臨床像と、多様式治療による良好な転帰を示す。
pmid-21422687.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old man with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor diagnosed by percutaneous biopsy and elevated AFP. AFP normalized after chemotherapy, but the mass enlarged and compressed the trachea, requiring mechanical ventilation and airway stenting. After three further chemotherapy cycles, the enlarged mass was resected and showed mature teratoma, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. The case illustrates successful multimodal management.

pmid-21422691.summary_ja: 骨盤内腫瘤を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の21歳女性の症例報告。ピアノ演奏様の不随意運動と低換気を呈し、人工呼吸管理を要した。早期に腫瘍摘出を行い、血漿交換、免疫グロブリン療法、ステロイド投与を併用して神経症状は徐々に改善した。病理では未熟奇形腫と診断され、B細胞・T細胞浸潤を伴っていた。早期の腫瘍切除と免疫療法が回復に有用とされる。
pmid-21422691.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with a pelvic mass. She developed pseudo-piano playing orofacial movements and hypoventilation requiring ventilation. Tumor resection was performed early, followed by plasma exchange, immunoglobulin, and steroids, with gradual neurological recovery. Pathology showed an immature teratoma with B- and T-cell infiltrates. The authors conclude early resection with immunotherapy aids recovery, though central hypoventilation may need prolonged support.

pmid-21424033.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎や水腫性流産が疑われた61例と正常妊娠対照21例を対象とした研究。CD31・CD34の免疫組織化学染色を用いて脈管形成を評価した。部分胞状奇胎と完全胞状奇胎を鑑別する組織学的・免疫組織化学的基準を提示した。完全奇胎における栄養膜の分布と異型栄養膜が最も重要な鑑別点とされる。胞状奇胎は侵入奇胎や絨毛癌へ進展しうる病変として位置づけられている。
pmid-21424033.summary_en: This study examined 61 suspected molar pregnancy or hydropic abortion cases and 21 normal pregnancy controls. Histology and CD31/CD34 immunohistochemistry were used to assess vasculogenesis. The authors established histological and immunohistochemical criteria distinguishing partial and complete hydatidiform mole. Trophoblast distribution and atypical trophoblast in complete mole were the most important differential diagnostic features. Molar pregnancy is considered a precursor pathway toward invasive mole and choriocarcinoma.

pmid-21424055.summary_ja: 前立腺がんが疑われた43歳男性で、超音波検査とCTにより後腹膜に巨大腫瘤を認めた。手術で尿管と精管への浸潤があり、病理は古典的セミノーマと診断された。左精巣摘除術の標本では広範な線維化と2mmのセミノーマ巣のみで、退縮性精巣腫瘍に一致した。後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍では潜在性の精巣原発を画像と生検で必ず除外すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-21424055.summary_en: A 43-year-old man presented with suspected prostate cancer and was found to have a large retroperitoneal mass on ultrasonography and CT. Surgery showed ureteral and vas deferens infiltration, and pathology was classical seminoma. Testes appeared normal on palpation, but ultrasonography showed fibrosis and microcalcifications. Left orchidectomy revealed extensive fibrosis with only a 2 mm seminoma focus, consistent with a burnt-out testicular tumor. The authors emphasize excluding an occult testicular origin for retroperitoneal germ cell tumors.

pmid-21430455.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた扁平上皮癌3例の後方視的研究です。1551例中0.19%で悪性転化が認められました。リスク因子として年齢、腫瘍径、超音波所見、SCCおよびCA125の上昇が挙げられ、定期的な超音波検査による経過観察が提案されています。進行例には化学療法や骨盤放射線照射が検討されています。
pmid-21430455.summary_en: This retrospective study examined three women with squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma, identified among 1551 MCT cases over two decades, a malignant transformation rate of 0.19%. The median age was 39 years, and tumors were large, averaging 17.3 cm. Two of three patients reached stage IIIC and died. The authors suggest caution with patient age, tumor size, ultrasound and CT findings, and elevated SCC and CA125 levels, with regular ovarian ultrasound surveillance. They also review cytoreductive surgery, platinum or paclitaxel chemotherapy, and pelvic radiation for advanced or recurrent disease.

pmid-21431497.summary_ja: 27歳女性の後腹膜に生じた6cmの嚢胞性腫瘤(仙骨前面)を腹腔鏡下に一塊切除した症例報告です。病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫と診断されました。狭い骨盤腔内でも腫瘍を損傷せずに切除でき、整容面も良好で、術後1年6か月時点で再発はありません。成人の仙尾部奇形腫は稀とされます。
pmid-21431497.summary_en: This report describes a 27-year-old woman with a 6 cm cystic retroperitoneal mass overlying the anterior sacrum, which was successfully removed by laparoscopic en bloc resection. Histopathological examination showed a mature teratoma. The magnifying function of the laparoscope allowed precise resection in the narrow pelvic cavity without tumor damage. The cosmetic result was excellent, and the patient remained relapse-free 1 year and 6 months after surgery. The authors note that sacrococcygeal teratoma is rare in adults.

pmid-21435262.summary_ja: 62歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌の上皮内癌の症例報告です。左卵管卵巣摘出後、子宮全摘術などを行い、補助療法は行われませんでした。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化では、最適な減量術が生存率の改善と関連すると結論づけられています。
pmid-21435262.summary_en: This case report describes a 62-year-old woman with an abdominopelvic mass, in whom squamous cell carcinoma in situ was found arising within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma after left salpingo-oophorectomy. She underwent total hysterectomy, contralateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and omentectomy, without adjuvant treatment. The authors note that squamous cell carcinoma is the most common malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma. They conclude that optimal cytoreduction is associated with improved survival in malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-21438975.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマ276例に対し、カルボプラチン2サイクルの補助療法を後方視的に評価した多施設研究。骨髄抑制は主にグレード1/2で忍容性は良好。再発は3例(1.06%)で、いずれもシスプラチン併用化学療法で救済された。2サイクル投与の有効性を支持する結果である。
pmid-21438975.summary_en: This retrospective multicentre study evaluated two cycles of adjuvant carboplatin monotherapy in 276 patients with clinical stage I seminoma, with a mean follow-up of 75 months. Chemotherapy was well tolerated, with mainly grade 1/2 bone marrow suppression and no neutropenic fever. Three patients (1.06%) developed retroperitoneal recurrence within two years, all salvaged with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and five developed a contralateral testicular germ cell tumor. The authors conclude that two cycles are highly effective and well tolerated, and that a second cycle may reduce recurrence rates.

pmid-21439527.summary_ja: 絨毛癌が肺・肝・脳・歯肉に広範囲に転移した症例の報告。頭蓋内出血に対して減圧開頭術を行い、貧血と凝固障害の補正のため輸血を実施し、高リスク化学療法を施行したが、多臓器病変の進行により死亡した。歯肉出血は絨毛癌の転移と予後不良を示唆する所見である。
pmid-21439527.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with widely disseminated choriocarcinoma involving the lungs, liver, brain and gum. Gum bleeding was recognized as a sign of metastasis and poor prognosis. Despite decompressive craniectomy for intracranial haemorrhage, transfusions to correct anaemia and coagulopathy, and high-risk chemotherapy, the multi-organ involvement led to death. The authors conclude that gum bleeding in choriocarcinoma should prompt consideration of metastatic disease, as it signals a grave outcome.

pmid-21440128.summary_ja: シスプラチン時代に化学療法後の肺・縦隔転移を切除した精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍431例の検討。中央生存期間は23.4年で、切除された残存病変の病理(奇形腫など)が生存と関連した。残存奇形腫に対する積極的な外科治療を支持する結論である。
pmid-21440128.summary_en: This institutional review of 431 patients with testicular NSGCT who underwent 640 postchemotherapy resections of lung or mediastinal metastases in the cisplatin era found a median survival of 23.4 years. Survival did not differ between lung and mediastinal resections. Pathology of the residual disease, including teratoma, persistent NSGCT, necrosis or non-germ cell cancer, predicted survival, as did older age at diagnosis and non-germ cell cancer in the orchiectomy specimen. The authors support aggressive surgery to remove residual teratoma, including repeated procedures if necessary.

pmid-21447974.summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術後の臨床病期I非セミノーマに対する積極的監視の成績を後方視的に検討した。70例中12例(17%)が再発し、多くは1年以内であった。再発例の大半はシスプラチン併用化学療法で治療された。順守のよい患者では監視療法は信頼できる戦略である。
pmid-21447974.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated active surveillance after radical orchiectomy in 70 analysable patients with clinical stage I nonseminoma, followed according to NCCN guidelines for a median of 18.5 months. Twelve patients (17%) relapsed, most within one year; three had retroperitoneal lymph node metastases, five had marker relapse only, and four had both. Relapsed patients were treated mainly with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and one underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The authors conclude that surveillance is a reliable strategy for compliant patients, since relapses can be detected early and treated successfully.

pmid-21450035.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、化学療法および初回手術の後、フォローアップ中に発見された卵巣のgrowing teratoma syndromeを有する36歳女性について述べている。初回手術は悪性未熟奇形腫に対して行われた。腫瘤はフルオロデオキシグルコースPETで集積を示し、第2回手術前に血清CA19-9が上昇していた。切除された腫瘤の組織像は成熟奇形腫のみであった。患者は2回目の手術後6か月間無病であり、診断の確定と治療方針の決定には外科的切除が必要であることを示す症例である。
pmid-21450035.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with growing teratoma syndrome of the ovary, found during follow-up after chemotherapy and primary surgery for a malignant immature teratoma. Fluorodeoxyglucose PET showed uptake in the masses, and serum CA19-9 was elevated before a second operation. Histology of the resected masses showed only mature teratoma. The patient remained disease-free for six months after the second surgery, illustrating the need for surgical resection to confirm the diagnosis and guide management.

pmid-21453887.summary_ja: 潰瘍性大腸炎の27歳男性で、抗TNFα製剤インフリキシマブ投与の3か月後に精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍を発症し、精巣摘除術を受けた症例報告。抗TNFα製剤使用者での精巣がんの発症は過去に4例が報告されている。若年男性に多いIBDの状況を踏まえ、この合併症を集団ベースで検討すべきと提言している。
pmid-21453887.summary_en: This report describes a 27-year-old man with ulcerative colitis who developed a testicular mixed germ cell tumor three months after starting infliximab, an anti-TNF-alpha agent that induced remission within six weeks. He had previously been maintained on mesalamine suppositories. The tumor required orchiectomy. The authors identified four previous cases of testicular cancer in patients receiving anti-TNF-alpha agents. Given the prevalence of IBD in young men and the trend toward top-down therapy, they call for population-based study of this potential complication.

pmid-21457154.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎が疑われた20歳女性の左卵巣腫瘍切除術における麻酔管理の症例報告。全身痙攣と意識レベルの低下を呈した。本症は抗NMDA受容体抗体と関連し、早期の腫瘍切除と免疫療法で回復が促進される。麻酔は合併症なく遂行され、NMDA受容体と麻酔薬感受性の相互作用が議論された。
pmid-21457154.summary_en: The authors describe anaesthetic management of a 20-year-old woman with paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma, who presented with generalized convulsions and reduced consciousness. The condition has been linked to antibodies against N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor heteromers. Early tumor resection with immunotherapy facilitates recovery. Anaesthesia for left ovarian tumor resection proceeded without complications. The case raises questions about possible interactions between NMDA receptors and anaesthetic sensitivity.

pmid-21460156.summary_ja: 本報告は胎児の口腔腫瘤であるエピグナサス(口腔奇形腫)を対象に、複数の三次元超音波検査技術による出生前評価を示す。三次元データから得た画像を、出生後の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)、CT、切除標本と比較した。各手法の診断的価値と限界が検討され、表面表示を超える三次元超音波画像の有用性が示された。
pmid-21460156.summary_en: This report describes the prenatal evaluation of a fetal epignathus, an oral mass arising from the palate, using several three-dimensional ultrasound imaging techniques. Images from 3D datasets were compared with postnatal MRI, CT, and the surgical specimen. The authors explored the diagnostic value and limitations of each 3D technique, showing that advanced 3D sonographic modes extend beyond surface rendering for evaluating oral masses.

pmid-21461571.summary_ja: 本研究では胎盤性絨毛癌におけるWnt5aの役割を検討した。Wnt5aは初代細胞栄養膜細胞で発現する一方、絨毛癌細胞株JARでは発現が欠如していた。組換えWnt5aをJAR細胞に加えると増殖が抑制され、アポトーシスが誘導された。化学療法を行っても死亡率の高い本疾患への治療応用が期待されると結論づけている。
pmid-21461571.summary_en: This study examined Wnt5a in placental choriocarcinoma. Wnt5a was expressed in primary cytotrophoblasts but absent from the JAR choriocarcinoma cell line. Adding recombinant Wnt5a to JAR cells suppressed proliferation and induced apoptosis, suggesting a tumor-suppressive role. The authors propose Wnt5a as a potential therapeutic target for this highly malignant tumor, which carries notable mortality even with chemotherapy.

pmid-21471263.summary_ja: 23歳男性の化学療法抵抗性の大型縦隔未熟奇形腫に対し、積極的な外科的切除を行った症例報告。早期の結果は良好であり、化学療法抵抗性の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に対する救済手術の選択肢を示唆する。まれな病態のため、長期成績は示されていない。
pmid-21471263.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old man with a large mediastinal germ cell tumor that was refractory to chemotherapy and managed with an aggressive surgical approach. Immature mediastinal teratomas resistant to systemic treatment are very rare. The authors report successful resection of the large tumor with a satisfactory early postoperative outcome. The report suggests that salvage resection can be considered for selected chemorefractory mediastinal tumors, although only early results are described.

pmid-21475076.summary_ja: SEERデータベースに基づくこのコホート研究では、悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍1529例を対象とし、両側性(66例)と片側性(1463例)を比較した。両側性腫瘍は進行期であることが多く、5年生存率は低かった(80.7%対93.6%)。しかし、年齢、組織型、病期、外科的病期分類で調整した多変量解析では、両側性は生存の独立した予測因子ではなかった(HR 1.3、P = 0.40)。著者らは、両側性は予後を独立して悪化させるというより、主として進行期疾患と高リスク組織型を反映すると結論づけている。
pmid-21475076.summary_en: This SEER-based cohort study of 1529 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors compared bilateral (66) and unilateral (1463) disease. Bilateral tumors were more often advanced stage and associated with lower five-year survival (80.7% vs 93.6%). However, in multivariate analysis adjusted for age, histology, stage, and surgical staging, bilaterality was not an independent predictor of survival (HR 1.3, P = 0.40). The authors conclude that bilaterality mainly reflects advanced disease and high-risk histology rather than independently worsening prognosis.

pmid-21477387.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの治療に関するシステマティックレビュー。病期Iおよび病期I以外の予後良好・中間群について、サーベイランス、カルボプラチンや化学療法レジメン、放射線療法の有効性と安全性を評価した。29研究を対象とし、GRADEでエビデンスの質を評価している。
pmid-21477387.summary_en: This BMJ Clinical Evidence systematic review summarizes evidence on treating testicular seminoma. It covers management of stage 1 seminoma after orchidectomy, good- and intermediate-prognosis non-stage 1 disease, and maintenance chemotherapy. Interventions assessed include surveillance, single-agent carboplatin, different cycle numbers of adjuvant chemotherapy, bleomycin-containing and etoposide-cisplatin regimens, and adjuvant radiotherapy to para-aortic and iliac fields. Twenty-nine studies were included, and evidence quality was graded using GRADE.

pmid-21480199.summary_ja: 1,057例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者のデータベースを用いた後方視的研究です。生存者57例に、計63件の異時性二次がんが見つかりました。二次がんは初発腫瘍の診断から中央値9.9年後に発生しました。腫瘍マーカーや画像検査を含む定期的な腫瘍科フォローアップで発見されたのは27%にとどまり、多くは症状による受診や他科受診で見つかりました。CTは一部のがんを早期に発見しましたが、全体の検出率は低いものでした。
pmid-21480199.summary_en: This retrospective study of 1,057 testicular germ cell tumor patients identified 63 metachronous second malignancies in 57 survivors, including 26 contralateral testicular cancers. Second cancers arose a median of 9.9 years after the first diagnosis. Routine oncology follow-up, including tumor markers, physical examination, and imaging, detected only 27% of these cancers, while most were found through symptoms or non-oncology visits. CT identified some cancers early, but overall yield was low.

pmid-21482994.summary_ja: 1995年から2003年にスウェーデンとノルウェーで転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の成人603例を対象とした集団ベースの研究です。BEP療法2コース後の腫瘍マーカーの半減期に応じて治療を個別化しました。反応不良例にはイホスファミドを加えた強化療法を行い、さらに大量化学療法と幹細胞救援を行いました。10年全生存期間は予後良好群94.7%、中間群90.0%、予後不良群67.4%で、全国規模でも良好な成績が得られました。
pmid-21482994.summary_en: This population-based Swedish-Norwegian study included 603 adults with metastatic testicular NSGCT treated from 1995 to 2003 under a strict protocol. Treatment was tailored to tumor marker half-life after two cycles of BEP: poor responders received ifosfamide-containing intensification, then high-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell rescue. Median follow-up was 8.2 years. Ten-year overall survival was 94.7% for good-prognosis, 90.0% for intermediate, and 67.4% for poor-prognosis patients, supporting marker-guided treatment at national level.

pmid-21489835.summary_ja: 本総説は、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する白金製剤による化学療法後に残存する非後腹膜病変の管理を扱っています。病期III/IVの患者の約35%にこのような残存腫瘤が見られます。管理は転移部位と、精巣原発巣との組織学的一致の有無によって異なります。後腹膜リンパ節郭清で線維化のみが確認されても、後腹膜外に奇形腫や生存腫瘍が残る可能性があります。長期生存データから外科的切除は依然として重要とされています。
pmid-21489835.summary_en: This review addresses management of residual non-retroperitoneal masses after platinum-based chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. About 35% of stage III/IV patients retain such masses. Management depends on metastatic site and whether histology is concordant with the testicular primary. Residual teratoma or viable tumor can persist outside the retroperitoneum despite RPLND findings such as fibrosis alone. Long-term survival data favor surgical resection, which remains important.

pmid-21489989.summary_ja: 本研究では、精巣がん由来の胎児性癌細胞においてSTK17A(DRAK1)がp53の直接標的遺伝子であることを示しました。シスプラチンはp53依存的にSTK17Aを誘導し、その上流のp53応答配列への結合が確認されました。STK17Aのノックダウンはシスプラチン耐性を高め、活性酸素種を減少させ、メタロチオネインの発現を上昇させました。過剰発現では逆に活性酸素種が増加しており、STK17Aが精巣がん細胞のシスプラチン毒性を調節することが示唆されます。
pmid-21489989.summary_en: This study identifies STK17A (DRAK1) as a direct p53 target gene in testicular cancer-derived embryonal carcinoma cells. Cisplatin induced STK17A in a p53-dependent manner, binding a p53 response element upstream of the gene. Knockdown of STK17A increased cisplatin resistance and reduced reactive oxygen species, with upregulation of metallothioneins. Overexpression increased reactive oxygen species, suggesting STK17A modulates cisplatin toxicity in testicular cancer cells.

pmid-21492468.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、38歳男性がステージIの精巣セミノーマに対して根治的精巣摘除術と予防的傍大動脈リンパ節照射を受けた3年後に、低緊張性で弛緩性の神経因性膀胱を発症したことを報告している。尿流動態検査とMRIの所見は、放射線誘発性の腰仙部神経根障害と一致していた。著者らは、放射線照射後腰仙部症候群において膀胱機能障害という内臓病変が従来報告されていない発現であり、臨床医にとって診断上の課題となりうることを強調している。
pmid-21492468.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old man with stage I testicular seminoma who developed a hypotonic, flaccid neuropathic bladder three years after radical orchidectomy and prophylactic para-aortic irradiation. Urodynamic testing and MRI were consistent with radiation-induced lumbosacral radiculopathy. The authors highlight visceral involvement, specifically bladder dysfunction, as a previously unreported presentation of postirradiation lumbosacral syndrome, which may challenge clinicians.

pmid-21493427.summary_ja: 1988年から2010年に三次気道管理施設で治療された先天性頭頸部奇形腫の新生児14例の症例集積。胎盤循環下での気管挿管や気管切開により多くで初期気道確保に成功したが、5例が死亡した。晩期には声帯麻痺や気管狭窄が生じ、喉頭気管形成術を要した例もあった。多職種チームによる標準化された対応と出生後の気道再評価が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-21493427.summary_en: This case series reviewed 14 consecutive neonates with congenital head and neck teratomas treated at a tertiary airway center from 1988 to 2010. Initial airway stabilization on placental support, using intubation or tracheotomy, succeeded in most cases, though five patients died, four of them from teratoma-related complications shortly after birth. Long-term airway problems included vocal cord paralysis and stenosis requiring laryngotracheoplasty. The authors recommend a multidisciplinary team, a standardized operating-room approach, and reassessment of the airway after delivery to reduce morbidity and mortality.

pmid-21497366.summary_ja: 5歳女児の仙尾部に生じたエストロゲン産生腫瘍の症例報告。先天性臀部腫瘤と思春期早発症を呈した。生検で成熟奇形腫に隣接する非定型細胞が認められ、核分裂像の増加や血管侵襲、壊死を伴っていた。仙尾部成熟奇形腫の体細胞型悪性転化による悪性ステロイド産生腫瘍と診断された。化学療法と切除後、再発は認められていない。仙尾部奇形腫からの発生例として初報告とされる。
pmid-21497366.summary_en: This case report describes a 5-year-old girl with a large estrogen-producing tumor in the sacrococcygeal region, who had precocious puberty and a congenital gluteal mass. Biopsy showed atypical round cells adjacent to a mature teratoma, with steroidogenic markers, increased mitoses, vascular invasion, and necrosis. The tumor was diagnosed as a malignant steroidogenic tumor arising from sacrococcygeal mature teratoma through somatic malignant transformation. Chemotherapy and resection were followed by no recurrence. The authors report this as the first such case.

pmid-21499881.summary_ja: 臍帯ヘルニアの内容物として見つかった、肝鎌状間膜由来の先天性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。病理組織学的な検討で確定診断された。文献上の報告がほとんどない極めてまれな病変である。臍帯ヘルニアの内容物には腸管や肝臓以外の予期しない病変が含まれうることを示している。
pmid-21499881.summary_en: This case report describes an unusual congenital mature cystic teratoma of the falciform ligament of the liver, found as the content of an omphalocele. Histopathology confirmed the diagnosis. The authors note the entity is very uncommon and not previously described in the world literature. The report highlights that omphalocele contents can include unexpected lesions beyond intestine and liver, which matters for surgical planning.

pmid-21499930.summary_ja: 米国のSTEED研究を基にした症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性246例と非がん対照236例の生活の質を比較した。SF-36の身体・精神の両スコアを評価したところ、症例では身体スコアがやや低かった。化学療法を受けた群は身体・精神の両スコアが低下していた一方、化学療法以外の治療を受けた群は対照と差がなかった。精巣がんの生存者では、特に化学療法後に身体的・全般的健康の制限が生じうると結論づけている。
pmid-21499930.summary_en: This U.S. case-control study compared quality of life between 246 men with testicular germ cell tumors and 236 non-cancer controls from the STEED study. Cases were at least five years from diagnosis, averaging 14 years. Using SF-36 physical and mental component scores, cases had modestly lower physical scores than controls. Men treated with chemotherapy had lower physical and mental scores, while those treated otherwise did not differ from controls. The authors conclude testicular cancer survivors may have physical and general health limitations, especially after chemotherapy.

pmid-21505904.summary_ja: 乳癌を合併した閉経後女性で、両側成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫に伴う良性卵巣甲状腺腫を認めた症例報告です。乳癌と卵巣腫瘍を同時性に外科的に治療した経過を示しています。単一症例の報告であり、卵巣甲状腺腫と乳癌の併存は稀です。
pmid-21505904.summary_en: The authors report a postmenopausal woman with breast cancer who had benign struma ovarii associated with bilateral mature cystic ovarian teratoma. Both the breast and ovarian tumors were treated surgically at the same time. As a single case report, it describes the rare coexistence of a struma ovarii with a breast malignancy and documents synchronous surgical management of both lesions.

pmid-21507373.summary_ja: 1996年から2010年に卵巣奇形腫の手術を受けた580例を後方視的に解析しました。20歳以上では無症状例が有意に多く、20歳未満では腫瘍径が大きい傾向でした。卵巣捻転は4.9%に認め、年齢差はありませんでした。未熟奇形腫は成熟奇形腫より有症状で腫瘍径が大きいことも示されました。
pmid-21507373.summary_en: This retrospective study from Samsung Medical Center reviewed 580 patients who underwent surgery for ovarian teratoma between 1996 and 2010. Older patients were more often asymptomatic, while patients under 20 had larger tumors. Ovarian torsion occurred in 4.9% without an age-specific difference. Immature teratomas presented more often with symptoms and were larger than mature teratomas. The authors conclude that clinical features of ovarian teratoma differ by age.

pmid-21508138.summary_ja: 45,X/46,XYモザイク患者48例を対象とした多施設研究で、外性器男性化スコア(EMS)と性腺分化・悪性胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を検討しました。EMSの群間で腫瘍リスクは性腺分化パターンと有意に関連していました。男児ではEMSによらずテストステロン産生が保たれることが多い一方、EMSが低いほど悪性リスクが高い傾向があり、厳格なフォローアップが必要とされています。
pmid-21508138.summary_en: This multicenter study of 48 patients with 45,X/46,XY mosaicism examined whether the external masculinization score (EMS) predicts gonadal differentiation and malignant germ cell tumor risk. Tumor risk differed significantly by gonadal differentiation pattern across the three EMS groups. In boys, testosterone production was usually adequate regardless of EMS, but follow-up remained necessary because malignancy risk appeared inversely related to EMS. In girls, gonads were nonfunctional, favoring gonadectomy.

pmid-21508670.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるGPER(GPR30)発現に関する先行報告へのコメントです。著者らは、ヒトセミノーマ細胞株を用いた研究を基に、エストロゲンや外因性エストロゲン様物質の精巣発がんにおける役割を論じています。GPER拮抗薬がセミノーマ細胞に及ぼす影響も示し、標的治療としての可能性を支持しています。
pmid-21508670.summary_en: This commentary responds to a report by Franco et al. on GPER (GPR30) expression in testicular germ cell tumors. The authors summarize their prior work on a human seminoma cell line, describing roles of estrogens and xeno-estrogens in testicular carcinogenesis. They report effects of a GPER antagonist on human seminoma cells, supporting the potential of GPER-targeted therapy. The commentary aims to inform readers of this line of research.

pmid-21509630.summary_ja: SEERデータベースを用いて、1988～2006年に診断された精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の病期I 4,620例と病期II 1,671例における後腹膜リンパ節郭清の利用動向を解析しました。病期Iでは利用率が39%から18%へ低下した一方、病期IIでは56～62%で安定していました。低下は積極的監視や化学療法の普及によるものと考察されています。
pmid-21509630.summary_en: This population-based SEER study examined trends in retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy (RPLND) use among 4,620 stage I and 1,671 stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis patients diagnosed from 1988 to 2006. RPLND use in stage I fell from 39% to 18% over time, with regional variation, while stage II rates remained stable at 56-62%. Year of diagnosis, registry, and age predicted RPLND use in stage I only. The authors attribute the decline to wider use of surveillance or chemotherapy.

pmid-21514631.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍におけるMMPsとその阻害因子の発現を免疫組織化学的に比較しました。絨毛癌ではMMPが高発現で阻害因子が低く、浸潤能の高さと関連すると考えられました。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍では逆のパターンを示しました。MMP阻害薬は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療に有用な可能性があります。
pmid-21514631.summary_en: This study immunohistochemically examined matrix metalloproteinases, their inhibitors TIMP-3 and TIMP-4, and the inducer CD147 across normal placentas, partial and complete moles, choriocarcinomas, and placental site trophoblastic tumors. Choriocarcinoma showed high MMP-14, MMP-28, and MMP-21 expression with lower TIMP levels, which may explain its invasiveness. PSTT showed lower MMP and higher TIMP expression, consistent with its lower invasiveness. MMP inhibition may be a useful therapeutic strategy for GTD.

pmid-21516272.summary_ja: 社会的背景により診断が遅れた成人男性が、左精巣の潰瘍・壊死を伴う腫瘤と転移性セミノーマで来院しました。小児期に左停留精巣の手術歴がありました。ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法で完全寛解し、30か月後も持続しました。化学療法中に原発部位からの出血が生じ、外科的管理が必要となりました。
pmid-21516272.summary_en: An adult man presented with a large ulcerated, necrotic left testicular mass due to metastatic seminoma, after a diagnostic delay driven by social circumstances. He had a childhood history of orchiopexy for left cryptorchidism. He achieved complete remission with standard bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy, which persisted at 30 months. Chemotherapy was complicated by bleeding from the primary site, requiring surgery and removal of an arterial prosthesis.

pmid-21518128.summary_ja: 40歳女性の両側卵巣扁平上皮癌の症例報告です。左卵巣には先行する類皮嚢腫がありました。卵管、子宮頸部、大網への進展も認められました。卵巣扁平上皮癌は通常、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの悪性転化で生じ、多くは片側性とされます。
pmid-21518128.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman with squamous cell carcinoma involving both ovaries. The left ovary had a preceding dermoid cyst, and the tumor also involved the fallopian tubes, cervix, and omentum. The authors note that ovarian SCC usually arises from malignant transformation of a mature cystic teratoma, which is typically unilateral. Contralateral mature teratoma without malignancy has been rarely reported, making this bilateral presentation notable.

pmid-21519041.summary_ja: 7歳のカニクイザルの左卵巣に生じた混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。胎児性癌、絨毛癌、類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍の3成分からなり、肺転移と右卵巣への浸潤も認めた。免疫組織化学で各成分を鑑別し、非ヒト霊長類で胎児性癌が混合型胚細胞腫瘍の構成成分として報告された初めての例とされる。
pmid-21519041.summary_en: This report describes a mixed germ cell tumor in the ovary of a seven-year-old female cynomolgus monkey, with pulmonary metastasis and involvement of the right ovary. Three histologic components were identified: embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Each was distinguished by immunohistochemical profiles, including AFP, OCT-4, CD30, hCG, CK7, p63, and inhibin-alpha. The authors note this is the first report of embryonal carcinoma in nonhuman primates as a component of a mixed germ cell tumor.

pmid-21519793.summary_ja: 精巣がん由来のシスプラチン耐性細胞NEC-8/DDPを親株と比較するマイクロアレイ解析で、ENTPD6を同定した。ENTPD6はがん部で非がん部より低発現で、セミノーマでは他の精巣腫瘍より高発現だった。E-カドヘリンとの相互作用を介してシスプラチン感受性に関与し、耐性の分子マーカーおよび治療標的の候補として提案されている。
pmid-21519793.summary_en: Using cDNA microarray analysis of cisplatin-resistant testicular cancer NEC-8/DDP cells versus parental NEC-8 cells, the authors identified ENTPD6 among 19 differentially expressed genes. ENTPD6 was less expressed in cancerous than non-cancerous tissue, and higher in seminoma than in other testicular tumors. Its expression influenced cisplatin sensitivity through interaction with E-cadherin. The authors propose ENTPD6 as a candidate molecular biomarker of cisplatin resistance and a potential therapeutic target in testicular cancer.
