pmid-21793665.summary_en: The authors describe a 10-year-old girl with a primary pure yolk sac tumor of the right thyroid lobe, reported as the first such case. Fine-needle aspiration raised the diagnosis, and extensive sampling of the thyroidectomy specimen found no teratoma or other germ cell component. Serum alpha-fetoprotein rose markedly after excision, and imaging showed bilateral pulmonary nodules suggestive of metastatic disease without a mediastinal mass. The tumor responded favorably to bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy.

pmid-21795662.summary_ja: 本研究では、抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者の脳における補体沈着と抗体産生細胞(形質細胞)を検討しました。患者抗体は in vitro で補体を結合しましたが、脳組織には補体沈着は認められませんでした。一方、奇形腫21例の組織では補体が検出されました。脳では CD138陽性の形質細胞が多数認められ、髄腔内抗体合成を説明しうる所見です。
pmid-21795662.summary_en: This study examined whether complement and antibody-secreting plasma cells are present in the brains of patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, a condition often associated with ovarian teratoma. Patient antibodies bound complement in vitro, but complement deposits were not detected in patient brain tissue, whereas teratoma tissue from 21 patients contained complement. Brain samples showed abundant CD138-positive plasma cells and B and T cells in perivascular regions. The authors conclude that complement-mediated mechanisms are unlikely to play a substantial pathogenic role, while plasma cell infiltrates may explain intrathecal antibody synthesis.

pmid-21795985.summary_ja: MITO施設の卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍123例を後方視的に解析しました。再発率は17.8%で、45歳超とMITO施設以外での治療が主な再発予測因子でした。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は88.8%で、病期I超と卵黄嚢腫瘍組織型が独立した予後不良因子でした。多くの症例で妊孕性温存手術が行われています。
pmid-21795985.summary_en: This MITO-9 retrospective analysis of 123 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors evaluated outcomes and recurrence risk factors across MITO centers. Dysgerminomas, immature teratomas, mixed germ cell tumors, and yolk sac tumors were the main histologies. Recurrence occurred in 17.8 percent, with age over 45 years and treatment outside referral centers as the main predictors. Five-year overall survival was 88.8 percent, and stage above I and yolk sac histology were independent poor prognostic factors. Most patients underwent fertility-sparing surgery.

pmid-21797113.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の転移能に関わる遺伝子を、高転移性のJEG-3細胞と低転移性のJAR細胞の比較により検討しました。FN、MMP-2、uPA、CAV-1、VEGF-Bが上位の遺伝子でした。VEGF-B shRNAにより発現を抑制すると、JEG-3細胞のマトリゲル浸潤が有意に低下しました。VEGF-Bが絨毛癌の転移能に重要な役割を果たすと結論づけています。
pmid-21797113.summary_en: The authors used cDNA microarray to compare gene expression between highly metastatic JEG-3 and weakly metastatic JAR choriocarcinoma cell lines. They identified 51 upregulated genes correlated with metastatic ability, with FN, MMP-2, uPA, CAV-1, and VEGF-B ranking highest. Knocking down VEGF-B with shRNA reduced its mRNA expression and significantly decreased invasion of JEG-3 cells in Matrigel assays. The study concludes that VEGF-B plays an important role in the metastatic capability of human choriocarcinoma, and that reducing its expression weakens invasive ability.

pmid-21797119.summary_ja: 本研究は、1990年から2010年に治療された小児卵巣胚細胞腫瘍137例の単施設後方視的レビューであり、奇形腫が最も多く、次いで卵黄嚢腫瘍であった。主症状は腹痛と腹部膨満で、21例が卵巣捻転を呈した。大部分は病期Iであった。奇形腫患者は手術のみを受け、55例は手術と化学療法を受けた。卵巣温存腫瘍摘出術は48例に施行された。治療を断念して死亡した16例を除外すると、5年無再発生存率と全生存率はそれぞれ93.4%と98.3%であった。著者らは、可能な場合には卵巣組織の温存を推奨している。
pmid-21797119.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review of 137 children with ovarian germ cell tumors treated from 1990 to 2010 found teratomas most common, followed by yolk sac tumors. Abdominal pain and distension were the main symptoms, and 21 patients presented with ovarian torsion. Most patients were stage I. Patients with mature or immature teratomas underwent surgery alone, while 55 received surgery plus chemotherapy. Ovarian-sparing tumorectomy was performed in 48 patients. Excluding patients who declined treatment and died, 5-year relapse-free and overall survival were 93.4 and 98.3 percent, and the authors recommend preserving ovarian tissue when feasible.

pmid-21797132.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の既往がある28歳女性が頻回の頭痛で受診しました。hCGと乳酸脱水素酵素が著明に上昇し、MRIで左側頭部に急速に増大する出血性腫瘤を認めました。後腹膜を含む複数部位の組織は絨毛癌と診断されました。正中外後腹膜原発の絨毛癌が神経症状で発症しうることを示す症例です。
pmid-21797132.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman with a history of dilatation and curettage for hydatidiform mole presented with frequent headaches. Laboratory testing showed markedly elevated hCG and lactate dehydrogenase, and brain MRI revealed a rapidly growing hemorrhagic mass in the left temporal area. Histology of tumor samples from multiple sites, including the retroperitoneum, was consistent with choriocarcinoma. The report describes an off-midline retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma that presented with neurologic symptoms, illustrating that such choriocarcinoma can first present with neurologic findings.

pmid-21803708.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、左副腎を圧迫し非機能性副腎偶発腫瘍に類似した、後腹膜の良性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を有する50歳女性を記述している。検査で機能性腫瘍は否定され、腫瘍は腹腔鏡下に切除された。組織学的には呼吸上皮に覆われた嚢胞と、軟骨、骨、神経節組織を認めた。術後経過は順調で、18か月時点で再発はない。著者らは、後腹膜奇形腫を副腎偶発腫瘍の鑑別診断に含めるべきだと述べている。
pmid-21803708.summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old woman with a retroperitoneal benign mature cystic teratoma that compressed the left adrenal gland and mimicked a nonfunctioning adrenal incidentaloma. Laboratory tests excluded a functioning tumor, and the lesion was resected laparoscopically. Histology showed cysts lined by respiratory epithelium with cartilage, bone, and ganglionic tissue. The patient had an uneventful postoperative course and no recurrence at 18 months. The authors recommend including retroperitoneal teratoma in the differential diagnosis of adrenal incidentalomas.

pmid-21804387.summary_ja: 35歳女性の卵巣腫瘍例で、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫(20%)と線維肉腫(80%)が混在していた。腹痛と体重減少で受診した。手術と併用化学療法を行ったが病勢は急速に進行し、診断後18か月で死亡した。純粋な卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に線維肉腫を伴う例の既報は見当たらないとしている。
pmid-21804387.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman with an ovarian tumor composed of dysgerminoma (20%) and fibrosarcoma (80%), presenting with abdominal pain and weight loss. Despite surgery and combination chemotherapy, the disease progressed rapidly and the patient died 18 months after diagnosis. The authors note that no prior report of ovarian fibrosarcoma associated with pure dysgerminoma was found in the literature. Sarcomatous components have, however, been described in mixed and extragonadal germ cell tumors and in some testicular spermatocytic seminomas.

pmid-21804392.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍4例を報告した。3例には上皮成分(漿液性癌、明細胞腺癌など)が認められ、1例は前駆病変が不明であった。既報24例を含めて検討し、通常の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍用化学療法への反応が低いことから、独立した疾患単位として積極的治療が必要と論じている。プラチナ製剤ベースの化学療法が推奨されている。
pmid-21804392.summary_en: This study reports four cases of yolk sac tumor in postmenopausal women, three with an identified epithelial component (serous carcinoma, clear cell adenocarcinoma, and an endometrioid and clear cell admixture) and one without a recognizable precursor. Reviewing 24 reported cases, the authors argue these tumors form a distinct entity that responds poorly to chemotherapy used for ovarian germ cell tumors. They recommend aggressive treatment with platinum-based regimens covering both epithelial and germ cell components. Recent stage I patients treated this way remained disease-free beyond one year.

pmid-21806332.summary_ja: 予後不良因子を持つ進行胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する、自家幹細胞支持下の大量化学療法(HDCT)の成績をまとめた総説である。末梢血幹細胞移植や支持療法の進歩により、治療関連死亡は3%未満に低下した。一次治療では通常用量化学療法に対する優位性は示されず、主にサルベージ療法に限定されている。HDCT後に再発した例は治癒困難とみなされる。
pmid-21806332.summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) with autologous stem cell support in advanced germ cell tumor patients with poor-risk features, both as salvage and first-line therapy. Advances in peripheral blood stem cell transplantation and supportive care have reduced treatment-related mortality to under 3% in recent reports. Three large randomized phase III trials did not show a benefit of HDCT over conventional-dose chemotherapy in the first-line setting, so routine use is generally reserved for salvage. Prognostic models for salvage HDCT are discussed, and patients who relapse after HDCT are usually considered incurable.

pmid-21807171.summary_ja: 小児骨盤内腫瘍の画像所見をまとめた総説である。重なり合う画像所見のため性状診断が難しい点を踏まえ、精巣、卵巣、子宮、膀胱の腫瘤に加えて仙尾部奇形腫を取り上げている。臨床像と画像所見から鑑別診断の範囲を絞り込む要点を示している。小児の骨盤内胚細胞腫瘍を他の病変と区別する際の参考になる。
pmid-21807171.summary_en: This review describes imaging features of pediatric pelvic neoplasms, which often overlap in appearance and are difficult to characterize. It covers testicular, ovarian, uterine, and bladder masses, along with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Key clinical features and imaging findings are highlighted to help narrow the differential diagnosis. The article is useful for radiologists distinguishing germ cell tumors such as sacrococcygeal teratoma and ovarian masses from other pelvic lesions in children.

pmid-21811174.summary_ja: オーストラリアの妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)女性176例を対象とした横断研究である。うつと不安の高値はそれぞれ22%と26%、性機能障害は52%に認められた。化学療法を受けた女性は性生活への悪影響をより感じていた。社会的に不利な立場の女性や、その後妊娠しなかった女性は心理社会的転帰が不良であり、化学療法を要しない患者にもサポートが必要である。
pmid-21811174.summary_en: This cross-sectional study of 176 Australian women with gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) assessed long-term psychological morbidity, sexual functioning, and relationships using validated questionnaires and medical records. Elevated depression and anxiety were reported by 22% and 26%, and 52% reported sexual dysfunction. Women who received chemotherapy more often felt that GTD had harmed their sex life, though objective measures showed no group difference. Socially disadvantaged women and those without subsequent conception had poorer outcomes, supporting ongoing psychosocial care even for those not needing chemotherapy.

pmid-21814322.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後残存腫瘤に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた24例のうち、晩期再発例と残存腫瘤例の計2例で結核が判明した症例報告である。腫瘍マーカーは正常で、PETでは残存腫瘤に集積亢進がみられた。化学療法後残存腫瘤における結核の初めての報告である。
pmid-21814322.summary_en: This case series reports two of 24 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for postchemotherapy residual masses in testicular germ cell tumor and were found to have tuberculosis. One patient had a late relapse and the other had a residual mass. Tumor markers were normal, and PET showed increased uptake in the residual mass. The authors note that tuberculosis in postchemotherapy residual masses has not been reported before, so clinicians should consider it in the differential diagnosis of residual disease.

pmid-21814325.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜リンパ節転移が前腹壁を突き破って発育(フンギング)した極めてまれな症例報告である。化学療法に良好な反応を示した。進行例ではこのような局所進展が起こりうること、またこの特異な進展様式でも化学療法が有効でありうることを示している。
pmid-21814325.summary_en: This case report describes testicular germ cell tumor with retroperitoneal lymph node metastases that fungated through the anterior abdominal wall, an extremely rare presentation. The patient showed a favorable response to chemotherapy. The report highlights that such extension can occur in advanced disease and that chemotherapy can remain effective even with this unusual pattern of local spread.

pmid-21819630.summary_ja: 原発性純粋セミノーマとリンパ節転移の管理、および病期別の治療選択肢を概説した総説である。治癒率は高く、特に病期Iでは予後が良好である。放射線療法、積極的監視、化学療法の中から、毒性と患者の希望を考慮して選択する必要があることを示している。
pmid-21819630.summary_en: This review covers management of primary pure seminoma and its nodal involvement, then compares therapeutic options by stage. It notes that cure rates are high and prognosis is excellent, especially in stage I. Options include radiotherapy, active surveillance, and chemotherapy, and the choice should weigh toxicity and patient preference.

pmid-21821490.summary_ja: SEOMによる精巣セミノーマの診断と治療に関する臨床ガイドラインの要旨である。精巣摘除術後は、腫瘍マーカー測定（αフェトプロテイン(AFP)陰性）、腹部CT、胸部X線検査による病期分類を行う。病期Iの患者は積極的監視または補助カルボプラチン化学療法を選択できる。進行例および性腺外セミノーマにはIGCCCGリスク分類に従いBEP化学療法を行う。残存病変は3cm未満なら監視し、3cm以上はPETで評価して、PET陽性の病変のみ手術を行う。
pmid-21821490.summary_en: These SEOM clinical guidelines outline diagnosis and treatment of testicular seminoma. After orchiectomy, staging includes serial tumor marker assays with negative AFP, abdominal CT, and chest X-ray. Stage I patients may undergo active surveillance or receive adjuvant carboplatin. Advanced disease and extragonadal seminoma receive BEP chemotherapy per IGCCCG risk. Residual masses under 3 cm are observed, while larger ones are evaluated by PET and resected only if PET-positive.

pmid-21821491.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の診療をまとめたSEOMガイドラインである。病期分類、化学療法、化学療法後残存病変の3つの決定樹で管理を整理している。BEPが標準治療で、BEP後に進行した場合はTIPが救援治療となる。大量化学療法の位置づけは未確立である。
pmid-21821491.summary_en: These SEOM guidelines for non-seminomatous germ cell cancer summarize management through three decision trees covering staging, chemotherapy, and postchemotherapy residual disease. BEP remains standard, the role of high-dose chemotherapy is not established, and TIP is standard salvage therapy after BEP. Residual disease should be surgically removed, and poor-prognosis patients should be referred to expert centers.

pmid-21823510.summary_ja: 17歳女性が精神症状で発症し、骨盤MRIで右卵巣腫瘍を認めた。右卵巣摘出術の病理組織学的診断は未熟卵巣奇形腫であった。血漿交換療法と大量メチルプレドニゾロンを行い、意識障害は完全に改善した。抗NMDAR抗体は血清と脳脊髄液で陽性で、臨床症状の改善に伴い減少した。奇形腫の摘出と免疫療法の併用が良好な回復につながった症例である。
pmid-21823510.summary_en: This report describes a 17-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis who developed psychiatric symptoms and was found to have a right ovarian tumor on pelvic MRI. After right salpingo-oophorectomy, histopathology confirmed an immature ovarian teratoma. Plasmapheresis and high-dose methylprednisolone were given, and consciousness fully improved with discharge on day 50. Serum and cerebrospinal fluid were positive for NMDAR antibodies, and the antibody levels decreased in parallel with clinical recovery. The case illustrates that teratoma removal combined with immunotherapy can lead to excellent neurological recovery.

pmid-21826274.summary_ja: ドバイの三次施設で2年間に管理された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍35例を後方視的に解析した。全胞状奇胎が最多で、絨毛癌や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は認めなかった。大多数は初回の吸引掻爬で治癒し、25%が単剤化学療法を要した。選択的な子宮頸管熟化と、地域的な登録体制の必要性が示された。
pmid-21826274.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 35 women with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia managed at a tertiary center in Dubai over two years. Complete mole was most common, followed by partial mole, and no choriocarcinoma or placental site trophoblastic tumor was observed. Most cases were cured by primary suction curettage, repeat evacuation cured some, and 25% required single-agent chemotherapy. The authors suggest cervical preparation with prostaglandins in selected cases and call for a regional registry.

pmid-21838164.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)患者で、血清および尿中の胎盤増殖因子(PlGF)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を測定した。血清PlGFとhCGの相関は非線形であった。PlGF中央値は絨毛癌を含む悪性群で良性群より有意に高く、hCGには差がなかった。悪性GTDではPlGF産生が亢進している可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21838164.summary_en: This study measured serum and urine placental growth factor (PlGF) and hCG in patients with gestational trophoblastic disease using ELISA. Serum PlGF and hCG were not linearly correlated, and urine and serum PlGF did not correlate. Median serum PlGF was significantly higher in malignant GTD, including choriocarcinoma, than in benign disease such as hydatidiform mole, while hCG did not differ between groups. The authors suggest that PlGF production is higher in malignant GTD.

pmid-21838170.summary_ja: 妊娠中に肺・肝・脳へ転移した絨毛癌と診断された28歳女性の症例報告である。妊娠中にEMA-CO療法を開始し、妊娠32週で発育の正常な女児を出産した。高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍では、早期の細胞障害性薬物投与が重要であることを強調している。出産時期は母体の治療と胎児リスクの両面から検討すべきとしている。
pmid-21838170.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma metastatic to the lungs, liver and brain, diagnosed during a viable intrauterine pregnancy. She received EMA-CO chemotherapy during pregnancy and delivered a developmentally normal female infant at 32 weeks. The authors emphasize that early cytotoxic chemotherapy is important for high-risk gestational trophoblastic tumors and that delivery timing should balance maternal treatment needs against fetal risk.

pmid-21838905.summary_ja: 16歳のインド人男児に生じた腰仙部の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。出生時から存在し、15cm×15cmまで増大した腫瘤を、椎体に至るまで完全切除した。この部位・男児での発生は極めて稀であり、悪性化の傾向があるため積極的な診断と治療が必要と述べている。
pmid-21838905.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old Indian boy with a lumbosacral mass present since birth that grew to 15 by 15 cm. Investigations and histopathologic examination confirmed a benign cystic teratoma, which was completely excised from its base to the vertebrae. The authors note that this lesion is very rare in this location and in boys. They argue that benign cystic teratomas should be diagnosed and managed aggressively because they can progress toward malignancy.

pmid-21840909.summary_ja: フランスの絨毛性疾患専門施設における後方視的研究で、基準病理医による再読が初回診断を確認した割合を検討した。完全奇胎(96%)と侵入奇胎(96%)では一致率が高かったが、部分奇胎(64%)、絨毛癌(86%)、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(60%)では低かった。疑わしい奇胎の標本を系統的に再読することで、診療の質が向上すると結論している。
pmid-21840909.summary_en: This observational retrospective study from the French Trophoblastic Disease Reference Centre (1999 to 2011) evaluated how often referent pathologists confirmed diagnoses made by initial pathologists. Among 1851 hydatidiform moles and 150 gestational trophoblastic tumours, agreement was high for complete moles (96%) and invasive moles (96%), but lower for partial moles (64%), choriocarcinoma (86%) and placental site trophoblastic tumour (60%). The authors conclude that systematic slide rereading for suspicious moles improves diagnostic quality and management nationally.

pmid-21843365.summary_ja: transverse testicular ectopiaを有する24歳男性に生じた卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。異所性精巣の腫瘍として発症し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は245.5ng/mlと上昇していた。両側精巣摘除後に生じた左鼠径部の再発に対し、腫瘤切除と両側後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。8か月のフォローアップで生化学的・画像的再発は認めていない。
pmid-21843365.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with transverse testicular ectopia who developed a yolk sac tumor in an ectopic testis, with elevated AFP. After radical orchiectomy of both testes, he developed a recurrent yolk sac tumor in the left inguinal mass, treated with mass resection and bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The retroperitoneal nodes were not involved. He has been followed for eight months without biochemical or radiological recurrence, highlighting the need for vigilant surveillance in ectopic testes.

pmid-21847120.summary_ja: 分化型および未分化型の胚細胞腫瘍、体細胞癌、細胞株、異種移植片でOCT3/4のアイソフォーム発現を解析した研究である。未分化型胚細胞腫瘍ではOCT4AとOCT4B1が優位に発現していた。OCT4Aタンパクはセミノーマ型腫瘍、胎児性癌および代表的細胞株にのみ認められ、胚細胞腫瘍の診断マーカーとしての特異性が確認された。
pmid-21847120.summary_en: This study examined expression of OCT3/4 isoforms (OCT4A, OCT4B, OCT4B1) in differentiated and undifferentiated germ cell tumours, somatic cancers, and associated cell lines and xenografts. OCT4A and OCT4B1 were preferentially expressed in undifferentiated germ cell tumours, whereas OCT4B showed no difference between germ cell and somatic tumours. OCT4A protein appeared only in seminomatous tumours, embryonal carcinoma and representative cell lines, supporting its specificity as a diagnostic marker. The authors recommend combining isoform-specific mRNA and protein detection.

pmid-21848999.summary_ja: 胃と肝臓が腹腔外に脱出した腹壁破裂に、仙尾部奇形腫と下肢異常を合併した新生児の症例報告である。奇形腫は仙尾部から殿部にかけて完全に体外に露出していた。腹壁破裂と仙尾部奇形腫の合併は極めて稀であり、その稀な異常の組み合わせを報告している。
pmid-21848999.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with gastroschisis in which the stomach and extracorporeal liver herniated, a combination that worsens prognosis. The infant also had a large, completely external sacrococcygeal teratoma over the posteroinferior trunk and gluteal region, plus a malrotated lower limb and talipes equinovarus. The authors note that gastroschisis is rarely associated with sacrococcygeal teratoma and present this very rare co-occurrence to illustrate the unusual pattern of anomalies.

pmid-21849196.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍で後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた183例の標本を再検討した。原報告では約半数で血管侵襲の記載がなく、原報告と再検討の一致度は低かった。再検討された血管侵襲およびリスク分類はリンパ節転移と有意に関連し、病理再評価がリスク層別化に有用であることを示唆した。
pmid-21849196.summary_en: This study re-reviewed pathology slides from 183 patients who underwent orchiectomy elsewhere before retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors. Vascular invasion was missing from the original reports in about half of cases, and agreement between original and reviewed reports was poor (kappa 0.16 and 0.22). Reviewed vascular invasion and risk category were significantly associated with nodal metastasis, whereas original parameters were not, suggesting that pathology review improves risk stratification in stage I disease.

pmid-21850383.summary_ja: 1988〜2010年に治療された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍55例を後方視的に解析した。若年男性が多く、69%が非セミノーマ組織型であった。5年生存率は52%、全生存期間中央値は87.9か月であった。化学療法と局所療法の併用が最も良好な生存をもたらし、進展度と初期奏効率が独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-21850383.summary_en: This single-institution study of 55 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumor (PMGCT) treated from 1988 to 2010 evaluated prognosis and treatment outcomes. Most patients were young men, and 69% had nonseminomatous histology. The 5-year survival rate was 52%, with a median overall survival of 87.9 months. Patients receiving combined chemotherapy with surgery or radiotherapy survived longest. On multivariate analysis, extent of disease and response at initial evaluation were independent prognostic factors, supporting chemotherapy combined with local therapy.

pmid-21857863.summary_ja: 46歳の閉経周辺期女性が良性卵巣腫瘍として卵管卵巣摘出術を受けたが、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に扁平上皮癌への悪性転化が判明した。術後2週間で血尿を呈し、膀胱生検で卵巣由来の転移性扁平上皮癌と診断された。放射線療法1コース後にフォローアップから脱落した。悪性転化が疑われる場合の術前評価の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-21857863.summary_en: A 46-year-old perimenopausal woman underwent salpingo-oophorectomy for a presumed benign ovarian tumor, later diagnosed as mature cystic teratoma with malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma. Two weeks later she presented with haematuria, and cystoscopic biopsy revealed metastatic squamous cell carcinoma likely originating from the ovary. She was lost to follow-up after one course of radiotherapy. The authors stress thorough preoperative evaluation for suspected ovarian teratoma with malignant transformation.

pmid-21860563.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に対し外科的切除と補助化学療法を受けた25歳男性が、化学療法終了1週間後に白血球増多と芽球を呈した。骨髄検査で12p等染色体を含む複雑核型の急性巨核芽球性白血病と確認された。追加化学療法でも寛解に至らず、敗血症性ショックで死亡した。治療関連二次性白血病とは異なる特徴を有すると考察されている。
pmid-21860563.summary_en: A 25-year-old man with primary mediastinal germ cell tumor underwent surgical resection and adjuvant chemotherapy. One week after the final cycle he developed leukocytosis with blasts. Bone marrow examination confirmed acute megakaryoblastic leukemia with a complex karyotype including isochromosome 12p. Despite further chemotherapy he did not achieve remission and died of septic shock. The authors argue that the leukemia was clinically, morphologically and cytogenetically distinct from therapy-related secondary leukemia.

pmid-21860741.summary_ja: 非妊娠性由来と考えられる純粋卵巣絨毛癌の症例に対し、減量手術と術後化学療法を実施した。純粋卵巣絨毛癌は極めてまれで侵襲性が高く、臨床情報が乏しい。12か月のフォローアップで無病であり、併用治療の有効性が示唆された。報告例が少ないため、治療の参考となる症例である。
pmid-21860741.summary_en: The authors report a pure ovarian choriocarcinoma, likely of non-gestational origin, treated with cytoreductive surgery combined with postoperative chemotherapy. Pure ovarian choriocarcinomas are extremely rare and aggressive, and clinicopathologic information on them is limited. The patient remained disease-free at 12-month follow-up, suggesting that this combined approach can achieve durable control in this rare entity.

pmid-21860773.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎に対し5年前に全前子宮摘出術を受けた閉経後女性の、両側腎絨毛癌の症例報告。絨毛癌は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の中で最も悪性度が高く、腎転移は稀で両側性はさらに稀である。腎細胞癌との鑑別診断が問題となるため、胞状奇胎の既往がある高齢女性の腎腫瘤では絨毛癌の可能性を念頭に置く必要がある。
pmid-21860773.summary_en: A case report of bilateral renal choriocarcinoma in a postmenopausal woman who had undergone total anterior hysterectomy five years earlier for a hydatidiform mole. Choriocarcinoma is the most malignant form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, typically metastasizing to lung, liver and, less often, brain. Renal metastasis is rare, and bilateral involvement is exceptional. The renal lesions can mimic renal cell carcinoma, so clinicians should consider gestational trophoblastic origin in older women with renal masses and a prior molar pregnancy.

pmid-21861805.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する新たな抗癌分子標的をレビューした総説。キナーゼ阻害薬、血管新生阻害薬、細胞表面分子を標的とする抗体、遺伝子治療など、新規治療戦略の概要を示している。これらの手法は他の癌種の臨床試験で有効性が確認された例も多いと述べられている。精巣セミノーマに特有の候補分子標的の同定に焦点を当てている。
pmid-21861805.summary_en: This mini-review surveys newly proposed molecular targets for treating human testicular seminomas. It covers emerging therapeutic strategies including specific serine/threonine and tyrosine kinase inhibitors, angiogenesis inhibitors, antibodies against cell-surface receptors and molecules, and gene therapy. The authors note that these approaches have often shown efficacy in clinical trials across various cancers. The review focuses on identifying new potential molecular targets specific to testicular seminoma.

pmid-21872237.summary_ja: トルコの後方視的研究で、卵巣癌を合併した妊婦11例を検討した。腫瘍の約8割は病期I期で、多くは保存的手術を受けていた。組織型には悪性胚細胞腫瘍2例と、病期IV期で経過観察中に死亡したディスジャーミノーマが含まれた。3名の乳児は早産で出生したが良好な経過をたどった。著者らは、早期診断が極めて重要であり、妊娠中の手術は慎重な検討を要するため、治療は個別化すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-21872237.summary_en: This retrospective Turkish series of 11 pregnant women with ovarian cancer found that about 80% of tumors were stage I, and most underwent conservative surgery. Histologies included two malignant germ cell tumors and a stage IV dysgerminoma that caused death during follow-up. Three infants were born prematurely but did well. The authors conclude that early diagnosis is crucial and that treatment should be individualized, with surgery in pregnancy requiring careful consideration.

pmid-21876335.summary_ja: 1987〜2007年に治療されたセミノーマ型精巣がん180例を後方視的に検討した単施設研究である。臨床病期Iの症例が増加し、pT3はpT2より転移リスクが著明に高かった。10年・15年の無再発生存率は91%・85%、全生存期間(全生存率)は97%・96%であった。進行病期の患者では予後が有意に不良で、監視療法と予後因子の評価の必要性が示された。
pmid-21876335.summary_en: This single-center retrospective analysis of 180 patients with seminomatous testicular cancer (1987 to 2007) examined changes in stage distribution, treatment, and outcomes over four periods. Clinical stage I presentation increased over time, and pT3 tumors carried a much higher risk of metastasis than pT2. Ten- and 15-year recurrence-free survival were 91% and 85%, and five- and ten-year overall survival were 97% and 96%. Patients with advanced clinical stage had significantly worse outcomes, underscoring the need for surveillance and predictive-factor evaluation.

pmid-21876702.summary_ja: 妊娠初期に3次元パワードプラ超音波検査で診断された卵巣奇形腫の症例報告である。開腹で腫瘍を摘出し、母体・胎児ともに合併症はなかった。3次元超音波はMRIと同等に良性奇形腫を悪性腫瘍や複雑な病変から鑑別でき、手術適応の判断にも役立つとされる。
pmid-21876702.summary_en: This case report describes a pregnant woman with an ovarian teratoma diagnosed by three-dimensional power Doppler ultrasonography in the first trimester. The cyst was successfully removed by laparotomy without maternal or fetal complications. The authors argue that 3D ultrasound with multiplanar imaging can distinguish benign teratomas from complex or malignant adnexal lesions, comparably to MRI, and is reliable for preoperative assessment even in early pregnancy, helping decide which patients need surgery.

pmid-21881357.summary_ja: 12歳女児の前縦隔に生じた、成熟奇形腫と胎児型横紋筋肉腫が併存する悪性転化奇形腫の症例報告である。補助化学療法にもかかわらず再発し、術後16か月で死亡した。小児における自然発生の縦隔悪性転化奇形腫の初報告とされ、早期の外科的切除の必要性が強調されている。
pmid-21881357.summary_en: This case report describes a 12-year-old girl with an anterior mediastinal teratoma with malignant transformation, in which a mature teratoma coexisted with embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma. The solid component enlarged over six months and was surgically resected, but the tumor recurred despite adjuvant chemotherapy, and the patient died 16 months after surgery. The authors claim this is the first naturally occurring mediastinal TMT in a child and stress early surgical resection.

pmid-21893385.summary_ja: 東南アジアで絨毛癌の発生率が高い理由として、同地域で多いαサラセミア・メジャーによる自然流産の増加を挙げる仮説論文である。両疾患の地理的分布が類似している点に着目している。食事性因子に加えてこの関連を解明することで、絨毛癌の発生率を減らせる可能性があると述べている。
pmid-21893385.summary_en: This hypothesis article proposes that the high incidence of choriocarcinoma in Southeast Asia may be linked to alpha thalassemia major, which is associated with high rates of spontaneous abortion in the same regions. The authors compare the geographic distribution of the two conditions and argue that thalassemia-related pregnancy loss could be a plausible explanation beyond dietary factors. They suggest that clarifying this link could help reduce choriocarcinoma incidence.

pmid-21894083.summary_ja: 42歳男性が右精巣腫瘍（セミノーマ）と診断され右精巣摘除術を受けた。8年前には無精子症による男性不妊の精査中に左精巣セミノーマが発見されており、異時性の両側精巣腫瘍であった。対側の精巣生検では悪性所見はなく、現在はアンドロゲン補充療法を受けて再発はみられていない。
pmid-21894083.summary_en: A 42-year-old man presented with a right scrotal mass. Ultrasonography confirmed a right testicular tumor, and right high orchiectomy showed seminoma. Eight years earlier, during evaluation for azoospermia-related male infertility, a left testicular seminoma had been found. Left high orchiectomy was performed with right testicular biopsy and sperm extraction. The right testicular biopsy showed no malignancy. He receives androgen replacement therapy and has no evidence of recurrence. The case shows metachronous bilateral testicular tumors detected through infertility evaluation.

pmid-21894084.summary_ja: 56歳男性が左陰嚢内の無痛性腫瘤で受診した。中学生時代から約40年間放置されていた7cmの腫瘤で、腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲内であった。左高位精巣摘除術が行われ、病理組織学的検査で悪性胚細胞成分を含まない成熟奇形腫と診断された。術後4年間再発はみられていない。
pmid-21894084.summary_en: A 56-year-old man presented with a painless 7 cm left scrotal mass. He first noticed the mass as a junior high school student and had left it untreated for about 40 years. Serum AFP, beta-hCG and LDH were within normal limits. A clinical stage T1 left testicular tumor was diagnosed, and left high orchiectomy was performed. Histopathology showed a mature teratoma without malignant germ cell components. No recurrence was observed for four years after surgery. The case documents a benign testicular teratoma with childhood onset and very long natural history.

pmid-21894353.summary_ja: 2000年から2010年にサウジアラビアで原発性卵巣癌に対して保存的治療を受けた39例を後方視的に検討した。過半数が病期Iで、約半数が胚細胞腫瘍であった。再発は3例にみられ、8例が正常分娩に至った。妊孕性温存手術は選択された症例で安全かつ実行可能と結論づけられた。
pmid-21894353.summary_en: This retrospective study from Saudi Arabia reviewed 39 women, mostly young, treated conservatively for primary ovarian cancer between 2000 and 2010. Most had stage I disease, and about half had germ cell tumors. Fifteen patients received chemotherapy after surgery, and three had recurrence. Nearly all resumed regular menstruation, and eight had normal pregnancies. Many patients worried about their reproductive potential and the effects of treatment on offspring. The authors conclude that fertility-sparing surgery is safe and feasible in selected patients.

pmid-21897571.summary_ja: 新生児の口腔から突出する巨大な腫瘤を報告した症例である。舌根部から発生しており、切除と病理組織学的検査により悪性エピグナトスと診断された。エピグナトスは口咽頭に生じる奇形腫の一型で、新生児期にまれである。
pmid-21897571.summary_en: This report describes a neonate with a huge mass protruding from the oral cavity. The mass arose from the base of the tongue. Successful surgical excision was performed, and histopathological examination identified a malignant epignathus. Epignathus is a teratoma arising in the oropharynx, and it is rare in the newborn period. The report documents the clinical presentation, the surgical management, and the pathological diagnosis of this congenital malignant teratoma. It is a brief case description rather than a systematic study.

pmid-21897573.summary_ja: 開存尿膜管、重複尿道、精巣奇形腫の三者が合併したまれな症例の報告である。先天性尿路異常と精巣腫瘍が併存する点を強調している。抄録からは臨床経過の詳細は読み取れない。
pmid-21897573.summary_en: This case report describes a rare association of patent urachus, double urethra and testicular teratoma. The authors highlight the combination of these congenital anomalies with the development of a testicular teratoma. The report emphasizes the uncommon nature of this association. It is a brief case description without a detailed clinical course in the abstract. The paper is relevant to clinicians managing congenital urogenital anomalies that coexist with testicular germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-21898576.summary_ja: 2001年から2011年にコロンビア大学医療センターで抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された9例（女性8例、男児1例）を検討した。女性4例は卵巣奇形腫を有し、治療として摘除された。免疫抑制療法に加えて治療的血漿交換（TPE）が計56回施行され、合併症は手技の20%に生じたがほとんどは一過性の低血圧であった。早期のTPE開始が有益な可能性が示された。
pmid-21898576.summary_en: Nine patients were diagnosed with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis at Columbia University Medical Center between 2001 and 2011. Four of the female patients had ovarian teratomas, which were removed as part of treatment. Therapeutic plasma exchange was added to immunosuppressive therapy, with 56 procedures in total. Complications occurred in 20 percent of procedures, most of them transient hypotension. Early initiation of plasma exchange appeared beneficial. The authors concluded that plasma exchange is relatively safe, although the small series precludes firm conclusions about efficacy.

pmid-21907123.summary_ja: 生後6か月の女児が急速な片側性眼球突出を呈し、リンパ管腫と誤認された眼窩奇形腫の症例である。経結膜的アプローチで病変を完全切除し、整容面・機能面で良好な結果を得た。眼窩奇形腫は非性腺由来の胚細胞腫瘍で、新生児では視力障害を来すおそれがあるため、視機能保持のための早期切除の重要性を強調している。
pmid-21907123.summary_en: The report describes a 6-month-old girl with rapid unilateral proptosis and poor eyelid closure whose orbital mass was initially mistaken for lymphangioma. The authors fully excised the lesion through a transconjunctival approach, achieving good cosmetic and functional results. The paper emphasizes early excision to preserve vision in newborn orbital teratoma, a germ cell tumor of extragonadal origin.

pmid-21908299.summary_ja: 55日齢の雄子牛の腹腔に胎児性癌が見つかった症例である。腹水と腹壁・臓器表面の多発腫瘤を伴い、陰嚢内に精巣は認められなかった。腫瘍細胞はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)や胎盤型アルカリフォスファターゼに陽性で、ヒトの胎児性癌と類似していた。動物における性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の報告である。
pmid-21908299.summary_en: A 55-day-old male calf had an embryonal carcinoma in the abdominal cavity, with ascites and widespread masses on the abdominal wall and organ surfaces. The scrotum lacked testes. Histology showed solid sheets with papillary and tubular patterns. Tumor cells were positive for alpha-fetoprotein, placental alkaline phosphatase, cytokeratin and carcinoembryonic antigen. Ultrastructural and lectin findings resembled human embryonal carcinoma. This veterinary report describes an extragonadal germ cell tumor in an animal.

pmid-21908369.summary_ja: 2頭のペットのウサギに精巣性性腺芽腫が見られた。大型の胚細胞様円形細胞と小型紡錘形細胞からなる管状構造を示し、Call-Exner小体を形成していた。うち1例はセミノーマを併発していた。免疫組織化学では円形細胞がc-kit陽性、紡錘形細胞がビメンチン陽性を示した。
pmid-21908369.summary_en: Two pet domestic rabbits were found to have testicular gonadoblastoma, a rare tumor in domestic animals. Histology showed tubular structures of large germ-cell-like round cells and small Sertoli-like spindle cells, forming Call-Exner bodies. One case coexisted with seminoma. Immunohistochemistry showed c-kit and placental alkaline phosphatase in round cells, and vimentin and Wilms tumor protein in spindle cells. Ultrastructure confirmed Call-Exner bodies with duplicated basal lamina.

pmid-21915385.summary_ja: 精巣類表皮嚢腫は精巣腫瘍の1〜2%を占める良性病変で、両側発生は極めて稀である。若年男性の精巣腫瘤では、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の方が約50倍多いため悪性を疑う必要がある。両側例で精巣温存手術を可能にするには、術前の正確な画像診断が重要である。
pmid-21915385.summary_en: This report describes a young man with bilateral testicular epidermoid cysts, a rare benign lesion accounting for only 1–2% of testicular tumors. The authors stress that a testicular mass in a young man must be treated as malignant until proven otherwise, because testicular germ cell tumor is about 50 times more common. Accurate preoperative imaging diagnosis is essential to permit testis-sparing surgery in bilateral cases.

pmid-21916045.summary_ja: ナイジェリア・ラゴスの大学病院で、10年間の卵巣生検486例を後方視的に検討した。卵巣腫瘍203例のうち胚細胞腫瘍が52.7%と最多で、良性では成熟奇形腫が最も多かった。悪性では漿液性嚢胞腺癌が最多であった。アフリカの他地域と類似したパターンであった。
pmid-21916045.summary_en: This ten-year retrospective histologic study of 486 ovarian biopsies at Lagos University Teaching Hospital, Nigeria, identified 203 true ovarian neoplasms. Germ cell tumors were the most common (52.7%), and mature teratoma was the most frequent benign tumor. Serous cystadenocarcinoma was the commonest malignancy. The authors conclude that this pattern, with germ cell tumors predominating, resembles that seen in most of Africa.

pmid-21929773.summary_ja: 46,XY純粋性性腺異形成（Swyer症候群）の21歳患者の異形成性性腺に生じたディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例報告。Swyer症候群は46,XY核型で表現型は女性、精巣組織を欠く。性腺が機能しないため思春期に無月経などで発症する。本例は、この疾患の性腺に胚細胞腫瘍が発生しうることを示す。
pmid-21929773.summary_en: This case report describes a dysgerminoma diagnosed in a dysgenetic gonad of a 21-year-old woman with pure 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis, also known as Swyer syndrome. Affected individuals have a 46,XY karyotype, female external genitalia, normal Müllerian structures, and no testicular tissue. They usually present in adolescence with delayed puberty and primary amenorrhea because their gonads lack hormonal and reproductive function. The case illustrates that germ cell tumors can develop in dysgenetic gonads in this condition.

pmid-21929968.summary_ja: 新生児の大型Altman III型仙尾部奇形腫が脊柱管内へ進展し、対麻痺を来した症例。術前に外側仙骨動脈を塞栓し、前後の複合アプローチで完全摘出した。病理は成熟奇形腫で、1歳時点で再発はないものの対麻痺は残存した。良性組織像でも神経症状が回復しない場合があることを示す。
pmid-21929968.summary_en: This report describes a neonate with a large Altman type III sacrococcygeal teratoma that extended into the spinal canal and caused paraplegia. Preoperative embolization of the lateral sacral arteries preceded complete resection through combined anterior and posterior approaches. Pathology confirmed a mature teratoma. Although the tumor was removed without evidence of recurrence, paraplegia persisted at one year of age, showing that intradural extension can lead to lasting neurological deficit despite benign histology.

pmid-21934226.summary_ja: CA-125高値と両側卵巣腫瘤を呈した46歳女性の症例。左卵巣に濾胞型乳頭状甲状腺癌を伴う両側奇形腫（悪性卵巣甲状腺腫）と診断された。両側奇形腫に悪性卵巣甲状腺腫を合併した初めての報告である。上皮性卵巣腫瘍との鑑別の難しさ、術中迅速診断、管理およびフォローアップ上の課題を論じる。
pmid-21934226.summary_en: This report describes a 46-year-old woman with bilateral cystic adnexal masses, one containing ossified elements, and raised CA-125 levels. Intraoperative frozen section and final pathology showed bilateral teratomas, with a follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in the left ovary. The authors note this is the first reported malignant struma ovarii occurring with bilateral teratomas. They discuss the diagnostic difficulty of mimicking an epithelial ovarian neoplasm, the role of intraoperative frozen section, and management and follow-up challenges.

pmid-21934340.summary_ja: 1998〜2009年に再発または難治性の胚細胞腫瘍14例に施行された救援化学療法TIPの後方視的検討。14例中10例はシスプラチン抵抗性であった。5例(37.5%)がTIP単独で奏効し、1例は術後に完全寛解を得た。全生存期間(全生存率)の中央値は21.1か月。不良な予後因子を有する患者にも有効となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-21934340.summary_en: This retrospective review evaluated salvage paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and cisplatin (TIP) in 14 patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors treated between 1998 and 2009. Ten had cisplatin-refractory disease. Five patients (37.5%) responded to TIP alone, and one more achieved complete response after surgery. The median overall survival was 21.1 months. The authors conclude that TIP can be active even in patients with poor prognostic features.

pmid-21935879.summary_ja: 甲状腺機能が正常で抗甲状腺ペルオキシダーゼ抗体陽性の女性において、両側性良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の甲状腺組織に橋本病を認めた症例報告。甲状腺組織は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の約10%に見られるが、卵巣奇形腫に橋本病が生じることは極めて稀である。
pmid-21935879.summary_en: This case report describes a clinically euthyroid woman with normal thyroid hormone levels who tested positive for antithyroid peroxidase antibodies. Histology of a bilateral benign ovarian cystic teratoma showed Hashimoto's thyroiditis within the thyroid tissue component. Thyroid tissue occurs in about 10% of mature cystic teratomas, but Hashimoto's thyroiditis is an extremely rare finding in ovarian teratomas. The authors highlight the rarity of this combination.

pmid-21935881.summary_ja: 68歳男性の前頸部正中の腫瘤で、甲状腺峡部に浸潤していた。病理組織学的検査により、性腺外原発の胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。前頸部正中に生じる原発性胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀であり、前頸部腫瘤の鑑別診断に含めるべきことを示す。
pmid-21935881.summary_en: This case report describes a 68-year-old man with a midline anterior neck mass infiltrating the thyroid isthmus. Histopathological examination showed a primary germ cell tumor with extragonadal localization. Primary germ cell tumors involving the midline anterior neck are extremely rare. The report underscores that extragonadal germ cell tumors can present in unexpected cervical locations and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of anterior neck masses.

pmid-21941493.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫から生じた腸型粘液性境界悪性卵巣腫瘍が、腫瘍減量術後に遅発性の浸潤性再発をきたした症例の報告。卵巣由来の腹膜偽粘液腫は稀で、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の粘液性腫瘍の破綻が関与すると考えられている。境界悪性腫瘍は一般に緩慢な経過をたどり予後は良好とされ、文献レビューを併記している。
pmid-21941493.summary_en: This case report describes a late invasive recurrence, after complete surgical debulking, of an intestinal-type mucinous borderline ovarian tumor that arose from a mature teratoma. The authors note that pseudomyxoma peritonei associated with primary ovarian tumors is rare and has been linked to ruptured mucinous tumors arising in mature cystic teratomas. Borderline tumors usually behave indolently, so prognosis is generally excellent. A literature review accompanies the case.

pmid-21941958.summary_ja: 1991〜2009年に単施設で管理された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍34例の後方視的解析。10年生存率は最大80%。病期I 13例中8例が積極的監視とされ、3例が再発、未熟奇形腫の1例が死亡した。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍は治癒可能だが精巣例より予後不良とされ、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の管理を範とした広域的診療体制が提案されている。
pmid-21941958.summary_en: This retrospective single-center review of 34 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors managed between 1991 and 2009 reports 10-year survival rates of up to 80%. Among 13 patients with Stage I disease, 8 were recommended active surveillance, and three of them relapsed; one patient with immature teratoma died. The authors conclude that ovarian germ cell tumors are potentially curable but have a worse prognosis than testicular tumors, and propose a supra-regional service modeled on gestational trophoblastic disease management.

pmid-21941968.summary_ja: 急性腹症と異所性妊娠の所見を呈した若年女性例。初診時のhCG 1110.5 IU/lは術後に18.5 IU/lへ低下した。腹腔鏡下の卵巣生検により原発性卵巣絨毛癌と診断された。異所性妊娠と臨床的に紛らわしい原発性卵巣絨毛癌の一例として示されている。
pmid-21941968.summary_en: A young woman presented with acute abdominal pain and signs of ectopic pregnancy. Her initial beta-hCG was 1110.5 IU/L and fell to 18.5 IU/L postoperatively. Ovarian biopsy taken at laparoscopy confirmed primary ovarian choriocarcinoma. The case illustrates how primary ovarian choriocarcinoma can mimic an ectopic pregnancy clinically, and shows the value of tracking hCG levels after treatment.

pmid-21943440.summary_ja: セミノーマと考えられていた卵黄嚢分化を伴う精巣胚細胞腫瘍が、43年の監視後に再発した症例報告。従来の最長再発間隔は32年とされる。病期にかかわらず晩期再発が起こり得るため、欧州泌尿器科学会のガイドラインに沿った少なくとも5年間の密なフォローアップが必要と論じている。
pmid-21943440.summary_en: This case report describes a late testicular relapse 43 years after surveillance of a germ cell tumor thought to be a pure seminoma that had undergone yolk sac differentiation. The previous longest recorded interval to relapse was 32 years. The authors argue that late relapse can occur whatever the initial stage, and note that European Association of Urology guidelines require close, active follow-up for at least five years, with the optimal duration of continued follow-up unclear.

pmid-21943446.summary_ja: 26歳女性で類皮嚢腫の破裂後に硬化性被包性腹膜炎(SEP)を発症した症例報告。類皮嚢腫破裂による急性化学性腹膜炎がSEPへ進展する可能性を提唱している。この稀な合併症の臨床経過と管理に焦点を当て、本症例の臨床像と治療経過をまとめ、類皮嚢腫破裂が腹膜の線維化を伴う重篤な病態を引き起こし得ることを示している。
pmid-21943446.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman developed sclerosing encapsulating peritonitis (SEP) after rupture of a dermoid cyst. The authors propose that acute chemical peritonitis caused by dermoid cyst rupture can progress to SEP, producing the clinical features described in this case. The report focuses on the presentation and management of this rare complication.

pmid-21943447.summary_ja: 直腸腫瘤として発症した良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。多診療科チームにより直腸の根治的切除が行われた。大腸内視鏡や画像検査を含む術前評価と、多職種連携による正確な診断の重要性が強調されている。非定型な症状を示す若年女性では、卵巣類皮嚢腫が直腸へ浸潤している可能性も考慮すべきとされる。
pmid-21943447.summary_en: This case report describes a benign ovarian cystic teratoma that presented as a rectal mass and was treated with radical resection by a multidisciplinary team. The authors emphasize thorough preoperative evaluation, including colonoscopy and radiological investigation, and multidisciplinary involvement to achieve accurate diagnosis. They also note that erosion of an ovarian dermoid into the rectum should be considered in young women with atypical presentations and benign-appearing rectal lesions.

pmid-21949666.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、通常は生殖腺堤近くの正中線上に生じる奇形腫が、異例の部位である前腹膜外に生じた二側性奇形腫を記述する。著者らは、原始胚細胞が本来の移動先を逸れて別の場所で腫瘍を形成するとする「移動先の逸脱」説と整合すると論じ、性腺外奇形腫の胎生学的起源仮説を支持する所見を提示している。ただし単一症例であり、結論は推測的なものにとどまる。
pmid-21949666.summary_en: This case report describes a bipartite anterior extraperitoneal teratoma, an unusual location for a teratoma that typically occurs in the midline near the gonadal ridges. The authors discuss the embryological basis of teratomas, proposing that primordial germ cells may miss their normal migration target and form tumors elsewhere, consistent with the 'missed target' theory. Teratomas are described as arising from totipotent primordial germ cells and can occur anywhere from brain to coccyx. The report adds support for the embryological origin hypothesis of extragonadal teratomas, though it is a single case and the conclusions remain speculative.

pmid-21951524.summary_ja: 本総説は、ヒトとゼブラフィッシュにおける生殖系の発生と胚細胞腫瘍の生物学をまとめたものである。胚細胞腫瘍は乳児から若年成人に発生し、組織学的分化や臨床経過が多様である。分子機構や代表的動物モデルが不足していることから、生殖系の発生がヒトと広く保存されているゼブラフィッシュが、胚細胞の発生と腫瘍形成を結びつける有用なモデルになると述べている。ゼブラフィッシュ生殖系の研究法も概説されている。
pmid-21951524.summary_en: This review summarizes germline development and germ cell tumor (GCT) biology in humans and zebrafish. GCTs arise from pluripotent germ cells in infants, children and young adults and show diverse histologic differentiation with varying clinical behavior. Because molecular mechanisms and representative animal models are lacking, the authors argue that zebrafish, whose germline development is broadly conserved with humans, is a useful model for linking germ cell development to tumorigenesis. The article also outlines methods for studying the zebrafish germline.

pmid-21953186.summary_ja: 本研究では、根治的精巣摘除術を受けた15例からのセミノーマと隣接正常精巣組織を、脱離エレクトロスプレーイオン化質量分析イメージングで比較した。正常精細管ではセミノリピドやグリセロホスホイノシトールが高強度に検出され、セミノーマでは検出されなかった。一方、アスコルビン酸はセミノーマで増加していた。これらの脂質・代謝物の空間分布により腫瘍と正常組織を識別できた。セミノーマにおけるアスコルビン酸の増加は既報がなかった知見である。
pmid-21953186.summary_en: This study used desorption electrospray ionization mass spectrometry imaging to compare seminoma tissue with adjacent normal testicular tissue from 15 patients who underwent radical orchiectomy. Seminolipids and a glycerophosphoinositol were present at higher intensity in normal seminiferous tubules and were undetectable in seminoma, whereas ascorbic acid was increased in seminoma. The spatial distribution of these lipid and metabolite signals distinguished tumor from normal tissue. The finding that ascorbic acid accumulates in seminoma compared with normal tubules had not been previously reported.

pmid-21965259.summary_ja: 1995年から2007年に、化学療法後の精巣腫瘍の後腹膜残存腫瘤を切除した60例を後方視的に検討した。組織は奇形腫48%、壊死・線維化42%、生存腫瘍10%であった。hCG高値は生存腫瘍と関連し、原発巣の奇形腫は後腹膜の奇形腫と関連したが、術前に組織型を確実に予測できる因子はなかった。
pmid-21965259.summary_en: This retrospective series of 60 residual retroperitoneal mass resections after chemotherapy for testicular tumours (1995 to 2007) found teratoma in 48%, necrosis or fibrosis in 42%, and viable tumour in 10%. Tumour marker normalization was seen in 87%. Elevated hCG correlated with viable tumour, and teratoma in the primary tumour was associated with retroperitoneal teratoma, but no preoperative factor reliably predicted histology. Repeated resections were needed in four patients.

pmid-21969283.summary_ja: 8歳女児が筋炎様症状、CK・ネオプテリン高値、爪郭部の変化を呈し、若年性皮膚筋炎が疑われた。筋生検では否定された。骨盤部の画像検査で左卵巣腫瘤が確認され、成熟奇形腫と合致した。摘除後、筋炎・滑膜炎・皮膚症状は追加治療なしに4か月で軽快した。
pmid-21969283.summary_en: This case report describes an 8-year-old girl with myositis-like symptoms, elevated creatine kinase, neopterin and IgG/IgE, and nailfold changes that initially suggested juvenile dermatomyositis. A muscle biopsy did not support that diagnosis. Pelvic MRI and ultrasound revealed a left ovarian mass, which was consistent with a mature teratoma. After surgical removal, the myositis, synovitis and cutaneous findings resolved within four months without further therapy.

pmid-21969832.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍(奇形腫と胎児性癌の混合型)に対し精巣摘除、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、化学療法を受けた36歳男性が、18年後にαフェトプロテイン上昇で受診した。MRIとPET-CTで左腎腫瘤と後腹膜リンパ節腫大を認め、後腹膜鏡下に両者を同時に切除した。リンパ節は胎児性癌、腎腫瘤は腎細胞癌であった。長期のフォローアップの重要性が示された。
pmid-21969832.summary_en: A 36-year-old man treated for mixed teratoma and embryonal carcinoma of the left testis (orchiectomy, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and chemotherapy) presented 18 years later with elevated alpha-fetoprotein. MRI and PET-CT revealed a 30 mm left renal mass and a 22 mm retroperitoneal lymph node. Retroperitoneoscopic lymph node dissection and left renal tumour resection were performed in one session. Histology showed embryonal carcinoma in the node and renal cell carcinoma in the kidney, underscoring the need for long-term follow-up.

pmid-21969846.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の寛解導入化学療法後の残存腫瘤の管理を概説している。腫瘍マーカーが正常化した後腹膜残存腫瘤が1cmを超える場合は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行うべきとしている。1cm未満で腫瘍マーカーが正常な場合は完全奏効とみなせるが、残存奇形腫や生存腫瘍は否定できない。良好な長期無病生存から、この群ではサーベイランスが妥当な選択肢となりうる。
pmid-21969846.summary_en: This review addresses management of residual masses in advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumours after induction chemotherapy. Retroperitoneal residual masses larger than 1 cm with normalized tumour markers should undergo post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Masses under 1 cm with normal markers may be regarded as complete response, although residual teratoma or viable tumour cannot be excluded. Surveillance may be a reasonable option for this subgroup given its good long-term disease-free survival.

pmid-21970241.summary_ja: 2000年から2009年にエヌグ大学病院に入院した婦人科悪性腫瘍407例を後方視的に検討した。全体では子宮頸癌が78%と最多であった。30歳未満では絨毛癌(36.1%)が最も多く、卵巣癌(33.3%)が続いた。貧血が最も多い合併症であった。若年女性における絨毛癌の多さが示された。
pmid-21970241.summary_en: A retrospective review of 407 gynaecological cancers admitted to the University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital, Enugu, between 2000 and 2009. Cervical cancer was the most common overall (78%). Among women under 30, choriocarcinoma (36.1%) was the commonest cancer, followed by ovarian cancer (33.3%). Anaemia was the most frequent complication. The study highlights the high burden of choriocarcinoma in young women in this setting.

pmid-21971107.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマ患者に傍大動脈リンパ節への補助放射線療法(総線量24Gy)を行い、13〜84か月追跡した研究である。悪心・嘔吐や心理・認知症状が主な副作用で、持続例は6%に留まった。個別化治療と家族への相談により、QOLや妊孕性への影響は許容範囲と結論づけている。
pmid-21971107.summary_en: This study followed patients with stage I testicular seminoma who received adjuvant radiotherapy to para-aortic lymph nodes, over 13 to 84 months. Common acute effects were nausea, vomiting, and psychological or cognitive symptoms, which were managed with antiemetics and anxiolytics. Persistent side effects occurred in 6 percent of patients. Most patients in the 18 to 39 age group later had healthy children. The authors conclude that this 24 Gy regimen is acceptable when treatment is individualized and families receive counseling.

pmid-21972094.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍325例を用い、クラスI HDAC1〜3の発現を組織学的亜型ごとに比較した。HDAC2と3は全亜型で高発現、HDAC1は低めであった。セミノーマと非セミノーマで差があり、絨毛癌は3つすべてが高発現だった。HDAC阻害薬への反応性の指標となる可能性があり、今後の検討が必要である。
pmid-21972094.summary_en: This study used a tissue microarray of 325 testicular germ cell tumors to compare class I histone deacetylase (HDAC) 1, 2, and 3 expression across histological subtypes. HDAC2 and HDAC3 were highly expressed in all subtypes, while HDAC1 was generally lower. Expression differed significantly between seminoma and non-seminoma components. Choriocarcinomas showed high expression of all three isoforms. No clear clinicopathological correlations emerged, but the high levels may predict response to HDAC inhibitors, which warrants further study.

pmid-21974818.summary_ja: ヒト精巣の正常組織と腫瘍(胚細胞腫瘍を含む)でGPERの発現を免疫組織化学とウェスタンブロットで検討した。正常精巣ではライディッヒ細胞とセルトリ細胞が陽性で、胚細胞は陰性であった。セミノーマや胎児性癌では腫瘍細胞が陽性で、正常胚細胞との違いが示された。
pmid-21974818.summary_en: This study examined GPER, a G-protein-coupled estrogen receptor, in normal and neoplastic human testes using immunohistochemistry and Western blot. GPER was expressed in Leydig and Sertoli cells in control testes, but germ cells were negative. Neoplastic cells from seminoma and embryonal carcinoma samples, along with Sertoli and Leydig cell tumors, were GPER-positive. The findings suggest GPER may mediate estrogen signaling in somatic cells, while expression in germ cell neoplasms differs from normal germ cells.

pmid-21975326.summary_ja: 38歳女性の腎盂原発絨毛癌の症例で、転移病変による脳出血で発症した。腎生検と血清β-hCG高値で診断され、腎盂起源と確認された。性腺外絨毛癌の文献レビューも含む。重篤な脳出血が初発症状となった初の症例として報告されている。
pmid-21975326.summary_en: The authors report a 38-year-old woman with primary choriocarcinoma of the renal pelvis who presented with intracerebral hemorrhage from metastatic lesions. Diagnosis was made by renal biopsy and elevated serum beta-hCG, and extensive workup confirmed a renal pelvis origin. The report also reviews extragonadal choriocarcinomas and highlights this as the first case with severe intracerebral hemorrhage as the initial presentation. The authors emphasize considering choriocarcinoma in women of reproductive age with unexplained tumors.

pmid-21975933.summary_ja: LSD1阻害薬を開発し、多能性がん細胞に対する効果を検討した。胎児性癌やセミノーマの細胞株の増殖を強く抑制し、非多能性のがん細胞や正常体細胞への影響は小さかった。ヒト精巣セミノーマ組織でもLSD1が高発現しており、多能性腫瘍の標的として示唆された。
pmid-21975933.summary_en: This study developed small-molecule inhibitors of the histone demethylase LSD1 and tested them on pluripotent cancer cells. The inhibitors suppressed proliferation of teratocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, and seminoma cells, which express Oct4 and Sox2, with little effect on non-pluripotent cancer or normal somatic cells. LSD1 protein was elevated in these cells and in human testicular seminoma tissue expressing Oct4. The authors conclude that LSD1 is a cancer-selective epigenetic target in pluripotent tumor cells.

pmid-21976922.summary_ja: 精巣悪性腫瘍に対する部分精巣摘除術と対側ITGCNに関する文献をレビューした。単精巣や両側腫瘍例など選択された患者で、2cm未満の腫瘍など厳格な基準下で適応となる。術後は18〜20Gyの精巣照射が行われる。異時性の対側腫瘍のリスクは約5%で、綿密なフォローアップが必要とされる。
pmid-21976922.summary_en: This world literature review examines partial orchiectomy for testicular malignancy and contralateral intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN). Partial orchiectomy is an option in selected patients, such as those with a solitary testis or bilateral tumors, when tumors are under 2 cm and strict surgical criteria are met. It is followed by testicular irradiation of 18 to 20 Gy. Patients with testicular cancer have about a 5 percent risk of metachronous contralateral tumor, so close follow-up is required.

pmid-21979483.summary_ja: 成人女性の仙尾部奇形腫の症例を報告する。仙尾部奇形腫は乳児に多いが、成人では稀である。臨床経過、画像所見と組織学的所見、治療、転帰を記載し、文献レビューを併せて行っている。
pmid-21979483.summary_en: The authors present a case of sacrococcygeal teratoma in a female adult. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is common in infants but rare in adults. The report describes the clinical presentation, radiological and histological findings, management, and outcome. It is a case report with a literature review.

pmid-21979590.summary_ja: 著者らは、子宮体部に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を生じた46歳女性を報告する。子宮奇形腫の多くは子宮頸部由来であるため、本症例は稀である。短鎖反復配列(STR)によるDNA解析の結果、この腫瘍は卵巣や子宮頸部の奇形腫と異なり単為生殖に由来しないことが示された。著者らは、子宮の多能性幹細胞または減数分裂I前の原始胚細胞に由来する可能性を指摘している。
pmid-21979590.summary_en: The authors report a 46-year-old woman with a mature cystic teratoma arising in the uterine corpus, which is rare since most uterine teratomas are cervical. Short tandem repeat DNA analysis showed the tumor did not arise by parthenogenesis, unlike ovarian and cervical teratomas. The authors suggest it may originate from uterine pluripotent stem cells or primordial germ cells before meiosis I.

pmid-21982889.summary_ja: 生検で確定診断された縦隔の大きな卵黄嚢（内胚葉洞）腫瘍を有する24歳男性の症例を報告する。患者は合併した血球貪食症候群により汎血球減少と凝固障害を呈し、転帰は致死的であった。本報告には関連文献の簡単な検討が含まれる。この合併はきわめてまれで、既報は数例にとどまる。
pmid-21982889.summary_en: The authors report a 24-year-old man with a large mediastinal endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor, confirmed by biopsy. He developed pancytopenia and coagulopathy from associated hemophagocytic syndrome, and the outcome was fatal. The report includes a brief literature review. Such an association is exceedingly rare, with only a few prior cases on record.

pmid-21985733.summary_ja: 無症状で拡大傾向を示す腹膜前間隙の腫瘤を有する69歳男性に、類皮嚢腫が認められた。類皮嚢腫は良性腫瘍だが、破裂や悪性転化の可能性がある。本症例は腹腔鏡下に切除され、破裂リスクを減らす標準的な方法がとられた。著者らは、類皮嚢腫の外胚葉起源、腹腔内での発現様式、化学性肉芽腫や腹膜炎などの合併症を論じている。腹腔内類皮嚢腫は症例報告のみであるため、この性腺外での稀な発現に関する限られた知見を補う報告である。
pmid-21985733.summary_en: A 69-year-old man with an asymptomatic, enlarging preperitoneal mass was found to have a dermoid cyst, a benign tumor with potential for rupture and malignant transformation. The lesion was excised laparoscopically, the standard approach for minimizing rupture risk. The authors review dermoid cysts' ectodermal origin, abdominal presentation, and complications including chemical granuloma and peritonitis. Only case reports describe abdominal dermoid cysts, so the report adds to limited evidence on this rare extragonadal presentation.

pmid-21985734.summary_ja: 両側卵巣類皮嚢腫の腹腔鏡手術を試みた3日後に、発熱と腹膜刺激症状、白血球増多を呈した女性の症例である。化学性腹膜炎と診断され、再手術で残存する嚢腫内容物と広範な癒着が確認された。残存物の除去、両側卵管卵巣摘出術、大量の洗浄により軽快した。術中の嚢腫内容物の漏出による合併症に注意が必要である。
pmid-21985734.summary_en: A woman presented three days after attempted laparoscopic removal of bilateral ovarian dermoid cysts with fever, peritoneal signs, and leukocytosis. Diagnosed with chemical peritonitis, she underwent repeat laparoscopy, which revealed residual dermoid contents and extensive adhesions. Removal of residual contents, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and copious irrigation resolved the peritonitis. The authors conclude that prompt repeat laparoscopy with removal of remaining contents and peritoneal lavage is an effective treatment. The report highlights the complication risk of cyst spillage during surgery.

pmid-21985849.summary_ja: 1960年から2009年に治療された病期I精巣セミノーマの320例を後方視的に検討した。中央値22.7年の追跡で、10年疾患特異的生存率は97.7%、無再発生存率は97.6%であった。大多数が補助放射線療法を受け、急性毒性は主に消化器症状であった。欧州のコンセンサスに基づき、サーベイランスが第一選択とされる。
pmid-21985849.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 320 patients with stage I testicular seminoma treated from 1960 to 2009, with median follow-up of 22.7 years. Most received adjuvant radiotherapy, with mild acute toxicity. The 10-year disease-specific and relapse-free survival were 97.7% and 97.6%. Eight patients relapsed and were treated with chemotherapy. The authors conclude that surveillance is the preferred first option per European consensus given comparable outcomes and low toxicity, with adjuvant radiotherapy or chemotherapy reserved for patients declining surveillance.

pmid-21986018.summary_ja: 35歳の絨毛癌患者で、5コース目の化学療法後にβ-hCGは正常範囲に保たれていた。しかし8コースの併用化学療法後に子宮が自然穿孔し、腹腔内出血を来した。緊急子宮摘出術により救命された。子宮内に病変が残存すると、十分な化学療法後でも穿孔が起こりうるため、治療後のフォローアップの重要性が強調されている。
pmid-21986018.summary_en: A 35-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma had serum β-hCG levels within normal range after a fifth course of chemotherapy. After eight courses of combined chemotherapy, she developed spontaneous uterine perforation with intra-abdominal hemorrhage despite normal markers. Emergency hysterectomy was performed and she survived. The authors note that persistent uterine disease may cause perforation even after adequate chemotherapy, emphasizing the importance of careful follow-up after treatment, since normal hCG levels do not exclude residual disease.

pmid-21986223.summary_ja: 2009年上海でのSIU/ICUDコンセンサス会議による、局所限局性の病期I-IIセミノーマの管理に関する提言である。病期Iでは実施可能な場合、サーベイランスが選択される。病期IIAは放射線療法、IIBは化学療法または放射線療法、IICは化学療法が標準とされる。化学療法後の残存腫瘤は3cm未満であれば経過観察可能である。
pmid-21986223.summary_en: This consensus report from the 2009 Shanghai SIU/ICUD meeting addresses management of localized stage I-II seminoma. For stage I, surveillance is preferred when feasible, after informing patients of all options including salvage treatment effects. Stage IIA is best treated with radiotherapy, IIB with chemotherapy or radiotherapy, and IIC with chemotherapy. Residual masses under 3 cm after chemotherapy may be safely observed, while larger masses may warrant surgery or close observation, which is technically challenging with higher morbidity.

pmid-21986225.summary_ja: 2009年11月の上海会議によるSIU/ICUDコンセンサス報告で、進行セミノーマおよび非セミノーマの胚細胞腫瘍の治療を総括する。シスプラチン併用化学療法により、進行精巣がん患者の約80%で完全寛解が得られるようになった。毒性軽減を目指し、進行セミノーマではカルボプラチンがエトポシドおよびブレオマイシンと併用して検討された。欧州の標準治療は、無作為化試験とコンセンサス会議により定められた。
pmid-21986225.summary_en: This SIU/ICUD consensus report, from the November 2009 Shanghai meeting, reviews management of advanced seminoma and nonseminoma germ cell tumors. Cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy has substantially improved cure rates, with complete response in about 80% of advanced testicular cancer patients. Subsequent trials sought to reduce toxicity by limiting cycles or omitting drugs, and carboplatin combined with etoposide and bleomycin was investigated for advanced seminoma. The European standard was defined through consensus conferences and trials, with evidence graded by a modified Oxford scale.

pmid-21987446.summary_ja: セミノーマ様細胞株TCam-2を、HDAC阻害薬デプシペプチドや脱メチル化剤などで処理し、感受性を検討した。デプシペプチド(10nM超)でアポトーシスが誘導され、セミノーマに対する治療選択肢となりうることが示された。NANOGの抑制では分化遺伝子の発現が増加したが形態変化は認めず、NANOGは分化阻害の主因ではないと結論された。
pmid-21987446.summary_en: This study examined the seminoma-like cell line TCam-2 in response to HDAC inhibitor depsipeptide, the demethylating agent 5-aza-2'-deoxycytidine, all-trans retinoic acid, and tranylcypromine, as well as NANOG and TFAP2C knockdown. TCam-2 cells underwent apoptosis with depsipeptide above 10 nM but were resistant to the other agents, suggesting depsipeptide as a potential seminoma treatment. NANOG knockdown induced endoderm and trophectoderm gene expression without morphological differentiation, with compensatory OCT3/4 and SOX17 upregulation, indicating NANOG is not a primary inhibitor of differentiation.

pmid-21987615.summary_ja: 85歳女性が重度の腹部膨満で受診し、ガスを含む巨大な腹部腫瘤が認められた。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)でガス液面形成と糞便が確認され、S状結腸との交通が疑われた。緊急開腹術で腫瘤と関連する結腸を一括切除した。病理学的に卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌と確定した。卵巣奇形腫が瘻孔を形成しガス貯留性腫瘤を呈した、極めて稀な症例である。
pmid-21987615.summary_en: An 85-year-old woman presented with severe abdominal distension due to a huge gas-filled abdominal mass. Computed tomography showed air-fluid levels and fecal matter, suggesting communication with the sigmoid colon. Emergency laparotomy revealed the mass fistulating to the colon, which was resected together with the involved colon segment. Pathology confirmed squamous cell carcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The case illustrates an extremely rare presentation of an ovarian teratoma with a gas-filled mass and malignant transformation.

pmid-21987947.summary_ja: 妊娠18週の35歳女性が、腹痛、腹部膨満、嘔吐を主訴に来院した症例報告。超音波検査で両側卵巣腫瘤と妊娠を認め、手術で右側の腫瘤が小腸と癒着していた。両側の腫瘤を摘出し、病理学的に良性の嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。妊娠は保存的に管理され、正期産で健康な男児が出生した。迅速な手術と保存的妊娠管理の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-21987947.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman at 18 weeks of gestation who presented with abdominal pain, distension, and vomiting caused by intestinal obstruction. Ultrasound showed bilateral ovarian masses and a viable singleton pregnancy. At surgery, the right mass was adherent to the small intestine. Both masses were excised and histologically confirmed as benign cystic teratoma. The pregnancy was managed conservatively, and she delivered a healthy male infant at term. The authors emphasize prompt surgical intervention and conservative pregnancy management for a favorable outcome.

pmid-21988930.summary_ja: 単一施設の後方視的研究で、病期I〜IVの悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍57例を解析した。大多数が術後にシスプラチン併用化学療法を受け、5年生存率は96.5%であった。初回治療失敗は6例で、多変量解析では救済手術後の残存腫瘍のみが独立した有意な危険因子だった。救済手術後の残存病変は、リスク層別化や補助療法の判断に役立つと結論づけられている。
pmid-21988930.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective study analyzed 57 patients with stage I to IV malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Most patients received cisplatin-based chemotherapy after surgery. The five-year survival rate was 96.5%, with six primary treatment failures. In multivariate analysis, residual tumor after salvage surgery was the only significant independent predictor of primary treatment failure. The authors conclude that residual disease after salvage surgery may guide risk stratification and decisions about adjuvant therapy.

pmid-21995170.summary_ja: 間欠的な腹痛を訴えた60歳女性の症例報告。当初は卵巣腫瘍と誤診された腸間膜の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（9×8×8cm）を経験した。毛髪と皮脂を含み、腸間膜と小腸に広範な肉芽腫性炎症を認めた。子宮と付属器に病変はなかった。30年間で2000例を超える卵巣腫瘍を検討した施設で、卵巣外発生は極めて稀であったと報告されている。
pmid-21995170.summary_en: This case report describes a 60-year-old woman with intermittent abdominal pain caused by a 9 x 8 x 8 cm mesenteric mature cystic teratoma that was initially misdiagnosed as an ovarian tumor. The mass contained hair and sebum, and histology showed typical mature cystic teratoma features with extensive granulomatous inflammation in the mesentery and small intestine. The uterus and adnexa were uninvolved. The authors note that this extraovarian location is unique among more than 2000 ovarian tumors examined over 30 years at their institution, and they include a literature review.

pmid-21995685.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫に伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告。本疾患は卵巣奇形腫を有する女性に多く、精神症状に続き呼吸不全、意識障害、異常運動を呈する。腫瘍切除と免疫療法により症状は劇的に改善した。精神症状の強い脳炎では速やかに卵巣腫瘍の検索を行うべきと強調されている。
pmid-21995685.summary_en: This case report describes anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with an ovarian immature teratoma in a patient. The authors review the typical presentation of this autoimmune encephalitis, which usually affects women with ovarian teratoma and presents with neuropsychiatric symptoms, followed by respiratory failure, clouding of consciousness, and bizarre dyskinesia. They emphasize that physicians should promptly search for an ovarian tumor when encountering encephalitis with marked psychiatric features. Symptoms improved dramatically after tumor resection combined with immunotherapy.

pmid-21997172.summary_ja: 単一施設で10年間に治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍76例の後方視的研究。HIV陽性は14例だった。化学療法を受けた73例の76.7%が完全寛解し、5年全生存率は81.9%であった。HIV陽性者の生存率は64.3%と、陰性または不明の群（85%超）より低かった。進行期、HIV陽性、治療遵守不良が予後不良因子とされる。
pmid-21997172.summary_en: This retrospective 10-year review from a single hospital analyzed 76 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, of whom 14 were HIV-positive. Most patients had hydatidiform mole or choriocarcinoma. Of 73 treated with chemotherapy, 76.7% achieved complete remission and 9.6% relapsed. Five-year overall survival was 81.9%. HIV-positive patients had markedly lower survival (64.3%) than HIV-negative or unknown-status patients (over 85%). The authors conclude that advanced stage, HIV seropositivity, and poor treatment adherence predict worse outcomes.

pmid-21998764.summary_ja: 子宮穿孔と難治性出血で発症し、組織学的に絨毛癌と診断された48歳女性の症例報告です。6年間の無病期間後に直腸S状結腸へ再発し、EMACO化学療法に抵抗性を示しました。低位前方切除術とリンパ節郭清を行い、術後にhCG値は正常化して13か月間無病を維持しました。化学療法抵抗性の転移に対する外科的切除の意義を示しています。
pmid-21998764.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma that presented with uterine perforation and hemorrhage. After six disease-free years, she had recurrence in the rectosigmoid colon, which progressed despite seven cycles of EMACO chemotherapy. Low anterior resection with lymphadenectomy was performed, and hCG normalized after surgery. She remained disease-free for 13 months. The authors suggest that surgical resection of metastases may cure a small subset of chemo-resistant patients.

pmid-22005364.summary_ja: XY染色体核型をもつ表現型女性11例(アンドロゲン不応症候群)を後方視的に検討した研究です。全例で腹腔鏡下両側性性腺摘出術が施行され、部分型AISの2例(18.1%)で両側性セミノーマと性腺芽腫が病理組織学的に確認されました。部分型では悪性腫瘍のリスクが高い可能性があり、腹腔鏡下性腺摘出術の日常的な実施が提唱されています。
pmid-22005364.summary_en: This retrospective review of 11 phenotypic females with XY karyotype and androgen insensitivity syndrome (AIS) assessed malignancy risk and the timing of gonadectomy. Laparoscopic bilateral gonadectomy was performed in all patients, and histopathology revealed bilateral seminoma and gonadoblastoma in two patients with partial AIS (18.1%). A benign hamartoma was found in one more patient. The authors suggest partial AIS may carry a higher malignancy risk and recommend routine laparoscopic gonadectomy.

pmid-22008360.summary_ja: 腹痛と月経過多・不正性器出血を訴えた15歳女児で、子宮平滑筋腫と成熟卵巣奇形腫が合併した症例報告です。両病変とも外科的切除が必要でした。小児の子宮平滑筋腫は稀であり、本論文では2つの婦人科腫瘤の画像診断と最適な治療法を文献と併せて検討しています。
pmid-22008360.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old girl with abdominal pain and menometrorrhagia who had both a uterine leiomyoma and a concomitant mature ovarian teratoma. Both masses required surgical resection. The authors review diagnostic imaging and optimal management of these two gynecologic masses in an adolescent. Uterine leiomyoma is rare in children, with only 10 previously reported cases.

pmid-22009410.summary_ja: 感染性の発熱で入院した47歳男性の症例報告です。マルチディテクタ型コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、脂肪濃度を示す空洞性肺浸潤影と脂肪性気管支像が確認されました。縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫が細菌感染を契機として肺内へ破裂し、脂肪成分が気管支を介して肺に流入したと考えられます。脂肪性気管支像は嚢胞性奇形腫破裂の画像所見として有用です。
pmid-22009410.summary_en: This report describes a 47-year-old man admitted with febrile infection whose multidetector CT showed a cavitated lung consolidation with fat density and a fatty bronchogram. The findings indicated rupture of a mediastinal cystic teratoma into the lung, likely triggered by bacterial infection. Lipoid material from the teratoma had drained through the bronchus into the lung. The paper highlights fatty bronchogram as an imaging sign of cystic teratoma rupture.

pmid-22010062.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を扱った論文です。稀な自己免疫疾患で、通常は傍腫瘍症候群の一部として発症し、若年女性に多く、しばしば卵巣奇形腫を伴います。腫瘍細胞が産生する抗体が辺縁系の受容体を障害します。治療は原疾患の治療に加え、ステロイドや血漿交換療法が用いられます。神経学的後遺症は75%に残存し、再発は20%、死亡率は25%とされています。
pmid-22010062.summary_en: This article reviews anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis, a rare autoimmune disorder usually part of a paraneoplastic syndrome. It occurs mainly in young women and is frequently associated with ovarian teratoma, where tumor-produced antibodies damage limbic receptors. Presentation includes altered mental status, bizarre behavior, and seizures. Treatment targets the underlying tumor or infection and uses steroids or plasmapheresis. Neurological sequelae persist in 75 percent of cases, relapse occurs in 20 percent, and mortality is 25 percent.

pmid-22014805.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術標本で胎児性癌が30%を超える高リスク精巣がん患者90例を後方視的に解析した。胎児性癌の割合とリンパ管侵襲は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清での陽性リンパ節と独立して関連していた。胎児性癌100%の陽性的中率は65.5%、30%の陰性的中率は85.7%であった。治療選択肢について患者に説明する際の参考になるとされる。
pmid-22014805.summary_en: Analysis of 90 patients with testicular cancer whose orchiectomy specimens contained more than 30% embryonal carcinoma and who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Lymphovascular invasion and the percentage of embryonal carcinoma were independently associated with positive retroperitoneal lymph nodes at dissection. The positive predictive value was 65.5% for 100% embryonal carcinoma, and the negative predictive value was 85.7% for 30%. These findings may help in counseling high-risk patients about treatment options.

pmid-22015888.summary_ja: 1949年に小児白血病治療薬として開発されたメトトレキサートが、妊娠性絨毛性疾患や転移性絨毛癌の有効な治療薬となった経緯を辿る歴史的総説である。一世紀にわたる多くの臨床家・研究者の貢献を紹介し、婦人科腫瘍学における化学療法の発展を論じている。生殖能力の温存につながった治療の歩みとして位置づけられている。
pmid-22015888.summary_en: A historical review tracing how methotrexate, developed in 1949 for childhood leukemia, became an effective treatment for gestational trophoblastic disease and metastatic choriocarcinoma. It describes the contributions of many clinicians and scientists over the past century to chemotherapy in gynecologic oncology. The development of the drug is framed as a path to preserving reproductive potential in women.

pmid-22016418.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性腺および精巣腫瘍において、X染色体にコードされる10種のがん精巣抗原を免疫組織化学的に検討した。成人の精巣では、多くの抗原が精原細胞または一次精母細胞で発現している。胎児の胚細胞では、妊娠13週頃に出現し、多能性の喪失とともに減少する。精母細胞性セミノーマはほぼすべての抗原を発現する一方、古典的セミノーマは一部のみを発現しており、両者の起源の違いを反映すると考えられる。
pmid-22016418.summary_en: An immunohistochemical study of ten chromosome X-encoded cancer/testis antigens in human fetal gonads and testicular tumors. In adult testis, most antigens are expressed in spermatogonia or primary spermatocytes. In fetal germ cells, they appear around 13 weeks and decline as pluripotency is lost. Spermatocytic seminomas express nearly all antigens, whereas classical seminomas express only a subset, reflecting their different cellular origins.

pmid-22022070.summary_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群を有する男性2例の症例報告である。両例とも停留精巣があり、腹腔内に停留した精巣にセミノーマを認め、子宮および卵管などのミュラー管由来構造を伴っていた。停留精巣の患者において、この症候群を認識する上での重要な症例として位置づけられる。
pmid-22022070.summary_en: A report of two males with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome, a rare form of male pseudohermaphroditism. Both had cryptorchidism with seminoma arising in an undescended abdominal testis, and both had Müllerian duct derivatives, including a uterus and fallopian tubes, despite otherwise normal male phenotype and genotype. The report highlights that seminoma and Müllerian structures can coexist, which is relevant to recognizing this syndrome in patients with undescended testis.

pmid-22024911.summary_ja: 2000年から2010年に出生前診断された孤立性仙尾部奇形腫の胎児22例を後方視的に解析した。胎内治療群は腫瘍が大きく血管に富み、羊水過多や心拡大を伴い、早産率も高かった。新生児生存率は治療群6/8、非治療群14/14であった。全例で出生後の切除が必要で、術後合併症として便失禁が最も多かった。胎内治療は予後不良因子を伴う症例で選択されたが、新生児転帰は同程度であった。
pmid-22024911.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study examined 22 fetuses with isolated sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally between 2000 and 2010, comparing outcomes by whether in utero intervention was performed. Intervention cases, mainly radiofrequency ablation and shunting, had larger, more vascular tumors with polyhydramnios or cardiomegaly and a higher preterm birth rate. Only one tumor regressed after ablation. Neonatal survival was 6/8 with intervention and 14/14 without. All neonates required postnatal resection, most commonly followed by fecal incontinence. Intervention was associated with worse prognostic features, but neonatal outcomes were similar.

pmid-22027660.summary_ja: 妊娠25週の21歳女性が、妊娠悪阻、肝機能異常、体重減少で入院後、診断前に急死した症例である。医療過誤を疑い法医学的調査が行われた。剖検で子宮に大型の栄養膜細胞とフィブリノイド沈着、筋層および血管への浸潤が認められ、肺には多数の腫瘍塞栓があった。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の肺転移による死亡と考えられる。著者は、診断と生物学的挙動の予測の困難さと、医療過誤をめぐる問題を論じている。
pmid-22027660.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman at 25 weeks of gestation who was admitted with hyperemesis, hepatic abnormalities, and weight loss, and died suddenly before a diagnosis was made. A forensic investigation for possible malpractice followed. Autopsy showed large trophoblastic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, fibrinoid deposition, myometrial invasion, and vascular invasion. Lung sections contained numerous neoplastic emboli, consistent with metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor. The authors emphasize the rarity of this tumor, the difficulty of diagnosis and of predicting its behavior, and the medicolegal issues involved.

pmid-22028524.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎は、若年女性の卵巣奇形腫に関連して初めて記載された自己免疫性脳炎である。患者の約60%に腫瘍（多くは卵巣奇形腫）が認められる。精神症状、意識障害、自律神経障害、運動異常、けいれん、中枢性低換気などが典型的である。血清と脳脊髄液中の抗体で確定診断し、抗体価は治療反応の指標となる。腫瘍摘出に加え、ステロイド、免疫グロブリン、血漿交換、リツキシマブやシクロホスファミドによる免疫療法を行う。早期治療が良好な転帰に重要である。
pmid-22028524.summary_en: This review describes N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis (anti-NMDAR encephalitis), an autoimmune encephalitis first described in young women with ovarian teratoma. About 60% of patients have an underlying tumor, usually an ovarian teratoma. Typical features include psychiatric symptoms, reduced consciousness, dysautonomia, movement disorders, seizures, and central hypoventilation. Diagnosis is confirmed by serum and cerebrospinal fluid antibodies, whose titers guide treatment. Management includes tumor removal, steroids, immunoglobulins, plasma exchange, and rituximab or cyclophosphamide. Early treatment is important for a good outcome.

pmid-22028979.summary_ja: パキスタン・クエッタの三次医療機関で、入院16,625例中85例の胞状奇胎を前向きに解析した。膣出血が最多の症状（94.2%）で、39%に莢膜黄体化嚢胞を認めた。多くは吸引掻爬術で治療され、子宮摘出は14.1%に行われた。高リスク例には単剤化学療法が施行され、忍容性は良好だった。平均5.7か月のフォローアップで、持続性絨毛性疾患、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌は発生しなかった。
pmid-22028979.summary_en: This prospective study from a tertiary care hospital in Quetta, Pakistan, identified 85 molar pregnancies among 16,625 admissions. Vaginal bleeding was the most common symptom (94.2%), and theca lutein cysts were present in 39%. Suction curettage was the usual management, and hysterectomy was performed in 14.1%. Single-agent chemotherapy was given to high-risk patients and was well tolerated. During mean follow-up of 5.7 months, none developed persistent trophoblastic disease, invasive mole, or choriocarcinoma. The authors note the higher incidence reported for South Asia.

pmid-22034885.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍110例と転移性11例、ならびに非胚細胞腫瘍119例を対照として、免疫組織化学的にLIN28の発現を検討した。性腺芽腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍は全例で強陽性（4+）であり、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）39例中37例も同様であった。未熟奇形腫では未熟神経上皮に限局して陽性例が多く、成熟奇形腫や卵巣甲状腺腫は陰性だった。非胚細胞腫瘍の陽性は5例のみであった。
pmid-22034885.summary_en: This immunohistochemistry study assessed LIN28 expression in 110 primary and 11 metastatic ovarian germ cell tumors, with 119 non-germ cell tumors as controls. Strong (4+) staining was seen in all gonadoblastomas, embryonal carcinomas, and yolk sac tumors, and in 37 of 39 dysgerminomas. Variable staining occurred in 12 of 14 immature teratomas, confined to immature neuroepithelium. Mature teratomas, carcinoids, struma ovarii, and strumal carcinoids were negative. Only 5 of 117 non-germ cell tumors showed weak-to-moderate staining, so LIN28 helps distinguish ovarian germ cell tumors from mimics.

pmid-22037459.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は単為発生由来と考えられており、その細胞における中心小体と中心体の有無を免疫蛍光法と透過型電子顕微鏡で検討した。その結果、中心小体と中心体の存在が確認された。精子由来の中心小体がなくても、活性化卵子から生じた単為発生胚は独自に中心小体を生成し、成熟組織へ分化しうることが示唆された。体外でのヒト単為発生研究への意義が論じられている。
pmid-22037459.summary_en: This study examined whether centrioles and centrosomes are present in ovarian mature cystic teratoma cells, which are considered parthenogenetic in origin. Using immunofluorescence and transmission electron microscopy, the authors confirmed centrioles and centrosomes in these tumor cells. They argue that human parthenotes developed in vitro can produce their own centrioles and differentiate into mature tissue even without a sperm-derived centriole. The work addresses the fate of centrioles in acentriolar parthenogenetic development and its implications for in vitro human parthenogenesis.

pmid-22042940.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマ227例を対象とした多施設共同研究で、術後のリスク因子に応じた治療戦略の有効性を検討した。2つのリスク因子を有する症例には補助カルボプラチンを投与し、他は監視とした。中央値34か月の追跡で再発は全体の7%であり、3年無病生存率は監視群88.1%、カルボプラチン群98.0%であった。再発の多くは後腹膜リンパ節で、化学療法により全例が治癒した。
pmid-22042940.summary_en: This multicenter study of 227 patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma evaluated a risk-adapted strategy after orchiectomy. Patients with two risk factors (tumor larger than 4 cm and rete testis involvement) received adjuvant carboplatin, while others were placed under surveillance. With a median follow-up of 34 months, relapse occurred in 7% overall: 9.8% of surveillance patients versus 1.4% of carboplatin-treated patients. Nearly all relapses were retroperitoneal, and all were curable with chemotherapy. Three-year disease-free survival was 88.1% under surveillance and 98.0% with carboplatin; overall survival was 100%.

pmid-22043416.summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマを合併した初産婦が、生殖補助医療を用いずに自然妊娠し、母児ともに障害なく生児を得た症例を報告している。ディスジャーミノーマは卵巣原始胚細胞腫瘍の代表的な組織型であり、妊孕性の低下を伴うことが多い。このような自然妊娠と生児出産の経過は極めてまれであり、卵巣悪性腫瘍を合併した妊娠の管理に関する知見として重要である。
pmid-22043416.summary_en: This case report describes a primigravida who conceived spontaneously while harboring an ovarian dysgerminoma. Dysgerminomas, the most common primitive germ cell tumors of the ovary, usually impair fertility, and natural pregnancy with a viable birth is extremely rare. The authors describe a successful pregnancy without assisted reproduction and without fetomaternal compromise. The report highlights the uncommon coexistence of a malignant ovarian germ cell tumor and a healthy pregnancy outcome, and underscores the need for careful management of pregnancies complicated by ovarian malignancy.

pmid-22045175.summary_ja: 精巣がんにおける後腹膜リンパ節郭清の役割を総説した論文である。低病期および高病期の症例に対する適応と、その使用をめぐる論点を整理している。周術期および長期の合併症についても検討している。術式の改良により診断・治療上の利点が増し、合併症は減少してきたとされる。集学的治療の一部として位置づけられている。
pmid-22045175.summary_en: This review addresses the role of retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in testicular cancer management. It discusses indications for the procedure in both low-stage and high-stage disease, along with ongoing controversies in its use. The article also reviews complications associated with the operation, including perioperative and long-term morbidity. The authors note that refinements in surgical technique have improved both diagnostic and therapeutic value while reducing morbidity. The review frames lymphadenectomy as an integral component of multidisciplinary care for testicular cancer, alongside systemic chemotherapy.

pmid-22045176.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を取り上げた論文である。低病期では病期分類と治療を兼ねる手技とされる。開腹手術と比べ回復が早く、整容性に優れ、術後合併症も少ない。経験豊富な施設では化学療法後の症例にも適用できると述べている。手術は診断と治療において依然として重要である。
