pmid-22045176.summary_en: This article examines minimally invasive, laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer. Laparoscopic RPLND serves as both a staging and therapeutic procedure in low-stage disease. Compared with open surgery, it offers faster recovery, improved cosmesis, and reduced postoperative morbidity, which drive its adoption. In experienced centers, the technique can also be applied to patients after chemotherapy. The authors emphasize that surgery remains critical in diagnosis and treatment despite improved survival attributed largely to systemic chemotherapy.

pmid-22050751.summary_ja: 本総説は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の予後マーカーと新たな治療標的をまとめたものである。セミノーマは放射線療法と化学療法に良く反応し、非セミノーマは白金系化学療法に反応するが、転移性奇形腫ではシスプラチン耐性が生じうる。OCT3/4、SOX2、SOX17、HMGA1/2などの新規マーカーは組織学的サブグループの識別に役立つ。著者らは、ヒト化抗体、キナーゼ阻害薬、血管新生阻害薬などの標的治療についても論じ、一部は臨床試験で有効性が確認されていると述べている。
pmid-22050751.summary_en: This review summarizes prognostic markers and emerging therapeutic targets in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs). Seminomas respond well to radiation and chemotherapy, whereas nonseminomas respond to platinum-based chemotherapy, and metastatic teratomas can show cisplatin resistance. Novel markers such as OCT3/4, SOX2, SOX17, and HMGA1/2 help distinguish histological subgroups. The authors also discuss targeted approaches, including humanized antibodies, kinase inhibitors, and angiogenesis inhibitors, some supported by clinical trial results. The review focuses on molecular alterations in post-pubertal TGCTs and strategies aimed at chemotherapy-resistant disease.

pmid-22053583.summary_ja: 32歳男性に3年間で3つの原発性胚細胞腫瘍が生じた経過を報告している。2002年に後腹膜非セミノーマ、2004年に後腹膜成熟奇形腫、2005年に異時性精巣セミノーマが診断された。既知の危険因子がないこと、および奇形腫増大症候群に言及している。長期のフォローアップの必要性を示す症例である。
pmid-22053583.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man who developed three primary germ cell tumors within three years. He was diagnosed with a retroperitoneal nonseminoma in 2002, a retroperitoneal mature teratoma in 2004, and a metachronous testicular seminoma in 2005. The report also refers to teratoma growing syndrome and notes the absence of known risk factors. The unusual combination of histologies in one patient illustrates the need for long-term follow-up in patients with germ cell tumors.

pmid-22053686.summary_ja: 腹痛を主訴とした38歳女性の卵管異所性妊娠の症例報告である。hCG値は高値で、手術時に卵管破裂と血腹が確認された。病理学的に原発性卵管絨毛癌と診断され、妊娠性絨毛癌の一例とされた。β-hCGの適切な監視と病理標本の慎重な検討が誤診防止に重要と結論している。
pmid-22053686.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old woman who presented with abdominal pain and a serum hCG above 15,000 mIU/mL. Ultrasound suggested a ruptured tubal ectopic pregnancy, and surgery revealed hemoperitoneum. Histopathology diagnosed a primary tubal choriocarcinoma, a gestational choriocarcinoma arising from ectopic pregnancy. The patient was referred to a tertiary center for treatment and follow-up. The authors conclude that careful monitoring of beta-hCG titers and meticulous pathological review are essential to avoid misdiagnosis of ectopic gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-22054018.summary_ja: 原発性不妊症の31歳女性が、体外受精の卵巣刺激周期中に未熟奇形腫を発症した症例報告である。卵巣刺激中の成熟奇形腫の発見は珍しくないが、未熟型の報告はこれまで見当たらない。非定型嚢胞の超音波所見を契機に慎重な対応を行い、適切な外科的治療につなげた。刺激中の超音波所見の評価の重要性を示す。
pmid-22054018.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman with primary infertility who developed an immature ovarian teratoma during an in vitro fertilization ovarian stimulation cycle. The authors note that mature teratomas, or dermoid cysts, are often found during stimulation, but immature teratomas have not been reported in this setting. Ultrasound findings of an atypical cyst prompted a cautious clinical approach and appropriate surgical oncological treatment. The case highlights the importance of recognizing atypical ultrasound features during ovarian stimulation.

pmid-22070047.summary_ja: 2000年から2009年の143例の卵巣捻転を後方視的に検討し、嚢胞性奇形腫の症例と他疾患の症例を比較しました。嚢胞性奇形腫は捻転のリスクを高めることが示され、患者への説明と早期の外科的管理が推奨されています。卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍に関連する知見を含みます。
pmid-22070047.summary_en: This retrospective study of 143 adnexal torsion cases at one clinic from 2000 to 2009 compares patients with benign cystic teratoma against those with other pathologies. Benign cystic teratoma was associated with a statistically different profile, including mass size and torsion frequency, indicating it increases torsion risk. The authors recommend patient counseling about torsion symptoms and early surgical management to preserve fertility.

pmid-22070612.summary_ja: 23歳のSRY陰性の真性半陰陽患者で、右卵精巣に生じた純粋な非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌の症例報告です。STR解析で非妊娠由来であることを確認しました。根治的手術とBEP療法（ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン）により良好な経過をたどりました。SRY陰性例における精巣決定機構についても考察しています。
pmid-22070612.summary_en: This case report describes pure non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma in the right ovotestis of a 23-year-old with 45,XO/46,XX SRY-negative true hermaphroditism. Short tandem repeat testing confirmed non-gestational origin. The patient responded well to radical surgery followed by BEP chemotherapy. The authors also propose an X-linked or autosomal gene mechanism for testicular determination in SRY-negative true hermaphrodites.

pmid-22073516.summary_ja: 3週間持続する重度の上背部痛を呈した33歳男性の症例報告です。画像検査で上大静脈と気管を圧迫する縦隔腫瘤が見つかり、病理学的にセミノーマに一致する低分化悪性腫瘍と診断されました。精巣原発巣は認められず、縦隔の性腺外セミノーマと確定しました。非典型的な背部痛が性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の初期症状となりうることを示しています。
pmid-22073516.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with three weeks of severe upper back pain who was found to have a mediastinal mass compressing the superior vena cava and trachea. Pathology showed a poorly differentiated malignant neoplasm consistent with seminoma. No primary testicular tumor was identified, establishing a mediastinal extragonadal seminoma. The case highlights that atypical back pain can herald an extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-22075608.summary_ja: 1991年から2009年に治療された純粋型セミノーマ67例を後方視的に検討した。15例が転移性または再発性疾患を有し化学療法を受け、6例が化学療法抵抗性（難治性）であった。難治例は主に臨床病期III期であった。難治例には追加化学療法、サルベージ手術、サルベージ放射線療法が行われ、3例は複数回の治療にもかかわらず死亡した。著者らは、難治性は予測が困難であり、サルベージ放射線療法を含む多モダリティ治療が生存利益をもたらす可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-22075608.summary_en: This retrospective study of 67 patients with pure seminoma treated between 1991 and 2009 found that 15 developed metastatic or recurrent disease and received chemotherapy. Six patients had chemotherapy-resistant (refractory) disease, most often with clinical stage III disease. Refractory patients received additional chemotherapy, salvage surgery, or salvage radiation, and three died of cancer despite multiple salvage treatments. The authors conclude that refractory seminoma is hard to predict, and that multimodality therapy including salvage radiation may improve survival.

pmid-22075615.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する精巣摘除術の6年後に歩行障害で発症した40歳男性の症例報告。胸椎の単発性転移が確認され、BEP化学療法と放射線療法により完全寛解に至った。3年間再発はない。治療後数年経過してからも単発性骨転移が生じうることを示す。
pmid-22075615.summary_en: A 40-year-old man presented with gait disturbance six years after orchiectomy for stage I testicular seminoma. Imaging and biopsy after emergency decompression showed a solitary thoracic vertebral metastasis of seminoma. Treatment with three cycles of BEP chemotherapy and external beam radiotherapy led to complete remission, and he remained free of recurrence for three years. The case shows that solitary bone metastasis of seminoma can appear years after initial treatment.

pmid-22075617.summary_ja: 左陰嚢内容の無痛性腫脹で受診した56歳男性の症例。画像検査で両側精巣腫瘍と診断され、両側高位精巣摘除術を施行。病理診断は両側精母細胞性セミノーマ(pT1)であった。補助療法は行わず経過観察し、術後5か月時点で再発を認めていない。
pmid-22075617.summary_en: A 56-year-old man presented with painless left scrotal swelling, and imaging showed bilateral testicular tumors. Bilateral high orchidectomy was performed, and histology confirmed bilateral spermatocytic seminoma, pT1. Spermatocytic seminoma is a rare germ cell tumor first described in 1946. No adjuvant therapy was given, and the patient was followed closely. No recurrence was seen five months after surgery. The authors report this rare bilateral presentation.

pmid-22078409.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、化学療法後に残存する1cm未満の腫瘤の扱いを論じたレビュー。再発率が低いことから経過観察も選択肢だが、pcRPLNDによる外科的切除の論拠も残る。1cmを超える残存腫瘤は手術すべきという点では合意がある。
pmid-22078409.summary_en: This paper reviews management of subcentimeter residual masses after first-line chemotherapy in advanced non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Patients with complete serologic and radiographic response may be observed, since recent reports show low relapse rates. However, surgical excision by post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection remains an option. The arguments for and against pcRPLND are presented. There is consensus that residual masses over 1 cm should undergo surgery.

pmid-22081528.summary_ja: 悪性転化を伴った類皮嚢腫の2症例を報告。細胞診で悪性が示唆され、1例は腺癌、もう1例は腹水中の悪性黒色腫であった。いずれも進行期で発見された。類皮嚢腫の悪性転化はまれで、細胞診による診断は困難であると指摘している。
pmid-22081528.summary_en: Two cases of dermoid cysts with malignant transformation are described, in which cytologic examination first suggested malignancy. In one case, an adenocarcinoma was found on Pap smear, which the author believes is a first report of this kind. The second involved malignant melanoma, a finding rarely reported in ascitic fluid. Both patients presented at advanced stages. The paper highlights that malignant transformation of dermoid cysts is rare and difficult to diagnose cytologically.

pmid-22086180.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)または双胎動脈反転灌流症候群(TRAP)の胎児19例を後方視的に検討。水腫または周産期死亡に至った群では心血管プロファイルスコアが低く、心胸郭比が高かった。胎児心エコーは収縮機能異常を捉えられるが、拡張機能異常は捉えられないと結論づけている。
pmid-22086180.summary_en: This study assesses whether pre-intervention fetal echocardiographic parameters can predict outcome in fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma or twin-reversed arterial perfusion sequence. Among 19 fetuses reviewed, those who developed hydrops or died had worse cardiovascular profile scores and higher cardiothoracic ratios. Abnormalities such as a high cardiothoracic ratio, high combined ventricular output, or valve regurgitation were found only in poor-outcome fetuses. The authors conclude that echocardiography detects systolic but not diastolic dysfunction.

pmid-22091297.summary_ja: 41歳女性の乳腺絨毛癌の症例を報告した論文。病歴、身体所見、検査所見、画像所見、病理所見を詳述している。乳腺絨毛癌は極めて稀で、絨毛癌様成分を伴う乳癌と乳腺への転移性絨毛癌という二つの用語で記載されてきたことを踏まえ、既報の文献をレビューしている。
pmid-22091297.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma of the breast. The paper details her history, physical examination, laboratory findings, imaging studies, and pathological findings. The authors note that breast choriocarcinoma is extremely rare and has been described in the literature under two terms: breast cancer with choriocarcinomatous features and metastatic choriocarcinoma to the breast. They review previously published breast choriocarcinoma cases to place this patient within existing knowledge of this rare entity.

pmid-22096674.summary_ja: 高齢女性が、腸管に癒着していない巨大な卵巣類皮嚢腫により小腸閉塞を来した症例報告。卵巣奇形腫は成熟型と未熟型に分類され、成熟型は類皮嚢腫と呼ばれ、生殖年齢女性で最も多い良性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍である。捻転や破裂により急性腹症様の症状を呈しうる。
pmid-22096674.summary_en: This case report describes an elderly woman who presented with small bowel obstruction caused by a very large ovarian dermoid cyst that was not adherent to the intestine. The authors summarize that ovarian teratomas are mature or immature, and that the mature type, termed dermoid cyst, is the most common benign germ cell tumor of the ovary in women of reproductive age. Although often asymptomatic until large, cysts may cause symptoms through pressure, torsion, or rupture, which can mimic an acute abdomen. The case highlights an uncommon presentation of a mature teratoma with mechanical bowel obstruction.

pmid-22105478.summary_ja: 51歳女性で、回腸のセロトニン産生神経内分泌腫瘍の術後に左横隔膜の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が異時性に見つかった症例報告。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の性腺外発生は極めて稀で、横隔膜発生の報告は10例のみである。両疾患の偶然の併存の可能性について考察している。
pmid-22105478.summary_en: This report describes a 51-year-old woman who developed a benign mature cystic teratoma of the left diaphragm metachronously with a serotonin-producing neuroendocrine tumor of the ileum. She had earlier undergone ileal resection for the neuroendocrine tumor and resection of a benign right ovarian cystadenoma. The authors note that mature cystic teratomas are rarely extragonadal, with only 10 prior diaphragmatic cases reported. They present this as the first report of metachronous benign mature cystic teratoma of the diaphragm with a highly differentiated neuroendocrine tumor of the ileum and discuss the possible coincidence of the two diseases.

pmid-22110200.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍）と良性精巣組織を比較し、PTEN、リン酸化Akt、p27Kip1を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究。PTENは全ての病型で著明に低下していた。リン酸化Aktの過剰発現は認めず、古典的なAkt活性化以外の経路との相互作用が示唆された。
pmid-22110200.summary_en: This study examined Akt pathway proteins (PTEN, phosphorylated Akt, and p27Kip1) by immunohistochemistry in non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, including 17 teratomas, 27 embryonal carcinomas, and 6 yolk sac tumors, compared with 24 benign testicular samples. PTEN was markedly reduced in all NST subgroups, and nuclear p27Kip1 was concentrated in teratomas and embryonal carcinomas. Phospho-Akt was not overexpressed, and no negative correlation with PTEN or p27Kip1 was found. Yolk sac tumors showed a late cytoplasmic shift of PTEN and p27Kip1. The authors conclude that NST signaling likely involves crosstalk with other pathways rather than classical Akt activation.

pmid-22111476.summary_ja: 24歳女性が高いβ-hCG値、無月経、悪心、貧血など妊娠様の症状を呈し、その後上部消化管出血をきたした。内視鏡で胃腫瘍が確認され、病理組織学的検査で原発性胃絨毛癌と診断された。非妊娠性絨毛癌に準じた化学療法3コースを行ったが、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で腫瘍の残存が示され、診断から約6か月で死亡した。
pmid-22111476.summary_en: A young woman presented with high serum beta-hCG, amenorrhea, nausea and anemia mimicking pregnancy, followed by upper gastrointestinal bleeding. Endoscopy revealed a gastric tumor, and histopathology confirmed primary gastric choriocarcinoma. Three cycles of nongestational choriocarcinoma chemotherapy failed, and CT showed persistent disease. The patient died about six months after diagnosis. The authors emphasize the highly aggressive course, frequent liver and lung metastases, and hormonal symptoms that mimic pregnancy.

pmid-22114578.summary_ja: 古典的ホジキンリンパ腫の治療歴を持つ25歳男性が、10年後に縦隔腫瘤と持続する咳嗽を呈した。再発ホジキンリンパ腫と考えられ複数の化学療法が行われたが、切除リンパ節生検で絨毛癌と判明した。病勢は急速に進行し、患者は2週間以内に死亡した。
pmid-22114578.summary_en: A 25-year-old man treated for classic Hodgkin lymphoma with splenectomy, radiation therapy and chemotherapy later developed a paraspinal relapse. A decade after completing treatment, he presented with a persistent cough and a mediastinal mass, which was repeatedly interpreted as relapsed lymphoma. Excisional lymph node biopsy revealed choriocarcinoma. Despite multiple regimens, the disease progressed rapidly and the patient died within two weeks, illustrating a rare extragonadal germ cell malignancy that mimicked relapsed Hodgkin lymphoma.

pmid-22117832.summary_ja: 2002～2010年に腹腔鏡下治療を受けた卵巣類皮嚢腫63例を解析した。病理組織学的検査で成熟型58例、未熟型5例が確認された。合併症は認められず、嚢腫内容物の漏出があっても化学性腹膜炎は観察されなかった。破裂例で腹腔内を十分に洗浄・ドレナージすれば、腹腔鏡手術は安全な選択肢と結論された。
pmid-22117832.summary_en: This study analyzed 63 patients with ovarian dermoid cysts treated laparoscopically between 2002 and 2010. Histopathology confirmed 58 mature and 5 immature cases. Most patients underwent cystectomy, and seven required salpingo-oophorectomy. No intra- or postoperative complications occurred, and no chemical peritonitis was observed even when cyst contents spilled. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is safe when the peritoneal cavity is thoroughly washed and drained in ruptured cases.

pmid-22126669.summary_ja: 17歳の女性が精神症状、記憶障害、痙攣、その後の反応低下や中枢性低換気を呈した。血清では抗甲状腺抗体とEBウイルスIgM抗体が高値であった。未熟卵巣奇形腫を切除したところ完全に回復し、脳脊髄液中の抗NMDA受容体抗体により抗NMDA受容体脳炎と確定した。奇形腫では異所性の未熟神経組織とEBウイルス潜伏感染が確認された。1年後も抗甲状腺ペルオキシダーゼ抗体と抗NMDA受容体抗体は陽性のままであり、神経自己免疫と甲状腺自己免疫の関連が示唆されている。
pmid-22126669.summary_en: A 17-year-old woman presented with psychiatric symptoms, memory deficits, seizures, and later unresponsiveness, dyskinesias and central hypoventilation. Serum showed high anti-thyroid antibodies and EBV capsid IgM. Resection of an immature ovarian teratoma led to full recovery, and anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis was confirmed by CSF antibodies. Teratoma pathology showed NR1-positive ectopic immature neural tissue and EBV latent infection. At one-year follow-up, anti-TPO and anti-NMDAR antibodies persisted, suggesting a link between neuronal and thyroid autoimmunity.

pmid-22128625.summary_ja: 34歳男性が三毛喀血を呈し、肺内奇形腫と診断された。胸腔内奇形腫は通常縦隔に発生するが、まれに肺から発生することがある。本報告は、この稀な性腺外病変の臨床像を示し、文献的考察を加えている。
pmid-22128625.summary_en: A 34-year-old man presented with tricoptysis, hemoptysis containing hair, and was diagnosed with an intrapulmonary teratoma. Intrathoracic teratomas usually arise in the mediastinum but rarely originate from the lung, as in this case. The authors describe the clinical presentation of this rare extragonadal lesion and review the relevant literature.

pmid-22128656.summary_ja: 1990～2003年のデータを用い、20～59歳男性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の罹患率を米国現役軍人と一般集団で比較した。非セミノーマの罹患率は軍人で有意に低かった（罹患率比0.90）。セミノーマでは両集団で罹患率が有意に増加し、限局性腫瘍の増加が認められたが、その理由は未解明である。
pmid-22128656.summary_en: Using ACTR and SEER data for men aged 20 to 59 from 1990 to 2003, this study compared testicular germ cell tumor incidence among US active-duty servicemen with the general population. Nonseminoma incidence was significantly lower in the military (rate ratio 0.90). Incidence rose for both histologic types in both populations, but significantly only for seminoma. Increases were confined to localized tumors. The authors note that the lower nonseminoma incidence and rising localized tumors remain unexplained.

pmid-22143885.summary_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞を用いた全ゲノムshRNAスクリーニングにより、分化に必要なMp1を同定した。Mp1のノックダウンは自己複製を促進し、FGF4による分化を阻害したが増殖は変化させなかった。さらに、ヒトの胚細胞腫瘍では浸潤性の胎児性癌やセミノーマでMp1発現が低く、浸潤性GCT細胞でのノックダウンは分化抵抗性をもたらした。
pmid-22143885.summary_en: A genome-wide shRNA screen in mouse embryonic stem cells identified Mp1 as a regulator required for differentiation. Mp1 knockdown stimulated self-renewal, blocked FGF4-induced differentiation without affecting proliferation, and upregulated pluripotency genes. The authors also show that human germ cell tumors express low Mp1 in invasive embryonic carcinoma and seminoma, and that Mp1 knockdown in invasive GCT cells confers resistance to differentiation, suggesting a functional role in germ cell cancer.

pmid-22145221.summary_ja: 心膜内奇形腫が出生前には診断されず、剖検で初めて確認された胎児死亡例の症例報告である。35歳女性の妊娠23週の定期超音波検査で心拍動が確認されず、人工妊娠中絶が行われた。心膜内奇形腫は稀な先天性腫瘍で、無治療では出生前後に心不全を来す。多くは出生前診断をすり抜けるため、早期診断と外科的進歩の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-22145221.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with an intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed only at postmortem examination. Fetal death occurred after no cardiac activity was seen on routine ultrasound at 23 weeks, and an abortion was induced. Intrapericardial teratoma is a rare congenital tumor that can cause cardiac failure prenatally or postnatally if untreated. The authors emphasize that such tumors often go undetected during prenatal diagnostics, highlighting the value of early diagnosis and surgical advances.

pmid-22145275.summary_ja: 40歳男性が脳梗塞と構音障害で受診し、胸部X線で偶然後縦隔腫瘍が見つかった。CT誘導下生検でセミノーマと診断され化学療法を受けた。5か月後に再発した神経症状の原因は、既存梗塞部位に生じた転移性セミノーマだった。胚細胞腫瘍が脳梗塞として初発しうること、脳転移が虚血病変に類似しうることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-22145275.summary_en: A 40-year-old man presented with cerebral infarction and slurred speech. Chest radiography revealed a posterior mediastinal tumor, diagnosed as seminoma by CT-guided biopsy. After chemotherapy, he developed recurrent neurological symptoms; brain MRI showed two lesions within prior infarct areas, histologically confirmed as metastatic seminoma. The case highlights that a germ cell tumor can initially present as cerebral infarction, and that brain metastases may mimic ischemic lesions.

pmid-22147099.summary_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌の41歳女性が131ヨウ素治療を受けた。治療後全身スキャンで左骨盤に集積があり、SPECT/CTで卵巣の腫瘤と特定された。病理組織学的に良性甲状腺組織を伴う嚢胞性奇形腫（卵巣甲状腺腫）で悪性所見はなかった。その後の治療でサイログロブリン値は低下し、フォローアップ画像に異常集積はなかった。偶発的な集積の評価におけるSPECT/CTの有用性を示す症例報告である。
pmid-22147099.summary_en: A 41-year-old woman with papillary thyroid carcinoma underwent radioiodine therapy. Post-therapy whole-body scanning showed a left pelvic focus, and SPECT/CT localized it to an ovarian mass. Pathology revealed a cystic teratoma with benign thyroid tissue (struma ovarii) without malignancy. Subsequent radioiodine treatment was given, and thyroglobulin levels fell with no abnormal uptake on follow-up scans. The report emphasizes the value of SPECT/CT for characterizing incidental uptake.

pmid-22151977.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌と多臓器転移を有する26歳男性が、化学療法中に両側の脈絡膜転移を発症し、片眼の視力低下を来した。化学療法の継続と頭蓋骨および脊椎への定位放射線療法を併用した結果、完全寛解が得られ、4年以上の経過観察後も視力は保たれた。著者らは、この稀な合併症において放射線療法が根治的精巣摘除術および化学療法を補完すると結論づけている。
pmid-22151977.summary_en: A 26-year-old man with testicular choriocarcinoma and multiorgan metastases developed bilateral choroidal metastases during chemotherapy, causing vision loss in one eye. Treatment combining continued chemotherapy with stereotactic radiotherapy to the skull and spine achieved complete remission, with preserved vision after over four years of follow-up. The authors conclude radiotherapy complements orchiectomy and chemotherapy in this rare complication.

pmid-22154172.summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節転移を伴う同時性転移性精巣セミノーマと、良性の後腹膜神経節腫を併存した患者の症例である。併存腫瘍により診断と治療方針の決定が難しくなった。併用化学療法でセミノーマは完全奏効し、その後神経節腫を完全切除した。胚細胞腫瘍患者において併存する良性腫瘍が病期診断や治療計画を混乱させうることを示す症例報告と文献レビューである。
pmid-22154172.summary_en: A patient with synchronous metastatic testicular seminoma involving retroperitoneal lymph nodes also had a benign retroperitoneal ganglioneuroma, complicating diagnosis and management. Combination chemotherapy produced a complete response of the seminoma, and the ganglioneuroma was then completely resected. The case illustrates how a coexisting benign retroperitoneal tumor can confound staging and treatment planning in germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-22154173.summary_ja: 陰嚢腫瘤の疑いで紹介された45歳男性の症例である。超音波検査で左精巣上体頭部に病変を認め、肉芽腫の可能性が示された。精巣上体腫瘍はまれで、多くは平滑筋腫や腺腫様腫瘍などの良性だが、悪性病変も報告されている。本報告は精巣上体ジャーミノーマが独立した疾患単位として存在するのかという問いを提起する。
pmid-22154173.summary_en: This report describes a 45-year-old man referred for a suspected scrotal mass. Ultrasonography showed a lesion in the left epididymal head, possibly a granuloma. The authors review the rare epididymal tumors, most benign (leiomyoma, adenomatoid tumor), with malignant entities including adenocarcinoma, liposarcoma, and lymphoma. The title questions whether epididymal germinoma truly exists as a distinct entity.

pmid-22166828.summary_ja: 右尿管癌と50mmの膀胱腫瘍を有する85歳男性の症例である。両病変ともcT3N0M0と診断され、来院時に転移は認めなかった。右腎尿管全摘除術と膀胱摘除術が施行された。病理組織学的に尿路上皮癌に絨毛癌が混在していた。尿路上皮由来の原発腫瘍に絨毛癌成分が生じうることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-22166828.summary_en: An 85-year-old man with a right ureteral cancer and a 50 mm bladder tumor underwent right nephroureterectomy and cystectomy. Staging was cT3N0M0 for both lesions, with no metastasis at presentation. Histopathology revealed urothelial carcinoma admixed with choriocarcinoma, an unusual finding in the urinary tract. The case illustrates that a choriocarcinomatous component can arise in a urothelial primary tumor.

pmid-22166830.summary_ja: 10歳時に停留精巣の精巣固定術を受けた36歳男性。左鼠径部腫瘤で受診し、鼠径リンパ節から胎児性癌の転移が判明した。超音波検査で萎縮精巣内の腫瘤を認め、左高位精巣摘除術でセミノーマと胎児性癌の混合型と診断された。BEP化学療法後18か月、再発なし。国内で11例目の報告。
pmid-22166830.summary_en: A 36-year-old man who had undergone orchiopexy for undescended testis at age 10 presented with a painful left inguinal mass. Surgery revealed enlarged inguinal lymph nodes with metastatic embryonal carcinoma. Scrotal ultrasonography then showed a mass in the atrophic left testis, and high orchiectomy revealed a mixed seminoma and embryonal carcinoma, pT1N2M0. After three cycles of BEP chemotherapy, he remained free of recurrence and metastasis at 18 months. This is reported as the 11th Japanese case of this presentation.

pmid-22174500.summary_ja: アンドロゲン不応症候群の20歳女性。下腹部の大きな腫瘤(約15cm)を認め、細胞診で非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌疑い)と診断。術前BEP化学療法後に開腹で精巣摘除術などを施行し、術後さらに2コース実施。3年間無病経過。
pmid-22174500.summary_en: A 20-year-old with androgen insensitivity syndrome and primary amenorrhea presented with a large lower abdominal mass of about 15 cm. Cytology suggested non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, likely embryonal carcinoma. After three cycles of neoadjuvant BEP chemotherapy, laparotomy with orchidectomy, omentectomy and appendectomy was performed, followed by two more cycles. She has remained free of disease for three years.

pmid-22174503.summary_ja: 精巣未熟奇形腫の治療から12年後に、32歳男性に転移性腺癌が出現した症例。転移に対し局所放射線療法を行ったが奏効せず、腫瘍切除と緩和的化学療法を実施した。稀な経過と治療の難しさを報告する。
pmid-22174503.summary_en: A 32-year-old man developed metastatic adenocarcinoma 12 years after treatment for an immature teratoma of the testis. The metastases did not respond to local radiotherapy, so tumor excision and palliative chemotherapy were performed. The authors present the case for its rarity, unusual presentation, and difficulty of management.

pmid-22174520.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫に悪性転化を伴った稀な症例の報告。術前のFDG PET/CTで、CT部分により三胚葉由来の成分が描出され、PET部分の高集積が悪性転化を示唆した。こうした稀な腫瘍の評価においてPET/CTは有用と結論づけている。
pmid-22174520.summary_en: A rare case of mature teratoma with malignant transformation is reported. Preoperative FDG PET/CT was performed. The CT component identified three embryonal components, while increased FDG uptake on the PET component suggested possible malignant transformation before surgery. The authors conclude that PET/CT is a valuable tool for evaluating these rare tumors.

pmid-22175045.summary_ja: 42歳女性が連続6回の部分胞状奇胎妊娠を経験し、最後の妊娠後に絨毛癌と診断された。β-hCGの追跡を行い、絨毛癌には多剤併用化学療法を実施して治癒。その後、早発閉経を疑う症状が出現した。再発性胞状奇胎の文献レビューを含む。
pmid-22175045.summary_en: A 42-year-old woman had six consecutive partial molar pregnancies without an intervening normal pregnancy, and choriocarcinoma was diagnosed after the last one. She was followed with serial beta-hCG measurements, and multi-agent chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma led to cure. She later developed symptoms suggestive of premature menopause. The report includes a review of the literature on recurrent hydatidiform mole.

pmid-22179558.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者1,182例を後方視的に検討し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関連するサルコイド様肉芽腫症を13例で同定した。診断時の年齢中央値は25.5歳で、病期はIからIIIに及んだ。肉芽腫は9例で診断時に、4例で経過観察中に認められ、主に重篤な臓器障害を伴わない良性の肺サルコイドーシスであった。著者らは、臨床所見と組織所見の解釈に注意を要し、転移性精巣腫瘍の鑑別診断にサルコイド様肉芽腫症を含めるべきと勧めている。
pmid-22179558.summary_en: This retrospective study of 1,182 patients with testicular tumours identified 13 with sarcoid-like granulomatosis associated with testicular germ cell tumour (GCT). Median age at diagnosis was 25.5 years, with stages ranging from I to III. Granulomatosis appeared at diagnosis in 9 patients and during follow-up in 4, mainly as benign pulmonary sarcoidosis without severe organ involvement. The authors advise caution when interpreting clinical and histological findings and recommend including sarcoid-like granulomatosis in the differential diagnosis of metastatic testicular tumours.

pmid-22184538.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法の27か月後に、FIP1L1-PDGFRA陽性の慢性好酸球性白血病を発症した症例報告。患者は原子力発電所作業員として職業性放射線被曝歴があった。イマチニブにより血液学的完全寛解と分子学的完全奏効が得られた。職業性および治療的放射線被曝が原因となりうることを示唆している。
pmid-22184538.summary_en: A 40-year-old nuclear power plant worker with 20 years of occupational radiation exposure developed FIP1L1-PDGFRA-positive chronic eosinophilic leukemia 27 months after radiotherapy for testicular seminoma. He presented with eosinophilia and bone marrow and lymph node involvement. Imatinib achieved complete hematological remission at six months and complete molecular response at one year. The authors suggest that occupational and therapeutic radiation may be causative factors in this rare myeloproliferative neoplasm.

pmid-22187866.summary_ja: 30歳男性の縦隔腫瘍は当初多房性胸腺嚢胞と診断され切除された。その後、肺病変により死亡した。剖検で左肺病変は血管肉腫と診断され、嚢胞内には微小なセミノーマ成分と血管肉腫成分が確認された。セミノーマに関連して生じた血管肉腫が肺へ転移したと推測されている。
pmid-22187866.summary_en: A 30-year-old man had a large anterior mediastinal tumour that was resected and diagnosed as a multilocular thymic cyst. He later developed pulmonary nodules and died. Autopsy diagnosed the left lung lesion as hemangiosarcoma and revealed microscopic seminomatous and hemangiosarcomatous components within the original cyst. The authors speculate that the hemangiosarcoma arose in association with the seminoma and metastasized to the lung.

pmid-22191318.summary_ja: 左眼の疼痛と視力低下を呈した24歳男性で、非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の孤立性眼球転移が判明した。右根治的精巣摘除術とPEB化学療法（シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン）により腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、眼の病変は縮小した。その後眼球摘出術が行われ、経過観察中再発はみられなかった。著者らは、この腫瘍の血行性による眼への孤立性転移はまれであると述べている。
pmid-22191318.summary_en: A 24-year-old man presented with left eye pain and vision loss, and was found to have an isolated eyeball metastasis from a non-seminomatous germ cell testicular tumour. Right radical orchiectomy and PEB chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin) normalized tumour markers and regressed the eye lesion. Enucleation followed, and the patient remained free of recurrence during follow-up. The authors note that isolated haematogenous metastasis of this tumour to the eye is rare.

pmid-22195336.summary_ja: 卵巣異所性妊娠の既往後にhCG上昇を認めつつフォローアップが途絶えていた49歳女性の症例報告。3年後に肺・膣転移を伴う絨毛癌と診断され、化学療法で寛解した。元の組織再評価で卵巣胞状奇胎が判明し、これが絨毛癌の起源と考えられた。妊娠産物の検査では胞状奇胎の除外が重要であると強調している。
pmid-22195336.summary_en: A 49-year-old woman with a prior ectopic pregnancy, lost to follow-up despite rising hCG, presented three years later with hemoptysis, vaginal bleeding and elevated hCG. Pulmonary and vaginal metastases confirmed choriocarcinoma, which responded to six months of chemotherapy. Review of the original specimen revealed an ovarian hydatidiform mole that likely gave rise to the choriocarcinoma. The authors emphasize excluding hydatidiform mole in products of conception and monitoring hCG until it is negative.

pmid-22212325.summary_ja: 14歳女児の外陰部卵黄嚢腫瘍・胎児性癌の症例報告である。外陰切除と化学療法、放射線療法後に肺転移を来し、切除後に大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を施行して無病で経過している。初回治療に抵抗性の転移性外陰部胚細胞腫瘍に対し、大量化学療法の選択肢を示唆している。
pmid-22212325.summary_en: A 14-year-old girl with vulvar yolk sac tumor mixed with embryonal carcinoma underwent vulvectomy, inguinal lymph node dissection, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy. Eight months later she developed lung metastasis, which was resected. She then received high-dose TIP and GEMOX chemotherapy with two peripheral blood stem cell transplants and remained disease-free. The authors suggest that high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue may be considered for metastatic vulvar germ cell tumors that fail first-line therapy.

pmid-22212327.summary_ja: Currarino症候群を有する26歳女性の12cm大の仙骨前部奇形腫の症例報告である。MNX1遺伝子に未報告の挿入変異が同定された。仙骨骨欠損を伴う仙骨前部腫瘍では本症候群を疑う必要があり、治療の遅れは中枢神経系感染などの重篤な合併症につながると述べられている。
pmid-22212327.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman with Currarino syndrome presented with a 12 cm presacral teratoma causing compression symptoms. She had a pelvic teratoma diagnosed eight years earlier. Imaging showed sacral dysraphism, and laparotomy confirmed presacral teratoma. Genetic analysis identified a previously unreported triple CGC insertion in exon 1 of MNX1. The authors emphasize that a presacral tumor with a sacral bony defect should prompt evaluation for Currarino syndrome, and that delayed treatment can cause serious complications.

pmid-22220149.summary_ja: シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによる化学療法を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の2症例で、脳静脈洞血栓症が発症した。頭痛と神経脱落症状が主症状であった。抗凝固療法により数週間以内に症状は可逆的に改善した。化学療法中の精巣がん患者の神経症状では本疾患を鑑別に挙げるべきと述べられている。
pmid-22220149.summary_en: Two patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor developed cerebral sinus venous thrombosis after chemotherapy with cisplatin, bleomycin, and etoposide. Headache and neurological deficits were the main symptoms. The authors note that cancer and cisplatin are known thrombotic risk factors. Anticoagulation therapy led to symptom reversal within weeks. Cerebral sinus venous thrombosis should be considered in the differential diagnosis of neurological symptoms in patients with testicular cancer receiving chemotherapy.

pmid-22228895.summary_ja: 1992〜2009年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍106例の後方視的研究である。セミノーマが54.7%を占め、腫瘍マーカー上昇は非セミノーマで多かった。危険因子を有する病期I症例には補助療法が行われ、無イベント生存率は93.3%であった。
pmid-22228895.summary_en: A retrospective review of 106 testicular germ cell tumors treated from 1992 to 2009. Most patients were diagnosed recently, and 54.7% had seminoma histology. Tumor marker elevation was more frequent in non-seminoma. Most patients were stage I-II and in the good prognostic group. Stage I seminomas with rete testis invasion or tumor size over 4 cm, and non-seminomas with vascular or lymphatic invasion, received adjuvant therapy. With median follow-up of 60 months, event-free survival was 93.3%.

pmid-22228899.summary_ja: 48歳男性の左精索に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告と文献的考察である。超音波検査では診断が確定せず、外科的切除を行った。術中病理で良性と確認されたため、根治的精巣摘除術は回避された。精索腫瘤の治療判断の前に、精巣傍腫瘍の鑑別として本疾患を考慮すべきと述べられている。
pmid-22228899.summary_en: A 48-year-old man presented with a recurrent mass in the left high scrotum and inguinal area. Ultrasound and physical examination were inconclusive, so surgical exploration with complete excision was performed. Intraoperative pathology confirmed a benign dermoid cyst, and radical orchiectomy was avoided. The authors review the literature and note that spermatic cord dermoid cyst is rare but should be considered in the differential diagnosis of paratesticular masses before treatment decisions are made.

pmid-22234099.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫28例の後方視的な臨床病理学的研究である。全例で未熟間葉組織が認められ、神経上皮はグレードで評価された。病期I症例の予後は良好であった。手術と化学療法の併用は再発例においても生存期間を延長しうると述べられている。
pmid-22234099.summary_en: A clinicopathological study of 28 ovarian immature teratomas. Immature mesenchyme was present in all cases, while neuroepithelium was seen in 26 and graded I to III. Grade did not correlate with immature mesenchyme. Among 23 patients with follow-up, 17 remained alive without recurrence, and six experienced death or local recurrence. Stage I tumors had a better prognosis, and combined surgery and chemotherapy may prolong survival even in recurrent disease.

pmid-22247806.summary_ja: 経口避妊薬服用中の36歳女性が、異所性妊娠に類似した所見で受診した。β-hCG高値が持続したためメトトレキサートによる治療を受けた。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で前縦隔に大きな腫瘍が発見され、原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。異所性妊娠の治療後にβ-hCGが持続高値の場合は胸部X線検査を勧めている。
pmid-22247806.summary_en: A 36-year-old woman taking oral contraceptives presented at seven weeks of amenorrhea with a beta-hCG of 850 IU and an apparent uterine mass, mimicking ectopic pregnancy. She underwent left adnexectomy and curettage, then methotrexate for persistently elevated beta-hCG. Computed tomography finally revealed a large anterior mediastinal tumor, a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor. The authors recommend chest X-ray in patients with persistently elevated beta-hCG after ectopic pregnancy treatment.

pmid-22268289.summary_ja: 46,XY核型のSwyer症候群を有する22歳女性で、右性腺に生じたディスジャーミノーマの症例報告である。迅速病理でディスジャーミノーマと診断され、腫瘍減量術と化学療法が行われた。Y染色体の存在は性腺腫瘍のリスクを高めるため、予防的な両側卵管性腺摘出術が勧められると結論づけている。
pmid-22268289.summary_en: A 22-year-old woman with a 46,XY karyotype and Swyer syndrome presented with primary amenorrhea and a pelvic mass. Laparotomy revealed a hypoplastic uterus and an 80 x 70 x 60 mm right gonadal mass extending to the pelvic peritoneum. Frozen section showed dysgerminoma. She underwent debulking surgery with pelvic lymphadenectomy and four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. The authors conclude that Y chromosome presence increases gonadal tumor risk and prophylactic bilateral salpingo-gonadectomy should be advised.

pmid-22312558.summary_ja: 本総説は、侵入胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む、あらゆる病期の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の評価、化学療法による管理、フォローアップを扱う。早期病変は単剤化学療法で治癒することが多いが、進行期には多剤併用レジメンが必要とされる。著者らは、治療後の慎重な経過観察、再発の積極的な管理、既往のある女性の将来の妊娠の綿密なモニタリングを強調している。
pmid-22312558.summary_en: This review covers the workup, chemotherapeutic management, and follow-up of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia at all stages, including invasive hydatidiform mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Early-stage disease is often cured with single-agent chemotherapy, whereas advanced disease requires multiagent regimens. Adjunctive surgical procedures can help some patients. The authors emphasize careful surveillance after treatment, aggressive management of recurrence, and close monitoring of future pregnancies in women with prior GTN.

pmid-22315711.summary_ja: 21歳女性の左卵巣に生じた卵巣甲状腺腫に、乳頭状甲状腺癌が発生した症例を報告する。卵巣甲状腺腫は奇形腫の一種で、甲状腺組織が主体または唯一の成分となる。本症例は、甲状腺組織が正常甲状腺と同様の良性・悪性の病理像を示しうることを示した。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍内に生じた稀な悪性成分の一例である。
pmid-22315711.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with papillary thyroid carcinoma arising within a struma ovarii of the left ovary. Struma ovarii is an uncommon ovarian teratoma in which thyroid tissue predominates or is exclusive, and it can show benign or malignant thyroid pathology. The report notes that thyroid tissue in this setting can show the same spectrum of pathologic features as normal thyroid. It provides a concise illustration of a rare malignant component within an ovarian germ cell tumor.

pmid-22320982.summary_ja: 2001〜2011年に治療された精巣腫瘍31例を解析した東南アジアの大学病院の研究。平均診断年齢は33.7歳で、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が最多であった。胚細胞腫瘍患者の半数以上が診断時に転移を有し、転移例には補助化学療法が行われた。5年生存率は胚細胞腫瘍で88.9%、全精巣がんで83.9%であった。
pmid-22320982.summary_en: This ten-year retrospective review from a Southeast Asian university hospital analyzed 31 patients with testicular tumours. The average age at presentation was 33.7 years. Non-seminomatous germ cell tumour was the most common histology, followed by seminoma, lymphoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma. More than half of GCT patients had metastasis at diagnosis. All underwent radical orchidectomy; adjuvant chemotherapy was given to patients with metastatic disease, and four seminoma patients received para-aortic radiotherapy. The 5-year survival rate was 88.9% for GCT and 83.9% for all testicular cancers.

pmid-22335029.summary_ja: 一施設での15年間の奇形腫256例のうち、卵巣甲状腺腫（単一胚葉性奇形腫）11例を検討した。多くは若年成人で、腹痛や骨盤内腫瘤が主症状だった。組織像は微小濾胞型、充実型、偽腺管型などがみられ、非定型例では免疫組織化学が診断に有用だった。悪性例はなく、腫瘍摘出術が適切な治療と結論している。
pmid-22335029.summary_en: This paper reviews 11 monodermal teratomas of struma ovarii identified among 256 teratomas examined at one pathology laboratory over 15 years. Patients were mostly young adults, with pain and pelvic mass as the most common presentations. Most tumors were unilateral and compact or microcystic, with microfollicular, solid, or pseudoglandular histology. Immunohistochemistry aided diagnosis in atypical cases. No malignant struma ovarii was found. Tumorectomy was the main treatment, with hysterectomy for large tumors, and the authors favor conservative surgery given the benign course.

pmid-22335044.summary_ja: 早期の卵巣悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の若年女性例で、片側卵管卵巣摘出術と大網切除、骨盤・傍大動脈リンパ節郭清を行い、化学療法を実施した。3年後に自然妊娠し、健康な児を出産した。早期例では保存的手術により妊孕性を温存できる可能性があると結論している。
pmid-22335044.summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with early-stage malignant mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary who underwent fertility-sparing surgery. Treatment consisted of unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, infracolic omentectomy, and pelvic and paraaortal lymph node dissection, followed by chemotherapy. Three years later she conceived spontaneously and delivered a healthy infant. The authors conclude that fertility can be successfully preserved through conservative surgery in selected patients with early-stage malignant ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-22338389.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫の既往から12年後に発生した後腹膜の続発性奇形腫の症例である。非特異的な腹痛の評価のために施行したCTで偶然発見された。CTとMRIでは石灰化と周辺増強を伴う嚢胞性後腹膜腫瘤が認められ、画像所見の特徴が示された。後腹膜奇形腫の文献的考察と鑑別診断もまとめている。
pmid-22338389.summary_en: This case report describes a retroperitoneal mass in a patient with a history of primary testicular teratoma diagnosed 12 years earlier, representing secondary gonadal teratoma. The mass was incidentally found on abdominal CT performed for nonspecific abdominal pain. CT and MRI showed cystic retroperitoneal masses with calcifications and peripheral enhancement. The authors review the literature on retroperitoneal teratomas and the common differential diagnoses to consider.

pmid-22356044.summary_ja: 4歳男児の傍咽頭腔腫瘤が、成熟奇形腫内に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍であったと報告している。卵黄嚢腫瘍は乳幼児では主に性腺に生じ、性腺外発生は稀である。成熟奇形腫からの卵黄嚢腫瘍発生は文献上初めての報告とされる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の多様な発生様式を示す貴重な症例である。
pmid-22356044.summary_en: The authors report a four-year-old boy with a parapharyngeal mass that proved to be a yolk sac tumour arising within a mature teratoma. Yolk sac tumour is usually a gonadal germ cell tumour in infants, and extragonadal presentations are rare. Parapharyngeal mature teratomas are also uncommon. Although malignant transformation of extragonadal mature teratoma has been described, the authors state that yolk sac tumour arising in such a teratoma had not previously been reported.

pmid-22361499.summary_ja: 28歳女性で、混乱、幻視、けいれんを呈した抗NMDA受容体抗体関連辺縁系脳炎の症例である。CTで左卵巣の類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）が見つかり、脳脊髄液中の抗体陽性で診断された。ステロイドパルス、血漿交換、左卵巣摘出術により認知機能は改善し、けいれんは消失した。卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性脳炎として腫瘍切除の重要性を述べている。
pmid-22361499.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor antibody-associated limbic encephalitis presenting with confusion, hallucinations, and seizures. CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis revealed a left ovarian dermoid cyst, and CSF antibody testing confirmed the diagnosis. Treatment included methylprednisolone, plasmapheresis, and left salpingo-oophorectomy, with marked cognitive improvement and no further seizures. The authors emphasize that ovarian teratoma is strongly associated with this paraneoplastic syndrome and that tumor resection is key.

pmid-22380998.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫と腹膜神経膠腫症を有する33歳女性の症例で、腹部膨満と腹痛で受診した。経時的な画像のフォローアップ所見を示している。腹膜病変の鑑別は予後に重要で、数年後の悪性転化も否定できないため、術後サーベイランスの指針作成が必要と述べている。
pmid-22380998.summary_en: This report describes a 33-year-old woman with an immature ovarian teratoma and gliomatosis peritonei, presenting with abdominal distension and pain. Follow-up imaging was reviewed over time. The authors note that gliomatosis peritonei is metastatic implantation of mature glial tissue from ovarian teratoma, and that differentiating peritoneal implants is important for prognosis. Malignant transformation can occur years later, so the authors call for guidelines on postoperative surveillance of these patients.

pmid-22384287.summary_ja: ガーナの2歳女児で、可動性のある無痛性の腹部腫瘤を呈した巨大な腸間膜類皮嚢腫の症例である。小児外科専門医のいない農村部の病院で外科的切除が行われた。腸間膜に発生する成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は稀であり、術前診断の困難さと資源の限られた環境における治療上の課題を指摘している。
pmid-22384287.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old girl in Ghana with a large mesenteric dermoid cyst, presenting as a freely movable, non-tender abdominal mass. The cyst was removed surgically in a rural hospital without a dedicated pediatric surgical service. The authors note that mesenteric cysts are rare and usually occur in children under 10, and that dermoid cysts, or mature cystic teratomas, rarely arise in the mesentery. They also highlight diagnostic challenges and limited resources in Africa.

pmid-22384429.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症（CAIS、XY核型）を有する58歳女性で、鼠径ヘルニアを契機に大型の進行セミノーマと診断された症例である。診断が遅れたため適切な治療を受けられなかった。停留精巣の悪性転化リスクは加齢とともに高まり、思春期後の性腺摘出が推奨されることを述べ、CAISにおける早期診断の重要性を示している。
pmid-22384429.summary_en: This report describes a 58-year-old woman with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (CAIS), an XY karyotype, who presented with inguinal hernia and was diagnosed with a large advanced seminoma. Because the diagnosis was made late, she could not receive proper management. The authors explain that the risk of malignant transformation in undescended testes increases with age, so gonadectomy is recommended after puberty. The case highlights the importance of early diagnosis in CAIS.

pmid-22413055.summary_ja: 若年男性の精巣奇形腫内に発生した体細胞型扁平上皮癌の症例報告。臍部転移結節（Sister Mary Joseph結節）として発症した。精巣由来の扁平上皮癌からこの転移形式が報告されたのは初めてと考えられ、若年男性の臍部結節の鑑別では本起源も念頭に置くべきであると述べている。
pmid-22413055.summary_en: This report describes a rare somatic-type squamous cell carcinoma arising within a testicular teratoma in a young man. The tumor presented as a metastatic umbilical nodule (Sister Mary Joseph nodule), a finding not previously reported from testicular squamous cell carcinoma. The authors stress that this origin should be considered when evaluating umbilical nodules in young male patients.

pmid-22435165.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者25例を対象とした後方視的研究で、子宮と対側卵巣を温存する手術を、化学療法の有無にかかわらず評価した。多くは若年患者で、腫瘍の多くは早期病期であった。2年間の追跡で、再発は2例、術後死亡は1例、化学療法群では健康な生児が5例得られた。研究者らは、妊孕性を温存する治療法が実行可能であることを示唆している。
pmid-22435165.summary_en: This retrospective study of 25 patients with ovarian malignant germ cell tumors evaluated conservative surgery that preserved the uterus and contralateral ovary, with or without adjuvant chemotherapy. Most patients were young, and most tumors were early stage. Over two years of follow-up there were two recurrences, one postoperative death, and five healthy live births in the chemotherapy group, suggesting fertility-sparing approaches are feasible.

pmid-22468260.summary_ja: 小児の頭頸部奇形腫を扱った症例集積であり、多様で予測困難な臨床経過や劇的な症状を呈することがある希少腫瘍群について述べている。最近の用語分類の見直しにも言及し、性腺・中枢神経外の胚細胞由来奇形腫の理解を整理している。
pmid-22468260.summary_en: This case series reviews pediatric teratomas of the head and neck, a group with diverse, unpredictable clinical behavior and often dramatic presentation. The article discusses their rarity and the recent terminology used for this tumor group. It is a descriptive review centered on extragonadal germ cell-derived teratomas outside the gonads and central nervous system.

pmid-22567517.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍の女性患者において、静注エトポシドによるI型過敏反応が生じたため、エトポシドホスフェートへ置換し、BEP療法4サイクルを完遂できた症例報告。婦人科胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法における薬剤過敏症への実際的な対応を示している。
pmid-22567517.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with yolk sac tumor who developed a type I hypersensitivity reaction to intravenous etoposide. Authors substituted etoposide phosphate and allowed completion of all four planned cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (BEP). The report highlights practical management of drug hypersensitivity during germ cell tumor chemotherapy in gynecologic oncology.

pmid-22606550.summary_ja: 精巣性女性化症候群を有する36歳女性の腹腔内精巣腫瘍の症例報告。病理学的にセミノーマと診断された。超音波、MRI、MRスペクトロスコピーによる画像所見を記載しており、腹腔内精巣セミノーマにおけるこれらの所見の報告は初めてとしている。原発性無月経で受診した。
pmid-22606550.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with testicular feminization syndrome and an intra-abdominal testicular tumor, histologically confirmed as seminoma. Imaging with ultrasound, MRI, and MR spectroscopy was documented, which the authors note is the first such description for intra-abdominal testicular seminoma. The case presented with primary amenorrhea.

pmid-22654332.summary_ja: 小児の仙尾部腫瘤23例の症例集積で、髄膜瘤を除くと奇形腫が主要な群を占めた。類皮嚢腫、変性神経線維、横紋筋肉腫なども含まれる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である仙尾部奇形腫を中心に、まれな仙尾部病変の診断と管理の理解を深めることを目的としている。
pmid-22654332.summary_en: This series of 23 pediatric sacrococcygeal masses, excluding meningomyelocele, identifies teratoma as a major group alongside presacral dermoid, degenerated nerve fiber, fibrofatty tissue, and rhabdomyosarcoma. Presented at a pediatric surgery department over ten years, it aims to improve diagnosis and management of unfamiliar sacrococcygeal lesions. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is an extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-22654694.summary_ja: 27歳の女性が慢性の多発性脊椎痛でカイロプラクティック教育施設を受診した。脊椎のX線検査で偶発的に骨盤内の石灰化陰影が見つかった。超音波検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断され、開腹手術で完全に切除された。脊椎症状はカイロプラクティック治療で改善を続け、骨盤内腫瘤は症状の原因ではなかったと考えられた。著者らは、卵巣由来が疑われる石灰化骨盤内腫瘤には追加の画像診断と適切な紹介が必要であると強調し、石灰化を伴う卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断も概説している。
pmid-22654694.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman who presented to a chiropractic teaching clinic with chronic multilevel spinal pain. Routine spinal radiography incidentally revealed calcific densities in the pelvis. Ultrasonography identified a mature cystic teratoma, which was completely excised through laparotomy. Her spinal symptoms continued to respond to chiropractic care, indicating the pelvic mass was not the source of her complaints. The authors emphasize that calcific pelvic masses suspected of ovarian origin require additional imaging, careful clinical correlation, and appropriate referral. They also review differential diagnoses for ovarian masses with calcifications.

pmid-22666943.summary_ja: 女性表現型で染色体モザイクを有する真性半陰陽の35歳女性に、卵巣のディスジャーミノーマが認められた稀な症例。真性半陰陽の悪性腫瘍はほぼ全例が胚細胞腫瘍であり、大半は男性表現型の患者に生じると述べている。本論文は、この非典型例の治療経過と反応を報告している。
pmid-22666943.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman with a female phenotype and cytogenetic mosaicism who had true hermaphroditism. She was diagnosed with a dysgerminoma of the ovary, a rare malignancy in this setting. The authors note that malignancies in true hermaphrodites are rare, occur almost exclusively with cytogenetic mosaicism, and are nearly always germ cell neoplasms such as seminoma, gonadoblastoma, or teratoma, usually in patients with a male phenotype. The paper reports the treatment and clinical response in this atypical case.

pmid-22688478.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍でhCGが著しく高値の31歳男性が、甲状腺機能亢進症を呈した症例。hCGはTSHと構造が類似するため、高値になるとTSH受容体を刺激して甲状腺機能亢進を来しうる。化学療法の開始後にhCG値が低下し、甲状腺機能亢進症も改善した。腫瘍マーカーの増加と臨床症状の関連を示す傍腫瘍性内分泌合併症の一例である。
pmid-22688478.summary_en: The authors report a 31-year-old man with a metastatic germ cell tumour and markedly elevated human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) who presented with hyperthyroidism. Because hCG is structurally similar to thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), very high levels can activate the TSH receptor and cause thyroid dysfunction. After chemotherapy was started, hCG levels fell and the hyperthyroidism resolved. The case illustrates a paraneoplastic endocrine complication of germ cell tumours and the link between tumour marker burden and clinical symptoms.

pmid-22699468.summary_ja: 急性精神病で入院した29歳女性は、発熱と幻覚の悪化を呈していた。腰椎穿刺で脳脊髄液の反応性変化が認められ、経腟超音波検査で卵巣奇形腫が疑われる腫瘤が見つかった。初期の抗NMDAR抗体は陰性であったが、腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術と血漿交換を受けて徐々に改善した。その後、抗体は陽性となった。卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎と抗体検出の遅延を示す症例である。
pmid-22699468.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman admitted with acute psychosis, fever, and worsening hallucinations. Lumbar puncture showed reactive cerebrospinal fluid, and transvaginal ultrasound revealed a left ovarian mass suggestive of teratoma. Initial anti-NMDA receptor antibody testing was negative, but she underwent laparoscopic oophorectomy and plasma exchange. Her condition gradually improved, and the anti-NMDAR antibody later became positive. The report highlights a paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma and the potential for delayed antibody detection.

pmid-22700350.summary_ja: 進行性の腹部膨満を呈した生後4か月男児の、石灰化を伴う多嚢胞性腹部腫瘤の症例。AFPやβ-hCGなどの腫瘍マーカーは年齢相応であった。試験開腹術で胃小弯から発生した23cmの腫瘤が認められ、病理組織学的検査で未熟奇形腫と診断された。1年間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。乳児期に生じる稀な腫瘍として文献レビューも行っている。
pmid-22700350.summary_en: This case report describes a 4-month-old male infant with progressive abdominal distension and a multicystic abdominal mass with calcification. Serum AFP, beta-hCG, and other markers were within age-appropriate ranges. Laparotomy revealed a 23 cm multilobulated cystic mass arising from the lesser curvature of the stomach and fed by the left gastric artery. Histopathology showed an immature teratoma, and the infant had no recurrence after one year of follow-up. The paper also reviews the literature on this rare tumour in infancy.

pmid-22710543.summary_ja: ネパールのBPKIHSで2008〜2010年に記録された胞状妊娠64例の後方視的研究。完全胞状奇胎37例、部分胞状奇胎23例に加え、侵入奇胎や絨毛癌も含まれていた。発生率は分娩1000件あたり3.94で、中央値は22歳であった。母体年齢や血液型との関連を検討し、完全奇胎は若年層に多いと報告している。
pmid-22710543.summary_en: This retrospective study analysed 64 molar pregnancies recorded at BP Koirala Institute of Health Sciences in Nepal between January 2008 and January 2010. The series comprised 37 complete moles, 23 partial moles, one persistent gestational trophoblastic tumour, one choriocarcinoma, and two invasive moles. The incidence was 3.94 per 1000 deliveries, with a median patient age of 22 years. Most women presented in early second trimester. The authors describe relationships between molar pregnancy, maternal age, and blood group, and note that complete moles were most common in younger women.

pmid-22714605.summary_ja: 経産婦の36歳女性に、卵巣の衝突腫瘍が認められた症例報告。大型の粘液性嚢胞腺腫の表面の壁に、小さな卵円形の胚様成熟奇形腫が存在していた。著者らは、嚢胞壁内の卵巣胚細胞遺残に由来すると考察している。卵子の単為発生と濾胞上皮の化生による発生という別の機序も提案している。
pmid-22714605.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old multiparous woman with a collision tumour of the ovary. A small ovoid embryoid mature teratoma was found in the surface wall of a large mucinous cyst adenoma, without columnar epithelium or mucin-secreting cysts in the teratoid component. The authors suggest the teratoma arose from an ovarian germ cell rest within the cyst wall. They also propose an alternative pathogenesis involving parthenogenesis of the ovum and epithelial metaplasia of the follicular lining of the adenoma.

pmid-22714612.summary_ja: 産後に頭痛や左下肢のしびれを呈し、後に痙攣で集中治療室に入院した32歳女性の症例。脳、肺、肝、膵に病変があり、β-hCGは132,000 IU/Lを超えていた。転移性絨毛癌と診断され、併用化学療法により良好な反応を示し、完全に回復した。産後の多臓器症状では妊娠性悪性腫瘍を考慮する必要性を示している。
pmid-22714612.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman who developed headaches, blurred vision, and left leg numbness after delivery, initially attributed to migraine with sciatica. She later had seizures and was admitted to intensive care. Investigations showed abnormal cerebral perfusion, multiple lung nodules, liver lesions, and a pancreatic mass. Beta-hCG exceeded 132,000 IU/L, and metastatic choriocarcinoma was diagnosed. She responded well to combination chemotherapy and made a full recovery. The case illustrates the importance of considering gestational malignancy in postpartum patients with multisystem findings.

pmid-22776228.summary_ja: 子宮筋腫と8cmの左卵巣腫瘍を有する50歳女性の症例。腹腔鏡下子宮全摘術と左卵管卵巣摘出術が施行された。病理組織学的検査で、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の甲状腺組織から生じた濾胞型甲状腺型乳頭癌と診断された。卵巣甲状腺腫の稀な悪性転化であり、腹腔鏡下治療では本疾患の可能性を念頭に置く必要があると論じている。
pmid-22776228.summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old woman with a uterine fibroid, hypermenorrhea, and an 8 cm left ovarian tumour. She underwent laparoscopic hysterectomy and left salpingo-oophorectomy. Histopathological examination showed a follicular variant thyroid-type papillary carcinoma arising from thyroid tissue within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, representing a rare malignant transformation of ovarian struma. The authors note that such rare malignancy should be considered when treating teratomas laparoscopically, and that the operative strategy requires careful selection given reports of early postoperative death.

pmid-22866146.summary_ja: 本研究は大豆由来のフィトエストロゲンであるゲニステインが、絨毛癌細胞株JARの浸潤に与える影響を検討したものです。ゲニステインは用量依存的に浸潤を抑制し、MTA3の減少、SnailおよびE-カドヘリンの増加をもたらしました。ERβのノックダウンによりこれらの効果は消失し、ERβを介した経路が示されました。絨毛癌の予防や治療への応用が期待されると述べています。
pmid-22866146.summary_en: This in vitro study examined whether genistein, a soy phytoestrogen, suppresses invasion of the choriocarcinoma cell line JAR. Using a Matrigel invasion assay, genistein reduced invasion in a dose-dependent manner, decreasing MTA3 and increasing Snail mRNA and E-cadherin protein. Knockdown of estrogen receptor β with siRNA abolished these effects, indicating that genistein acts through ERβ to regulate the MTA3/Snail/E-cadherin pathway. The authors suggest these findings may inform the prevention and therapy of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-22937423.summary_ja: 2歳男児に発生した巨大な肺内奇形腫の症例報告と文献レビューです。肺奇形腫は稀で、多くは左肺上葉に発生します。肺原発と診断するには、性腺や他の性腺外原発巣を除外し、病変が肺内に完全に限局している必要があります。本論文は、この症例の臨床経過と診断基準を文献と照らし合わせて概説しています。
pmid-22937423.summary_en: The authors report a giant pulmonary teratoma in a 2-year-old boy and review the relevant literature. Pulmonary teratomas are rare and most often arise in the upper lobe of the left lung. Diagnosis of pulmonary origin requires exclusion of a gonadal or other extragonadal primary site and origin entirely within the lung. The paper describes the clinical course of this case and summarizes previous reports to place its diagnostic criteria in context.

pmid-22942597.summary_ja: 出生時に口から大きな腫瘤が突出していた女児の先天性鼻咽頭奇形腫(epignathus)と口蓋裂の症例報告です。出生当日に口外部分を減量し、その後口腔内から摘出して、口蓋裂の修復は段階的に行いました。病理組織学的検査で先天性奇形腫と確定しました。7年間のフォローアップを行い、本症の疫学と臨床像も概説しています。
pmid-22942597.summary_en: The authors describe a female infant with a congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma (epignathus) and cleft palate, whose large mass protruded from the mouth at birth. Management involved immediate debulking of the extraoral portion, followed by intraoral extirpation and staged cleft palate repair. Histopathological examination confirmed a congenital teratoma. The paper reviews the epidemiology and clinical features of epignathi, which may extend intracranially, and reports seven years of follow-up.

pmid-22953284.summary_ja: 生後15日の新生児にみられた腹部腫瘤で、胃奇形腫と判明した症例報告です。超音波検査では混合エコー性の病変、CTでは内部石灰化を伴う充実性・嚢胞性腫瘤が認められました。手術では胃後壁から発生し、胃外性と胃内性の両方に広がっていました。生検では成熟奇形腫が示唆されました。極めて稀な混在型の胃奇形腫の症例を報告しています。
pmid-22953284.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-day-old neonate with an abdominal mass later identified as a gastric teratoma. Ultrasonography showed a mixed-echogenicity lesion, and CT revealed a solid and cystic mass with internal calcifications. At surgery, the tumor arose from the posterior gastric wall and was both exogastric and endogastric in location. Biopsy suggested a mature teratoma. The authors highlight this mixed exogastric and endogastric variant, which is exceptionally rare.

pmid-22997845.summary_ja: 初期胚の多能性細胞と奇形腫形成との関係をまとめた総説です。ES細胞やEG細胞は多様な組織へ分化する能力を持ち、分化プログラムが障害されると奇形腫や奇形癌、一部のセミノーマが生じ得ると述べています。未分化ES/EG細胞を免疫不全マウスに移植して生じる実験的奇形腫は、細胞運命決定や発がんの研究モデルとして有用です。腫瘍中の未分化細胞を標的とする治療法の開発につながると論じています。
pmid-22997845.summary_en: This review examines pluripotent cells of the early embryo and their relationship to teratoma formation. It discusses permanent ES and EG cell lines, which can differentiate into diverse tissues, and notes that pluripotent cells and primordial germ cells can give rise to teratomas, teratocarcinomas and some seminomas when differentiation programs are disrupted. Teratomas formed after transplantation of undifferentiated ES and EG cells into immunodeficient mice are presented as a model for studying cell fate and carcinogenesis. The authors suggest that signaling pathways may serve as targets for eliminating undifferentiated cells in tumors.

pmid-23024547.summary_ja: 小児に生じた稀な奇形である胎児内胎児の症例報告です。胎児内胎児と高分化奇形腫の鑑別については長く論争があり、診断に脊柱の存在が必須かどうかが議論されています。両者は胚発生上の障害時期に応じたスペクトラムを成すという考えを示し、本症例もその範囲に当てはまると位置づけています。
pmid-23024547.summary_en: This case report presents a pediatric patient with fetus-in-fetu, an uncommon anomaly, and discusses its differentiation from well-differentiated teratoma. The authors note the longstanding controversy over whether an axial skeleton is required for diagnosis, given reports of fetus-in-fetu without a vertebral column. They propose that the two entities form a spectrum of lesions depending on the timing of the embryological insult, and position the present case as another example fitting this spectrum.

pmid-23056797.summary_ja: 生後20日の女児に発生した、6×4×3cmの鼻咽頭奇形腫と広範な口蓋裂の症例報告です。腫瘤は気道を閉塞し経口哺乳を妨げていたため、術前画像検査の後、入院2日目に切除されました。病理組織学的検査で成熟充実性奇形腫と判明し、術後経過は良好でした。2歳時に口蓋裂を修復し、6歳時点で正常な発達を示しています。気道閉塞がある場合は緊急手術が望ましいと結論づけています。
pmid-23056797.summary_en: A 20-day-old female neonate presented with a 6×4×3 cm nasopharyngeal mass and wide cleft palate that blocked the airway and prevented oral feeding. After preoperative imaging, the mass was excised two days after admission. Pathology showed a well-differentiated mature solid teratoma, and the postoperative course was uneventful. The cleft palate was repaired at age two, and the child was developing normally at six years. The authors conclude that congenital nasopharyngeal teratomas are usually benign and that urgent surgery is preferred when airway obstruction is present.

pmid-23705093.summary_ja: 嚢胞性仙尾部奇形腫を有する胎児2例に対し、分娩期に超音波ガイド下で嚢胞を穿刺ドレナージした症例報告である。経腟分娩が可能となり、分娩障害や帝王切開に伴うリスクを回避できた。経皮的な嚢胞穿刺は簡便で安全な方法であると結論づけている。
pmid-23705093.summary_en: This case report describes two fetuses with cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) whose cysts were drained by peripartum ultrasound-guided puncture. Drainage reduced tumor size enough to allow uncomplicated vaginal delivery, avoiding labor dystocia and the risks of cesarean section, including hemorrhage and uterine rupture in later pregnancies. The authors conclude that percutaneous emptying of cystic SCT is an easy, safe and efficient procedure, reducing the risk of tumor rupture during labor.

pmid-23804993.summary_ja: 本報告は、巨大な心膜内腫瘍による心タンポナーデで呼吸および心機能の障害を呈した新生児の症例を記述する。緊急の心膜探索により、心臓より大きい被膜に包まれた腫瘍を完全切除し、未熟奇形腫と診断した。フォローアップ期間中αフェトプロテインは正常範囲にとどまり、児は合併症なく退院した。著者らは、有意な心膜液貯留を伴う心膜内奇形腫は外科的緊急症であり、悪性化の可能性から完全切除が必要であり、多職種による管理が不可欠であると強調している。
pmid-23804993.summary_en: This report describes a neonate with respiratory and cardiac compromise from cardiac tamponade caused by a large intrapericardial tumor. Emergency pericardial exploration allowed complete excision of a well-encapsulated tumor, larger than the heart, diagnosed as immature teratoma. Alpha-fetoprotein remained normal during follow-up, and the infant was discharged without complications. The authors stress that intrapericardial teratoma with significant effusion is a surgical emergency, that complete excision is needed due to malignant potential, and that multidisciplinary care is essential.

pmid-24198649.summary_ja: 精巣がんにおける血清腫瘍マーカーの臨床的役割をまとめた総説である。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)が、セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の診断、病期分類、治療効果判定、フォローアップに用いられる。マーカーの限界と新規候補分子も論じている。
pmid-24198649.summary_en: This review discusses the clinical role of serum tumor markers in testicular cancer, focusing on human chorionic gonadotropin, alpha-fetoprotein and lactate dehydrogenase. These markers aid diagnosis, staging, prognosis, monitoring of treatment response and surveillance of seminomatous and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. The authors also outline the limitations of these markers and additional serum molecules being investigated as novel germ cell tumor markers.

pmid-24371596.summary_ja: 妊孕性温存手術と化学療法を受けた卵巣混合性悪性胚細胞腫瘍の2症例の報告である。BEP療法中に肝腫瘤が増大し、画像上は転移が疑われたが腫瘍マーカーは陰性化した。growing teratoma syndromeの非典型的な肝病変として報告しており、化学療法中の画像所見の解釈の難しさも指摘している。
pmid-24371596.summary_en: This report describes two patients with ovarian malignant mixed germ cell tumors who developed enlarging liver masses during BEP chemotherapy after fertility-sparing surgery. Imaging suggested metastasis, yet serum tumor markers became negative, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. The authors highlight that liver involvement is an unusual site for this syndrome and that radiological findings can be misleading during chemotherapy.

pmid-24371602.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の内部から発生した悪性黒色腫の症例報告である。奇形腫は外胚葉・中胚葉・内胚葉の三胚葉すべての組織を含み、いずれも悪性転化しうると指摘されている。本論文は要旨が簡潔で臨床的詳細は少ないが、卵巣奇形腫に生じるまれな悪性成分の一例として位置づけられる。
pmid-24371602.summary_en: This case report describes malignant melanoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The authors note that teratomas are composed of elements from all three germ layers, each of which could potentially undergo malignant transformation. The abstract is brief and provides few clinical details beyond the diagnosis itself. The case documents an uncommon malignant component of a mature ovarian teratoma.

pmid-24578860.summary_ja: 精巣原発腫瘍からの肝転移巣が破裂し、大量の血腹症を来した症例の報告である。精巣がんは後腹膜リンパ節や肺に転移しやすく、肝転移は予後不良でまれである。肝転移巣からの出血は極めてまれであり、生命に関わりうる合併症として示された。
pmid-24578860.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with massive hemoperitoneum caused by rupture of hepatic metastases from a primary testicular tumor. The authors note that testicular cancer commonly spreads to retroperitoneal nodes and lungs, that liver involvement is rare and carries poor prognosis, and that bleeding of secondary liver lesions is very uncommon. The case illustrates a rare, potentially life-threatening complication of hepatic metastatic testicular cancer.

pmid-24765370.summary_ja: 若年女児に発生した大網原発の奇形腫の症例報告である。性腺外に生じる極めてまれな胚細胞腫瘍で、画像所見から疑われ外科的切除が行われた。病理組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。大網や腸間膜の奇形腫は無症状か圧迫症状を示すことが多いと述べている。
pmid-24765370.summary_en: This case report describes a young girl with a primary omental teratoma, an extremely rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. The mass was managed with surgical resection after imaging suggested the diagnosis. Histopathological examination confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. The report reviews the origin of germ cell tumors and notes that omental and mesenteric teratomas are uncommon and often asymptomatic or cause compressive symptoms.

pmid-24851180.summary_ja: レトロゾールによる排卵誘発中の29歳女性で、卵管に生じた胞状奇胎を報告している。胞状奇胎は通常子宮腔内に発生するため、異所性着床は極めてまれである。通常の子宮外妊娠との鑑別の重要性を強調し、特に排卵誘発を受けた不妊女性で注意が必要と述べている。
pmid-24851180.summary_en: This case report describes a hydatidiform mole implanted in the fallopian tube, mimicking a tubal ectopic pregnancy. The patient was a 29-year-old woman who had ovulation induction with letrozole. Because molar gestations usually arise in the uterine cavity, ectopic implantation is rare. The authors emphasize distinguishing a hydatidiform mole from a conventional ectopic pregnancy, particularly in infertile women who have undergone ovulation induction.

pmid-24950396.summary_ja: 重度の進行性便秘を呈した60歳女性で、卵巣甲状腺腫性カルチノイドを報告している。右卵巣腫瘤を外科的に切除し、病理組織学的に診断された。術後に便秘は完全に消失した。腸管運動を抑制するペプチドYYの分泌が、腫瘍による機械的圧迫より原因と考察している。
pmid-24950396.summary_en: This case report describes a 60-year-old woman with severe progressive constipation caused by an ovarian strumal carcinoid, a carcinoid arising within a struma ovarii germ cell tumor. A right ovarian mass was surgically removed, and histopathology confirmed the diagnosis. The constipation resolved completely after surgery. The authors attribute the symptom to peptide YY secretion, which inhibits intestinal motility, rather than to mechanical compression by the tumor.

pmid-24971840.summary_ja: 停留精巣に生じた巨大セミノーマが腹壁腫瘤として発現した29歳男性の症例報告である。CTとPET/CTで皮下層と外腹斜筋膜の間に腫瘍を確認した。一括切除後の病理組織は古典的セミノーマであり、遠隔転移は認められなかった。停留精巣の腫瘍は腹壁腫瘤として現れうると指摘している。
pmid-24971840.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old man with a giant seminoma arising in an undescended testis and presenting as an abdominal wall mass. CT and PET/CT localized the tumor between the subcutaneous layer and the external oblique fascia. En-bloc excision was performed, and pathology showed classical seminoma. PET/CT showed no distant metastasis. The authors stress that tumors of an undescended testis can present as abdominal wall masses.

pmid-25648048.summary_ja: 上縦隔に生じたセミノーマ性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍により上大静脈が完全閉塞した20歳男性の症例報告である。縦隔放射線療法とステロイドを開始し、生検で転移性セミノーマと確定した。BEP療法で部分奏効が得られたが、救援化学療法では追加の縮小は得られなかった。集中治療後32か月間、再発はない。
pmid-25648048.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with a seminomatous extragonadal germ cell tumor in the upper mediastinum that completely obstructed the superior vena cava. Mediastinal radiotherapy and steroids were started, and biopsy confirmed metastatic seminoma. BEP chemotherapy produced a partial response, but additional salvage chemotherapy caused no further tumor shrinkage. The patient has remained free of recurrence for 32 months after intensive treatment.

pmid-27278506.summary_ja: 妊娠16週で発見された巨大頸顔面奇形腫の胎児症例である。超音波検査と胎児MRIで腫瘍の範囲を評価し、気道圧迫がないことを確認した。妊娠中に超音波ガイド下で嚢胞内液を吸引し、37週で帝王切開により出生した。生後28日目に外科的切除が行われた。正確な出生前診断と慎重な管理の重要性を強調している。
pmid-27278506.summary_en: This report describes a fetus with a massive cervicofacial teratoma detected at 16 weeks' gestation. Ultrasound and fetal MRI defined the tumor's extent without airway compression. Ultrasound-guided removal of cystic fluid during pregnancy relieved maternal discomfort. Cesarean delivery was performed at 37 weeks, and the tumor was surgically resected on day 28 of life. The authors highlight the value of accurate prenatal diagnosis and careful perinatal management.

pmid-27307906.summary_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌に対して甲状腺全摘を受けた閉経後女性の症例報告である。術後のI-131治療後シンチグラフィで骨盤内の集積が偶発的に見つかり、超音波検査で右卵巣腫瘤が確認された。手術で成熟奇形腫、主として良性甲状腺組織からなる卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。甲状腺癌の経過観察中に偶発的に検出されうることを示している。
pmid-27307906.summary_en: This report describes a postmenopausal woman with papillary thyroid carcinoma who underwent total thyroidectomy. Postoperative I-131 scanning incidentally detected a focus in the pelvis, and ultrasound revealed a right ovarian mass. Surgery confirmed a mature teratoma with predominantly benign thyroid tissue, consistent with struma ovarii. The case shows that struma ovarii can be detected incidentally during thyroid cancer surveillance with radioiodine scanning.

pmid-27678234.summary_ja: 右側上顎臼歯部に生じた口腔奇形腫で、原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍成分を伴った6歳男児の症例報告である。成熟および未熟な三胚葉由来組織と、CD99陽性の小円形細胞のシートが認められた。頭頸部の奇形腫は小児の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍としてまれである。奇形腫からの悪性転化により生じたまれな原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍として報告している。
pmid-27678234.summary_en: This case report describes a 6-year-old boy with an oral teratoma in the right maxillary molar region that contained a primitive neuroectodermal tumor component. Histology showed mature and immature trilineage elements, along with sheets of small round cells with vague rosettes that were CD99 positive. Head and neck teratomas are a rare form of extragonadal germ cell tumor in childhood. The authors describe this as a rare PNET arising from a teratoma through malignant transformation.

pmid-28191116.summary_ja: 41歳女性の右卵巣嚢胞性病変。超音波検査で脂肪-液体レベル、dermoid mesh、tip of the iceberg signの2つ以上を認め、病理組織学的に卵巣類皮嚢腫と確定した。血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の上昇を伴っていたが、嚢腫摘出後に正常化した。超音波所見からの確実な診断の有用性を示す。
pmid-28191116.summary_en: A 41-year-old woman had a known cystic lesion on her right ovary. Ultrasound showed two typical dermoid features, a fat-fluid level and a tip-of-the-iceberg sign, and histopathology later confirmed an ovarian dermoid cyst. Her serum hCG was elevated, an unusual but recognized finding with dermoid cysts. The hCG normalized after removal of the cyst, and the authors highlight that two or more typical sonographic features allow a confident diagnosis.

pmid-29147233.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術を受けた患者の後方視的解析。年齢調整罹患率は報告値と同等であった。組織型はセミノーマ55.1%、非セミノーマ14.3%、混合型30.6%で、病期Iが61.2%を占めた。腫瘍マーカー高値は約43%に認められた。著者らはIGCCCG予後分類に基づく厳格な管理の重要性を強調している。
pmid-29147233.summary_en: This single-centre retrospective review of patients who underwent orchiectomy for testicular cancer assessed age-adjusted incidence, histology, stage and tumour markers. Seminoma accounted for 55.1% of cases, non-seminoma 14.3% and mixed histology 30.6%; most patients had stage I disease. Incidence matched reported figures. About 43% had elevated tumor markers, and the authors stress strict adherence to IGCCCG risk classification.

pmid-29699094.summary_ja: 24歳未経妊女性で病期IIIcの卵巣未熟奇形腫。妊孕性温存手術後、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ペプロマイシンによる化学療法を4コース実施した。34歳で結婚後、38歳で排卵誘発と人工授精を行い妊娠し、健康な女児を出産した。著者らは不妊治療の適応を慎重に検討すべきとしている。
pmid-29699094.summary_en: A 24-year-old nulliparous woman with stage IIIc ovarian immature teratoma underwent fertility-sparing surgery followed by four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and pepleomycin. Years later, after ovulation induction and intrauterine insemination, she conceived and delivered a healthy infant. The authors conclude that infertility treatment after malignant ovarian germ cell tumor may be appropriate in some women but needs further study. A literature review is included.

pmid-21567140.summary_ja: 小児・思春期に多い卵巣腫瘍の臨床像と画像所見をまとめた総説である。超音波を第一選択とし、判定困難な骨盤内腫瘤にはMRIを、病期分類やフォローアップ、救急時にはCTを用いると述べる。腹痛や外傷の評価で偶発的に見つかる卵巣腫瘍では、大きさや所見、年齢に応じた対応が必要とされる。
pmid-21567140.summary_en: This review covers clinical and imaging features of the most common ovarian neoplasms in children and adolescents. It notes that incidental adnexal masses are increasingly found during evaluation of abdominal pain or trauma, and that management depends on lesion size, appearance and patient age. Ultrasound is the first-line modality, MRI is used for indeterminate or complex pelvic masses to distinguish benign from malignant lesions, and CT is reserved mainly for staging, follow-up and emergencies.

pmid-19943082.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株P19を癌幹細胞様モデルとして、赤ワインポリフェノールの抗癌作用を検討したin vitro研究。正常線維芽細胞NIH/3T3と比べ、P19の増殖を選択的に抑制し、G1期停止とp53上昇・カスパーゼ-3活性化を伴うアポトーシスを誘導した。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした研究ではない。癌幹細胞に対する新規薬剤のスクリーニング系として胎児性癌細胞株の有用性を示唆する。
pmid-19943082.summary_en: This in vitro study used the embryonal carcinoma cell line P19 as a model of cancer stem-like cells to test red wine polyphenols for anticancer chemopreventive activity. Compared with normal NIH/3T3 fibroblasts, polyphenols selectively inhibited P19 proliferation, induced G1 cell-cycle arrest, and triggered apoptosis with p53 upregulation and caspase-3 activation. The authors suggest these effects relate to growth inhibition and p53-dependent apoptosis, and propose embryonal carcinoma cells as a convenient system for screening agents against cancer stem cells. The work does not involve clinical germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-20596749.summary_ja: マウスP19胚性癌細胞を用いた研究で、抗がん剤リダマイシンが増殖を抑制した。Oct4、Sox2、c-Mycの発現低下を伴い、自己複製能が失われることが示された。アドリアマイシンとの併用で効果が増強された。
pmid-20596749.summary_en: This study tested lidamycin, an anticancer agent, on mouse P19 embryonal carcinoma cells. Lidamycin inhibited growth in a time- and dose-dependent manner, causing G1 arrest without apoptosis. It reduced colony formation and downregulated Oct4, Sox2 and c-Myc, unlike adriamycin. Combining low-dose lidamycin with adriamycin further reduced proliferation. The authors propose that lidamycin reduces self-renewal capacity through repression of embryonic stem cell-like genes, with potential for cancer stem cell-based therapy and use as a tool for studying pluripotency.

pmid-20851532.summary_ja: 5α還元酵素阻害薬フィナステリドが、テストステロンの上昇とDHTの低下を介して、P19胎児性癌細胞の神経分化と増殖を促進する可能性を提唱する仮説論文である。実験データは示されていない。胎児性癌細胞は腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく幹細胞の神経分化モデルとして扱われており、本サイトの対象としては境界的である。
pmid-20851532.summary_en: This hypothesis paper proposes that finasteride, a 5α-reductase inhibitor, may promote neural differentiation and proliferation of P19 embryonal carcinoma cells by raising testosterone and lowering dihydrotestosterone. The authors cite prior work showing P19 cells differentiate into neurons and astroglia under DHEA. No experiments are reported here. The paper uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a model of stem-cell neural differentiation rather than studying the tumor clinically, so its relevance to this site is borderline.

pmid-20878477.summary_ja: E3ユビキチンリガーゼの構成因子であるFbxw8が、絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞の増殖に必要であることを示した研究である。Fbxw8の発現抑制はG2/M期での細胞周期停止を引き起こし、過剰発現は逆の効果を示した。絨毛癌という疾患そのものではなく、栄養膜細胞の増殖機構を調べるモデル細胞として用いられている。
pmid-20878477.summary_en: This study shows that Fbxw8, an F-box component of an E3 ubiquitin ligase, is expressed in four human trophoblast cell lines and is needed for proliferation of choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells. Silencing Fbxw8 arrested cells at G2/M phase by altering CDK1, CDK2, cyclin A, cyclin B1 and p27 levels, while overexpression had the opposite effect. The authors suggest Fbxw8 supports trophoblast proliferation during placentation. The disease itself is not clinically studied; JEG-3 cells serve as an experimental model.

pmid-20945389.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株NCCITを、非がんおよびがんの前立腺間質細胞とトランスウェル共培養した研究。NCCITは非がん間質細胞のmiRNAとmRNA発現をがん関連型へ変化させた。胎児性癌細胞が分泌する拡散性因子で間質の遺伝子発現が誘導されうることを示す。主題は前立腺間質生物学であり、胎児性癌細胞は実験ツールとして用いられている。
pmid-20945389.summary_en: Using the embryonal carcinoma cell line NCCIT, the authors co-cultured normal and cancer-derived prostate stromal cells in a transwell system. NCCIT cells shifted miRNA and mRNA expression of normal stromal cells toward a cancer-associated profile but did not alter cancer stromal cells. This indicates diffusible factors from embryonal carcinoma cells can induce stromal changes. The authors propose cancer-associated stroma may be a less differentiated cell type. The main focus is prostate stromal biology, with embryonal carcinoma used as an experimental tool.

pmid-21054935.summary_ja: 一過性中大脳動脈閉塞マウスの虚血脳に未分化iPS細胞を移植した研究。虚血脳では正常脳よりも奇形腫形成の頻度と大きさが増加した。腫瘍ではc-Myc、Oct3/4、Sox2の発現が強く、MMP-9とリン酸化VEGFR2も増加していた。iPS細胞の安全性は病態モデルでも評価すべきとされる。
pmid-21054935.summary_en: This mouse study transplanted undifferentiated iPS cells into the striatum and cortex after transient middle cerebral artery occlusion. iPS cells in ischaemic brain formed teratomas more often and at larger volumes than in intact brain. The tumours showed strong c-Myc, Oct3/4 and Sox2 expression, with increased MMP-9 and phospho-VEGFR2. The authors propose that iPS cell safety should be tested in disease models, not only under normal conditions.

pmid-21083502.summary_ja: マウスP19胎児性癌細胞を原始外胚葉のモデルとして用い、Oct4の役割を解析した研究。Oct4はWnt/β-カテニンシグナルを抑制し、Brachyury誘導にはOct4が必要であった。P19細胞の多能性維持機構を示すもので、臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の研究ではない。
pmid-21083502.summary_en: Using mouse P19 embryonal carcinoma cells as an in vitro model of primitive ectoderm, this study examined the role of Oct4. Oct4 knockdown activated Wnt/β-catenin signaling and upregulated early mesoderm genes, while overexpression suppressed it. Brachyury induction required Oct4, which positively regulates Tdgf1, a Nodal signaling component. The authors propose that Oct4 maintains pluripotency of P19 cells by suppressing Wnt-driven mesoderm induction and by conferring competence for Brachyury response. The work concerns developmental biology rather than clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-21166089.summary_ja: 喉頭癌への放射線療法と非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍への化学療法を受けた患者で、18F-FLT-PETにより骨髄の増殖活性を評価した予備研究。照射野の骨髄ではFLT集積が有意に低下したが、化学療法後6か月の全身SUVmaxには有意差がなかった。18F-FLT-PETは骨髄増殖の非侵襲的評価法として有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-21166089.summary_en: This feasibility study used 18F-FLT-PET to quantify bone marrow proliferative activity in patients receiving radiotherapy for laryngeal carcinoma and chemotherapy for nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. Radiotherapy significantly reduced FLT uptake in the irradiated marrow, whereas BEP chemotherapy did not produce a significant change in whole-body SUVmax at six months, and hematologic recovery was confirmed. The authors propose 18F-FLT-PET as a potential noninvasive tool.

pmid-21174097.summary_ja: 超音波検査で判定困難な付属器腫瘤の38例を対象に、拡散強調画像を含むMRIが手術判断に与える影響を前向きに検討した。MRIで28.9%に重要な診断情報が得られ、5例で手術が回避された。DWIでは良悪性の鑑別はできなかったが、奇形腫は他の付属器病変より見かけの拡散係数(ADC)が有意に低かった。
pmid-21174097.summary_en: This prospective study of 38 women with indeterminate adnexal masses on ultrasound assessed whether MRI, including diffusion-weighted imaging, changed surgical decision-making. MRI provided major diagnostic information in 28.9% of cases, allowing surgery to be avoided in five, and yielded a net cost saving. DWI did not distinguish benign from malignant lesions, but teratomas had significantly lower ADC values than other adnexal lesions.

pmid-21247562.summary_ja: 2000〜2009年に妊娠中の付属器腫瘤に対して腹腔鏡手術を受けた88例を後方視的研究で検討した。最も多い病理組織像は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（35.2%）で、悪性腫瘍は6.8%であった。31.8%が捻転のため緊急手術を要し、緊急手術後に2例の自然流産が起きた。母体と胎児の周産期転帰は許容範囲であった。より大規模な前向き試験の必要性が指摘されている。
pmid-21247562.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 88 pregnant women who underwent laparoscopic surgery for adnexal masses between 2000 and 2009. Mature cystic teratoma was the most common histology (35.2%), and malignancy occurred in 6.8%. Torsion required emergency surgery in 31.8%, with two spontaneous abortions after emergency procedures. Obstetric outcomes were acceptable for mother and fetus. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is tolerable in pregnancy, while larger prospective trials are needed.

pmid-21280163.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で誘導される神経分化におけるWnt-4とWnt-11の役割を、胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2と2102Epを用いて検討した研究です。Wnt-4の発現抑制は早期神経分化を促進し、Wnt-11の過剰発現は神経新生を増強しました。胎児性癌細胞は分化のモデルとして用いられており、腫瘍そのものを対象とした研究ではありません。
pmid-21280163.summary_en: This study examined noncanonical Wnt ligands Wnt-4 and Wnt-11 during retinoic acid-induced neuronal differentiation. Using two human embryonal carcinoma cell lines, NTERA-2, which differentiates in response to retinoic acid, and 2102Ep, which does not, the authors showed retinoic acid suppresses beta-catenin/Tcf activity in NTERA-2 cells. Wnt-4 knockdown reduced OCT4 and NANOG downregulation and promoted early neuronal gene expression, while Wnt-11 overexpression potentiated neurogenesis. The embryonal carcinoma lines serve as differentiation models rather than tumor subjects, so germ cell tumor relevance is limited.

pmid-21289002.summary_ja: 初期妊娠の原発栄養膜細胞と、汎用される7種の栄養膜由来細胞株のDNAメチル化を網羅的に比較した。絨毛癌由来株などでプロモーター領域のメチル化が全体的に増加しており、一般的ながんでみられる遺伝子の高メチル化も認められた。細胞株を用いた機能解析には、エピジェネティックな違いへの注意が必要であると指摘している。
pmid-21289002.summary_en: This study profiled genome-wide DNA methylation in primary first-trimester trophoblasts and seven commonly used trophoblast-derived cell lines. Four choriocarcinoma-derived lines and transformed HTR-8/SVneo cells showed a general increase in promoter methylation, including hypermethylation of genes commonly altered in human cancers. Choriocarcinoma lines resembled unrelated solid cancers more than untransformed trophoblasts. Methylation contributed significantly to expression differences, and the authors caution that manipulating these pathways in vitro requires careful interpretation.

pmid-21289512.summary_ja: 帝王切開時に偶発的に診断された卵巣悪性腫瘍13例を後方視的に解析した。悪性胚細胞腫瘍は2例で、病期Iの症例が多かった。多くの症例に保存的手術が行われ、全例が完全寛解を維持した。適切に症例を選べば保存的治療が有効であると結論された。
pmid-21289512.summary_en: A retrospective study of 13 ovarian malignancies incidentally diagnosed during cesarean section, with an incidence of 0.21 per 1000 cesareans.
