Histology included two malignant germ cell tumors, three epithelial carcinomas, and eight low-malignant potential tumors. All patients were asymptomatic and diagnosed at stage I, and ultrasound detected masses in only five before surgery. Most underwent conservative surgery, three received adjuvant chemotherapy, and all remained in complete remission, supporting conservative management in carefully selected patients.

pmid-21295110.summary_ja: 正常精巣25例と精巣腫瘍24例で、NPY受容体のオートラジオグラフィーによる発現を検討した。正常精巣ではライディッヒ細胞がY2受容体を強く発現し、機能的であった。胚細胞腫瘍では腫瘍細胞のY1およびY2発現が33%、腫瘍内血管のY1発現が50%に認められた。正常精巣はNPY標的治療の生理学的・薬理学的な標的として重要である。
pmid-21295110.summary_en: This study examined neuropeptide Y (NPY) receptor expression in 25 normal human testes and 24 testicular tumors using autoradiography. In normal testis, Leydig cells strongly expressed functional Y2 receptors, while small arteries expressed Y1. Germ cell tumors expressed Y1 and Y2 on tumor cells in 33% of cases and Y1 on intratumoral vessels in 50%. The authors suggest the normal testis is a potentially important physiological and pharmacological target for NPY-directed therapies.

pmid-21328457.summary_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞に二重レポーター遺伝子を導入し、生物発光イメージングにより移植後の奇形腫形成を追跡した研究です。奇形腫の血管は宿主と分化したhES細胞の双方に由来していました。SSEA-4陽性細胞は多分化能を示し、生体内で三胚葉への分化能を保持していました。細胞治療の障壁としての奇形腫形成を扱っています。
pmid-21328457.summary_en: The authors stably transduced human embryonic stem cells with a dual firefly luciferase and GFP reporter and tracked teratoma formation after engraftment using bioluminescence imaging. Histology confirmed teratomas whose vasculature derived from both differentiated hES cells and the host. Teratoma cells expressed CD56 and SSEA-4, and SSEA-4-positive cells showed multipotency and retained differentiation into three germ layers in vivo. The study focuses on teratoma formation as a barrier to hES cell therapy rather than on clinical tumor disease.

pmid-21339043.summary_ja: 化学発がん物質で形質転換したマウス骨髄由来細胞から、多能性を持つがん開始細胞(bmPCI細胞)を作製した研究。胎児性癌様の性質を示し、体細胞系列の腫瘍細胞へ分化し、in vivoで奇形癌を形成した。成体細胞における胚性遺残の現象を再現するin vitroモデルとして提示された。
pmid-21339043.summary_en: Researchers showed that chemical carcinogen-transformed mouse bone marrow-derived cells can give rise to pluripotent cancer-initiating cells, named bmPCI cells. These cells resemble embryonal carcinoma and embryonic stem cells, differentiate into multiple somatic tumor lineages, form oocyte-like cells, and cause teratocarcinomas in vivo. The authors propose this as an in vitro model of the embryonal rest phenomenon in adult cells.

pmid-21344133.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株P19の細胞凝集におけるCCN2/CTGFの役割を検討した研究。外因性CCN2は細胞塊の数を減らしサイズを増大させ、増殖や生存には影響しなかった。siRNAによるCCN2のサイレンシングは凝集を阻害し、外因性CCN2で部分的に回復した。CCN2が胚性細胞の凝集に重要な分子であると結論づけている。
pmid-21344133.summary_en: Connective tissue growth factor (CCN2/CTGF) was examined for its role in cell aggregation of P19 cells, an embryonal carcinoma line used as a model for differentiation and migration. Adding exogenous CCN2 at 0.1 to 20 nM reduced the number of clusters and enlarged them without affecting proliferation or survival. Silencing CCN2 with siRNA inhibited aggregation, and this could be partly rescued by exogenous CCN2. The authors conclude CCN2 is a key molecule for aggregation of embryonic P19 cells.

pmid-21391829.summary_ja: 1歳未満または体重10kg未満の乳幼児21例に対する腹腔鏡下または腹腔鏡補助下骨盤手術の後方視的報告です。適応は停留精巣、ヒルシュスプルング病、鎖肛、性分化疾患、仙尾部奇形腫1例、卵巣腫瘤などで、全例が開腹移行なく完遂されました。胚細胞腫瘍は多数の適応の一部にすぎません。
pmid-21391829.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 21 infants under 1 year or under 10 kg who underwent laparoscopic or laparoscopic-assisted pelvic surgery. Indications included undescended testes, Hirschsprung disease, anorectal malformation, disorders of sexual differentiation, one sacrococcygeal teratoma, and ovarian masses. All procedures were completed without conversion, and no major complications occurred. Germ cell tumor is only one minor component of the series.

pmid-21421564.summary_ja: DNAメチル化解析により、ヒト6p25のFAM50Bを新規インプリンティング候補遺伝子座として同定した研究。大部分の組織で父由来アレルから発現し、卵巣では両アレル発現を示した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍で発現異常があり、セミノーマではインプリンティングの消失が高頻度に見られることから、腫瘍形成への関与が示唆されている。
pmid-21421564.summary_en: This study identifies FAM50B at human 6p25 as a candidate imprinted locus using DNA methylation analysis of a differentially methylated region. FAM50B is paternally expressed in most tissues except ovary, where expression is biallelic. Evolutionary analysis suggests it arose by retrotransposition in Therian mammals. The authors note FAM50B is deregulated in testicular germ cell tumors and that loss of imprinting occurs frequently in seminomas, suggesting a role in tumorigenesis.

pmid-21432780.summary_ja: 原始胚細胞(PGC)が脱分化して多能性を獲得する機構を総説的にまとめた論文です。PI3K/Akt経路の過剰活性化が精巣奇形腫を誘導することが示されています。GCTの発生機序に関連しますが、主題は胚細胞の多能性と脱分化であり、腫瘍そのものの臨床研究ではありません。
pmid-21432780.summary_en: This review discusses how primordial germ cells (PGCs), which normally differentiate into sperm or oocytes, can dedifferentiate into pluripotent embryonic germ cells in vitro and give rise to testicular teratomas in vivo. The authors show that appropriate PI3K/Akt signaling maintains the male germ lineage by inhibiting dedifferentiation through p53 suppression, while hyperactivation leads to testicular teratomas. They also describe how Akt activation during ESC mesodermal differentiation generates PGC-like pluripotent cells that revert to an ESC-like state, and compare these mechanisms with testicular stem cell dedifferentiation and somatic reprogramming.

pmid-21440429.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞を用い、フォルスコリンによる分化誘導がシチメンチョウ卵の漿尿膜(CAM)上での腫瘍形成に与える影響を検討した。分化誘導細胞は未処理細胞より腫瘍形成率が高かった。主題は栄養膜細胞の生物学と浸潤アッセイであり、患者の妊娠性絨毛疾患の研究ではない。
pmid-21440429.summary_en: This study used BeWo cells, a choriocarcinoma-derived line commonly employed as a trophoblast model, to test how forskolin-induced differentiation affects tumor formation on the chorioallantoic membrane of turkey eggs. Forskolin-differentiated cells, especially when applied directly, produced macroscopic tumors in more eggs (70%) than untreated cells (40%). The authors suggest that BeWo cells integrate environmental signals to choose differentiation pathways similar to primary trophoblast. The work concerns cell biology and invasion assays rather than gestational trophoblastic disease in patients.

pmid-21442239.summary_ja: 小脳腫瘍として混合型胚細胞腫瘍(ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）、絨毛癌、成熟奇形腫成分)と血管芽腫が併存した22歳男性の症例。初回切除標本は確定診断に至らず、後の再検でジャーミノーマと判明した。精巣由来の胚細胞腫瘍からの転移が成因として推定されている。
pmid-21442239.summary_en: The authors report a 22-year-old man with a cerebellar tumor containing both a mixed germ cell tumor (germinoma, choriocarcinoma and mature teratomatous component) and a hemangioblastoma. The initial resection was classified as an undetermined neoplasm, and germinoma was identified retrospectively. A later cerebellar hemorrhage required emergency re-resection. The authors propose that the mixed GCT was a metastasis from a testicular GCT with burnout of the primary site, and that a non-germinomatous intracranial GCT at an unusual site should prompt consideration of extracranial metastasis.

pmid-21530431.summary_ja: 本総説は、出生前診断と胎児治療が新生児外科の管理と予後にどのような影響を与えたかを概観したものです。先天性肺奇形、仙尾部奇形腫、脊髄髄膜瘤、巨大胎児頸部腫瘤、横隔膜ヘルニア、先天性心疾患などが取り上げられています。仙尾部奇形腫は複数の疾患の一つとして扱われており、中心的な主題ではありません。
pmid-21530431.summary_en: This review examines how prenatal diagnosis and fetal therapy have changed the management and outcomes of neonatal surgical conditions. It covers congenital lung malformations, sacrococcygeal teratoma, myelomeningocele, giant fetal neck masses, diaphragmatic hernia, and congenital heart defects. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is one of several conditions reviewed rather than the central focus. Overall, the authors describe the integration of obstetric, fetal medicine, and neonatal surgical expertise in perinatal care.

pmid-21533838.summary_ja: 非胚腫性悪性胚細胞腫瘍の患者3例の報告です。エトポシド・白金製剤による化学療法と放射線療法などを受け、いずれも腫瘍の再発はありませんでした。しかし8〜10年後に膠芽腫、髄膜腫、海綿状血管腫といった治療関連二次性腫瘍が生じました。膠芽腫の1例は発見から1年後に死亡しています。
pmid-21533838.summary_en: This report describes three patients with non-germinomatous malignant germ cell tumors who received etoposide and platinum-based chemotherapy, radiotherapy, neoadjuvant therapy, complete excision, and maintenance chemotherapy. All remained free of recurrence, but roughly 8 to 10 years later they developed therapy-associated secondary tumors: glioblastoma, meningioma, or cavernous angioma. The patient with glioblastoma died one year after its detection. The authors note that such secondary tumors are rare.

pmid-21593487.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株NTERA2を用いた画像ベースのスクリーニング研究です。ROCKやPRK2を阻害する化合物が生存を改善し、GF109203xとロッテリンが分化を誘導しました。ロッテリンはヒトES細胞でも自己複製を抑制しました。臨床的な腫瘍学の観点はありません。
pmid-21593487.summary_en: The authors developed an image-based high-content screen using the human embryonal carcinoma line NTERA2 to find compounds that affect survival or differentiation. Pilot screening of 80 kinase inhibitors identified ROCK and PRK2 inhibitors that improved survival, and GF109203x and rottlerin that induced differentiation. Rottlerin also reduced self-renewal and altered pluripotency gene expression in human ES cells. The study uses embryonal carcinoma cells primarily as a surrogate for embryonic stem cells, with no clinical tumor focus.

pmid-21620559.summary_ja: 1人の術者が施行した付属器腫瘍に対する単孔式腹腔鏡手術(LESS)94例の後方視的検討。90例(95.7%)でLESSが完遂された。病理診断では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が30例含まれていた。重大な術中・術後合併症は認められず、従来の腹腔鏡手術に代わる安全で実行可能な選択肢と結論づけている。
pmid-21620559.summary_en: This retrospective study reports one surgeon's first 94 laparoendoscopic single-site surgeries (LESS) for adnexal tumors. Ninety patients (95.7%) completed LESS, with two converted to laparotomy for suspected malignancy. Pathology included mature cystic teratoma in 30 cases, alongside endometriosis, cystadenomas and a serous adenocarcinoma. No major complications occurred. The authors conclude LESS is a safe and feasible alternative to conventional laparoscopy for adnexal tumors.

pmid-21707703.summary_ja: 未熟および異形成のセルトリ細胞の新規マーカーとしてインヒビン小体を提案した。インヒビンαとGrp78による免疫組織化学を胎児期から成人期の正常精巣と病変で行った。上皮内癌やセミノーマ細胞を含む精細管でも認められ、停留精巣や精巣腫瘍、不妊症の評価に有用とされる。
pmid-21707703.summary_en: This study proposes inhibin bodies as a marker for immature and dysgenetic Sertoli cells, using immunohistochemistry for inhibin-alpha and Grp78 across normal human testes from fetal life to adulthood and abnormal testicular lesions. Inhibin bodies were seen in tubules lacking germ cells, containing only spermatogonia, or containing carcinoma in situ and seminoma cells, but not in tubules with more advanced germ cells. The marker is intended to aid identification of Sertoli cells in cryptorchidism, testicular tumours and infertility. The authors suggest inhibin bodies reflect slower inhibin transit through the endoplasmic reticulum, given their association with Grp78.

pmid-21715192.summary_ja: 思春期・若年成人の良性卵巣嚢腫282例を後方視的に検討し、腹腔鏡手術の適応と成績を評価した。子宮内膜症性嚢胞、類皮嚢腫、単純性嚢胞などが多く、悪性は1.4%と少なかった。術中診断と病理診断の一致は高かった。類皮嚢腫は奇形腫の一型だが、本研究では多数の嚢腫分類の一つとして扱われている。
pmid-21715192.summary_en: This retrospective chart review of 282 females aged 25 or younger evaluated laparoscopic management of presumed benign ovarian cysts. Endometriomas, dermoid cysts, paraovarian cysts and simple cysts were most common, and malignancy was rare (1.4%). Cystectomy was the most frequent procedure, and intraoperative diagnosis correlated highly with pathology. Dermoid cysts, which are mature teratomas, form one category among several rather than the main focus.

pmid-21731714.summary_ja: 血清を含まない化学的に定義された培地で3継代培養したマウスES細胞は、6か月まで奇形腫を形成しなかった。一方、血清培養細胞は5週間で奇形腫を形成した。多能性は保たれ、血清添加で奇形腫形成が回復した。Gsk3β阻害は無血清条件下でも増殖と奇形腫形成を回復させ、Eras・c-Mycの上昇を伴わなかった。腫瘍様増殖の制御は多能性とは別の機構によると示唆される。
pmid-21731714.summary_en: Mouse embryonic stem cells cultured for three passages in a chemically defined serum-free medium failed to form teratomas for up to six months, whereas serum-cultured cells formed them within five weeks. Pluripotency was preserved, and adding serum restored teratoma formation. Gsk3β inhibition under serum-free conditions restored proliferation and teratoma formation without upregulating Eras and c-Myc. This suggests Gsk3β controls tumor-like growth by a mechanism separate from pluripotency.

pmid-21747415.summary_ja: 出生後マウス精巣由来の生殖系列幹細胞を対象に、自己複製の制御を検討した。H-RasとCyclin D2の導入により、サイトカインなしで精原幹細胞様の自己複製能が再現された。一方でセミノーマ様腫瘍が生じ、過剰な自己複製シグナルが原因と考察されている。主題は幹細胞研究だが、胚細胞腫瘍の発生機序にも言及する。
pmid-21747415.summary_en: Mouse germline stem cells derived from postnatal testes were studied for regulation of self-renewal and epigenetic status. Transfection of H-Ras and cyclin D2 reconstructed spermatogonial stem cell-like self-renewal without exogenous cytokines, and these cells showed stem cell activity in transplantation assays. However, seminomatous tumors also developed, which the authors attribute to excessive self-renewal signaling. The paper links these findings to mechanisms of germ cell tumor development, though its main focus is stem cell self-renewal and imprinting rather than tumor treatment or clinical course.

pmid-21771862.summary_ja: 非栄養膜細胞におけるシンシチン1・2のエピジェネティックな抑制を検討した研究。HeLa細胞ではH3K9のトリメチル化が転写抑制と関連し、スプライシングは栄養膜細胞でのみ効率的に生じた。精巣セミノーマの生検でERVWE1の転写・スプライシングの異常が見られ、病原性の可能性が示唆された。胚細胞腫瘍の解析は基礎研究の一部として扱われている。
pmid-21771862.summary_en: This study examines epigenetic suppression of syncytin-1 and syncytin-2 in non-trophoblastic cells. In HeLa cells, H3K9 trimethylation was associated with transcriptional silencing, and efficient splicing occurred only in trophoblastic cells. The authors detected deregulated transcription and splicing of ERVWE1 in testicular seminoma biopsies, suggesting pathogenic potential. Ectopic expression experiments indicated that proper chromatin context is important for ERVWE1 splicing. Germ cell tumor analysis is a secondary component of this endogenous retrovirus study.

pmid-21777437.summary_ja: 本研究は、低コストな卓上型MRI（ベンチトップMRI）の前臨床腫瘍モデルへの適用可能性を検討した方法論的研究である。ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍および大腸癌のヌードマウス異種移植モデルを撮像し、腫瘍の増殖を経時的に追跡した。造影剤Gd-BOPTAにより腫瘍内部の壊死・線維化領域も描出でき、MRIによる腫瘍体積の推移はキャリパー計測とよく相関した。画質は腫瘍の進展と構造の評価に十分と結論づけられた。
pmid-21777437.summary_en: This methodological study evaluates a benchtop (low-field) MRI prototype for preclinical imaging. Nude mouse xenografts of human testicular germ cell tumor and colon carcinoma were visualized, and their growth was tracked over time. Subcutaneous tumors appeared as hypointense areas, and growth measured by MRI correlated with caliper measurements. Gd-BOPTA contrast revealed internal necrotic or fibrotic regions. The authors conclude that benchtop MRI provides adequate image quality to monitor tumor progression and structure in mice, offering a low-cost alternative to superconducting scanners.

pmid-21784733.summary_ja: 本研究は、絨毛癌由来のJeg3細胞株（侵襲性絨毛外栄養膜細胞のモデル）において、糖鎖修飾型と非糖鎖修飾型CCN3が細胞増殖、遊走、浸潤に与える影響を検討した。CCN3は糖鎖修飾の有無にかかわらず細胞数を減少させた一方、遊走・浸潤能を高めたのは非糖鎖修飾型のみで、MMP-2とMMP-9の活性も上昇した。両型のバランス異常が早発型妊娠高血圧腎症における浸潤の浅さに関与する可能性が示唆された。絨毛癌そのものより、栄養膜細胞の生物学が主題である。
pmid-21784733.summary_en: This study investigated how glycosylated and non-glycosylated forms of CCN3 affect growth, migration, and invasion of the choriocarcinoma-derived Jeg3 cell line, which serves as a model of invasive extravillous trophoblast. CCN3 reduced cell numbers regardless of glycosylation, while only the non-glycosylated form enhanced migration and invasion, along with MMP-2 and MMP-9 activity. The authors propose that an imbalance between these forms could contribute to shallow trophoblast invasion in early-onset pre-eclampsia. The paper focuses on trophoblast biology rather than choriocarcinoma itself.

pmid-21848013.summary_ja: 9か月の男児における3q部分重複と、コルネリア・デ・ランゲ症候群様の特徴を示した症例報告である。通常の染色体分析で由来不明の21番染色体誘導体を認め、サブテロメアFISHで3q部分重複と診断した。タイトルには仙尾部奇形腫の合併が示されているが、要旨では腫瘍の経過や治療には触れていない。
pmid-21848013.summary_en: This case report describes a 9-month-old boy with partial duplication of 3q and features resembling Cornelia de Lange syndrome. Conventional cytogenetic analysis identified a derivative chromosome 21, and subtelomeric FISH was used to clarify its origin, leading to a diagnosis of partial 3q duplication. The title indicates that the child also had a sacrococcygeal teratoma, but the abstract does not describe that tumor's management or course. The report mainly addresses genetic diagnosis in a child with a dysmorphic phenotype.

pmid-21934480.summary_ja: 正常男性生殖路上皮およびそこ由来の上皮性腫瘍におけるPAX8・PAX2の免疫組織化学的発現を検討。精巣網から射精管まで発現し、男性生殖路の一部の癌や付属器腫瘍で陽性となった。一方、胚細胞腫瘍は49例中48例で陰性で、小児卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例のみ弱い限局的染色を示した。鑑別診断用の免疫組織化学パネルへの組み込みを提案している。
pmid-21934480.summary_en: This study examined PAX8 and PAX2 immunohistochemistry in normal male genital tract epithelium and epithelial tumors derived from it. Both markers were expressed from the rete testis to the ejaculatory duct and in a few male genital tract carcinomas and adnexal tumors. They were absent in Leydig and Sertoli cell tumors and in 48 of 49 germ cell tumors, where one pediatric yolk sac tumor showed weak focal staining. Mesothelial tumors were negative. The authors suggest including these markers in differential diagnostic panels for male genital tract tumors.

pmid-21956364.summary_ja: 本稿は、良性・悪性・境界悪性の卵巣腫瘍におけるFDG-PET/CTとMRIの所見をまとめたレビューである。子宮内膜症性嚢胞、線維腫、奇形腫は淡いから中等度の集積を示すことが多く、悪性腫瘍は強い集積を示すが、充実成分が少ないものは集積が乏しい場合がある。読影にはFDG-PET/CTの多様な所見への習熟が重要であると強調している。奇形腫は卵巣腫瘍の一分類として扱われ、主題ではない。
pmid-21956364.summary_en: This pictorial review describes FDG-PET/CT and MRI findings across benign, malignant, and borderline ovarian tumors. Benign lesions such as endometriomas, fibromas, and teratomas generally show faint to moderate FDG uptake, while malignant tumors usually show intense uptake, although those with a small solid component may show minimal uptake. The authors emphasize familiarity with the range of FDG-PET/CT appearances to aid interpretation. The review covers imaging of ovarian tumors broadly, with teratomas discussed as one of several categories rather than as the main focus.

pmid-21987218.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(mEC)細胞とマウス胚性幹(mES)細胞において、レチノイン酸による分化の前後でRARαおよびRARγタンパク質の局在を免疫組織化学的に検討した。核内に陽性反応が認められ、一部の抗体では細胞質にも反応があった。細胞ごとに蛍光強度と分布が異なり、タンパク質発現は集団内で同期せず動的であることが示唆された。腫瘍病態や臨床上の胚細胞腫瘍は扱われていない。
pmid-21987218.summary_en: The authors immunolocalized RARα and RARγ proteins in pluripotent mouse embryonal carcinoma (mEC) and mouse embryonic stem (mES) cells, before and after retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Using three RARα antibodies and one RARγ antibody, they observed nuclear staining in all cell types, with cytoplasmic signal for two RARα antibodies. Immunofluorescence intensity and distribution varied between individual cells, indicating that RAR protein levels are not synchronous across the population and are dynamic. The study does not address tumor pathology or clinical germ cell tumor disease.

pmid-21991700.summary_ja: カトマンズの三次医療機関で2006〜2008年に手術された卵巣嚢腫102例の後方視的研究。最多は漿液性嚢胞腺腫（40.2%）で、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は15.7%だった。悪性は12.7%、卵巣転移は6.9%で、多くは消化管由来の腺癌だった。胚細胞腫瘍に特化した解析ではなく、卵巣嚢腫病理の概観である。
pmid-21991700.summary_en: This retrospective study of 102 ovarian cyst cases operated at a tertiary hospital in Kathmandu from 2006 to 2008 reports that ovarian cysts accounted for 2.0% of histopathological specimens. Most cysts were benign (87.3%), and serous cystadenoma was most common (40.2%), followed by mature cystic teratoma (15.7%). Malignant cysts comprised 12.7%, and ovarian metastasis occurred in 6.9% of cases, most often from gastrointestinal adenocarcinoma. The study is a descriptive overview of ovarian cyst pathology rather than a focused germ cell tumor analysis.

pmid-22066111.summary_ja: 単一施設での15例の後方視的研究で、直腸後方腔腫瘍の手術アプローチと転帰を検討しています。成熟奇形腫は神経鞘腫と並ぶ主要な組織型であり、腹腔鏡手術は回復が早い傾向がありました。胚細胞腫瘍は多様な腫瘍の一部にすぎず、関連性は部分的です。
pmid-22066111.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review of 15 adults with retrorectal tumors describes operative approaches and outcomes. Mature teratoma was among the most common histologies, alongside neurilemmoma, and laparoscopic transabdominal resection was associated with faster recovery. Because germ cell tumors are only one component of a mixed retrorectal tumor series, relevance to germ cell tumor management is partial. Most lesions were benign.

pmid-22075335.summary_ja: 1970年から2009年にセントジュード小児病院で治療された膣腫瘍の小児18例を後方視的に検討しました。組織型は横紋筋肉腫が13例、胚細胞腫瘍が3例、明細胞腺癌が2例でした。胚細胞腫瘍の3例中2例は病勢進行で死亡しており、胚細胞腫瘍は少数ながら予後に注意が必要です。
pmid-22075335.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review at St. Jude analyzed 18 children with vaginal tumors treated from 1970 to 2009. Histologies were rhabdomyosarcoma (13), germ cell tumor (3), and clear cell adenocarcinoma (2). Bleeding was the most common presentation. Most patients remain disease-free, though two germ cell tumor patients died of progression. Germ cell tumors form a small subset, so relevance is partial.

pmid-22162926.summary_ja: 9年間に直腸後方腫瘍の切除を受けた62例の後方視的レビューである。大半は仙骨経由の手術で、22.6%が悪性だった。類皮嚢腫や奇形腫が主要な構成要素の一つで、悪性例には悪性奇形腫3例が含まれた。合併症は14.5%に生じた。まれな直腸後方腫瘍の治療には、骨盤解剖の深い知識と骨盤手術の専門性が必要である。
pmid-22162926.summary_en: A retrospective review of 62 patients who underwent resection of retrorectal tumors over nine years. Most surgeries were transsacral, and 22.6% were malignant. Teratomas and dermoid cysts formed a notable subset, including three malignant teratomas among the malignant cases. Complications occurred in 14.5%. The authors stress that rare retrorectal tumors demand detailed pelvic anatomy knowledge and pelvic surgical expertise.

pmid-22175902.summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器および副腎腫瘍におけるCAIXの免疫組織化学的発現を検討した研究。淡明細胞型腎細胞癌で高発現し、コア生検での鋭敏なマーカーとなる。胚細胞腫瘍関連では、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌は大部分が陰性で、胎児性癌と奇形腫は反応性にばらつきがあった。他腫瘍にもCAIX陽性例があり、組織量が限られる場合は誤診に注意が必要である。
pmid-22175902.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined carbonic anhydrase IX (CAIX) expression across genitourinary and adrenal tumours. CAIX was highly expressed in clear cell renal cell carcinoma and core biopsies, serving as a sensitive marker. Among germ cell-related tumours, seminoma, yolk sac tumour and choriocarcinoma were predominantly negative, while embryonal carcinoma and teratoma showed variable reactivity. Urothelial, squamous, clear cell adenocarcinoma and adrenal cortical carcinoma also expressed CAIX, so overlap with clear cell RCC may lead to misinterpretation when tissue is limited.

pmid-22195379.summary_ja: ナイジェリアの教育病院で31年間に診察された新生児固形腫瘍17例を後方視的に検討した研究。良性16例のうち奇形腫は2例のみであった。悪性は横紋筋肉腫1例だった。好発部位は頭頸部で、多くは出生後2週間以内に受診した。奇形腫は全体のごく一部にすぎず、胚細胞腫瘍を主題とした研究ではない。
pmid-22195379.summary_en: This retrospective review of 17 solid tumours in neonates under 28 days old at a Nigerian teaching hospital over 31 years found 16 benign and one malignant tumour. Benign types included vascular tumours, granular cell tumours, teratomas (two cases) and myxofibroma; the malignant case was rhabdomyosarcoma. The head and neck was the commonest site, and most cases presented within two weeks of birth. Teratomas form only a small minority of this series.

pmid-22269405.summary_ja: 東インドの三次病院で2001〜2010年に診断された卵巣腫瘍957例を解析した研究。良性腫瘍では漿液性嚢胞腺腫に次いで成熟奇形腫が多く、悪性腫瘍では漿液性嚢胞腺癌が最多であった。病期が進むほど全生存率は低下し、病期Iの85%から病期IVの15.5%であった。悪性腫瘍は比較的若年で診断される傾向が示された。
pmid-22269405.summary_en: This 10-year study of 957 ovarian neoplasms at a tertiary hospital in eastern India examined histologic patterns, bilaterality, and age distribution. Serous cystadenoma was the most common benign tumor, followed by mature teratoma, which was the second most frequent benign lesion. Among malignant tumors, serous cystadenocarcinoma predominated, and most presented at stage III or II. Overall survival declined with advancing stage, from 85% in stage I to 15.5% in stage IV. Malignant tumors presented at an earlier age.

pmid-22470767.summary_ja: 放置された症例で術前にMDCTとMRIにより診断した胎児内胎児（fetus-in-fetu）の報告。特徴的な画像所見により奇形腫との鑑別が可能であったと述べ、組織コントラストと被曝回避からMRIの有用性を強調している。奇形腫は主に鑑別対象として扱われる。
pmid-22470767.summary_en: This report describes a fetus-in-fetu, a rare anomaly in which a fetus-like structure is enclosed within its twin, diagnosed preoperatively in a neglected case. The authors show that characteristic MDCT and MRI findings distinguish fetus-in-fetu from teratoma, and they argue MRI is the preferred modality because of its tissue contrast and avoidance of radiation. Teratoma appears mainly as a key differential diagnosis.

pmid-23264998.summary_ja: 多能性幹細胞の正常発生と、その生物学的特性を概説した総説である。悪性の胎児性癌(embryonal teratocarcinoma)幹細胞株の研究も含まれ、長期培養による染色体・遺伝子・エピジェネティック変化が腫瘍化につながりうると述べる。著者らは奇形腫性腫瘍細胞の研究を通じて、悪性細胞の標的を探索している。
pmid-23264998.summary_en: This review covers normal development of pluripotent stem cells derived from embryos and adult tissues, and their shared biological properties. It notes that malignant embryonal teratocarcinoma stem cell lines have restricted developmental potential due to genetic disturbances. The authors report that long-term culture of pluripotent lines causes chromosomal, genetic and epigenetic changes that may promote oncogenic transformation. Their research examines signaling pathways and gene expression in pluripotent and teratocarcinoma cells to identify targets for eliminating malignant cells.

pmid-18835791.summary_ja: 21週の胎児に左側胸水が認められ、妊娠を中絶した。剖検により心膜内奇形腫と確定診断された。乳幼児および小児の原発性心臓腫瘍は極めてまれであり、心膜内奇形腫はさらにまれである。本報告では文献を概観し、診断と治療の選択肢について検討している。出生前の発見が重要な点として強調されている。
pmid-18835791.summary_en: This report describes a 21-week fetus with a left-sided pleural effusion, in whom the pregnancy was terminated and autopsy confirmed an intrapericardial teratoma. The authors note that primary cardiac tumors in infants and children are rare, and intrapericardial teratomas are rarer still. They review the literature on intrapericardial teratomas and discuss diagnostic approaches and management options. The paper highlights prenatal detection as a key clinical consideration.

pmid-19097812.summary_ja: 1982年から2007年に精巣がんでRPLNDを受けた208例を後方視的に解析した。原発性と化学療法後のRPLNDで合併症率に有意差はなかった。化学療法後は手術時間、出血量、輸血が多かった。重篤な合併症は少なく、死亡は1例のみであった。専門の泌尿器腫瘍医による手術では両者とも安全性が高いと結論づけている。
pmid-19097812.summary_en: This retrospective study compared complications of primary and post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in 208 patients with testicular cancer treated between 1982 and 2007. Intraoperative, postoperative, and late complication rates were similar between approaches, though post-chemotherapy RPLND had longer operative times, more blood loss, and more transfusions. Major complications were rare, with one fatal pulmonary embolism. The authors conclude that both procedures have low morbidity and negligible mortality when performed by experienced urologic oncologists.

pmid-19110454.summary_ja: IGCCCG予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍30例に対し、M-TIP療法を初回治療として評価した。奏効率は76.6%で、病理学的完全奏効は15例、成熟奇形腫を含む。5年無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は66.6%、5年生存率は70%であった。骨髄毒性を除き毒性は概ね軽度で、G-CSFにより血液毒性は軽減された。BEP療法との比較が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-19110454.summary_en: This single-arm trial evaluated M-TIP (methotrexate, paclitaxel, ifosfamide, cisplatin) as first-line therapy in 30 patients with poor-risk germ cell tumors per IGCCCG criteria. The favorable response rate was 76.6%, with 15 patients achieving pathologic complete response, including four with mature teratoma. The 5-year progression-free survival was 66.6% and overall survival 70%. Toxicity was mostly mild apart from myelotoxicity, which G-CSF mitigated. The authors conclude M-TIP is effective and well tolerated and merits comparison with BEP in randomized trials.

pmid-19162511.summary_ja: 国際精巣がん連鎖コンソーシアムの解析で、2例以上の罹患者を含む461家系の精巣胚細胞腫瘍985例を検討した。大部分の家系は2例のみであった。セミノーマ患者は非セミノーマ患者より診断時の年齢が高かった。停留精巣の既往がある患者では同側の精巣に発生しやすかった。いとこ関係の組は発症年齢が若く、停留精巣の割合が高かった。
pmid-19162511.summary_en: This descriptive analysis from the International Testicular Cancer Linkage Consortium reviewed 985 testicular germ cell tumor cases from 461 families with at least two affected members. Most families had only two cases. Seminoma patients were diagnosed at an older age than nonseminoma patients. In men with cryptorchidism, tumors tended to arise in the ipsilateral testis. Cousin pairs formed a distinct subgroup with younger onset and higher cryptorchidism prevalence.

pmid-19226408.summary_ja: ヒト精巣セミノーマ由来細胞株JKT-1の30代・61代継代における胚性幹細胞マーカー発現を解析した研究です。NANOGやOCT3/4、AP2γ、HIWIなどは発現していましたが、OCT3/4とAP2γのタンパク質は弱く、胎児性癌のマーカーSOX2を発現し、c-KITは陰性でした。後期継代ではNANOGとHIWIが低下し、培養下での形質変化が示唆されました。
pmid-19226408.summary_en: This study characterizes JKT-1, a cell line derived from a human testicular seminoma, after 30 and 61 culture passages. Using RT-PCR, Western blot, and immunofluorescence, the authors found expression of pluripotency markers NANOG and OCT3/4 and seminoma-associated markers AP2gamma and HIWI, but weak OCT3/4 and AP2gamma protein levels, SOX2 expression typical of embryonal carcinoma, and no c-KIT. NANOG and HIWI protein declined at later passages, suggesting in vitro drift. The authors recommend validating this signature before functional studies.

pmid-19282291.summary_ja: 高齢女性の卵管に生じた成熟充実性奇形腫の症例報告です。CTで見つかった腫瘤は、子宮内膜腺癌の生検診断から転移と考えられていました。子宮全摘術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術を施行したところ、右卵巣にも小さな成熟充実性奇形腫が見つかりました。卵管の腫瘍は極めてまれで、イタリアでは初めての症例とされています。
pmid-19282291.summary_en: This report describes a mature solid teratoma of the fallopian tube in an elderly woman. The mass seen on CT was initially considered metastatic because of a prior biopsy diagnosis of endometrial adenocarcinoma. Hysterectomy, bilateral salpingectomy, and oophorectomy were performed, and a second, smaller mature solid teratoma was found in the right ovary. The authors note this is the first Italian case among roughly 60 reported in the literature, and that the case combines a minimal teratomatous diameter with the greatest recorded patient age.

pmid-19362785.summary_ja: 前向きに管理されている2つの腫瘍データベースを後方視的に検討し、停留精巣の既往がある病期Iの精巣セミノーマ男性23名を調べた。18名は補助放射線療法を受け、5名は経過観察となった。中央値64か月の追跡で、経過観察群の1名に再発がみられた。放射線療法群の1名に生じた対側精巣腫瘍は、再発より異時性の原発と判断された。5年再発非発生率は経過観察群80%、放射線療法群100%であった。著者らは、停留精巣が放射線療法を基本とした管理下で再発リスクを高めるようには見えないと結論づけている。
pmid-19362785.summary_en: This retrospective review of two prospectively maintained databases examined 23 men with stage I testicular seminoma and a history of cryptorchidism. Eighteen received adjuvant radiotherapy and five underwent surveillance. With a median follow-up of 64 months, relapse occurred in one surveillance patient, and a contralateral testicular tumor in one irradiated patient was judged more likely a metachronous primary. Five-year relapse-free rates were 80% for surveillance and 100% for radiotherapy. The authors conclude that cryptorchidism does not appear to increase relapse risk with radiotherapy-based management.

pmid-19424710.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に悪性転化が生じ、急性腹症として発症した経過を扱った報告です。このような発症形式は極めてまれです。悪性の可能性が高いため、子宮全摘術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術が治療として選ばれます。嚢胞が破裂せず完全切除され、がんが被膜を超えていなければ予後は良好ですが、それ以外では再発が多く化学療法抵抗性のため予後は不良とされています。
pmid-19424710.summary_en: This report describes a postmenopausal woman whose ovarian mature cystic teratoma had undergone malignant transformation and presented as an acute abdomen. The authors note such presentation is extremely rare and that total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy is the preferred treatment because malignancy risk is high. Prognosis is good when the cyst is intact, completely excised, and the cancer has not extended beyond the capsule. Otherwise recurrence is common and the tumor is chemoresistant, so the outlook is poor.

pmid-19425818.summary_ja: 46,XY完全性性腺異形成をもつ異母姉妹2例を報告し、各例の同一性腺に性腺芽腫と浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍が共存していました。1例はディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、もう1例は絨毛癌でした。絨毛癌のSNPアレイ解析では、複数の常染色体の増加とY染色体の消失が認められ、既報の胚細胞腫瘍と一致しました。著者らは、絨毛癌が性腺芽腫に由来する可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-19425818.summary_en: This report describes two half-sisters with 46,XY complete gonadal dysgenesis who each developed a gonadoblastoma with a coexisting invasive germ cell tumor in the same gonad: dysgerminoma in one and choriocarcinoma in the other. SNP array profiling of the choriocarcinoma showed a hyperdiploid pattern with gains on several autosomes, Y chromosome loss, and a homozygous X profile without copy-number change. The authors note these changes match those reported in germ cell tumors and suggest choriocarcinomas may arise from gonadoblastomas.

pmid-19469863.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の最初の症状として皮下腫瘤が出現した男性2例の症例報告です。尿および血清のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)検査で高値が確認されました。皮膚や多臓器への転移を伴い、文献的考察も加えられています。きわめてまれな症例ですが、若年男性の皮下腫瘤の鑑別診断で考慮すべきと述べられています。
pmid-19469863.summary_en: This report describes two men whose first clinical sign of testicular choriocarcinoma was a subcutaneous mass. Urine and serum hCG testing confirmed high hCG levels from the male choriocarcinoma. Although very rare, such presentations can pose diagnostic and therapeutic challenges and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of subcutaneous masses in young men. The paper also includes a literature review of the disease, which had metastasized to skin and multiple organs.

pmid-19488832.summary_ja: 両側病期I精巣セミノーマに対し18年前に両側精巣摘除術を受けた患者が、肝腫瘤として再発した症例を報告する。サーベイランス中は18年間無病で経過した。全身化学療法と残存肝腫瘤に対する肝切除により病変は消失した。セミノーマの晩期再発の頻度と管理について考察している。
pmid-19488832.summary_en: This report describes a patient who developed seminoma recurrence 18 years after bilateral orchidectomy for bilateral stage I testicular seminoma. He had been under surveillance and remained disease-free for 18 years before presenting with a liver mass. Systemic chemotherapy followed by hepatectomy for the residual hepatic mass cleared the disease. The authors discuss the incidence and management of late seminoma recurrence, highlighting the importance of long-term follow-up.

pmid-19529944.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者と健常対照の血清を、SELDI-TOF質量分析で解析した研究である。β-hCG陰性のセミノーマに着目している。機械学習により、患者の90.4%を正しく分類できた。β-hCG値が正常なセミノーマ患者も80%の感度で予測された。フォローアップ用の有用なツールとなる可能性を示している。
pmid-19529944.summary_en: The authors used SELDI-TOF mass spectrometry to profile serum proteins from testicular germ cell cancer patients and healthy controls, with a focus on beta-hCG-negative seminomas. An artificial intelligence learning algorithm classified samples correctly in 90.4 percent of patients. Decision trees predicted seminomas with 91.5 percent sensitivity and 89.4 percent specificity. Seminoma patients with normal beta-hCG levels were predicted with 80 percent sensitivity. The authors conclude that proteomic profiling may become a valuable tool, especially for aftercare.

pmid-19545941.summary_ja: 1980年から2004年に監視方針で管理された病期Iセミノーマ患者164例を、中央値13.5年追跡した単施設の解析である。22例(13%)が再発し、多くは傍大動脈リンパ節であった。疾患特異的死亡率は1.3%であった。サーベイランスは長期的に安全であり、多くの患者は追加治療を回避できると結論している。再発例では、補助療法の場合より治療負担が大きい可能性を指摘している。
pmid-19545941.summary_en: This single-centre audit reviewed 164 patients with stage I testicular seminoma managed with surveillance between 1980 and 2004, followed for a median of 13.5 years. Twenty-two patients (13 percent) relapsed, mostly in para-aortic nodes, and six of 13 patients treated with para-aortic radiotherapy alone relapsed again elsewhere. Disease-specific mortality was 1.3 percent. The authors conclude that surveillance is safe long term and most patients avoid further treatment, though relapsing patients may face a heavier treatment burden than with adjuvant therapy.

pmid-19554342.summary_ja: ソロカ大学医療センターでの21万例超の分娩を対象とした集団研究である。良性卵巣嚢腫を有する妊婦では、類皮嚢腫が36.7%を占め、嚢胞性腺腫に次いで多かった。類皮嚢腫は不妊治療と関連していた。周産期転帰は概ね良好で、超音波検査による定期的なフォローアップを伴う保存的管理が勧められている。
pmid-19554342.summary_en: This population-based study of 212,114 deliveries at Soroka University Medical Center compared pregnancy outcomes in women with and without benign ovarian cysts. Among 93 women with cysts, dermoid cysts accounted for 36.7 percent, the second most common type after cystadenomas. Dermoid cysts were associated with fertility treatments. Perinatal outcomes were favorable, and the authors suggest conservative management with routine ultrasound follow-up.

pmid-19560254.summary_ja: 本前臨床研究は、Mdm2阻害剤nutlin-3を野生型p53(NT2、2102EP)と変異型p53(NCCIT)の胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞株で検討した。野生型株ではシスプラチンとの併用で相加的なアポトーシス誘導が認められ、変異型株では効果がなかった。高リスク非セミノーマ型精巣胚細胞腫瘍で、野生型p53を有する患者に対する薬理学的Mdm2阻害のさらなる開発を支持する結果である。
pmid-19560254.summary_en: This preclinical study tested nutlin-3, an Mdm2 inhibitor, in germ cell tumour-derived embryonal carcinoma cell lines with wild-type or mutant p53, alone and combined with cisplatin. Nutlin-3 was active only in wild-type p53 lines (NT2, 2102EP), where it had additive effects with cisplatin, increased p53 and p21, and induced caspase cleavage and apoptosis. The p53-mutant NCCIT line was unresponsive. The authors conclude that Mdm2 inhibition merits further development for high-risk nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours with wild-type p53.

pmid-19577354.summary_ja: 1982年から2005年にサーベイランスを受けた病期Iセミノーマ527例を対象とした単施設後方視的研究である。5年再発率は14%で、再発の97.3%は胸部X線が正常でCT-APのみで検出された。CXR単独で検出された再発はなかった。定期的な胸部X線検査はサーベイランス・プロトコルから省略可能と結論された。ただし後方視的デザインと再発例の少なさが限界として挙げられている。
pmid-19577354.summary_en: This single-centre retrospective study of 527 patients with stage I testicular seminoma under surveillance (1982-2005) assessed whether routine chest radiography (CXR) adds value to CT of the abdomen and pelvis. The 5-year relapse rate was 14%. Of the relapses, 97.3% were detected on CT-AP with a normal CXR, and only one case showed pulmonary metastasis on both CXR and chest CT. No relapse was detected by CXR alone. The authors conclude that CXR could be omitted from routine surveillance protocols, noting the retrospective design and small number of relapses as limitations.

pmid-19595516.summary_ja: 17歳男性の縦隔腫瘤と心嚢液貯留を呈した症例報告である。当初は生検で異所性膵組織と診断されたが、広範な組織採取により一方向性膵分化を伴う成熟奇形腫と判明した。著者らは、縦隔異所性膵組織と報告された症例の一部は一方向性に分化した奇形腫であり、発生異常ではなく真の腫瘍として扱うべきだと主張している。
pmid-19595516.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old male with a large mediastinal mass and pericardial effusion. Initial core needle biopsy suggested heterotopic pancreatic tissue, and the excised lesion was first considered to be the same. Extensive sampling revealed a mature teratoma with subtotal unidirectional pancreatic differentiation. The authors argue that some cases reported as mediastinal heterotopic pancreas may be unidirectionally differentiated teratomas, which should be treated as true neoplasms rather than developmental abnormalities.

pmid-19616897.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫の内部に生じた砂粒腫型髄膜腫の症例報告である。髄膜上皮細胞と砂粒体がびまん性に豊富に認められ、診断が可能であった。奇形腫内に生じた髄膜腫は、その成分の性質や卵巣外への進展の有無によって予後的意義が異なると指摘されている。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍内のまれな増殖様式を示す症例である。
pmid-19616897.summary_en: This case report describes a benign psammomatous meningioma arising within a mature ovarian teratoma. Meningothelial cells and psammoma bodies were both abundant and diffuse, allowing confident diagnosis. The authors note that recognising meningioma within a teratoma matters prognostically, depending on the nature of the component and whether it extends beyond the ovary. The case illustrates a rare growth pattern within an ovarian germ cell tumour.

pmid-19656574.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療後3～5年の生存者165例を対象に、情動的苦痛と性腺機能低下症、アンドロゲン受容体多型、治療強度との関連を検討した。性腺機能低下症やAR多型は不安・抑うつと関連しなかった。一方、難治性または再発疾患に対し5サイクル以上のシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた患者では不安が強かった。
pmid-19656574.summary_en: This study of 165 testicular germ cell cancer survivors assessed, 3-5 years after treatment, whether emotional distress relates to biochemical hypogonadism, androgen receptor CAG/GGN polymorphisms, or treatment intensity. Anxiety and depression, measured by HADS, were not associated with hypogonadism or AR polymorphisms. However, patients who received five or more cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy for refractory or relapsed disease reported more anxiety. The authors conclude that hypogonadism and AR polymorphism are not risk factors, while intensive chemotherapy may increase anxiety.

pmid-19660796.summary_ja: 34歳男性が慢性の背部・下肢痛の精査でCTを受け、右腎に偶発的な8cmの造影される腫瘤を指摘された。腹腔鏡下根治的腎摘除術でセミノーマと診断され、その後の陰嚢超音波検査と右精巣摘除術で精巣原発のセミノーマが確認され、腎病変は転移と判明した。セミノーマの腎転移のまれな発生と、腎腫瘤の鑑別診断における胚細胞腫瘍の重要性を論じている。
pmid-19660796.summary_en: A 34-year-old man was evaluated by CT for back and leg pain and found to have an incidental 8-cm enhancing renal mass. Laparoscopic radical nephrectomy showed seminoma. Scrotal ultrasound and right orchiectomy then confirmed a testicular primary seminoma, establishing the renal lesion as a metastasis. The authors discuss the uncommon occurrence of renal metastasis in seminoma and the importance of considering germ cell tumor in the differential diagnosis of renal masses.

pmid-19669696.summary_ja: 若年患者が、8.5cmに及ぶ精索の大型類皮嚢腫によって嵌頓ヘルニアに類似した整復不能の鼠径部腫瘤を呈した。嚢腫摘出後に直接型ヘルニアが判明し、メッシュで修復された。嚢腫による慢性的圧迫が原因と考えられた。精索類皮嚢腫はきわめて稀だが、長期経過の鼠径部腫瘤の鑑別診断に含めるべきとされる。
pmid-19669696.summary_en: A young patient presented with an irreducible inguinal mass due to a large 8.5 cm dermoid cyst of the spermatic cord, mimicking an incarcerated hernia. Surgical excision of the cyst revealed a concealed direct inguinal hernia, which was repaired with a Lichtenstein polypropylene mesh. The authors attribute the hernia to chronic pressure from the cyst on the inguinal floor. They conclude that spermatic cord dermoid cysts, though very rare, belong in the differential diagnosis of long-standing inguinal masses.

pmid-19680688.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する傍大動脈放射線療法後のフォローアップを、11編・2,280例の文献から系統的に解析した。再発の中央値は15.5ヶ月で、3年以降の再発は10%未満だった。高ボリュームの画像検査は低ボリュームのものより早期発見や病期の軽減につながらず、技術的検査は最初の3年間に限定すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-19680688.summary_en: A systematic review of 11 publications covering 2,280 patients treated with paraaortic radiotherapy for stage I seminoma assessed the timing and detection of relapse. Median time to recurrence was 15.5 months, and fewer than 10% of recurrences appeared after three years. Routine technical investigations detected about 44% of relapses with a reported detection method, and high-volume imaging protocols did not detect relapse earlier or at a lower stage than low-volume protocols. The authors suggest restricting imaging surveillance to the first three years.

pmid-19688218.summary_ja: 妊娠14週の41歳女性で右卵巣腫瘍が摘出され、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌と判明した。健康な児を分娩し、産後9週で完全な外科的切除を行い、病期pT1a pN0と診断された。追加治療なしで37ヶ月後も無病生存している。この稀な病態には完全切除が安全な治療と考えられると結論づけている。
pmid-19688218.summary_en: A 41-year-old pregnant woman had a right ovarian tumour removed at 14 weeks' gestation, which proved to be squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. She delivered a healthy infant at term. Nine weeks postpartum she underwent complete surgical resection, staged pT1a pN0, and received no further treatment. She remained disease-free 37 months later. The authors conclude that complete surgical resection appears to be a safe approach for this rare entity, given the lack of standard management.

pmid-19708949.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の残存腫瘤切除を受けた51例を、単施設で後方視的に解析した。残存病変は線維化49%、成熟奇形腫35%、生存胚細胞16%だった。IGCCCG予後不良群は無イベント生存が不良で、原発性精巣腫瘍は性腺外腫瘍より良好だった。大半の患者で残存腫瘤切除により長期生存が期待できると結論づけている。
pmid-19708949.summary_en: This single-centre analysis of 51 patients who underwent surgery for residual masses after chemotherapy for advanced non-seminomatous germ cell tumours examined prognostic factors. Residual histology showed fibrosis in 49%, mature teratoma in 35%, and viable germ cells in 16%. Poor IGCCCG prognosis predicted worse event-free survival, while primary testicular tumours fared better than extragonadal ones. The authors conclude that residual mass resection yields favourable long-term survival in most patients.

pmid-19734064.summary_ja: 病理学的に確定した良性付属器病変68例について、多列検出器CT（MDCT）の画像所見を検討した研究です。対象には成熟嚢胞性奇形腫6例が含まれます。各病変の特徴的なCT所見を示し、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を含む良性付属器病変の良性診断にMDCTが有用であると結論づけています。
pmid-19734064.summary_en: This CT study reviewed 68 histologically confirmed benign adnexal lesions, including nonneoplastic cysts, endometriomas, cystadenomas, fibromas, and mature cystic teratomas (n=6). Using portal-phase multidetector CT, the authors described the characteristic imaging features of each lesion type. They conclude that MDCT accurately characterizes mature cystic teratomas and other benign adnexal lesions, providing useful information about benign nature before surgery.

pmid-19747353.summary_ja: 2001年から2008年に単一施設で後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた精巣がん患者190例を対象に、初回手術と化学療法後の手術を比較しました。初回手術群では手術時間、出血量、入院期間が有意に少なく、周術期合併症は9%で死亡例はありませんでした。開腹後腹膜リンパ節郭清の短期的な合併症は許容範囲であり、腹腔鏡手術との比較の基準になると結論づけています。
pmid-19747353.summary_en: This study reviewed 190 patients who underwent open retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for testicular cancer at one institution between 2001 and 2008, comparing primary RPLND with RPLND after chemotherapy. Operative duration, blood loss, and hospital stay were significantly lower in the primary group. Perioperative complications occurred in 9% of patients, with no deaths. The authors conclude that open RPLND has acceptable short-term morbidity and is safe at tertiary centres, providing a benchmark for laparoscopic comparison.

pmid-19775876.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマに対する管理法を、精巣摘除後の経過観察（サーベイランス）と補助療法で比較したシステマティックレビューです。ガイドライン、無作為化比較試験、非無作為化研究など54報を解析しました。治療法にかかわらず5年生存率は95%を超えていました。毒性を抑えつつ高い治癒率を保てるため、経過観察が望ましいと結論づけています。
pmid-19775876.summary_en: This systematic review assessed management options for stage I seminoma, including surveillance and adjuvant therapy after orchidectomy. Fifty-four reports were included, covering guidelines, randomised trials, and non-randomised studies. Five-year survival exceeded 95% regardless of strategy, including surveillance alone. The authors conclude that surveillance is preferable because it minimises treatment toxicity while preserving high cure rates, although the optimal approach remains to be defined.

pmid-19776291.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例234例と対照218例で、ホルモン関連11遺伝子の17か所の多型を解析した研究です。HSD17B4のrs11205多型が発症リスクと有意に関連し、マイナーアレルのホモ接合体ではオッズ比4.56でした。セミノーマと非セミノーマの両方でリスクの上昇が認められました。ホルモン代謝遺伝子の多型が精巣発がんに関与する可能性を示しています。
pmid-19776291.summary_en: This case-control study genotyped 17 polymorphisms in 11 hormone-related genes in 234 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 218 controls. A variant (rs11205) in HSD17B4 was significantly associated with risk, with an odds ratio of 2.27 per minor allele copy and 4.56 for homozygotes. Risk was elevated for both seminoma and nonseminoma. The findings support a role for hormone metabolism genetics in testicular carcinogenesis.

pmid-19780863.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常ヒト精巣および精巣胚細胞腫瘍における内皮性リパーゼ(EL)とリポタンパク質リパーゼ(LPL)の発現を解析した。両酵素は精細管と間質細胞に発現し、ELは上皮内癌および腫瘍細胞で豊富であった。LPLタンパクは上皮内癌では欠如し腫瘍ではわずかだったが、非セミノーマではOCT3/4に類似した分布を示した。ELは精巣のコレステロール供給に関与し、上皮内癌を伴う精細管の脂質やEL発現は診断に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-19780863.summary_en: This study examined the expression of endothelial lipase (EL) and lipoprotein lipase (LPL) in normal human testis and testicular germ cell tumours. Both lipases were detected in seminiferous tubules and interstitial cells, and EL was abundant in carcinoma in situ and tumour cells. LPL protein was largely absent from CIS cells and scarce in tumours, though it was present in non-seminomas, resembling OCT3/4 distribution in embryonal carcinoma. The authors propose that EL supports testicular nutrient and cholesterol supply for steroidogenesis, and that EL and lipid abundance in CIS tubules may have diagnostic value.

pmid-19833537.summary_ja: 5歳女児のプロテウス症候群症例で、骨盤内嚢胞性腫瘤が超音波検査で発見された。腹腔鏡手術により片側卵巣類皮嚢腫と同側傍卵管嚢胞と判明した。本症候群に伴う卵巣嚢胞は小児女児では稀であり、外科的介入の必要性を検討すべきと著者らは述べている。小児の骨盤内腫瘤の評価において重要な症例報告である。
pmid-19833537.summary_en: This case report describes a 5-year-old girl with Proteus syndrome who developed a pelvic cystic mass. Ultrasound detected the lesion, and laparoscopic surgery revealed a unilateral ovarian dermoid cyst with an ipsilateral paratubal cyst. The authors note that ovarian cysts are rare in girls with Proteus syndrome and that such underlying lesions may warrant surgical intervention. The report highlights the importance of considering ovarian cysts in patients with this mosaic overgrowth disorder when evaluating pelvic masses in childhood.

pmid-19836053.summary_ja: 混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者が化学療法後に後腹膜、縦隔、肺へ転移し、40か月後に縦隔の血管肉腫を発症した。マイクロダイセクション併用のLOH解析とFISHにより、原発腫瘍、転移奇形腫、血管肉腫のクローン関係を検討した。全てで一致したアレル欠失と12p染色体異常が認められ、血管肉腫は胚細胞腫瘍由来と考えられた。
pmid-19836053.summary_en: This report describes a patient with a mixed testicular germ cell tumour who developed retroperitoneal, mediastinal, and pulmonary metastases after chemotherapy. Forty months after diagnosis, a mediastinal angiosarcoma was found. Using microdissection-based loss of heterozygosity analysis and fluorescence in situ hybridization, the authors compared primary tumour components, metastatic teratoma, and angiosarcoma. Identical allelic loss patterns and consistent 12p abnormalities, including isochromosome 12p, supported a common clonal origin. The findings suggest the angiosarcoma arose from the testicular germ cell tumour rather than solely from treatment-related injury.

pmid-19836147.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と絨毛癌において、VEGF、HIF-1α、TGFβ1、TGFβ3の発現を免疫組織化学で比較した研究。絨毛癌ではVEGFとHIF-1αが高発現し、TGFβ3は全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌で高かった。絨毛癌でのこれらの高発現が、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発症や組織発生に関与する可能性を示した。
pmid-19836147.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compared VEGF, HIF-1alpha, TGFbeta1, and TGFbeta3 expression across partial and complete hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas, and nonhydropic spontaneous abortions as controls. VEGF and HIF-1alpha were highest in choriocarcinoma, while TGFbeta3 was highest in complete moles and choriocarcinoma. TGFbeta1 was highest in controls. The authors concluded that elevated VEGF, HIF-1alpha, and TGFbeta3 in choriocarcinoma may contribute to trophoblastic disease development and offer insight into its histogenesis.

pmid-19836934.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんの治療選択肢を評価したシステマティックレビューとメタ解析。32件の報告を解析し、全治療法で治癒率は良好だった。ガイドラインは初回の積極的監視を推奨し、直ちに治療を希望する患者には補助化学療法を提示している。
pmid-19836934.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis assessed management options for clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular cancer, including chemotherapy, surgery, and active surveillance. Thirty-two reports were included. Cure rates were excellent across all approaches, with overall and disease-free survival above 95%. Recurrence was more frequent with surveillance. Guideline recommendations favored primary surveillance, with adjuvant chemotherapy for patients who prefer immediate treatment or are unsuitable for surveillance. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy may suit high-risk patients, but evidence from prospective trials remains insufficient.

pmid-19852568.summary_ja: 閉経前女性121例、127個の卵巣類皮嚢腫(3〜12cm)に対し、エンドバッグを用いた腹腔鏡下摘出術を行った症例集積。内容物の漏出は12%で、腹膜炎の徴候はなかった。腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術は安全かつ有効で、開腹術の有用な代替法であると結論づけた。
pmid-19852568.summary_en: This large case series reports laparoscopic removal of 127 ovarian dermoid cysts, measuring 3 to 12 cm, in 121 premenopausal women using an endobag. Endobag rupture occurred in 2.5% of cases and total spillage in 12%, without signs of peritonitis. Recurrence and pregnancy outcomes were also evaluated. The authors concluded that laparoscopic cystectomy for ovarian dermoid cysts is safe and effective in premenopausal women and is a valuable alternative to laparotomy, provided thorough peritoneal washout is performed.

pmid-19876845.summary_ja: 精巣の発生過程および精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変であるCIS細胞におけるSOX2発現を検討した。in situハイブリダイゼーションと免疫組織化学により、多くのCIS細胞でSOX2 mRNAを初めて検出した。核内の斑状免疫反応は抗体によって異なり、SUMO化などの翻訳後修飾がSOX2の作用を制限している可能性が示唆された。
pmid-19876845.summary_en: This study examined SOX2 expression in human testicular germ cell tumor precursors and normal testes across developmental stages. Using in situ hybridization and immunohistochemistry with three antibodies, the authors detected SOX2 mRNA in most carcinoma in situ (CIS) cells, which had not been shown previously. Speckled nuclear immunoreactivity appeared with only one antibody, suggesting possible post-transcriptional regulation, potentially via sumoylation, that limits SOX2 action in these cells. SOX2, a pluripotency regulator also expressed in embryonal carcinoma, may thus contribute to testicular germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-19878051.summary_ja: 韓国の三次医療機関で、悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の思春期前および思春期の患者45例を後方視的に検討した。妊孕性温存手術と補助化学療法（ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン）を受けた患者は、再発や死亡を認めなかった。大多数で正常な初経・月経が得られ、卵巣機能は概ね保たれた。
pmid-19878051.summary_en: This retrospective review of 45 girls and young women treated for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors at a South Korean tertiary hospital evaluated fertility-preserving surgery combined with adjuvant chemotherapy. Nine patients were premenarchal and sixteen were adolescents. Seventeen received adjuvant bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. No recurrences or deaths occurred. Eight of nine premenarchal patients (88.9%) achieved normal menarche, and 15 of 16 adolescents (93.8%) resumed normal menstruation, with one developing premature ovarian failure. The authors conclude that survival is excellent and ovarian function is largely preserved.

pmid-19889611.summary_ja: 化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが上昇した原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍35例の外科的切除成績を後方視的に検討した。病理学的には生存腫瘍24例、奇形腫8例、壊死のみ3例であった。マーカーが上昇していても、熟練した胸部外科医による切除で良好な長期予後が得られうると結論づけている。
pmid-19889611.summary_en: Indiana University retrospectively reviewed 158 patients with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with platinum chemotherapy and complete surgical resection. Thirty-five patients had rising serum tumor markers at resection, mostly alpha-fetoprotein. Pathology showed viable tumor in 24, teratoma in 8, and necrosis only in 3. Twenty-seven normalized their markers postoperatively. Of the 35, 21 died, 5 were lost to follow-up, and 9 remained alive, seven of them continuously disease-free with median follow-up of 64 months. The authors conclude that rising markers do not preclude successful surgical salvage, particularly when performed by experienced thoracic surgeons.

pmid-19898969.summary_ja: 妊娠初期の超音波検査で偶然見つかった卵巣嚢胞の症例報告である。嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した濾胞亜型乳頭状甲状腺癌と診断され、HRAS遺伝子コドン61変異を認めた。卵巣甲状腺腫由来の悪性腫瘍でRAS変異を検出した初の報告であり、甲状腺原発癌と類似のMAPK経路異常が関与することを示唆している。
pmid-19898969.summary_en: The authors report a 38-year-old woman in whom an incidentally discovered ovarian cyst, found on first-trimester ultrasound, was ultimately diagnosed as a follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in a cystic teratoma. Molecular testing for BRAF, RAS and RET/PTC identified an HRAS codon 61 mutation. This is the first report of a RAS mutation in a follicular variant papillary carcinoma arising in struma ovarii. The findings suggest that tumors arising in struma ovarii share MAPK pathway mechanisms with thyroid-derived differentiated carcinomas.

pmid-19900756.summary_ja: 絨毛癌と正常栄養膜細胞のマイクロRNA(miRNA)プロファイルを比較し、絨毛癌ではmiR-199bが低発現であることを見いだした。miR-199bはSETの標的遺伝子であり、その発現低下によりSETタンパク質が増加することを示した。絨毛癌の急速な増殖にこの制御異常が関与する可能性が示唆される。
pmid-19900756.summary_en: This study compared microRNA profiles of choriocarcinoma with non-cancerous trophoblasts and found that miR-199b was underexpressed in choriocarcinoma. SET, a protein phosphatase 2A inhibitor, was identified as a miR-199b target by computational prediction and microarray analysis, and luciferase assays confirmed direct regulation via its 3'-UTR. Ectopic miR-199b expression reduced SET protein levels. Analysis of paraffin-embedded choriocarcinoma, hydatidiform mole and normal trophoblast tissues confirmed low miR-199b and high SET expression in choriocarcinoma, suggesting that SET dysregulation may contribute to its rapid growth.

pmid-19906660.summary_ja: 精巣または性腺外原発の胚細胞腫瘍男性139例を後方視的に検討した。病期Iでは無増悪生存率が高い一方、病期IIIのセミノーマは予後が不良であった。初回無病状態から2年以降の晩期再発は5例(3.6%)に生じ、サルベージ治療で全例が寛解した。二次性血液腫瘍が3例に発生し、全例がこれで死亡した。5年を超える定期的フォローアップと二次性悪性腫瘍への注意が推奨される。
pmid-19906660.summary_en: This single-center retrospective study followed 139 men treated for testicular or extragonadal germ cell tumors between 1980 and 2005 for long-term outcomes. Five-year progression-free survival was high in early-stage disease for both seminoma and non-seminoma, and lower in stage III seminoma. Five patients (3.6%) had late recurrence beyond two years, all of whom achieved remission with salvage therapy. Three (2.2%) developed second primary hematological neoplasms and died of them. The authors recommend follow-up beyond five years and vigilance for second malignancies.

pmid-19910023.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の5例を後方視的に検討し、リンパ節転移の様式とEGFR、VEGFなどの発現を解析した。文献286例の集計では、リンパ節転移は5.9%に認められ、傍大動脈リンパ節と後腹膜リンパ節が最も多かった。腫瘍細胞はEGFRとVEGFが強陽性、HER2/neuとCD117は陰性であった。EGFRとVEGFは標的候補となる可能性がある。
pmid-19910023.summary_en: This retrospective study of five PSTT cases examined lymphatic spread and immunohistochemical expression of EGFR, VEGF, HER2/neu, and CD117. Tumor cells strongly expressed EGFR and VEGF but were negative for HER2/neu and CD117. Combined with a literature review of 286 cases, lymph node metastasis occurred in 5.9%, most commonly in para-aortic and retroperitoneal nodes. One postmenopausal patient had a 33-year interval from pregnancy and four relapses. The authors conclude that EGFR and VEGF may be useful target markers in PSTT.

pmid-19912297.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫の後に対側精巣のセミノーマ、さらに乳頭状甲状腺癌を発症した2名の男性の症例報告である。両者とも癌の家族歴はなかった。偶然の発生も否定できないが、遺伝的素因や環境要因が関与している可能性が示唆された。異時性に生じた胚細胞腫瘍と甲状腺癌の組み合わせは報告がない。
pmid-19912297.summary_en: Two unrelated men each developed a testicular teratoma, followed by a contralateral testicular seminoma, and later papillary thyroid carcinoma. Neither had a family history of cancer. The authors note that random occurrence is possible, but genetic predisposition or environmental influences might explain this previously unreported combination of tumors. The report describes metachronous germ cell tumors and a thyroid malignancy in the same individuals.

pmid-19916013.summary_ja: 未矯正の両側停留精巣の一方に生じた3歳児の胎児性癌の症例である。卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌成分を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。停留精巣は悪性転化のリスクが高いが、通常は20〜40歳代にセミノーマとして生じることが多い。小児例としては非典型的な経過を示す。
pmid-19916013.summary_en: A 3-year-old child presented with embryonal carcinoma arising in an uncorrected bilateral cryptorchid testis. The tumor was a mixed germ cell tumor with yolk sac and embryonal carcinoma components. The report highlights that undescended testes carry increased risk of malignant transformation, although such tumors typically occur in the second to fourth decades and are usually seminomas. The case illustrates an atypical presentation of pediatric germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-19931126.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性混合型胚細胞腫瘍が、両側後腹膜リンパ節郭清で陰性だった8か月後に陰茎海綿体へ転移した症例報告。化学療法により完全奏効を得た。陰茎転移は報告例が200例未満とまれで、泌尿生殖器領域では進行前立腺がんが主な原因とされる。本症例は、手術時に陰性でも晩期に転移が生じうることを示している。
pmid-19931126.summary_en: A case report describes a nonseminomatous mixed germ cell tumor of the testis that metastasized to the corpus cavernosum of the penis eight months after a negative bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The patient received chemotherapy and achieved a complete response. Penile metastasis is rare, and advanced prostate cancer is the more common cause of genitourinary metastasis to the penis. The case shows that late metastasis can occur despite negative surgical staging.

pmid-19931248.summary_ja: 2006〜2008年にドイツで行われた精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療方針に関するセカンドオピニオン制度の642例を解析した研究。紹介医の計画と推奨が異なった割合は32.3%で、非セミノーマや進行期で多かった。不一致例の40.3%で過剰治療を、26.5%で治療不足を回避できた。
pmid-19931248.summary_en: A German nationwide second-opinion system for testicular germ cell tumor therapy planning was analyzed across 642 requests from 2006 to 2008. The treatment planned by the referring urologist differed from the recommendation in 32.3% of cases, more often for nonseminomas and with advancing stage. Discrepant recommendations prevented overtreatment in 40.3% and undertreatment in 26.5%. The authors conclude that published guidelines are applied only sporadically and benefit from supporting second-opinion systems.

pmid-19931379.summary_ja: 9年間に組織学的に確認された小児卵巣奇形腫41例を後方視的に検討し、成熟型と未熟型の画像所見を比較した研究。成熟奇形腫は主に嚢胞性で、未熟奇形腫は充実性と嚢胞性の混在や純粋な充実性を示すことが多かった。嚢胞成分の優位性は両型で有意差があった。
pmid-19931379.summary_en: A retrospective review of 41 children with histologically proven ovarian teratoma over nine years compared imaging features of mature and immature types. Mature teratomas made up 73.2% of cases and were predominantly cystic on ultrasonography, whereas immature teratomas more often appeared mixed solid and cystic or purely solid. Cystic predominance differed significantly between the two types, while size, fat and calcification did not. The authors conclude that cystic and solid patterns help distinguish mature from the more aggressive immature teratoma.

pmid-19937408.summary_ja: 標準化学療法後に再発した精巣未熟奇形腫の38歳男性が、左大腿の無痛性軟部組織腫瘤で受診した症例報告。腫瘤切除後、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常範囲に戻った。精巣未熟奇形腫の軟部組織転移は本報告で2例目であり、軟部肉腫との鑑別診断に精巣がんからの転移を加えるべきと指摘している。
pmid-19937408.summary_en: A case report describes a 38-year-old man with recurrent testicular immature teratoma who presented with a painless soft tissue mass in the left thigh after standard chemotherapy. After resection, serum alpha-fetoprotein returned to the normal range. The authors note this is only the second reported case of testicular immature teratoma metastasizing to soft tissue. They recommend that testicular cancer metastasis be included in the differential diagnosis of soft tissue masses alongside primary sarcoma.

pmid-19942267.summary_ja: 精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍（非セミノーマ）に対し左精巣摘除術を受けた16歳男児が、10日後に自然発症の腹腔内出血で救急搬送されました。開腹術で後腹膜リンパ節転移の破裂が判明し、大部分を切除しました。病理学的に95%以上が絨毛癌でした。標準化学療法で良好に反応し、診断から2年半経過した現在も寛解を維持しています。
pmid-19942267.summary_en: A 16-year-old boy developed spontaneous hemoperitoneum with 3 L of effusion 10 days after left orchiectomy for a testicular mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Laparotomy revealed a ruptured retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis, of which more than 90% was resected along with 3 cm of adherent jejunum. Pathology showed over 95% choriocarcinoma. The patient received standard chemotherapy with a good response and remains in remission 2.5 years after diagnosis. The report highlights a rare presentation, as such bleeding typically occurs at the start of chemotherapy and usually involves hepatic or gastrointestinal metastases.

pmid-19943053.summary_ja: 過去8年間にクアラルンプール病院小児外科で治療された新生児腫瘍28例を後方視的に検討しました。大半は仙尾部奇形腫で、新生児腫瘍は施設の腫瘍症例の7%を占めました。手術切除が主な治療でした。罹患率は29%、死亡率は7%でした。早期発見と専門施設への集約が重要であると結論づけています。
pmid-19943053.summary_en: Neonatal tumours treated at Kuala Lumpur Hospital over eight years were retrospectively reviewed. Of 28 cases, constituting 7% of the unit's tumours, most were sacrococcygeal teratoma. Surgical excision was the mainstay of treatment. Morbidity and mortality were 29% and 7%, respectively. The authors conclude that outcomes in Malaysia are influenced by local healthcare factors and recommend earlier detection and centralisation of expertise for neonatal tumours. Because sacrococcygeal teratoma forms the majority of this cohort, the paper is relevant to germ cell tumors, although it covers neonatal tumours broadly.

pmid-19956886.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍24例と対応する正常精巣組織で、DNA修復タンパクERCC1とXPFの発現をイムノブロットで比較した研究です。腫瘍ではERCC1が有意に増加し、非セミノーマではERCC1とXPFの両方が増加していました。非セミノーマはセミノーマより高発現で、両者の発現は相関していました。腫瘍進展に伴う発現上昇が示唆され、抗がん剤感受性への関与が考えられます。
pmid-19956886.summary_en: This study compared nucleotide excision repair proteins ERCC1 and XPF between 24 testicular germ cell tumors and matched normal testis. ERCC1 was increased in tumors overall, and XPF was elevated specifically in non-seminomas, which are more aggressive than seminomas. Both proteins were higher in non-seminomas than in seminomas and correlated with each other. The authors suggest that up-regulation of ERCC1 and XPF accompanies tumor progression. These repair proteins may influence cellular sensitivity to DNA-damaging anticancer drugs.

pmid-19956903.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞（融合性）とJEG-3細胞（非融合性）を用い、mTORおよびその下流因子の発現を検討した研究です。両細胞株でmTOR、4EBP、S6KのmRNAが発現していました。フォルスコリンによる合胞体化の誘導では、初期にmTORと4EBPの発現が低下し、完全に合胞体化した段階では基礎レベルに戻りました。BeWo細胞は合胞体化とmTORシグナルの研究モデルとして有用と結論されています。
pmid-19956903.summary_en: This study examined mTOR and downstream components 4EBP and S6K in two human choriocarcinoma cell lines, fusigenic BeWo and non-fusigenic JEG-3. All these genes were expressed at the mRNA level in both lines. Forskolin-induced syncytialisation in BeWo cells transiently reduced mTOR and 4EBP expression during early stages, with levels returning to baseline after full syncytialisation. p70S6K phosphorylation was unchanged. The authors propose BeWo cells as a valid model for studying mTOR signalling during syncytialisation, relevant to understanding placental growth regulation.

pmid-19961281.summary_ja: 1996年から2007年にタイの2施設で治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍130例の記述的研究です。最も多い組織型はディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）で、多くが早期病変でした。治療は多くが温存手術と化学療法で、評価可能な症例の大半で完全奏効が得られました。5年無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は82.4%、全生存期間(全生存率)は92.4%でした。術前の腫瘍マーカー高値が無増悪生存期間の唯一の予後不良因子でした。
pmid-19961281.summary_en: This descriptive study from two Thai institutions reviews 130 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated between 1996 and 2007. Dysgerminoma was the most common histology, and most patients had early-stage disease treated with conservative surgery. Most received chemotherapy, and 85 of 89 evaluable patients achieved complete response. Five-year progression-free survival was 82.4 percent and overall survival 92.4 percent. Elevated preoperative tumor markers were the only significant poor prognostic factor for progression-free survival. The authors conclude that prognosis is good with conservative surgery and chemotherapy.

pmid-19963242.summary_ja: 米国とオランダの精巣胚細胞腫瘍（非セミノーマ）の男性116例を対象とした前向き研究で、治療に伴う健康関連QOLを評価しました。化学療法を受けた患者では、治療直後に身体の痛み、疲労感、身体機能の低下が多く報告されました。12か月後には両群の差はなくなり、ベースラインより改善していました。化学療法によるQOLの低下は一時的であることが示されました。
pmid-19963242.summary_en: This prospective study of 116 men from the United States and the Netherlands assessed health-related quality of life after orchiectomy for newly diagnosed non-seminoma germ cell tumors of the testis. Patients were assessed at baseline, after adjuvant chemotherapy or surveillance, and at 12 months using the SF-36. Chemotherapy was linked to more bodily pain, fatigue, and poorer physical functioning immediately after treatment. By 12 months, quality-of-life scores were similar between groups and higher than baseline, suggesting the chemotherapy effect on quality of life is temporary.

pmid-19963410.summary_ja: 9か月の女児に生じた膣の卵黄嚢腫瘍が子宮留水症を引き起こした症例報告です。マルチディテクタ列コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、膣の造影される腫瘤と上流の子宮頸部・子宮腔の拡張が確認されました。治療は化学療法のみで行われました。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は診断と治療反応の評価に有用でした。
pmid-19963410.summary_en: This case report describes a 9-month-old girl with a vaginal endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor causing hydrometra. Multidetector-row computed tomography showed an enhancing vaginal mass obstructing the outflow tract, with upstream dilatation of the cervix and uterus. Histopathology confirmed a yolk sac tumor. The child was treated exclusively with chemotherapy. Serum alpha-fetoprotein levels helped establish the diagnosis and monitor response to treatment. The authors highlight the value of CT for characterizing this rare pediatric presentation and AFP for assessing response.

pmid-19968964.summary_ja: 本研究は、絨毛癌細胞株JARおよびBeWoがトリコサンチン(TCS)を効率よく結合・取り込みすることを示した。LRP1の発現を抑制するとTCSの結合が阻害され、LRP1が主要な受容体であることが示唆された。これが抗絨毛癌活性の分子基盤と考えられる。
pmid-19968964.summary_en: This study shows that two choriocarcinoma cell lines, JAR and BeWo, efficiently bind and internalize trichosanthin (TCS), a type-I ribosome-inactivating protein, whereas HeLa cells do not. Silencing LRP1 blocked TCS binding in JAR and BeWo cells, and TCS was shown to interact with LRP1. The authors conclude that LRP1 is a major receptor for TCS uptake and may underlie its abortifacient and anti-choriocarcinoma activity.

pmid-19969490.summary_ja: 口蓋裂を伴う新生児の鼻咽頭奇形腫2例を報告する。1例は蝶形骨基部、もう1例は鼻中隔から発生していた。いずれも経口的に完全切除され、病理組織学的検査で真の奇形腫の成分が確認された。フォローアップ期間中に再発は認められなかった。
pmid-19969490.summary_en: This report describes two newborns with nasopharyngeal teratomas accompanied by cleft palate. One tumor arose from the base of the sphenoid bone with a cleft soft palate, and the other arose from the nasal septum with an incomplete cleft palate. Both were completely resected intraorally, and microscopy confirmed typical components of true teratoma. Cleft palate reconstruction was performed before one year of age, and no recurrence was observed during follow-up.

pmid-19969558.summary_ja: 本免疫組織化学研究は、胎児精巣、精巣上皮内癌（CIS）、胚細胞腫瘍におけるGATA-4、GATA-6、FOG-2およびその下流標的を検討した。GATA-4は初期胎児ゴノサイト、CIS、セミノーマで発現していたが、より成熟した胚細胞では発現していなかった。セミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍はGATA-4/6陽性であり、胎児性癌と絨毛癌は陰性であった。これらの所見は、GATA-4の細胞特異的な機能と、CIS細胞の初期胎児起源を支持する。
pmid-19969558.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined GATA-4, GATA-6, FOG-2, and downstream targets in fetal testes, testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS), and germ cell tumors. GATA-4 was expressed in early fetal gonocytes, CIS, and seminoma but absent in more mature germ cells. Seminomas and yolk sac tumors were GATA-4/6 positive, whereas embryonal carcinomas and choriocarcinomas were negative. The findings suggest cell-specific GATA-4 functions and support an early fetal origin of CIS cells.

pmid-20002396.summary_ja: 1991年から2007年に小児病院で卵巣嚢腫の手術を受けた155例を後方視的に検討した研究である。良性奇形腫が最も多く、卵黄嚢腫瘍やディスジャーミノーマを含む悪性例は10例であった。腫瘍マーカーの測定や画像検査は限られており、多くの女児が良性疾患にも関わらず卵巣摘除術を受けていた。著者らは、術前の画像検査と腫瘍マーカーの使用、ならびに卵巣温存手術の推進を提言している。
pmid-20002396.summary_en: This retrospective study of 155 children and adolescents operated on for ovarian cysts at a children's hospital from 1991 to 2007 found that benign teratomas were most common, with ten malignant cases including a yolk sac tumor and a dysgerminoma. Tumor markers were rarely measured and imaging use was limited. Most girls underwent oophorectomy, even for benign disease. The authors recommend preoperative imaging, tumor markers, and ovary-sparing surgery.

pmid-20013345.summary_ja: 本研究は、成人男性の原発性肝絨毛癌5例の臨床病理学的特徴を報告したものです。全例で血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が上昇し、肝腫瘍の平均径は11cmでした。2例は外科的切除を受けましたが、3例は肝外転移のため化学療法のみを受けました。全例が2〜8か月以内に死亡し、剖検で肺や腹膜などへの転移が確認されました。精巣腫瘍の所見は認められませんでした。
pmid-20013345.summary_en: This clinicopathological study describes five adult male patients with primary hepatic choriocarcinoma, a rare and highly aggressive entity. Patients presented with right upper abdominal pain or distension and large liver masses averaging 11 cm, with elevated serum hCG in all cases. Two patients underwent surgical resection with tumor confined to the liver; three with extrahepatic metastases received chemotherapy only. All patients died within 2 to 8 months. Autopsy showed metastases to lung, peritoneum, adrenal glands, and brain, and no testicular primary was found. Immunohistochemistry showed keratin and hCG positivity with high Ki-67 indices.

pmid-20013844.summary_ja: 本論文は、甲状腺組織を主体とする稀な卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍である卵巣甲状腺腫の2症例を提示したものです。通常は単純切除で治癒するため婦人科医が伝統的に治療を担ってきましたが、耳鼻咽喉科・頭頸部外科医も重要な役割を果たしうることを論じています。多職種連携による患者ケアに焦点を当てた短い臨床的論考です。
pmid-20013844.summary_en: This article presents two cases of struma ovarii, a rare ovarian germ cell tumor composed predominantly of thyroid tissue, and discusses the role of otolaryngologist-head and neck surgeons in its management. Although the tumor is typically cured by simple excision and is traditionally managed by gynecologic surgeons, the authors argue that otolaryngologists may contribute critically to patient care. The paper is a brief clinical commentary emphasizing multidisciplinary involvement in patient care.

pmid-20015764.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、悪性奇形腫と癌肉腫の成分を併せ持つ稀で侵襲性の高い副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫の52歳男性例を報告しています。左副鼻腔に発生し、初回手術後18、23、28か月に頸部転移を再発しました。積極的な頸部手術と術後放射線療法を行いましたが、初回手術から43か月後に肺転移で死亡しました。早期の選択的頸部郭清の重要性が提言されています。
pmid-20015764.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old man with sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma, a rare and aggressive neoplasm combining malignant teratoma and carcinosarcoma. The tumor arose in the left sinonasal cavity and recurred as cervical metastasis at 18, 23, and 28 months despite aggressive neck surgery and postoperative radiotherapy. The patient died of lung metastasis 43 months after the initial surgery. The authors note this patient was younger than previously reported and had good locoregional control. They recommend early elective neck dissection and close attention to peri-nodal soft tissue to reduce the risk of distant metastasis.

pmid-20017138.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣摘除標本130例における精巣胚細胞腫瘍のC2GnT-1発現を免疫組織化学で検討したものです。C2GnT-1陽性率は病期Iより進行病期で有意に高値でした。病期Iのセミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のいずれにおいても、陽性例は再発リスクが高いことが示されました。さらに、C2GnT-1を導入した細胞株は浸潤能が高まり、マウスでの腫瘍増大と転移を促進しました。
pmid-20017138.summary_en: This study examined core 2 N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase-1 (C2GnT-1) expression in orchiectomy specimens from 130 testicular germ cell tumor patients. C2GnT-1 positivity was significantly more frequent in advanced stages than in stage I, and in stage I seminoma and nonseminoma, C2GnT-1-positive patients had higher recurrence risk. In a C2GnT-1-negative TGCT cell line, forced expression increased invasiveness and enhanced tumor growth and metastasis in nude mice, including retroperitoneal extension and lung colonization. The authors suggest C2GnT-1 may be a biomarker of aggressive behavior.

pmid-20018385.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、耳下腺に生じた類皮嚢腫の小児例としては初の報告例を提示したものです。類皮嚢腫は胚発生時の閉鎖線に沿った上皮細胞の迷入により生じ、頭頸部嚢腫の約7%を占めます。耳下腺発生は稀で、英語文献では過去に6例の報告しかありませんでした。小児の耳下腺病変として稀な発症例を記録しています。
pmid-20018385.summary_en: This case report describes the first pediatric patient with a dermoid cyst of the parotid gland, a rare location for these lesions. Dermoid cysts result from inclusion of epithelial cells along lines of embryonic closure and account for about 7% of head and neck cysts, most often arising in the floor of the mouth. The authors note only six prior parotid dermoid cases in the English literature. The report documents a rare pediatric presentation.

pmid-20019089.summary_ja: 本研究は、1980年以降に診断された精巣がん生存者5,533例を対象とした、スウェーデンの全国登録に基づく研究です。370例(6.7%)で二次がんが発生し、セミノーマ後により多く認められました。二次精巣がんの標準化発生比はセミノーマ後29、非セミノーマ後13と高値でした。消化管がんはセミノーマ後に、膀胱がんは非セミノーマ後に増加しました。
pmid-20019089.summary_en: This Swedish nationwide registry study examined second cancers among 5,533 testicular cancer survivors diagnosed after 1980, with follow-up through 2006. A total of 370 second cancers occurred (6.7%), more often after seminoma than nonseminoma. Second testicular cancer risk was markedly elevated, with standardized incidence ratios of 29 after seminoma and 13 after nonseminoma. Gastrointestinal cancers were mainly increased after seminoma, while bladder cancer was elevated after nonseminoma, especially in patients diagnosed before age 30.

pmid-20026807.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1999年から2007年の間に北米の2施設で併用化学療法を受けた播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の276例を検討した。画像上の完全寛解を得た161例では、中央値52か月の追跡で疾患特異的生存率は100%であった。再発は稀で、多くは奇形腫に対する外科的治療で対応され、2例は救援化学療法を要した。著者らは、血清学的完全寛解と最小限の残存病変を有する患者は、補助的な領域手術なしに安全に経過観察できると結論づけている。
pmid-20026807.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 276 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with combination chemotherapy at two North American centers between 1999 and 2007. Among 161 patients achieving radiographic complete remission, disease-specific survival was 100% at a median follow-up of 52 months. Relapses were uncommon, and most were treated surgically for teratoma alone, while two required salvage chemotherapy. The authors conclude that patients with complete serologic remission and minimal residual disease can be safely observed without adjunctive regional surgery.

pmid-20026808.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、Indiana大学でNSGCTに対して一次化学療法後に完全寛解を得て、化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行わず経過観察された141例を解析した。中央値15.5年の追跡で12例(9%)が再発し、推定15年の無再発生存率は90%、癌特異的生存率は97%であった。良好リスク群の無再発生存率は95%、中等度または不良リスク群は73%であった。晩期再発は治療後13年までみられた。著者らは、再発が稀で治癒可能であるため、経過観察は安全な戦略であると結論づけている。
pmid-20026808.summary_en: This retrospective Indiana University analysis followed 141 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who achieved complete remission after first-line chemotherapy and were observed without postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. After a median follow-up of 15.5 years, 12 patients (9%) relapsed, with an estimated 15-year recurrence-free survival of 90% and cancer-specific survival of 97%. Recurrence-free survival was 95% in good-risk patients and 73% in intermediate- or poor-risk patients. Late relapses occurred up to 13 years after treatment. The authors conclude that observation is a safe strategy, as relapses are rare and potentially curable.

pmid-20026812.summary_ja: デンマーク全国コホートで約216万人の男性を追跡し、停留精巣や尿道下裂の既往・家族歴と精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを検討した。既往があると相対リスクは停留精巣で3.71、尿道下裂で2.13と上昇した。一方、家族歴は多くの場合リスク上昇と関連せず、停留精巣の第3度近親者でのみ僅かな上昇がみられた。3疾患の遺伝的共有という仮説は支持されなかった。
pmid-20026812.summary_en: This Danish nationwide cohort study of 2,159,883 men examined whether a personal or family history of cryptorchidism or hypospadias is associated with testicular germ cell cancer risk. Among 5,441 cases, a personal history of cryptorchidism (RR 3.71) or hypospadias (RR 2.13) was linked to substantially increased risk. Family history of either condition, however, was generally not associated with increased risk, except for a small increase among third-degree relatives of cryptorchidism patients. The findings do not support a shared heritable basis for cryptorchidism, hypospadias, and testicular germ cell cancer.

pmid-20031937.summary_ja: 1999〜2004年の米国がん統計を用い、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマと非セミノーマの年齢調整発生率を算出した。非セミノーマはヒスパニック系男性で最も増加し、同集団では若年で発症のピークを迎えた。遠隔転移での診断は、非ヒスパニック系白人男性（9.6%）より他の人種・民族で多かった（13.8〜16.8%）。診断時病期の格差は、治療の効果に影響すると結論づけている。
pmid-20031937.summary_en: This analysis used U.S. Cancer Statistics data from 1999 to 2004 to estimate age-adjusted incidence of seminoma and nonseminoma testicular germ cell tumors. Nonseminoma incidence rose most among Hispanic men, followed by non-Hispanic White men, and nonseminomas peaked at younger ages in Hispanic, American Indian/Alaska Native, and Asian/Pacific Islander men. Distant-stage diagnosis was more frequent in these groups than in non-Hispanic White men (9.6%), ranging from 13.8% to 16.8%. The authors conclude that the disparities in stage at diagnosis have implications for effective treatment.

pmid-20035713.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ細胞株JKT-1と高転移性サブラインJKT-HMを用いたマウス異種移植モデルで検討した。JKT-HMの培養上清は、リンパ節転移を促進した。SERPINE2はJKT-HMで高発現しており、その発現抑制で転移は減少し、過剰発現で増加した。SERPINE2はセミノーマのリンパ節転移の促進因子となりうるが、機序は未解明である。
pmid-20035713.summary_en: This study sought genes that promote lymph node metastasis in testicular germ cell tumors using the seminoma cell line JKT-1 and its highly metastatic subline JKT-HM in a mouse xenograft model. Conditioned medium from JKT-HM increased lymph node metastasis, and microarray analysis identified high SERPINE2 expression. SERPINE2 silencing reduced metastasis, while overexpression in JKT-1 promoted it, without affecting xenograft volume, proliferation, or lymphangiogenesis. The authors conclude that SERPINE2 may promote lymph node metastasis in seminoma, although the exact mechanism remains unclear.

pmid-20036545.summary_ja: 32歳女性の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫に由来する腰椎単発転移の症例である。腫瘍摘出と前方脊椎再建術による外科治療を行った。この稀な卵巣腫瘍の既往手術後にも転移が生じうることを指摘している。卵巣甲状腺腫は通常良性であるが、骨転移を起こすことがあり、再発や転移の長期的な監視が必要であることを示している。
pmid-20036545.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman with a solitary lumbar spine metastasis from malignant struma ovarii. She was treated surgically with tumor extirpation and anterior spinal reconstruction. The authors note that metastasis may occur even after prior surgery for this rare ovarian tumor. The report highlights that struma ovarii, although typically benign, can metastasize to bone and require long-term surveillance for recurrence and spread.

pmid-20042943.summary_ja: 11か月の乳児が仙尾部奇形腫の切除および尾骨切除の17日後に馬尾症候群と硬膜外血腫を発症した症例報告。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で背側硬膜外に大きな病変を認め、緊急減圧術を行った。18か月かけて著明に改善し、7歳時点で神経学的に正常であった。
pmid-20042943.summary_en: This case report describes an 11-month-old infant who developed cauda equina syndrome and a spinal epidural hematoma 17 days after resection of a sacrococcygeal teratoma and coccyx excision. Magnetic resonance imaging showed a large dorsal epidural lesion extending from T12 to the sacrum, connected to the prior operative site. Emergency decompression was performed. The patient was discharged with diminished neurologic function but improved substantially over 18 months and was neurologically normal at age 7. The authors emphasize sealing access to the spinal canal after sacrococcygeal surgery.

pmid-20043168.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における EZH2 mRNA 発現をリアルタイムRT-PCRで解析した研究。EZH2は正常精巣で最も高く、上皮内癌から浸潤性腫瘍へ進展するにつれ低下した。精子形成障害の分子マーカーとしての可能性を示している。
pmid-20043168.summary_en: This study measured EZH2 mRNA expression by real-time RT-PCR in testicular germ cell tumors, including 64 seminomas, 36 non-seminomas, and 4 carcinomas in situ. Samples with spermatogenic defects and normal testicular biopsies were included for comparison. EZH2 was expressed in 99% of tumor samples. Its levels were highest in normal testis and decreased progressively with malignant transformation to carcinoma in situ and invasive tumor. EZH2 levels were not related to histological subtype or clinical stage. They inversely correlated with spermatogenic severity, suggesting EZH2 could be a molecular marker for spermatogenic defects.

pmid-20049928.summary_ja: イタリア小児血液腫瘍学会(AIEOP)が悪性体細胞成分を伴う奇形腫(TMSC)の小児14例を集積した。無再発生存率は35.7%、全生存率は42.8%であった。予後は通常の胚細胞腫瘍より不良であり、化学療法は組織型に応じて体細胞成分の悪性腫瘍への治療も含めるべきだと結論づけている。
