pmid-20732540.summary_ja: 過去12年間に治療した原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍15例のうち、体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う5例を報告する。病期は病期I 2例、病期II 3例であった。全例が周術期化学療法と外科的切除を受けた。平均60か月の追跡で4例が再発なく生存している。まれな組織型であり、集学的治療により良好な転帰が得られることを示した。
pmid-20732540.summary_en: This report describes five patients with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors containing somatic-type malignancy, selected from 15 mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients treated over 12 years. Two were stage I and three stage II. All received perioperative chemotherapy and surgical resection. At a mean follow-up of 60 months, four patients remained alive without relapse. The authors highlight this rare histologic subtype and its favorable outcome with multimodal therapy.

pmid-20735393.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で精巣摘除後にサーベイランスを受けた453例を検討。100例が再発し、そのうち2年以降の晩期再発は9例だった。晩期再発の転移巣は56%が純粋セミノーマであった。AFPが正常な晩期再発例には生検による組織型の確認を推奨。化学療法後の残存腫瘤が純粋セミノーマ由来なら後腹膜リンパ節郭清を省略できる可能性を示した。
pmid-20735393.summary_en: This study reviewed 453 patients under surveillance after orchidectomy for stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, of whom 100 relapsed. Nine relapsed after more than two years, and most late relapses were pure seminoma at metastatic sites (56%). All late relapsers were alive and disease-free at a median 45 months after relapse. The authors recommend biopsy for late relapses with normal AFP to define histology, and suggest retroperitoneal lymph node dissection may be avoidable in pure seminoma with residual masses after chemotherapy.

pmid-20736766.summary_ja: Swyer症候群の23歳女性に発生した両側性性腺芽細胞腫の症例。右の索状性腺はジャーミノーマ（病期I）、左は高分化型セルトリ細胞腫瘍へ同時性に腫瘍化していた。セルトリ細胞腫瘍には多数の良性腹膜播種を伴い、腹部手術の2か月前に行った腹腔鏡下生検による医原性の播種と考えられた。浸潤がなく増殖能が低いことから良性と判断された。
pmid-20736766.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old woman with Swyer syndrome and bilateral gonadoblastoma. The right streak gonad had transformed into stage I germinoma, and the left into a well-differentiated Sertoli cell tumor. The Sertoli tumor was accompanied by multiple benign peritoneal implants, considered iatrogenic from laparoscopic gonadal biopsies performed two months before abdominal surgery. Lack of invasion and low proliferation supported benignity. The authors discuss the pathogenesis of such benign abdominal implants.

pmid-20736769.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の若年女性に、卵巣摘出後2年以内に脳・肺・肝転移が出現した。転移巣は化学療法の前後に段階的に切除された。後の切除検体ほど成熟成分が増え、Ki-67標識率が低下しており、化学療法が分化成熟を誘導した可能性が示唆された。10年生存が得られ、卵巣未熟奇形腫からの脳転移の初例として報告されている。
pmid-20736769.summary_en: A young woman with a primary immature ovarian teratoma developed brain, lung, and liver metastases within two years of salpingo-oophorectomy. Sequential resections of metastatic lesions were performed before and during chemotherapy. Later resections showed more mature elements and lower Ki-67 labeling indices, suggesting chemotherapy induced maturation. The patient survived 10 years. The authors report this as the first case of brain metastasis from an ovarian immature teratoma with a favorable prognosis despite CNS involvement.

pmid-20736773.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の組織95例とRT-PCR用79例、絨毛癌細胞株を用いて、DJ-1とPTENの発現を検討。全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌では初期胎盤に比べ、DJ-1およびPTENの免疫反応性とmRNA発現が有意に高かった。DJ-1はBcl-2と負の相関、PTENは野生型p53と正の相関を示した。DJ-1の過剰発現が、PTENとp53を介して栄養膜細胞のアポトーシスを制御する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-20736773.summary_en: This study examined DJ-1 and PTEN expression in 95 trophoblastic tissue samples for immunohistochemistry and 79 samples for RT-PCR, plus choriocarcinoma cell lines. DJ-1 and PTEN immunoreactivity and mRNA levels were significantly higher in complete moles and choriocarcinomas than in first-trimester placentas. DJ-1 negatively correlated with Bcl-2, and PTEN positively correlated with wild-type p53 and with Stat3 and Nanog. The authors suggest DJ-1 overexpression may regulate trophoblast apoptosis through PTEN and p53.

pmid-20736774.summary_ja: 正期産で無症状の妊娠経過後、胎盤の日常検査で偶然発見された胎盤性絨毛癌の症例報告。2cmの結節は高度異型の栄養膜細胞からなり、hCG陽性であった。全身CTで転移はなく、hCG値は追跡中に陰性化した。正常分娩後の胎盤が通常検査されないため、実際の発生頻度は報告より高い可能性があると論じている。
pmid-20736774.summary_en: This case report describes placental choriocarcinoma discovered incidentally in a 29-year-old woman after an uncomplicated full-term delivery, an exceptionally rare event estimated at about 1 in 160,000 pregnancies. Routine placental examination revealed a 2 cm papillary nodule with highly atypical trophoblastic cells that were hCG positive, with extensive necrosis and hemorrhage. Whole-body CT showed no metastases, and serial hCG levels became negative during follow-up. The authors argue the true incidence may be higher than reported, since placentas after normal deliveries are often not examined.

pmid-20739009.summary_ja: 1997〜2007年に腹腔鏡下で良性嚢胞性奇形腫を切除された生殖年齢女性の妊娠転帰を、電話調査で後方視的に検討した研究。転帰が得られた45例中16例で術中漏出があった。自然妊娠率は漏出群で高く、初回妊娠までの期間は両群で類似していた。良性嚢胞性奇形腫の漏出は長期不妊の原因とならないと結論している。
pmid-20739009.summary_en: This retrospective telephone-survey study examined reproductive outcomes in women of reproductive age who underwent laparoscopic removal of benign cystic teratoma between 1997 and 2007. Of 45 women with available outcomes, intraoperative spillage occurred in 35.6%. Spontaneous pregnancy rates were higher in the spillage group, while time to first pregnancy was similar. The authors conclude that spillage of benign cystic teratomas does not cause long-term infertility.

pmid-20740202.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫(ステージIA、グレード2)の若年女性で、補助化学療法を見送るかどうかの判断に直面した症例報告。再発時に高い有効性が期待できる治療が利用可能であることが見送りの根拠となった。初回の補助療法と経過観察・救済治療との間の利害得失を示す症例である。
pmid-20740202.summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with a stage IA, grade 2 ovarian immature teratoma in whom the team faced the dilemma of withholding adjuvant chemotherapy that has documented clinical benefit. The rationale rested on the availability of highly effective treatment should the cancer recur. The report illustrates the trade-off between upfront adjuvant therapy and surveillance with salvage treatment in ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-20795340.summary_ja: 6種のhCG変異体の参照試薬に対し複数の免疫測定法を比較し、精巣・卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍とGTDの患者41例の血清hCGを測定した。hCGβおよびhCGβコア断片に対する認識能が測定法により大きく異なった。胚細胞腫瘍の4検体は測定法間で値が大きくばらつき、うち1例は市販測定法3種で大幅に過小評価された。
pmid-20795340.summary_en: This laboratory comparison tested several radioimmunoassays and commercial two-site immunoassays against six hCG variant reference reagents and measured serum hCG in 41 patients with germ cell tumors or gestational trophoblastic disease. Assay performance differed markedly for hCG variants, particularly hCGβ and the hCGβ core fragment. Four germ cell tumor samples varied widely between assays, and one was grossly underestimated by three commercial assays.

pmid-20795342.summary_ja: シェフィールドのトロホブラスト腫瘍センターで、高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍154例を対象にCNS浸潤の検索プロトコルを後方視的に評価した。CTで7例にCNS浸潤が認められ、腰椎穿刺単独では診断は得られなかった。神経症状のない絨毛癌患者のみをスクリーニング対象とすることを提案し、MRIを推奨している。
pmid-20795342.summary_en: This retrospective analysis from the Sheffield Trophoblastic Tumour Centre evaluated a protocol for screening for central nervous system involvement in 154 high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia patients. CT detected CNS involvement in 7 patients, and lumbar puncture alone never established a diagnosis. The authors suggest that only patients with choriocarcinoma need screening in the absence of neurological signs, and they prefer MRI head imaging for its sensitivity and safety.

pmid-20795343.summary_ja: ブラジル・バイーア州の紹介センターで、妊娠性絨毛性疾患140例を後方視的に調査し、地域的・人口統計学的分布を検討した。胞状奇胎が75.7%、侵入奇胎が22.9%を占め、発生率は分娩1000件あたり8.5であった。患者の多くは州都を含む沿岸地域の20〜34歳で、教育水準・就労率は低かった。妊孕性の高い年齢層と社会経済的に不利な女性に多いと結論している。
pmid-20795343.summary_en: This retrospective review of 140 patients at a referral center in Bahia, Brazil, characterized the geographic and demographic distribution of gestational trophoblastic disease. Hydatidiform mole comprised 75.7% of cases and invasive mole 22.9%, with an incidence of 8.5 per 1,000 deliveries. Most patients came from the coastal capital region, were aged 20 to 34, and had low education and employment levels. The authors conclude GTD predominated among women of peak fertility age and unfavorable socioeconomic status.

pmid-20795344.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後にhCGが正常化した若年女性2例の原発性肺絨毛癌を報告する。1例は肺葉切除と肝切除を行ったが、化学療法中に肝転移が生じ、診断後3年で肝不全により死亡した。もう1例は孤立性肺腫瘤で、肺葉切除と化学療法により24か月間寛解を維持している。孤立性肺腫瘤を呈する若年女性では絨毛癌を考慮し、早期の化学療法と専門施設での外科的切除が予後改善に重要だと結論している。
pmid-20795344.summary_en: This report describes two young women with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma arising after a molar pregnancy, both with previously normalized serum hCG. One patient underwent lobectomy and hepatectomy for liver metastasis detected by PET, but died of hepatic failure three years after diagnosis. The other, with an isolated pulmonary mass and persistently elevated hCG, underwent lobectomy and then chemotherapy, and remains in remission at 24 months. Pathology and microsatellite analysis confirmed gestational origin. The authors stress considering choriocarcinoma in young women with an isolated lung mass, with early chemotherapy and surgical resection at specialized centers.

pmid-20795345.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、完全奇胎の7年後に再発性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を発症した46歳の女性を報告している。追跡中にhCGが上昇し、メトトレキサートの単回投与とその後のエトポシド投与によりhCGは検出限界未満となった。3年後にβ-hCGが3.1 ng/mLに上昇したが、MRIおよびCTでは腫瘍は認められなかった。当初は休止期GTDが疑われたが、過剰糖鎖付加hCGを含む詳細な評価により再発性GTDと結論された。著者らは、再発リスクを減らすために初回の十分な化学療法が不可欠であると強調している。
pmid-20795345.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 46-year-old woman with recurrent gestational trophoblastic disease seven years after a complete mole. After hCG elevation during follow-up, she received single-dose methotrexate and then etoposide, and hCG became undetectable. Three years later, beta-hCG rose to 3.1 ng/mL, but MRI and CT showed no tumor. Initially suspected to be quiescent GTD, the case was concluded to be recurrent GTD after detailed evaluation including hyperglycosylated hCG. The authors emphasize that adequate initial chemotherapy is essential to reduce the risk of recurrence.

pmid-20806619.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対して根治的精巣摘除を受け、経過観察中だった若年男性で、診断から2年以上後に肺門部および気管分岐下のリンパ節腫脹が出現した。転移性セミノーマが疑われたが、縦隔生検では腫瘍はなく非乾酪性肉芽腫が認められた。精巣胚細胞腫瘍とサルコイドーシス様の肉芽腫性炎症の関連を指摘し、再発診断には病理組織学的確認が不可欠だと強調している。
pmid-20806619.summary_en: A young man with stage I testicular seminoma, treated with radical orchiectomy and surveillance, developed hilar and subcarinal lymphadenopathy more than two years after diagnosis. Metastatic seminoma was suspected, but mediastinal biopsy showed noncaseating granulomas without tumor, consistent with a sarcoid-like reaction. The authors highlight the rare association between testicular germ cell tumors, particularly seminoma, and granulomatous inflammation. They stress that histological confirmation is essential before diagnosing seminoma relapse in patients with lymphadenopathy during surveillance.

pmid-20810465.summary_ja: 右下腹部痛で救急受診した28歳の妊婦で、右卵巣の極めて大きな嚢胞性奇形腫に捻転を伴っていた症例報告である。妊娠中の腫瘤スクリーニングにはベッドサイドの超音波検査が有用で、腹腔鏡手術は診断と治療の双方に安全とされる。妊婦の急性腹痛では卵巣捻転を鑑別診断に含め、早期の外科的介入を行うべきだと結論している。
pmid-20810465.summary_en: A 28-year-old pregnant woman presented with right lower abdominal pain and was found to have an extremely large cystic teratoma of the right ovary complicated by torsion. The authors highlight that bedside ultrasonography is a readily available screening tool in pregnancy and that laparoscopic surgery is safe for both diagnosis and treatment. Because acute ovarian torsion is rare and difficult to diagnose in pregnancy, it should be kept in the differential diagnosis of pregnant women with acute abdominal pain, with early surgical intervention advised.

pmid-20811155.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌におけるシスプラチン耐性の主要因として、CDK阻害因子p21の細胞質内高発現が同定された。難治性精巣がん患者の大多数で、EC成分に細胞質p21の高発現が認められた。細胞質p21はCDK2の阻害を介してEC細胞をシスプラチン誘導性アポトーシスから保護し、Akt阻害により核内へ移行させると感受性が回復した。Oct4/miR-106b/p21経路を標的とすることが、化学療法抵抗性の精巣がん等に対する新たな治療戦略となり得ると結論している。
pmid-20811155.summary_en: This study identifies high cytoplasmic expression of the CDK inhibitor p21 as a key determinant of cisplatin resistance in testicular embryonal carcinoma. Most refractory testicular cancer patients showed high cytoplasmic p21 in their EC component. Cytoplasmic p21 protected EC cell lines from cisplatin-induced apoptosis via CDK2 inhibition, and Akt inhibition relocalized p21 to the nucleus, restoring sensitivity. High cytoplasmic p21 was inversely associated with Oct4 and miR-106b family expression, suggesting that targeting the Oct4/miR-106b/p21 pathway could offer new treatment strategies for chemoresistant testicular and other cancers.

pmid-20811519.summary_ja: 1989年から2005年にナイジェリア南西部の癌登録で確認された精巣および精巣傍組織腫瘍26例の後方視的研究である。精巣がんの発生率は10万人あたり0.55で、男性のがんの1.1%を占めた。横紋筋肉腫が最も多く、セミノーマは胚細胞腫瘍の50%であった。同地域では精巣がんの発生率が依然低く、セミノーマの減少により横紋筋肉腫が主要な腫瘍となっていると結論している。
pmid-20811519.summary_en: This retrospective study from the Ife-Ijesha cancer registry in southwestern Nigeria reviewed 26 histopathologically confirmed testicular and paratesticular tumors diagnosed from 1989 to 2005. Testicular cancer incidence was 0.55 per 100,000 men, accounting for 1.1% of male cancers. Rhabdomyosarcomas were the most common paratesticular and overall testicular tumor, while seminomas comprised 50% of germ cell tumors. The authors conclude that testicular cancer incidence remains low in the region and that declining seminoma frequency has made rhabdomyosarcoma the predominant tumor.

pmid-20817343.summary_ja: 1985年から1995年に、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の322例に補助化学療法を行わず後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した単施設の後方視的研究である。中央値17年の追跡で10年再発率は15.2%で、再発の大半は2年以内に生じた。pN+、pT>1、血管侵襲が再発予測因子だったが識別能は中等度であった。
pmid-20817343.summary_en: This retrospective single-centre study followed 322 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumours who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection without adjuvant chemotherapy, with a median follow-up of 17 years. The 10-year recurrence rate was 15.2%, and most recurrences occurred within two years. Recurrence was predicted by pN+, pT>1 and vascular invasion, but the model had modest discriminative ability and offered limited help in identifying high-risk patients.

pmid-20818302.summary_ja: 生後11か月の女児にみられた仙尾骨部の性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。当初は皮下の液体貯留として膿瘍と治療されたが、後に排液する皮下結節となった。正中部の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は良性軟部組織病変に似るため、非典型的な膿瘍様病変の乳児では本疾患を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-20818302.summary_en: This case report describes an 11-month-old girl with a sacrococcygeal extragonadal yolk sac tumour that first presented as a subcutaneous fluid collection and was initially treated as an abscess. The lesion later became a draining subcutaneous nodule, which led to the correct diagnosis. The authors emphasise that midline extragonadal germ cell tumours can mimic benign soft tissue conditions and should be considered in infants with atypical abscess-like lesions.

pmid-20822594.summary_ja: 1984年から2003年に、ナイジェリアの2施設で精巣がんと診断された24例を前向きに追跡した研究である。多くは受診が遅れ、病期の進んだ例が多かった。主な組織型はセミノーマと胎児性癌で、患者の5分の1が死亡し、半数はフォローアップから脱落した。
pmid-20822594.summary_en: This prospective study followed 24 patients treated for testicular cancer at two centres in Nigeria between 1984 and 2003. Most patients presented late, with advanced stages in many cases, and seminoma and embryonal carcinoma were the most common histological types. Treatment consisted of radical orchidectomy with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and radiotherapy in some patients. A fifth of patients died and half were lost to follow-up, reflecting resource constraints.

pmid-20825300.summary_ja: 45歳女性の左卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告である。手術後に濾胞型乳頭状癌が判明し、甲状腺全摘と放射性ヨウ素治療を受けたが、骨盤内再発と肝転移、腹膜播種を来した。診断から37か月後に悪液質で死亡した。卵巣甲状腺腫は血行性に広がりうると述べている。
pmid-20825300.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old woman with left ovarian struma ovarii that became malignant, with a follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma found after surgery. Despite total thyroidectomy and radioiodine therapy, she developed pelvic recurrence, hypervascular liver metastases and peritoneal carcinomatosis. She died of cachexia 37 months after diagnosis. The authors note that struma ovarii can spread haematogenously and that imaging reflects its mixed behaviour.

pmid-20828977.summary_ja: 腫瘍マーカー上昇で再発を疑われた精巣がん3例に対し、FDG-PETプローブ誘導手術を施行した研究である。術前のPET/CTと術中所見は良好に一致し、標的対背景比は約5:1であった。術前PETで描出されなかった2cmの病変もプローブで検出され、すべてのプローブ陽性病変に生存腫瘍が認められた。
pmid-20828977.summary_en: This study evaluated FDG-PET probe-guided surgery in three patients with resectable second or third recurrences of testicular cancer detected by elevated tumour markers. Pre-operative FDG-PET/CT correlated well with intra-operative detection by a gamma probe, with a target-to-background ratio of about 5:1. In one patient, a 2 cm lesion not seen on pre-operative PET was found with the probe. All probe-positive lesions contained viable tumour on histology, suggesting the technique can help guide resection in hard-to-access retroperitoneal sites.

pmid-20830245.summary_ja: 76歳男性に生じた原発性肺セミノーマの症例報告である。喀血と左下葉の腫瘤で受診し、外科的に左下葉切除を受けた。化学療法や放射線療法は行われず、術後140日で死亡した。免疫組織化学では胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼとCD117が陽性であった。
pmid-20830245.summary_en: This case report describes a 76-year-old man with a primary seminoma of the lung, presenting with haemoptysis and a left lower lobe mass. He underwent lobectomy without chemotherapy or radiotherapy and died 140 days later from dyscrasia and secondary seminoma in the left ribs. Immunohistochemistry was positive for placental alkaline phosphatase and CD117. The authors conclude that primary lung seminoma is rare in older men but highly malignant and metastatic.

pmid-20838061.summary_ja: 原因不明の辺縁系脳炎様症状を呈した31歳男性で、後腹膜に生じた絨毛癌が見つかった症例報告。血清抗Ma2抗体陽性から傍腫瘍性脳炎と確定した。根治的化学療法で腫瘍は制御されたが、神経症状は改善しなかった。若年男性の原因不明の脳炎では、抗Ma2抗体検査により潜在的な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を見つけることが推奨される。
pmid-20838061.summary_en: A 31-year-old man presented with eye motility dysfunction, dysarthria, depression, and disorientation that were initially unexplained by neurologic and imaging workup. Ultrasound revealed a retroperitoneal mass, and biopsy showed choriocarcinoma. Serum anti-Ma2 antibodies were positive, confirming a paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis. Curative chemotherapy controlled the tumor, but neurological symptoms did not improve. The authors recommend testing for anti-Ma2 antibodies in young men with unexplained limbic or brainstem encephalitis to uncover hidden extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-20838305.summary_ja: 胸骨下部痛と呼吸困難を呈した39歳男性の症例報告。骨シンチグラフィで前胸部に強い集積を認め、CTで前縦隔に境界明瞭な腫瘤が見つかった。コア針生検と病理組織学的検査により縦隔セミノーマと診断された。骨外への骨親和性製剤の集積を認識することは、骨シンチグラフィの診断価値を高めるとされる。
pmid-20838305.summary_en: A 39-year-old man with substernal pain and dyspnea showed intense uptake on bone scintigraphy in the anterior chest. Computed tomography revealed a well-demarcated anterior mediastinal mass, and core needle biopsy with histopathological examination confirmed mediastinal seminoma. The case illustrates extraskeletal uptake of a bone-seeking agent by a germ cell tumor. The authors argue that recognizing such nonosseous uptake can improve the diagnostic value of bone scintigraphy and prevent misinterpretation as bone metastasis.

pmid-20846106.summary_ja: 高血圧と低ナトリウム血症を呈した81歳女性の症例報告。超音波検査で左卵巣に骨盤内腫瘤が見つかり、病理組織学的に9.5cmの成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。対側の右卵巣には偶発的に海綿状血管腫が認められた。対側の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と同時性に生じた卵巣血管腫の初例として報告されている。
pmid-20846106.summary_en: An 81-year-old woman with hypertension and hyponatremia had a left ovarian mass on ultrasonography. Histology confirmed a 9.5 cm mature cystic teratoma in the left ovary. Incidentally, a 3.5 cm cavernous hemangioma was found in the contralateral right ovary. The authors report this as the first case of an ovarian hemangioma occurring synchronously with a contralateral mature cystic teratoma, focusing on the rarity of the coexisting lesions and their incidental discovery in an elderly patient.

pmid-20846270.summary_ja: 間欠的な腹痛を呈した若年男性の症例報告。開腹術で切除された後腹膜の被膜に包まれた嚢胞性病変は、三胚葉すべての成熟組織を含んでいた。隣接する小腸粘膜に、間質浸潤のない小腸型腺癌が認められた。後腹膜成熟奇形腫から生じた小腸型腺癌の初例であり、早期発見により予後は良好と考察されている。
pmid-20846270.summary_en: A young man with intermittent abdominal pain was found to have an encapsulated retroperitoneal mass, which was resected at laparotomy. The cyst contained mature tissues from all three germ layers, including a fully developed intestinal tract. Adjacent to the small intestinal mucosa, a non-invasive adenocarcinoma of small intestinal type was identified, with p53 overexpression and a high Ki-67 index. This is reported as the first small intestinal adenocarcinoma arising in a retroperitoneal mature teratoma, a malignant transformation with favorable prognosis due to early detection.

pmid-20849656.summary_ja: ターナー症候群患者（モザイク核型45,X/46,XY）の性腺芽細胞腫と、その父親（モザイク46,XY）の精巣セミノーマの家系例。両者は同一の新規SRY変異（L94fsX180）を有していた。変異型SRYタンパク質が性腺芽細胞腫の発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。SRY変異のないモザイク患者も悪性胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを持つと強調されている。
pmid-20849656.summary_en: A Turner syndrome patient with a mosaic 45,X/46,XY karyotype and gonadoblastoma, and her father with a mosaic 46,XY karyotype and testicular seminoma, shared the same novel SRY frameshift mutation (L94fsX180) in the HMG box. The authors propose that the mutant SRY protein may contribute to gonadoblastoma development. They also emphasize that mosaic patients without SRY mutation remain at risk for malignant germ cell tumors, linking sex chromosome mosaicism and SRY variants with gonadal tumor risk.

pmid-20850695.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍68例を対象に、セミノーマの免疫組織化学マーカーとしてポドプラニンをOCT3/4と比較した。ポドプラニンは全例でセミノーマ成分を染色し、胎児性癌は染色しなかった。胎児性癌の巣に隣接するセミノーマ細胞を同定し、セミノーマから胎児性癌が分化により生じるとの仮説を支持した。性腺外部位での鑑別に有用と考えられる。
pmid-20850695.summary_en: This study evaluates podoplanin as an immunohistochemical marker for seminoma in 68 testicular mixed germ cell tumors, comparing it with OCT3/4. Podoplanin stained seminoma components diffusely in all cases and did not stain embryonal carcinoma. Focal staining occurred in one third of choriocarcinomas. Podoplanin highlighted seminoma cell clusters adjacent to embryonal carcinoma foci, supporting the hypothesis that embryonal carcinoma arises from seminoma through differentiation. The marker may aid diagnosis, especially at extragonadal sites.

pmid-20855642.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発巣と転移巣計172例を免疫組織化学的に検討した。UTF1は精細管内胚細胞腫瘍、セミノーマ、胎児性癌で高頻度に陽性で、卵黄嚢腫瘍では弱陽性、奇形腫と絨毛癌は陰性であった。非胚細胞腫瘍での陽性は少数にとどまった。強い染色は胎児性癌とセミノーマの診断補助になりうる。
pmid-20855642.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study evaluated UTF1 expression in 104 primary and 68 metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, plus 339 non-germ cell tumors. UTF1 was present in all intratubular germ cell neoplasias, seminomas, and embryonal carcinomas, with strong staining in most embryonal carcinomas and seminomas. Weak staining appeared in some yolk sac tumors, while teratomas and choriocarcinomas were negative. Only a few non-germ cell tumors showed weak staining. UTF1 expression in normal spermatogonia suggests a role in spermatogenesis. Strong UTF1 staining may aid diagnosis of embryonal carcinoma and seminoma.

pmid-20857798.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、左眼に突出する先天性眼窩腫瘤を呈した乳児を記述しており、その臨床像は奇形腫に典型的であった。病理組織学的検査では診断は確定しなかったが、臨床経過から奇形腫が強く示唆された。多職種による治療により乳児の生命が救われ、治療成績も向上した。6か月間の良好な追跡が記録されている。著者らは、疑われる奇形腫の症例では細胞診が不可欠であると強調している。
pmid-20857798.summary_en: This case report describes an infant with a protruding congenital orbital mass in the left eye, whose clinical features were typical of teratoma. Histopathology did not confirm the diagnosis, but the clinical course strongly suggested teratoma. Multidisciplinary management preserved the infant's life and improved outcomes. Six months of compliant follow-up was documented. The authors emphasize that cytological examination is essential for any suspected teratoma case. The report highlights how rare congenital orbital teratoma is and the value of coordinated care.

pmid-20858655.summary_ja: 右精巣腫瘤、胸部X線での多数の陰影、右心室内腫瘤を呈した32歳男性の症例報告である。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の心臓内転移と考えられた。議論の末、心臓内腫瘤は切除せず化学療法単独で治療された。治癒を目指した治療方針の判断について考察し、今後の症例への推奨を示している。
pmid-20858655.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a right testicular mass, numerous round shadows on chest radiography, and a large right ventricular intracardiac mass, representing metastasis from a non-seminomatous germ cell tumour. After multidisciplinary debate, he was treated with chemotherapy alone rather than resection of the cardiac mass, with the aim of cure. The authors discuss the rarity of cardiac metastasis and present recommendations for future patients. The report is relevant to management decisions for metastatic testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-20862380.summary_ja: 腹痛の精査中にコンピュータ断層撮影で発見された、巨大な原発性後腹膜奇形腫を有する32歳男性の症例報告である。組織学的に非典型的な腫瘍であった。成人の後腹膜奇形腫はまれで、治療方針の決定が難しい。評価と治療の経過、および文献的考察が示されている。
pmid-20862380.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a giant primary retroperitoneal teratoma, discovered on computed tomography during evaluation of abdominal pain. Retroperitoneal teratomas are rare and present challenging management options. The tumor showed unusual histology. The authors describe the evaluation and treatment of the condition and review the relevant literature. The report highlights the difficulty of managing teratomas outside the gonadal and sacrococcygeal regions, where they typically arise in adults.

pmid-20863158.summary_ja: 左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に低悪性度の乏突起膠腫を伴った13歳女児の症例報告である。骨盤痛を主訴に来院し、開腹術と卵巣摘出術が施行された。奇形腫内には小脳組織を含む3胚葉の成熟組織が認められた。卵巣奇形腫由来の乏突起膠腫の小児例は初めての報告とされる。
pmid-20863158.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old girl with a left ovarian mass and two months of pelvic pain, diagnosed as mature cystic teratoma with a low-grade oligodendroglioma component. The mature teratoma contained tissues from all three germ layers, including cerebellar tissue. The neuroepithelial component showed uniform rounded cells with a fried-egg appearance. Treatment consisted of laparotomy and oophorectomy. This is described as the first pediatric case of oligodendroglioma arising in an ovarian mature teratoma, with prior reports limited to adults.

pmid-20868507.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)15例でGPC3の免疫染色を検討した研究。PSTTの80%と胎盤部結節が陽性であった。子宮頸部扁平上皮癌の陽性例はわずかで、子宮内膜腺癌は陰性であった。非栄養膜性腫瘍との鑑別に有用な補助マーカーとなる可能性が示された。
pmid-20868507.summary_en: This study examined glypican 3 (GPC3) immunohistochemistry in 15 placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT), along with placental site nodules, several uterine tumors, and non-neoplastic tissues. GPC3 was expressed in 80% of PSTT and in both placental site nodules, but only rarely in cervical squamous cell carcinoma and not in endometrial adenocarcinoma. Because PSTT can be confused with non-trophoblastic tumors, the authors suggest GPC3 may serve as a useful adjunctive immunohistochemical marker.

pmid-20876619.summary_ja: 縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が肺に穿孔した症例報告。臨床経過、CTおよび超音波検査所見、病理組織学的な穿孔の確認が記載された。奇形腫と肺の瘻孔の超音波所見はこれまで報告がなかった。正確な画像診断が外科的治療方針の決定に重要であることが示された。
pmid-20876619.summary_en: This case report describes a mediastinal mature cystic teratoma that perforated into the lung. The authors present the clinical manifestation, CT and ultrasound findings, and pathological confirmation of perforation without pulmonary invasion. They note that ultrasound features of a teratoma-lung fistula had not been described before. Because perforated cystic mediastinal teratoma is rare, accurate diagnosis and characterization of its complications are important for determining the surgical approach.

pmid-20879859.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、2006年から2009年にかけて臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、治療目的で腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた26例を検討した。9例(35%)が病理学的病期II であった。pN1の6例中4例は補助化学療法を受けず無病で経過した。病期I の2例が後腹膜外で再発した。著者らは、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清は許容可能な腫瘍学的有効性と低い罹患率を示し、pN1患者は経過観察が安全である可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-20879859.summary_en: This retrospective series reviews 26 patients who underwent therapeutic laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors between 2006 and 2009. Nine patients (35%) had pathologic stage II disease. Four of six patients with pN1 disease did not receive adjuvant chemotherapy and remained disease-free. Two patients with stage I disease recurred outside the retroperitoneum. The authors conclude that laparoscopic RPLND offers acceptable oncologic efficacy with reduced morbidity, and that pN1 patients may be observed safely pending longer follow-up.

pmid-20881859.summary_ja: 閉経後の48歳女性に生じた、絨毛癌分化を伴う卵巣明細胞癌の症例報告。術前化学療法で部分奏効を得たのち減量手術が行われたが、術後11か月で死亡した。予後は極めて不良であり、両成分を標的とした術前化学療法が病変縮小に寄与する可能性が示された。
pmid-20881859.summary_en: This case report describes ovarian clear cell carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation in a 48-year-old postmenopausal woman with lung and liver metastases. Biopsy showed poorly differentiated carcinoma positive for CK7 and hCG. After six cycles of neoadjuvant chemotherapy with partial response, debulking surgery revealed a clear cell carcinoma with a striking choriocarcinoma component. Despite further chemotherapy, the disease progressed and the patient died 11 months after surgery. The authors suggest that neoadjuvant therapy targeting both components may help reduce disease volume before surgery.

pmid-20882900.summary_ja: 35歳の女性に、卵巣類内膜腺癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍成分が同時に認められた症例を報告する。免疫組織化学染色により、2つの成分で異なるAFPおよびサイトケラチン7の染色パターンが示され、別個の系統に由来することが示唆された。BEP化学療法4コースの後、タキサンとカルボプラチンを2コース追加したが、病勢は制御できず、経過観察約12か月で患者は死亡した。著者らは、これらの成分の併存は極めてまれであり、英文文献では過去に12例のみが報告されていると指摘している。
pmid-20882900.summary_en: A 35-year-old woman with simultaneous ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinoma and a yolk sac tumor component is described. Immunohistochemistry showed distinct AFP and cytokeratin 7 staining patterns in the two components, supporting separate lineages. Treatment with four cycles of BEP chemotherapy followed by taxane and carboplatin for two cycles failed to control disease, and the patient died about 12 months after follow-up. The authors note that coexistence of these components is very rare, with only 12 prior cases in English literature.

pmid-20884137.summary_ja: 本総説は新生児奇形腫を扱い、これは発生部位にとって異質な組織から構成され、性腺性または性腺外、成熟または未熟に分類される。新生児症例の大半は良性で、仙尾部が最も多く、次いで前縦隔である。出生前診断が可能な場合が多く、胎児への介入が必要となることがある。治療は完全な外科的切除が推奨される。超音波、CT、MRIが手術計画の指針となり、AFPは残存または再発病変の検出に最も有用な腫瘍マーカーである。
pmid-20884137.summary_en: This review summarizes neonatal teratomas, which are composed of tissues foreign to their site of origin and are classified as gonadal or extragonadal and as mature or immature. Most neonatal cases are benign, with the sacrococcygeal region most common, followed by the anterior mediastinum. Prenatal diagnosis is often possible and may require fetal intervention. Complete surgical excision is the preferred treatment. Ultrasound, CT, and MRI guide surgical planning, and AFP is the most useful tumor marker for detecting residual or recurrent disease.

pmid-20920730.summary_ja: 2歳男児の精索類皮嚢腫の症例報告。これまでの報告9例はすべて成人で、本例は最年少である。小児の鼠径部腫瘤の鑑別診断として、長期間持続し圧痛がなく還納不能な場合には本疾患も考慮すべきだと述べている。鼠径部間接ヘルニアとの鑑別が重要である。
pmid-20920730.summary_en: A 2-year-old boy with a dermoid cyst of the spermatic cord is reported, the youngest case described so far, as prior reports involved only nine adults. The authors recommend including this lesion in the differential diagnosis of pediatric inguinal masses, especially those that are long-standing, nontender, and irreducible. Such masses are often misread as indirect hernias, so awareness matters. The rarity of these lesions makes recognition particularly important in children.

pmid-20930449.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を発症した21歳女性で、回復後に右卵巣奇形腫を摘出した症例。腫瘍の免疫染色では、神経組織および未分化神経上皮組織にNMDARのNR2Bサブユニットを含む各種グルタミン酸受容体が豊富に発現していた。正常卵巣の卵母細胞にもNR2B関連の発現がみられた。卵巣奇形腫内の神経成分が抗NMDAR抗体産生に関与するという説を支持する所見である。
pmid-20930449.summary_en: This report describes a 21-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis who underwent resection of a right ovarian teratoma about five months after recovery. Immunohistochemistry of the tumor showed abundant expression of various glutamate receptors, including the NR2B subunit of NMDAR, GluR1 and GluR2/3, in neural and undifferentiated neuroepithelial tissue. Control ovaries also showed NR2B-related immunoreactivity in oocytes. The findings support the view that neural elements within ovarian teratoma contribute to the production of anti-NMDAR antibodies.

pmid-20941978.summary_ja: 生後16日の女児に生じたIII型の巨大仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。胎生36週の出生前超音波検査で診断された。腫瘍は周囲組織から剥離され、尾骨とともに一塊として切除された。術後経過は順調で、6か月のフォローアップで機能的・整容的に良好であった。良性病変でも最大70%の症例で尾骨を含む根治的切除が必要であると強調している。
pmid-20941978.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-day-old girl with a large type III sacrococcygeal teratoma, first diagnosed at 36 weeks of gestation by prenatal ultrasound. The tumor was dissected from surrounding structures and removed en bloc together with the coccyx. Recovery after surgery was uneventful, and functional and cosmetic results were good at six-month follow-up. The authors emphasize that radical resection including the coccyx is needed in up to 70% of cases, even when the lesion is benign.

pmid-20944793.summary_ja: 巨大病変を伴う病期IICセミノーマの1例。初回化学療法と残存腫瘤に対する手術の後に骨盤内で再発した。再発は横隔膜下の限局した領域にとどまり、救済放射線療法で治療された。救済放射線療法後3.7年の時点で再発は認められていない。限局した横隔膜下の化学療法後再発に対して放射線療法が救済治療となりうるとし、さらなる検討を求めている。
pmid-20944793.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with bulky stage IIC seminoma who relapsed in the pelvis after primary chemotherapy and surgery for a post-chemotherapy residual mass. The recurrence was confined to the infradiaphragmatic region and was treated with salvage radiotherapy. The patient remained free of relapse 3.7 years after salvage radiotherapy. The authors conclude that radiotherapy may be a salvage option for post-chemotherapy seminoma recurrence confined to a limited infradiaphragmatic area, and call for further study.

pmid-20955354.summary_ja: 本研究は1985〜2006年に日本の25施設で病期Iセミノーマに対し精巣摘除術を受けた425例を後方視的に解析した。10年無再発生存率はサーベイランス群79%、化学療法群および放射線療法群ではいずれも94%であった。再発の独立した予測因子は精巣網浸潤と精巣摘除術後の管理法であった。晩期再発の検出には長期フォローアップが不可欠である。
pmid-20955354.summary_en: This Japanese multi-institutional retrospective study analyzed 425 patients with stage I seminoma treated with orchiectomy between 1985 and 2006. Ten-year relapse-free survival was 79% with surveillance, versus 94% with chemotherapy or radiotherapy. Rete testis invasion and post-orchiectomy management were independent predictors of relapse. Overall survival at 10 years exceeded 99% in all groups. Because over half of patients were lost to follow-up within five years, the authors emphasize that long-term follow-up is essential for detecting late relapse.

pmid-20955989.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、母親と3人の娘に生じた4例の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）を報告したものである。いずれも左側に発生し、20代に定期的な婦人科検診で診断された。著者らは家族性発生の頻度、遺伝的連鎖、発症機序、診断、合併症、外科的管理について文献的に概説している。世代を超えた片側性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の報告は、本例を含めてもわずか3例にとどまる。
pmid-20955989.summary_en: This report describes four cases of mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) affecting a mother and her three daughters, all with left-sided tumors diagnosed in their twenties during routine gynecologic examinations. The authors review the familial incidence, genetic linkage, pathogenesis theories, diagnosis, complications and surgical management of these tumors. Familial cases are exceedingly rare, and the literature review identifies only two previous reports of unilateral mature cystic teratomas across generations. The paper underscores the value of screening family members.

pmid-20956623.summary_ja: 本研究は、シスプラチン系一次化学療法後に進行した転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者の予後モデルを構築した国際多施設研究である。38施設の1,984例を解析し、学習群と検証群に無作為に分けた。組織型、原発巣、治療効果、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の値、肝・骨・脳転移などが独立した予後因子であった。2年無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は超低リスク群の75%から超高リスク群の6%に及び、救援化学療法の選択に役立つ。
pmid-20956623.summary_en: This international multicenter study developed a prognostic model for patients with metastatic germ cell tumors who progressed after cisplatin-based first-line chemotherapy. Using 1,984 patients from 38 centers, the authors randomly split the cohort into training and validation sets, with seminomas analyzed separately. Histology, primary site, response, progression interval, AFP and hCG levels, and liver, bone or brain metastases were independent prognostic variables. Two-year progression-free survival ranged from 75% in very low-risk to 6% in very high-risk patients, which can guide salvage treatment strategies.

pmid-20960902.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、巨大仙尾部奇形腫(Altman II型)を有する1,912g(腫瘍を含む)の低出生体重児の麻酔管理を報告したものである。胎児期に診断され、腫瘍を介した動静脈シャントによる心不全のため妊娠28週で緊急帝王切開により出生した。経鼻気管挿管と中心静脈カテーテルを用い、766gの腫瘍を全摘出した。一過性のアシドーシスと高カリウム血症が生じたが、安定した状態でNICUに移送された。
pmid-20960902.summary_en: This case report describes the anesthetic management of a low birth weight infant (1,912 g including the tumor) with a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma, Altman type II. The fetus was diagnosed prenatally, and the infant was delivered by emergency cesarean at 28 weeks because of heart failure from arteriovenous shunting through the tumor. Nasotracheal intubation and a central venous line guided volume infusion during complete resection of a 766 g tumor. Transient acidosis and hyperkalemia occurred, but the infant was transferred to the neonatal intensive care unit in stable condition.

pmid-20967026.summary_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞由来の奇形腫モデルを用いて、HDAC1欠損が奇形腫の分化と増殖に与える影響を検討した。HDAC1欠損奇形腫では増殖が亢進し、上皮様分化が低下していた。その原因としてSNAIL1の上昇が重要であった。ヒト奇形腫でもHDAC1の低下と悪性度の上昇が関連していた。HDAC1は良性奇形腫のマーカーとなりうると述べている。
pmid-20967026.summary_en: Using wild-type and HDAC1-deficient embryonic stem cells, the authors generated experimental teratomas in mice. HDAC1-deficient teratomas were similar in size but showed increased apoptosis and enhanced proliferation, with reduced epithelial differentiation. Upregulated SNAIL1 was crucial for this proliferative, less differentiated phenotype. Analysis of human teratomas revealed a similar link between HDAC1 loss and increased tumour malignancy. The authors propose HDAC1 as a potential marker that distinguishes benign teratomas.

pmid-20973266.summary_ja: 1988年から2008年に卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた悪性転化の治療を受けた20例を後方視的に検討した。扁平上皮癌が15例を占めた。11例が補助治療を受け、白金系化学療法が中心であった。1年の全生存率は70%で、年齢・病期・残存腫瘍量が全生存期間と関連した。白金/タキサン併用化学療法の有用性を示唆している。
pmid-20973266.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 20 women treated between 1988 and 2008 for malignant transformation arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Most tumours were squamous cell carcinoma, and 11 patients were stage I. Eleven patients received adjuvant treatment, mainly platinum-based chemotherapy or chemoradiation. The one-year overall survival rate was 70%. Age, stage, and residual tumour were significantly associated with overall survival. The authors suggest that combination platinum/taxane chemotherapy is a reasonable option.

pmid-20977645.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌を有していた多臓器提供者から、4人の移植患者へ癌が伝播した症例を報告。hCG上昇により診断され、膵腎移植例は化学療法で2年間寛解を維持した。肝移植例は腸管転移により死亡し、心移植例はびまん性転移を来した。免疫抑制患者における高い悪性度と、化学療法や移植臓器摘出の検討の必要性が示された。
pmid-20977645.summary_en: The authors report accidental transmission of placental choriocarcinoma from a pregnant multiorgan donor to four recipients. Diagnosis was established by rising hCG levels. One pancreas-kidney recipient remained in remission for 2 years after chemotherapy without graft removal. A single-kidney recipient underwent transplantectomy and actinomycin treatment and remains in remission. The liver recipient developed intestinal metastasis and died, while the heart recipient developed diffuse metastasis despite an initial response to EMA-CO. The authors suggest that chemotherapy with or without transplantectomy should be considered in such cases.

pmid-20979178.summary_ja: 生後6か月の男児に発生した、Wilms腫瘍様に発症した稀な腎内奇形腫の症例報告。術前生検により診断を明確にし、不要な化学療法を回避できた。SIOPガイドラインでは臨床・画像所見のみでWilms腫瘍と診断されるが、英国CCLGのガイドラインに従った生検が鑑別に有用であったことが示された。小児における過剰治療の防止に生検が役立つと結論づけられている。
pmid-20979178.summary_en: The authors report a rare intrarenal teratoma in a 6-month-old boy who presented as a Wilms tumor would. Under SIOP guidelines, Wilms tumor is diagnosed on clinical and imaging findings before neoadjuvant chemotherapy. Because the patient underwent biopsy before treatment according to UK (CCLG) guidelines, the diagnosis was clarified and unnecessary chemotherapy was avoided. He was successfully managed with primary nephrectomy. The case highlights the value of pre-treatment biopsy in distinguishing intrarenal teratoma from Wilms tumor in pediatric patients.

pmid-21034922.summary_ja: 9か月男児の右側腹部腫瘤として発症した、胸膜後腔に由来する奇形腫の初めての症例報告。腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲内で、画像検査では後腹膜腫瘤が疑われたが、手術で横隔膜の上方から発生していたことが判明した。病理では悪性所見のない成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。術前画像では横隔膜が不明瞭な場合があり、慎重な手術計画が必要と結論づけられている。
pmid-21034922.summary_en: The authors present a 9-month-old boy with a large right-sided abdominal mass that proved to be a retropleural teratoma, the first such report. Tumor markers were normal, and imaging suggested a retroperitoneal mass. At surgery, the tumor was found to arise above the diaphragm in the retropleural space. Histology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma without malignant features. The patient remained disease-free at 7-year follow-up. The authors caution that preoperative imaging may inaccurately depict the diaphragm and recommend careful surgical planning for tumors near the diaphragm.

pmid-21037873.summary_ja: 成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍における血清腫瘍マーカーの使用に関するASCO診療ガイドライン。組織型ごとに腫瘍マーカーの特性が異なるため、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のそれぞれについて、モニタリングとサーベイランスにおける使用を検討している。摘要は簡潔で、具体的な推奨内容は記載されていない。
pmid-21037873.summary_en: This ASCO clinical practice guideline addresses the use of serum tumor markers in adult males with germ cell tumors. It examines how markers should be used for monitoring and surveillance separately for seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, reflecting the different marker profiles of these histologic subtypes. The abstract is brief and does not state specific recommendations. The guideline is relevant to clinicians managing testicular germ cell tumor patients for treatment response and relapse detection.

pmid-21042504.summary_ja: 本神経画像報告は、Type II仙尾部奇形腫の臨床像と放射線学的所見を示し、その病理学的特徴、画像所見、外科的管理について概説している。仙尾部奇形腫は小児に多い胚細胞腫瘍の一型であり、臨床、画像、病理の所見を対応させた本症例の提示は、診断と手術計画の理解に役立つ。
pmid-21042504.summary_en: This neuroimage report describes the clinicoradiological presentation of a Type II sacrococcygeal teratoma. It summarizes the pathological features, radiological findings, and surgical management of the tumor. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is a common germ cell tumor in children, and imaging findings are important for diagnosis and surgical planning. The report provides a concise illustrative case with clinical, imaging, and pathological correlation.

pmid-21043373.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、肺転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の17歳女性例を示す。EMA-CO療法後にグレード4の腫瘍崩壊症候群と腎不全を発症し、ラスブリカーゼ投与により尿酸値が正常化し透析を回避した。その後、心不全のためアクチノマイシンDに変更され、β-hCGは5コース後に陰性化した。GTNへのラスブリカーゼ使用は初の報告である。
pmid-21043373.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old woman with metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia to the lungs, presenting with anemia, thyrotoxicosis, and elevated beta-hCG. After the first EMA-CO cycle she developed grade 4 tumor lysis syndrome with renal failure, which did not respond to hydration and allopurinol. A single dose of rasburicase normalized uric acid and reversed renal failure, avoiding dialysis. Later she developed heart failure and was switched to actinomycin-D, and beta-hCG became negative after five cycles. The authors report this as the first use of rasburicase for TLS in GTN.

pmid-21046693.summary_ja: 本研究は、20年間に治療した思春期前精巣腫瘍40例を検討し、外科的アプローチのアルゴリズムを提案する。超音波検査で良性と疑われた腫瘍はすべて術後に良性と確認された。術前のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫の乳児で有意差があった。精巣温存手術後、1例の奇形腫を除き再発や精巣萎縮はみられなかった。
pmid-21046693.summary_en: This study reviews 40 cases of prepubertal testicular tumors treated over 20 years to propose a surgical algorithm. All tumors suspected as benign on ultrasonography were confirmed benign after surgery. Preoperative AFP levels differed significantly between infants with yolk sac tumor and those with teratoma. Teratoma was the most common histologic subtype. Testis-sparing surgery was performed in several patients, and apart from one teratoma case, none had recurrence or testicular atrophy. The authors propose an algorithm based on ultrasonographic findings and preoperative AFP to guide surgical decisions.

pmid-21057822.summary_ja: 在胎34週で出生した早産新生児の、Altman3型の巨大仙尾部奇形腫切除に対する麻酔管理を報告した症例報告。高カリウム血症で手術が2日遅延し、腫瘍崩壊により全身状態が悪化した。術中は大量輸血を要する出血、腫瘍による換気困難、呼吸性アシドーシス、体温管理の問題が生じた。術後は良好に回復し退院した。
pmid-21057822.summary_en: This case report describes anesthetic management of a 34-week premature newborn undergoing resection of a massive Altman type 3 sacrococcygeal teratoma. Surgery was delayed two days due to hyperkalemia, and tumor lysis worsened the patient's condition. Intraoperative challenges included major bleeding requiring massive transfusion, difficult ventilation from the tumor pressing on the chest, respiratory acidosis, and temperature control. The patient recovered well and was discharged home. The paper highlights perioperative considerations for premature infants with large sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-21059207.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍の2大組織型である卵黄嚢腫瘍とジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）について、マイクロRNA(miRNA)発現プロファイルを小児例と成人例で比較した研究。卵黄嚢腫瘍ではmiR-302クラスターが著明に過剰発現し、転写因子との関連が示された。この差異が卵黄嚢腫瘍の攻撃的な臨床経過に寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21059207.summary_en: This study compared microRNA expression profiles of the two most common malignant germ cell tumor subtypes, yolk sac tumors (YSTs) and germinomas, in paediatric and adult samples. Multiple microRNAs were differentially expressed, and the miR-302 cluster was markedly overexpressed in YSTs. Transcription factors including GATA6, GATA3, TCF7L2 and MAF were associated with miR-302 expression and predicted to bind its promoter. Downregulated mRNAs in YSTs were enriched for miR-302 target sites, suggesting functional relevance. The authors propose that microRNA differences may contribute to the more aggressive behavior of YSTs.

pmid-21060097.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究では、5年間にICUへ入院した若年成人505例を検討し、原因不明の脳炎に該当する7例を同定した。そのうち6例が抗NMDA受容体脳炎であり、2例は卵巣奇形腫を伴っていた。奇形腫は1例で発症の3年後に発見された。全例で予後は良好であった。抗NMDAR脳炎は若年ICU入院の約1%を占めていた。著者らは、奇形腫との関連を踏まえ、該当基準を満たす脳炎患者全例でNMDA受容体抗体を検査することを推奨している。
pmid-21060097.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 505 young adults admitted to an ICU over five years and identified seven patients with encephalitis of unknown origin. Six of seven had anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, and two of these had ovarian teratomas, one detected three years after onset. Outcomes were favorable in all patients. Anti-NMDAR encephalitis accounted for about 1% of young ICU admissions. The authors recommend testing NMDA receptor antibodies in all encephalitis patients meeting these criteria, given the link with teratoma.

pmid-21061804.summary_ja: 3週間の異常膣出血を呈し、子宮頸部外口から脱出する壊死性で易出血性の腫瘤を認めた38歳女性の症例報告。β-hCGは13 mIU/mlと軽度上昇にとどまり、CTで転移は認めなかった。免疫染色で胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と確定し、手術により根治的に治療された。化学療法への反応が不良であるため、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の他病型との鑑別の重要性を強調している。
pmid-21061804.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old woman with three weeks of abnormal vaginal bleeding and a necrotic, friable mass protruding through the cervical os. Beta-hCG was only 13 mIU/ml, and CT showed no metastasis. Immunohistochemistry was positive for cytokeratin AE1/AE3, E-cadherin, hPL and alpha inhibin, confirming placental site trophoblastic tumor. Surgery was considered curative. The authors stress distinguishing PSTT from other gestational trophoblastic neoplasia because it responds poorly to chemotherapy.

pmid-21061810.summary_ja: 正常分娩の7か月後に発症した、非腫瘍性の反応性過剰胎盤部の症例報告。臨床的には胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍に類似していた。中間型トロホブラストと合胞体栄養膜細胞が子宮内膜と筋層に豊富に浸潤していた。病理組織学的所見と文献レビューを提示し、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍との鑑別の重要性を強調している。
pmid-21061810.summary_en: This case report describes a reactive exaggerated placental site that developed seven months after a normal pregnancy and clinically mimicked placental site trophoblastic tumor. The lesion was a non-neoplastic trophoblastic proliferation with exuberant infiltration of intermediate trophoblasts and syncytiotrophoblasts into the endometrium and myometrium. The authors present histopathological observations alongside a literature review of its clinical course and differential diagnosis. Accurate distinction from PSTT is emphasized because misdiagnosis may change management.

pmid-21062470.summary_ja: 1994〜2008年に、転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍でシスプラチン併用化学療法後に残存腫瘤を有した73例の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を検討した単施設研究。全体の合併症率は27.4%で、手術関連死はなかった。線維化や大きな残存腫瘤は合併症および非神経温存手術と関連し、本手術は比較的安全と結論された。
pmid-21062470.summary_en: This single-institution review of 73 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for residual masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, performed between 1994 and 2008. Mean age was 30.4 years, and 53% had mixed germ cell tumors. The overall complication rate was 27.4%, with no surgical deaths. Pathology showed fibrosis/necrosis in 37%, teratoma in 41%, and viable non-teratomatous tumor in 22%. Fibrosis and large residual masses were associated with complications and less nerve-sparing surgery, supporting PC-RPLND as a relatively safe procedure.

pmid-21074687.summary_ja: 18年間に当施設で得られた奇形腫および混合型胚細胞腫瘍45例を検討。24%に胆管様小管が認められ、多くは腫瘍組織の1%未満だった。サイトケラチン7・19陽性で胆管様の免疫表現型を示したが、予後への悪影響はなかった。奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍などとの鑑別の重要性が指摘された。
pmid-21074687.summary_en: This study reviewed 45 teratomas and mixed germ cell tumors from one institution over 18 years, mostly from testis, retroperitoneal nodes, and mediastinum. Bile duct-like tubules were found in 24% of cases, usually comprising less than 1% of tumor tissue. They were cytokeratin 7 and 19 positive, suggesting a biliary-like immunophenotype. The presence of these structures did not adversely affect prognosis. The authors emphasize recognizing this component because treatment and prognosis differ between teratoma and yolk sac or Sertoli cell tumors.

pmid-21092878.summary_ja: 7か月齢の男児に生じた腹腔内精巣成熟奇形腫の稀な症例報告。腹部腫瘤と片側停留精巣を呈し、画像所見から暫定診断され、切除後の病理組織学的検査で確定した。思春期前の病態・画像所見を成人女性の成熟卵巣奇形腫と比較し、放射線科医による早期診断の重要性を示している。
pmid-21092878.summary_en: This case report describes a 7-month-old boy with an intra-abdominal testicular mature teratoma presenting as a palpable abdominal mass with unilateral undescended testis. The diagnosis was provisionally made from clinical and characteristic radiologic findings and confirmed histologically after surgical removal. The authors compare the pathogenesis and imaging features of prepubertal testicular mature teratomas with mature ovarian teratomas in women of reproductive age. They emphasize that awareness of this entity helps radiologists suggest timely diagnosis and intervention.

pmid-21095363.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、7.5cmの嚢胞性縦隔セミノーマを有する36歳男性を報告するものである。本症例は、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の非典型的な嚢胞性変異型である。腫瘍は胸腔鏡下手術により良好に切除された。縦隔セミノーマの多くは充実性であるため、嚢胞性の外観は非典型的である。28か月の経過観察後も再発は認められなかった。本報告は、この稀な病態に対して胸腔鏡下切除が有効であり得ることを示唆している。
pmid-21095363.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with a 7.5-cm cystic mediastinal seminoma, an unusual cystic variant of extragonadal germ cell tumor. The tumor was successfully resected using video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery. The authors note that most mediastinal seminomas are solid, making the cystic appearance atypical. After 28 months of follow-up, no recurrence was observed. The report suggests that thoracoscopic resection can be effective for this rare presentation.

pmid-21098905.summary_ja: 精神遅滞の既往を有する37歳男性の進行精巣がんの症例報告。右陰嚢潰瘍で受診し、pT4の胎児性癌と診断された。治療を受けずに進行した自然経過を示したのち、BEP療法5サイクルで完全奏効が得られた。精巣腫瘍の疫学と中等度リスク非セミノーマの治癒率にも言及している。
pmid-21098905.summary_en: This report describes a 37-year-old man with intellectual disability who presented with a right scrotal ulcer and was diagnosed with pT4 embryonal carcinoma. Imaging showed multiple pulmonary nodules. The disease progressed naturally over several months without treatment. Five cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin (BEP) produced a complete response. The paper also reviews the epidemiology of testicular tumors and notes an approximately 70% cure rate for intermediate-risk nonseminoma treated with BEP.

pmid-21105138.summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘍の画像診断の総説で、胸腺腫瘍、リンパ腫、嚢胞性病変とともに胚細胞腫瘍を主要対象の一つとして扱う。成熟奇形腫は脂肪・骨成分が特徴、セミノーマは均一で造影効果に乏しく、非セミノーマ性悪性胚細胞腫瘍は変性と隣接構造への浸潤を示すと記載している。
pmid-21105138.summary_en: This review describes clinical, pathological and imaging features of mediastinal tumors, including thymic hyperplasia, thymic epithelial tumors, germ cell tumors, lymphoma and cystic masses. For germ cell tumors, mature teratomas show variable CT attenuation with characteristic fat and bone components. Seminomas are homogeneous with minimal enhancement, while nonseminomatous malignant germ cell tumors show prominent degeneration and local invasion. The authors also highlight the role of chemical shift MRI in differentiating thymic lesions and cystic masses.

pmid-21107090.summary_ja: 純粋型卵巣未熟奇形腫18例で、Oct4、PAX6、CD56の免疫組織化学的発現を検討した。Oct4は高悪性度（グレード3の全例とグレード2の2例）の未熟神経上皮にのみ認められ、高悪性度未熟奇形腫の診断バイオマーカーとして有望と示唆された。PAX6は全例で、CD56は様々な成熟度の神経成分で発現していた。
pmid-21107090.summary_en: This study examined Oct4, PAX6 and CD56 immunohistochemical expression in 18 pure immature ovarian teratomas. Oct4 was detected only in the immature neuroepithelium of higher-grade tumors (all grade 3 and two grade 2 cases). PAX6 was present in all immature teratomas, and CD56 was expressed in neural components of various maturities. Tumor cells lacked CD30 and AFP, supporting a pure immature teratoma diagnosis. The authors suggest Oct4 may be a promising biomarker for identifying highly malignant immature teratomas.

pmid-21108777.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマを発症した45歳の真性半陰陽の症例報告。根治的精巣摘除術の8か月後に鼠径リンパ節転移を生じた。過去の鼠径部・陰嚢手術が転移様式に影響する可能性を文献的に検討し、手術時の精巣操作の最小化と精索の高位結紮を提唱している。
pmid-21108777.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old true hermaphrodite raised as male who developed testicular seminoma and, eight months after radical orchidectomy, inguinal lymph node metastases, an unusual presentation. The patient had undergone left orchidopexy at age 10 for undescended testes. The authors review the literature on inguinal nodal involvement in early-stage testicular cancer and discuss possible metastatic routes. They suggest that prior inguinal or scrotal surgery may predispose to inguinal nodal spread and recommend minimal testicular handling and high spermatic cord ligation during orchidectomy.

pmid-21108779.summary_ja: 閉経から23年後に発症した73歳女性の絨毛癌の症例報告。性器出血とβ-hCGの著明高値（2,704,040 mIU/mL）を呈し、免疫組織化学で診断された。EMA/CO療法7サイクルでβ-hCGは5 mIU/mL未満に低下した。閉経後女性では胚細胞起源や上皮性腫瘍の脱分化を除外する免疫組織化学的評価の重要性を強調している。
pmid-21108779.summary_en: This case report describes a 73-year-old woman who presented with vaginal bleeding 23 years after menopause and 38 years after her last pregnancy, with markedly elevated beta-hCG (2,704,040 mIU/mL). Biopsies showed choriocarcinoma, supported by immunohistochemical positivity for beta-hCG and cytokeratin and negativity for OCT3/4 and AFP. She responded to EMA/CO chemotherapy, with beta-hCG falling below 5 mIU/mL after seven cycles. The authors emphasize immunohistochemical workup to exclude germ cell origin or epithelial dedifferentiation in postmenopausal women with such presentations.

pmid-21115895.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株2101EPとH12.1に逐次的X線照射を行い、耐性亜株を作製した。亜株はシスプラチンに対する感受性が上昇した一方、オキサリプラチンに対しては耐性を獲得した。p53、PARP、hMSH2、Fasの発現も上昇しており、放射線前治療が後続の白金製剤の選択に影響しうることが示唆された。
pmid-21115895.summary_en: This study examined human teratocarcinoma cell lines 2101EP and H12.1 after sequential fractionated X-irradiation, generating resistant sublines 2101EP/DXR-10 and H12.1/DXR-10. The irradiated sublines became more sensitive to cisplatin but acquired resistance to oxaliplatin. Radiosensitivity was unchanged, while p53, PARP, hMSH2 and Fas expression increased, suggesting altered DNA repair and apoptosis pathways. The authors suggest that prior radiation could influence the choice of subsequent platinum-based chemotherapy in testicular cancer.

pmid-21119263.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症候群の32歳の患者が骨盤痛で受診し、精巣腫瘤の一つが純粋セミノーマであることが判明した。外科的切除と傍大動脈領域への照射で治療された。停留精巣の悪性転化リスクや同症候群の内分泌異常について文献的に考察し、早期診断と誤診の影響の重要性を強調している。
pmid-21119263.summary_en: A 32-year-old individual with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome presented with pelvic pain and was found to have testicular masses, one of which was a pure seminoma. The authors describe treatment with surgical resection and para-aortic radiation. The paper reviews the biochemical and endocrine abnormalities underlying the syndrome and the potential for malignant change in undescended testes. It emphasizes the importance of early diagnosis and the consequences of misdiagnosis.

pmid-21119432.summary_ja: 23歳男性の縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍に対し、下顎および隣接する歯肉への転移を認めた。既に化学療法を受けており、追加治療は行われなかった。卵黄嚢腫瘍は精巣や卵巣に多いが、性腺外発生が10〜15%を占める。本稿では口腔転移の臨床的・病理組織学的特徴を述べ、頭頸部への転移はまれであることを示した。
pmid-21119432.summary_en: A 23-year-old man presented with mandibular and adjacent gingival metastasis of a mediastinal yolk sac tumor. He had already received chemotherapy, and no additional treatment was given. The authors review the clinical and histopathologic features of oral metastases from yolk sac tumor. They note that yolk sac tumors are malignant and prone to local recurrence, that extragonadal sites account for 10 to 15 percent of cases, and that head and neck involvement is uncommon.

pmid-21119489.summary_ja: 高齢患者に生じた巨大な側頭下窩奇形腫の症例報告である。頭頸部の奇形腫は極めてまれで、報告の多くは乳児や若年者に関するものである。高齢者での発生は異例であり、臨床的に注目に値する。本稿では、この希少疾患の現在の診断および治療のアプローチを概説している。
pmid-21119489.summary_en: A large teratoma of the infratemporal fossa was described in an elderly patient. Head and neck teratomas are extremely rare, and most reports involve infants and young people. The authors present this unusual case and review current diagnostic and management approaches for this rare entity. They emphasize that a teratoma at this site in an older adult is exceptional and clinically noteworthy.

pmid-21121215.summary_ja: 14歳の男児が、左側の大量胸水に類似した臨床像および画像所見を呈した。血清腫瘍マーカーの上昇と、開胸後に行った縦隔腫瘤の切除生検により、未熟縦隔奇形腫の診断が示唆された。未熟縦隔奇形腫は縦隔奇形腫の約1%とまれである。著者らは、血清αフェトプロテインが診断とフォローアップの重要なマーカーであることを強調し、15歳を超える患者では手術と補助化学療法が治療の中心となると述べている。
pmid-21121215.summary_en: A 14-year-old boy presented with a clinical and radiological picture resembling a massive left-sided pleural effusion. Raised serum tumor markers and excision biopsy of the mediastinal mass after thoracotomy supported a diagnosis of immature mediastinal teratoma. Immature mediastinal teratoma is rare, accounting for about 1% of mediastinal teratomas. The authors highlight serum alpha-fetoprotein as a key marker for diagnosis and follow-up, and note that surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy are central to management in patients older than 15 years.

pmid-21121389.summary_ja: 35歳女性が臀部の緩徐な腫脹を訴えた。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と超音波検査で骨盤内嚢胞性病変の進展と判明し、開腹術で広間膜に由来する類皮嚢腫が坐骨孔から脱出していた。内容物はチーズ状物質と毛髪で、病理組織学的検査で確定した。坐骨孔ヘルニアと広間膜類皮嚢腫の脱出はいずれも極めてまれである。
pmid-21121389.summary_en: A 35-year-old woman presented with a slowly enlarging gluteal swelling that proved to be an extension of an intrapelvic cystic mass. At laparotomy, the cyst arose between the layers of the broad ligament and herniated through the sciatic foramen. Its contents were cheesy material and hair, and histopathology confirmed a dermoid cyst. The authors note that sciatic hernia is very rare and that herniation of a broad ligament dermoid cyst is an equally rare event.

pmid-21129526.summary_ja: 胎児水腫を合併した巨大な縦隔奇形腫の症例報告である。出生前に腫瘍嚢胞液を穿刺吸引したところ水腫は改善し、児は呼吸窮迫なく出生した。生後30日に腫瘍切除が行われ、術後6か月まで良好に経過した。胎児期の縦隔奇形腫は胎児死亡や新生児の呼吸障害を招きうるため、出生前の嚢胞穿刺が根治術までの一時的対応として有用となりうることを示している。
pmid-21129526.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with a large mediastinal teratoma complicated by hydrops fetalis. Prenatal aspiration of the tumor cyst fluid resolved the hydrops, allowing the infant to be born without neonatal respiratory distress. Tumor resection was performed at 30 days of age, and the child remained healthy six months postoperatively. The report highlights that fetal mediastinal teratomas, though rare, can cause prenatal demise or neonatal respiratory compromise. In utero cyst drainage may be a viable temporizing strategy before definitive surgery.

pmid-21139939.summary_ja: 62歳の患者に発生した純粋な原発性胃卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。D2胃切除後に所属リンパ節転移が見つかり、PEB療法を3コース施行したが、3か月後に腹膜転移を伴う再発が生じ、術後1年で死亡した。胃卵黄嚢腫瘍の起源は不明で、予後は一般に不良であり、手術以外の標準治療も確立していないことを示す。
pmid-21139939.summary_en: This case report describes a primary pure gastric yolk sac tumor in a 62-year-old patient treated with D2 gastrectomy. Two of 14 regional lymph nodes were metastatic. Three courses of PEB chemotherapy followed, but three months later tumor recurrence with peritoneal nodules was found, and the patient died one year after surgery. The authors discuss the uncertain origin of gastric yolk sac tumor, which may involve migrating embryonic germ cells or multipotential gastric mucosal cells. Prognosis is generally poor, and therapy beyond surgery remains uncertain.

pmid-21139955.summary_ja: 39歳女性に生じた卵巣の原発性粘液性カルチノイドの症例報告である。卵巣の粘液性カルチノイドは単一胚葉性奇形腫の一亜型とされ、稀な腫瘍である。片側卵管卵巣摘出術後10年で対側卵巣に転移が生じた。長期間を経ても転移しうるため、保存的に治療した患者では慎重なフォローアップが必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-21139955.summary_en: This case report describes a primary mucinous carcinoid of the ovary, a rare monodermal teratoma variant, in a 39-year-old woman. She underwent unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and ten years later a metastasis appeared in the contralateral ovary. The case shows that ovarian mucinous carcinoid can metastasize after a long interval, even when treated conservatively. The authors therefore emphasize careful, long-term follow-up for patients managed with conservative surgery, as the long-term behavior of these tumors is poorly characterized in the literature.

pmid-21142864.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)の遺伝学的知見の最新動向をまとめた総説である。侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患のスペクトラムを対象としている。GTNの診断、胞状奇胎からの進展予測、薬剤耐性の出現といった臨床課題について、遺伝学の成果を診断、病因、予後、治療の観点から整理し、臨床医向けに解説している。
pmid-21142864.summary_en: This review summarizes recent genetic advances in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN), the malignant spectrum of gestational trophoblastic disease that includes invasive moles, choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Although most women are cured, unresolved clinical questions include diagnosing GTN, predicting progression from hydatidiform mole, and managing drug resistance. The article links genetic findings to diagnosis, etiology, prognosis, and treatment, providing an update for clinicians managing these disorders.

pmid-21150242.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者において、増殖因子単独や化学療法併用では末梢血幹細胞が十分に動員されなかった症例に対し、プレリキサホルを用いて幹細胞動員と自家移植に成功した症例報告である。プレリキサホルは多発性骨髄腫やリンパ腫で承認されているが、固形腫瘍でのデータは乏しい。大量化学療法を要する胚細胞腫瘍患者の動員不良例に対する救済策となりうることを示している。
pmid-21150242.summary_en: This case report describes successful stem cell mobilization and autologous transplantation using plerixafor in a patient with germ cell tumor, after growth factors alone or with chemotherapy failed to mobilize adequate peripheral blood stem cells. Plerixafor is approved for multiple myeloma and lymphoma, but data in solid tumors are scarce. The authors show that plerixafor can serve as a rescue option for poor mobilizers undergoing high-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell rescue in germ cell tumor, adding evidence for its use beyond hematologic malignancies.

pmid-21180213.summary_ja: カトマンズのParopakar Maternity and Women's Hospitalにおける504例の完全奇胎を対象とした後方視的研究で、発生率、臨床像、診断方法を検討した。完全奇胎は276出生に1例の割合で発生し、29歳未満の女性と初産婦に多かった。主な症状は膣出血で、多くは妊娠前半期に受診した。吸引掻爬が最も多く行われた治療であった。持続性奇胎は9.5%、絨毛癌は0.4%に発生しており、慎重なフォローアップの必要性が示された。
pmid-21180213.summary_en: This retrospective study of 504 complete hydatidiform moles at Paropakar Maternity and Women's Hospital in Kathmandu (2058-2065 B.S.) reviewed incidence, clinical presentation and diagnostic methods. Complete moles occurred in one per 276 births, most often in women under 29 and primigravidae. Vaginal bleeding was the main symptom, and most women presented in the first half of pregnancy. Suction evacuation was the most common treatment. Persistent mole developed in 9.5% and choriocarcinoma in 0.4%, highlighting the need for careful follow-up.

pmid-21187499.summary_ja: 31歳男性が腹痛で受診し、巨大な肝転移と前縦隔腫瘤が見つかった症例です。肝病変は絨毛癌と診断され、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法6サイクルで肝転移は完全奏効しました。残存縦隔腫瘍は完全切除され、成熟奇形腫と胎児性横紋筋肉腫が認められました。治療後6年以上再発はありません。
pmid-21187499.summary_en: A 31-year-old man presented with abdominal pain and was found to have diffuse, huge hepatic metastases and an anterior mediastinal mass. The liver lesions were diagnosed as choriocarcinoma based on histology and elevated hCG beta-subunit and AFP. After six cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy, the liver metastases achieved complete response, and the mediastinal tumor was completely resected. Histology showed mature teratoma with embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma, a somatic-type malignancy. The patient remained free of recurrence for over six years.

pmid-21187715.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマで左高位精巣摘除術と25Gyの術後放射線療法を受けた21歳男性の症例です。完全寛解にもかかわらず血清hCG-βがわずかに陽性で推移しましたが、尿中hCG-βコア断片は正常範囲で、血清値は偽陽性と判断されました。無治療で経過観察され、術後3年以上再発はありません。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別に尿中測定が有用と述べられています。
pmid-21187715.summary_en: A 21-year-old man with stage I seminoma underwent left high orchiectomy and adjuvant radiotherapy of 25 Gy. Serum hCG-beta remained slightly positive (0.3-0.5 ng/mL) despite complete clinical remission. Urinary hCG-beta core fragment was within normal limits, indicating that the serum result was false positive. No further treatment was given, and the patient has remained free of recurrence for over three years. The case highlights urinary hCG-beta core fragment measurement as a useful tool for differential diagnosis of low-level serum hCG-beta positivity in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-21189838.summary_ja: 18年前に左精巣摘除術を受けた停留精巣の既往がある54歳男性が、骨盤痛で救急受診した症例です。画像所見から腹腔内の精巣腫瘍と診断されました。停留精巣では精巣がんのリスクが一般人口の約40倍とされ、先進国では成人例は稀ながら依然として起こりうると述べられています。
pmid-21189838.summary_en: A 54-year-old man with cryptorchidism and a left orchiectomy 18 years earlier presented to the emergency department with pelvic pain. Investigation revealed an intra-abdominal testicular mass. The authors note that testicular cancer risk in undescended testes is about 40 times higher than in the general population, and that adult cases are now rare in developed countries because of early orchidopexy and orchiectomy. The report, with a literature review, emphasizes that intra-abdominal testicular tumors can still occur in adults despite these preventive practices.

pmid-21191538.summary_ja: 超音波内視鏡ガイド下穿刺吸引(EUS-FNA)により後腹膜の孤立性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を診断した症例です。原発性のほか、消失性精巣がんからの転移の可能性もあり、適切な治療で高い治癒が期待できるため正確な診断が重要と述べられています。原因不明の後腹膜腫瘤では胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に含め、免疫表現型染色が必要な場合があると指摘しています。
pmid-21191538.summary_en: A patient with an isolated extragonadal germ cell tumor in the retroperitoneum was diagnosed by endoscopic ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration. The authors note that such tumors may be primary or metastatic from a burned-out testicular cancer, and that accurate diagnosis is critical because appropriate therapy can be highly curative. They emphasize including germ cell tumors in the differential diagnosis of unexplained retroperitoneal masses, and note that immunophenotypic staining may be required to confirm the diagnosis.

pmid-21209765.summary_ja: 本研究は、北ベンガルの医科大学で10年間に診断された20歳以下の女児卵巣腫瘍を後方視的に検討したものである。151例中34例(22.6%)が悪性で、そのうち66%は胚細胞由来であり、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が最多であった。多くはIA期で化学療法と放射線療法により回復した。
pmid-21209765.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 10 years of ovarian tumors in girls up to age 20 at a North Bengal medical college. Of 151 cases, 34 (22.6%) were malignant, and 66% of malignant cases were of germ cell origin, with dysgerminoma the most common. Most dysgerminomas were stage IA and recovered after chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Patients from remote hilly areas and of low socioeconomic status had lower rates of early detection.

pmid-21214154.summary_ja: 新生児期に仙尾部の良性奇形腫を切除した。その4週間後、右眼に眼内腫瘍が出現して増大したため、16週時に眼球摘出が行われた。病理学的に良性の嚢胞性眼内奇形腫と診断された。仙尾部奇形腫と眼内奇形腫が併存した稀な症例であり、臨床病理学的な特徴を報告している。
pmid-21214154.summary_en: A benign sacrococcygeal teratoma was resected from an infant at birth. Four weeks later, intraocular tumors were identified in the right eye, which enlarged and required enucleation at 16 weeks. Histopathology showed a benign cystic intraocular teratoma. The authors describe this unusual co-occurrence of sacrococcygeal and ocular teratomas and report its clinicopathologic features.

pmid-21226308.summary_ja: 25歳男性が2か月前からの血痰と片側の女性化乳房で受診した。胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で多発肺結節・腫瘤を認め、精査で左精巣に石灰化病変が見つかった。高位精巣摘除術により精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン（BEP）による化学療法が開始された。若年男性の多発肺病変では精巣胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別診断に挙げるべきと強調している。
pmid-21226308.summary_en: A 25-year-old man presented with two months of bloody sputum and unilateral gynecomastia. Chest CT showed multiple pulmonary nodules and masses, and a small calcified lesion was found in the left testis. High orchiectomy revealed a testicular mixed germ cell tumor, and BEP chemotherapy was started. The authors emphasize that testicular germ cell tumor should be considered in young men with multiple pulmonary nodules.

pmid-21319517.summary_ja: 44歳女性の大網原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。大網肥厚とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値(27,612 ng/ml)を認め、手術と4コースのBEP療法を施行し、7か月間無病であった。女性の原発性大網卵黄嚢腫瘍としては4例目であり、文献的な考察を加えている。
pmid-21319517.summary_en: A 44-year-old woman presented with abdominal distension, a thickened omentum on CT, and markedly elevated alpha-fetoprotein (27,612 ng/ml). Surgery revealed a large omental mass with a small implant on the left ovary, and histology confirmed yolk sac tumour. She received hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and omentectomy, followed by four cycles of BEP chemotherapy, and remained disease-free for seven months. The authors review primary omental yolk sac tumour, noting this is only the fourth such case reported in women.

pmid-21319519.summary_ja: 27歳女性の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例である。妊孕性温存手術とBEP療法6クールで臨床的完全寛解に至ったが、約2年後に腹壁に紡錘形細胞肉腫として再発し、腹腔内播種の進行で死亡した。化学療法中・後に間葉様成分が肉腫様に変化し、化学療法抵抗性の再発を来した可能性を論じている。
pmid-21319519.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman with ovarian yolk sac tumour underwent fertility-sparing surgery and six cycles of BEP chemotherapy, achieving clinical complete remission. About two years later the tumour recurred as an unclassified spindle cell sarcoma of the abdominal wall, and she died from progressive intraperitoneal disease. The authors propose that the mesenchyme-like component of yolk sac tumour may undergo sarcomatous change during or after chemotherapy, producing a chemoresistant, metastasising recurrence.

pmid-21319525.summary_ja: 24歳女性の傍膀胱窩に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。挙筋を経て坐骨直腸窩へ進展していたが、開腹により完全切除し、術後2年のフォローアップまで良好な経過である。後腹膜奇形腫はまれで早期診断が難しく、予後は組織型に依存すると論じている。
pmid-21319525.summary_en: A 24-year-old woman presented with pelvic pain and a mass extending through the levator ani into the ischiorectal fossa. Laparotomy completely excised a cystic tumour from the left paravesical fossa, which was a mature cystic teratoma, and she had a good outcome at two-year follow-up. The authors review primary retroperitoneal teratomas, which are rare, hard to diagnose early, and whose prognosis depends on histology. They note this is only the second reported paravesical dermoid with ischiorectal extension.

pmid-21319527.summary_ja: 47歳と57歳の女性における、卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍と上皮性腫瘍の混合性原発腫瘍2症例の報告である。いずれも20cm・21cmの大きな奇形腫に、カルチノイドと悪性粘液性腫瘍が合併していた。胚細胞成分と上皮成分に共通する発がん機序の可能性を論じ、文献的レビューを加えている。
pmid-21319527.summary_en: The authors report two women, aged 47 and 57, with primary ovarian tumours combining germ cell and epithelial components. Each had a large teratoma (20 and 21 cm) together with carcinoid and malignant mucinous neoplasm. The paper proposes a possible common oncogenic mechanism for the mixed germ cell and epithelial components, and includes a literature review of such mixed ovarian tumours.

pmid-21351701.summary_ja: 36歳男性の原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。左鎖骨下静脈血栓症を伴う前縦隔腫瘤で、生検でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性の乳頭状・管状癌と判明した。シスプラチン併用化学療法4コースでAFPは低下した。予後は化学療法前後での完全切除が最も重要と述べている。
pmid-21351701.summary_en: A 36-year-old man presented with left subclavian vein thrombosis and a large anterior mediastinal mass invading the vein. Biopsy showed a papillary and tubular carcinoma that was alpha-fetoprotein positive, and serum AFP was elevated, supporting primary mediastinal yolk sac tumour. He received four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, with falling AFP levels. The authors note that complete excision before or after chemotherapy is the most important prognostic factor.

pmid-21355460.summary_ja: 2000〜2004年に保存的治療を受けた若年女性60例の卵巣腫瘍のコホート研究である。胚細胞腫瘍が26例(43.3%)で最多であった。6例で7回の正期産があり、9例に再発を認めた。病期I・低グレードの上皮性、境界悪性、性索腫瘍には妊孕性温存手術を推奨している。未熟奇形腫の死亡例も含まれる。
pmid-21355460.summary_en: This cohort reviews 60 young women with ovarian tumours treated conservatively between 2000 and 2004. Germ cell tumours were the largest group (26 patients, 43%). Seven term pregnancies occurred in six patients, and nine recurrences were reported. Two patients with advanced disease who refused radical surgery died. The authors recommend fertility-sparing surgery for stage I, low-grade epithelial, borderline and sex-cord tumours.

pmid-21358100.summary_ja: 脳および内臓に多発転移を伴う、侵襲性の絨毛癌の症例報告である。初期治療中に毎週のように新たな脳病変が画像上出現したが、緊急開頭術と補助療法の後、EMA-CO療法により長期の完全寛解が得られた。脳転移は予後不良因子であり、その画像所見と補助療法を考察している。
pmid-21358100.summary_en: The authors describe an unusual, aggressive choriocarcinoma with multiple brain and visceral metastases. New cerebral lesions appeared almost weekly on imaging during initial treatment, yet the patient achieved long-term complete remission after emergency craniotomy and EMA-CO chemotherapy. The paper discusses the radiological presentation of choriocarcinoma brain metastases, which carry a poor prognosis, and the adjuvant radiotherapy and chemotherapy strategies used.

pmid-21368870.summary_ja: 精子形成停止を伴う不妊男性の精巣でmiR-383の発現が低下していることを示した研究である。精巣胎児性癌細胞株NT2では、miR-383の過剰発現により増殖抑制、G1期停止、アポトーシスが誘導された。miR-383はIRF1を標的とし、CDK4の分解を介してpRbのリン酸化を抑制する。男性不妊と精巣胚細胞腫瘍を結びつける可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21368870.summary_en: This study examines microRNA-383 (miR-383), which is reduced in testes of infertile men with maturation arrest. In NT2 testicular embryonal carcinoma cells, miR-383 overexpression suppressed proliferation, caused G1 arrest, and induced apoptosis. miR-383 targets IRF1, affecting its mRNA stability and the levels of downstream cyclin D1 and p21. It also reduces CDK4 through proteasome-dependent degradation, which inhibits pRb phosphorylation. The authors suggest miR-383 is a negative regulator of proliferation and may link male infertility with testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-21369398.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣を伴う同時性両側セミノーマの症例報告である。救急で腹部鈍的外傷として受診し、術前には診断されなかった。術後に正しく診断され、化学療法を施行された。あわせて同時性両側胚細胞腫瘍の症例シリーズを検討し、臨床像と治療をまとめている。停留精巣を伴う場合は診断が難しい点に注意が必要である。
pmid-21369398.summary_en: This report describes a patient with synchronous bilateral testicular seminoma and bilateral cryptorchidism who presented to the emergency department with blunt abdominal injury and was not diagnosed preoperatively. After a correct diagnosis was made postoperatively, he was treated with chemotherapy. The authors also reviewed a larger series of synchronous bilateral germ cell tumors to summarize their presentation and management. The case highlights that bilateral testicular tumors in patients with cryptorchidism can be diagnostically challenging.

pmid-21381532.summary_ja: 急速に増大する嚢胞性病変を契機に出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は血行動態の異常や出血を合併しうるため、妊娠中を通じた慎重な経過観察が必要とされる。超音波検査と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を連続的に行い、腫瘍の増大、胎児臓器への影響、胎児の状態を評価することが推奨されている。分娩や出生後の精査の計画に役立つとされる。
pmid-21381532.summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally because of a rapidly growing cystic lesion. The authors note that these tumors can cause hemodynamic and hemorrhagic complications, so affected fetuses need careful surveillance throughout pregnancy. They recommend serial ultrasound and MR imaging to track tumor growth, its effects on fetal organs, and fetal wellbeing. Such monitoring allows delivery and postnatal workup to be optimized.

pmid-21381594.summary_ja: 多発胆石を伴う巨大卵巣腫瘤を有する30歳女性の症例報告である。妊孕性温存手術として卵巣腫瘤の切除と胆嚢摘出術を行い、続いて化学療法を施行した。その後、妊娠経過は順調で健康な児を出産した。若年女性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍では、妊孕性温存手術と術後化学療法により妊娠・出産が可能であることを示唆する。ただし単一症例であり一般化には限界がある。
pmid-21381594.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with a large ovarian mass and multiple gallstones. She underwent fertility-sparing excision of the ovarian mass and cholecystectomy, followed by chemotherapy for ovarian dysgerminoma. She later had an uneventful pregnancy and delivered a healthy baby. The report suggests that fertility-sparing surgery combined with adjuvant chemotherapy can allow successful pregnancy outcomes in young women with ovarian germ cell tumors. As a single case report, its generalizability is limited.

pmid-21381621.summary_ja: 縦隔の巨大腫瘤により上大静脈症候群と気管圧迫を来した19歳男性の症例報告である。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で18×24cmの縦隔腫瘤を認め、完全切除された。病理組織学的所見では生存腫瘍を含まない線維化した腫瘤であった。縦隔の悪性胚細胞腫瘍は若年男性に多く、手術に放射線療法や化学療法を組み合わせる治療が一般的であることを概説している。
pmid-21381621.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old man with a large mediastinal mass causing superior vena cava syndrome and tracheal compression. Computed tomography revealed an 18 x 24 cm mediastinal mass, which was completely resected. Histopathology showed a fibrotic mass without viable tumor, and the postoperative course was unremarkable. The authors review that malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors typically affect young males, and that surgery followed by radiation therapy and multimodal chemotherapy has been the usual treatment approach.

pmid-21388073.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の患者に、突然の自然発生性重症腫瘍崩壊症候群と重度の低血糖が出現した症例報告である。固形腫瘍で腫瘍崩壊症候群が自然発生することは極めて稀とされる。高尿酸血症、高リン血症、高カリウム血症、低カルシウム血症、尿毒症などの代謝異常を伴っていた。このような稀だが重篤な代謝合併症に注意が必要であることを強調している。
pmid-21388073.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metastatic germ cell tumor who developed abrupt, spontaneous severe tumor lysis syndrome together with severe hypoglycemia. Tumor lysis syndrome usually follows treatment in bulky, treatment-sensitive hematologic malignancies, and its spontaneous occurrence in solid tumors is very rare. The associated metabolic abnormalities included hyperuricemia, hyperphosphatemia, hyperkalemia, hypocalcemia, and uremia. Severe hypoglycemia is also rarely associated with solid malignancies. The authors emphasize that clinicians should be aware of these uncommon but serious metabolic complications.

pmid-21446374.summary_ja: 40歳女性の右副腎領域に生じた奇形腫の症例報告である。超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、石灰化と脂肪成分を含む混合エコーの腫瘤と、右腎門部のリンパ節腫大が確認された。手術では偽被膜に覆われた腫瘍が見つかり、十二指腸の一部が癒着していた。副腎奇形腫は稀な後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍であり、画像所見と術中所見が報告されている。
pmid-21446374.summary_en: This case report describes a teratoma arising in the right adrenal region of a 40-year-old woman who presented with vague complaints. Ultrasonography and computed tomography revealed a mixed echogenic mass with calcification and fat, and a right renal hilar lymph node mass. Intraoperatively, the tumor was found encapsulated in a pseudocapsule with a portion of duodenum adhered. The authors note that adrenal teratoma is a rare retroperitoneal germ cell tumor, with few cases reported. The report highlights the imaging features and surgical findings of this uncommon extragonadal presentation.

pmid-21472272.summary_ja: 生薬紫根由来の化合物β-ヒドロキシイソバレリルシコニンの、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoに対する抗腫瘍効果を検討したin vitro研究である。MTT法で増殖抑制が示され、細胞周期はG0/G1期に偏位した。アネキシンV染色とミトコンドリア膜電位の低下からアポトーシスの誘導が確認された。絨毛癌の治療薬候補となる可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-21472272.summary_en: This study examines the anti-neoplastic effects of β-hydroxyisovalerylshikonin, a compound from the herb Lithospermum radix, on the human choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo. The compound inhibited cell growth in an MTT assay, shifted cell cycle distribution toward G0/G1, and induced apoptosis as shown by Annexin V staining and mitochondrial membrane potential loss. Altered expression of genes related to growth, malignant phenotype and apoptosis was also observed. The authors suggest the compound may be a potential therapeutic agent for choriocarcinoma. This is an in vitro study.

pmid-21495249.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JeG-3からメトトレキサート(MTX)耐性亜株を間欠的および持続的誘導法で作製し、ジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素(DHFR)のmRNA量を検討した研究である。DHFR発現とβ-hCG分泌は一定の濃度範囲でMTX量と相関したが、高濃度では急減した。DHFR転写産物量は耐性の程度と一貫して対応せず、化学療法耐性予測のバイオマーカーとしての有用性は限られると結論づけている。
pmid-21495249.summary_en: This study evaluates whether dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) mRNA levels can predict methotrexate resistance in choriocarcinoma. Two series of MTX-resistant JeG-3 sublines were generated by intermittent and continuous induction. DHFR transcript levels and β-hCG secretion were measured across increasing MTX concentrations. Both correlated with MTX dose only within a certain range, then declined sharply at higher concentrations, and DHFR fold changes did not consistently track resistance. The authors conclude DHFR transcript level has limited utility as a biomarker for predicting MTX-based chemoresistance.

pmid-21510560.summary_ja: 生後1歳の女児に発生した巨大な良性胃奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は22×10×8cm、重量は2.25kgで、胃奇形腫としては最大級とされる。外科的に切除され、病理組織学的に皮膚、軟骨、線維脂肪組織、血管、高円柱上皮を有する腺組織など三胚葉由来の成分が確認された。胃奇形腫は稀で、男児に多いとされる。術後経過は順調であった。
pmid-21510560.summary_en: This case report describes a massive benign gastric teratoma in a one-year-old female infant. The tumor measured 22 × 10 × 8 cm and weighed 2.25 kg, reportedly one of the largest gastric teratomas. It was removed surgically.
