Both later developed recurrence with para-aortic lymph node metastasis requiring extensive surgery and multiagent chemotherapy. The authors emphasize that comprehensive initial surgery, including systematic para-aortic lymphadenectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy at tertiary centers, is needed to minimize the treatment burden for patients with apparently early-stage dysgerminoma.

pmid-19900938.summary_ja: ウィットヌームでクロシドライト（青石綿）に曝露した女性と少女の間で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の集積が見られたことを報告する仮説論文です。2,968人中、絨毛癌3例と胞状奇胎3例が確認されました。石綿は胎盤検体からも検出されており、生物学的な妥当性があると考えられています。患者の職業歴と居住歴の聴取、病理標本の石綿検査が有用と提案されています。
pmid-19900938.summary_en: This hypothesis paper describes a cluster of gestational trophoblastic disease among women and girls exposed to crocidolite (blue asbestos) at Wittenoom. Among 2,968 exposed individuals, the authors identified three choriocarcinomas and three hydatidiform moles. Four of six cases had lived with asbestos workers who brought dusty clothing home. Because asbestos fibers have been found in the ovary, peritoneum, and placental digests, the authors argue the association has biological plausibility. They suggest taking occupational and residential histories and examining pathologic specimens for asbestos in GTD patients.

pmid-19907116.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫）の治療後、血球貪食症候群を発症した20歳男性の症例です。同時期に骨転移も判明しました。血小板減少はステロイドに反応せず、腫瘍進行に対する化学療法後に改善しました。胚細胞腫瘍に伴う反応性血球貪食はこれまで3例のみの報告であり、両者の密接な関連が示唆されています。
pmid-19907116.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with a primary non-seminomatous mediastinal germ cell tumor, containing yolk sac tumor and immature teratoma, who developed hemophagocytic syndrome three months after surgical resection. Bone metastases were also found around that time. Thrombocytopenia did not respond to corticosteroids but improved after chemotherapy for tumor progression. The authors note that only three previous cases of germ cell tumor with reactive hemophagocytosis had been reported, suggesting a close relationship between the two conditions.

pmid-19909520.summary_ja: 3歳児の肝臓に生じた大きな腫瘍の症例報告。肝芽腫と悪性奇形腫の両方の特徴を示し、化学療法後に拡大右半肝切除術と補助化学療法が行われた。初診から36か月後も健康で、残存腫瘍は認められていない。著者らは、この病態を混合性肝芽腫・奇形腫と位置づけている。
pmid-19909520.summary_en: A 3-year-old child presented with a large liver tumor showing features of both hepatoblastoma and malignant teratoma. Biopsy revealed an immature teratoid tumor without hepatoblastic differentiation, while resected tissue showed intermixed hepatoblastoma-like, neuroblastoma-like, and rhabdomyosarcomatous areas. The tumor enlarged after chemotherapy, and an extended right hemihepatectomy was performed, followed by adjuvant chemotherapy. At 36 months after diagnosis, the patient remained healthy without residual disease. The authors designate this entity as mixed hepatoblastoma and teratoma.

pmid-19918516.summary_ja: 67歳男性の左鎖骨上窩リンパ節から、転移性セミノーマと濾胞性リンパ腫が同一リンパ節に併存して認められた症例報告。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を完遂した。胚細胞腫瘍マーカーは基線で上昇しておらず、腫瘍マーカーや陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)では再発の鑑別が困難と指摘している。
pmid-19918516.summary_en: A 67-year-old man with an enlarging left supraclavicular lymph node was found on biopsy to have both metastatic seminoma and grade 1 follicular lymphoma within the same node. Staging PET/CT showed several enlarged nodes. He completed chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Because germ cell tumor markers were not elevated at baseline, the authors note that serum tumor markers cannot reliably track response or relapse here. FDG-PET is also non-specific, since both diseases are avid. Biopsy of each enlarged node would be needed to distinguish recurrent seminoma from lymphoma.

pmid-19922278.summary_ja: 出生時から徐々に増大した仙骨部腫瘤を有する18歳女性の症例報告。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で周囲構造に浸潤しない充実性・嚢胞性腫瘤が認められ、肛門後方経路で完全切除された。先天性仙尾部奇形腫は乳幼児期に多い胚細胞腫瘍であり、成人例は稀である。
pmid-19922278.summary_en: An 18-year-old woman presented with a progressively enlarging sacral mass present since birth. MRI demonstrated a solid-cystic lesion with no involvement of surrounding structures. The tumor was completely excised via a post-anal approach. The authors describe this as an unusual adult presentation of congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma, which is the most common germ cell tumor of infancy and childhood and is typically diagnosed early in life. The report documents successful complete resection through the posterior route in an adult.

pmid-19926950.summary_ja: 右上腹部の膨満感と疼痛を主訴とした42歳男性の症例報告。直径12cmの右後腹膜腫瘤と同側腎の無形成が認められた。腫瘍切除とリンパ節郭清により、傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴うセミノーマ(pT1 pN3M0)と診断された。停留精巣と右腎無形成の合併例として、文献上3例目である。
pmid-19926950.summary_en: A 42-year-old man presented with right upper abdominal distension and pain. Imaging showed a 12 cm right retroperitoneal mass, and the ipsilateral kidney was not visualized. Tumor resection and lymphadenectomy confirmed seminoma with para-aortic lymph node involvement, classified as pT1 pN3M0. The tumor was diagnosed as arising from intra-abdominal cryptorchidism associated with right renal agenesis. The authors note this is only the third such case reported in the literature.

pmid-19926951.summary_ja: 26歳男性が左頸部リンパ節の針生検でセミノーマと診断され、後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と判定された。化学療法で完全寛解を得た後、7年後に右精巣腫大を認め、根治的精巣摘除術によりセミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍成分が確認された。術後10か月まで再発はない。
pmid-19926951.summary_en: A 26-year-old man initially diagnosed with seminoma by needle biopsy of a left cervical lymph node was found to have an aorto-caval retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor. After three courses of BEP and one of VIP, he achieved complete remission. Seven years later, right scrotal enlargement led to radical orchiectomy, which showed seminoma with yolk sac tumor components. No recurrence was seen after 10 months.

pmid-19934304.summary_ja: 進行固形腫瘍48例を対象に、フラボピリドールとFOLFOXの併用療法の第I相試験を実施した。プラチナ抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍で評価可能な9例中3例に部分奏効が得られ、10例中7例で腫瘍マーカーの低下がみられた。奏効例はp53変異陽性で、この結果から第II相試験が進行中である。
pmid-19934304.summary_en: This phase I trial combined flavopiridol with FOLFOX (oxaliplatin, fluorouracil and leucovorin) in 48 patients with advanced solid tumors. The maximum tolerated dose was defined, with dose-limiting toxicities including nausea, vomiting and neutropenia. Clinical activity was seen in platinum-refractory germ cell tumors, with partial responses in 3 of 9 evaluable patients and tumor marker declines in 7 of 10. Responders had p53-mutant tumors. A phase II trial in platinum-refractory germ cell tumors is now enrolling.

pmid-19935163.summary_ja: 筆者は妊娠の可能性がないはずの時期に陽性の妊娠検査結果を得た。この経験を起点に、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を解説する看護記事である。妊娠以外の疾患、特に各種のがんでも妊娠検査が陽性になりうることを示し、臨床所見と一致しない陽性結果はさらに精査すべきと強調している。
pmid-19935163.summary_en: Written for nurses, this article describes placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) after the author received an unexpected positive pregnancy test despite knowing she could not be pregnant. It emphasizes that positive pregnancy tests can arise from conditions other than pregnancy, including various cancers such as PSTT. The authors urge that positive tests without corresponding clinical findings be evaluated further.

pmid-19936119.summary_ja: 妊娠18週の初産婦の定期超音波検査で、胎児の口咽頭腔を満たし口外に突出する高エコー性腫瘤が見つかった。ミソプロストールで妊娠を終結し、死産児が得られた。剖検と病理検査で咽頭奇形腫と確定した。出生前超音波は稀な奇形腫の診断に有用で、早期の両親へのカウンセリングに役立つと結論している。
pmid-19936119.summary_en: A 24-year-old primipara at 18 weeks' gestation had a fetal echogenic mass filling the stomatopharyngeal cavity and protruding from the mouth, detected on routine ultrasound. Pregnancy was terminated with misoprostol, and a 250 g stillborn female fetus was delivered. Postmortem and pathologic examination confirmed a pharyngeal teratoma. The authors conclude that prenatal ultrasound can identify these rare tumors and facilitate early parental counseling, and they review the literature.

pmid-19940282.summary_ja: 1980〜1994年にノルウェーで片側の精巣がんと診断された男性1409人を対象とした全国多施設調査である。中央値10.7年の追跡で、化学療法を受けた男性の39%がレイノー様症状、29%が感覚異常を報告した。高用量化学療法は難聴と耳鳴りのリスク上昇と関連し、放射線療法は足の感覚異常と関連した。
pmid-19940282.summary_en: This national multicenter survey of 1409 assessable Norwegian men treated for unilateral testicular cancer in 1980-1994 examined long-term neurological and Raynaud-like side effects. With a median follow-up of 10.7 years, Raynaud-like phenomena were reported by 39% and paresthesias by 29% of chemotherapy-treated men, and hearing impairment by 21%. Dose-intensive chemotherapy was associated with markedly higher odds of hearing impairment and tinnitus. Radiotherapy was associated with higher odds of foot paresthesias.

pmid-19944031.summary_ja: 54歳女性が肛門からの出血で受診した。内視鏡で直腸内に毛髪様表面を持つ腫瘍を認め、画像で骨組織を含む所見があった。開腹で左卵巣が直腸前壁と癒合しており、左卵巣摘出術と腸管切開下の腫瘍摘出を行った。病理は三胚葉由来の組織から成り、直腸腫瘍の鑑別診断として卵巣奇形腫を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-19944031.summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old woman with transanal bleeding caused by a solid mature ovarian teratoma that protruded into the rectum. Endoscopy revealed a hairy-surfaced tumor 15 cm from the anal margin, and imaging showed bony tissue within it. Laparotomy found the left ovary fused to the rectal wall. Left oophorectomy was performed, and the tumor was extracted through a peritumoral intestinal incision with primary closure. Histology showed tissues from all three germ layers. The authors recommend considering intrarectal ovarian teratoma in the differential diagnosis of rectal tumors.

pmid-19944234.summary_ja: 出生後に呼吸窮迫を呈した男児の両側性嚢胞性・充実性肺病変を報告する。肺実質温存切除を行い、組織学的に神経膠細胞で裏打ちされた嚢胞とグリア結節を認め、肺神経膠異所症と診断された。さらに口蓋奇形腫を含む神経組織が検出され切除された。既報例と照合し、病態と臨床像を考察している。
pmid-19944234.summary_en: This report describes a male infant with extensive bilateral cystic and solid lung lesions who presented with respiratory distress after birth. Parenchyma-sparing resections were performed. Histology showed neuroglial cell-lined cysts and glial nodules consistent with pulmonary neuroglial heterotopia. A neural element containing a palatinal teratoma was also detected and excised. The authors discuss the pathogenesis and clinical features of pulmonary neuroglial heterotopia based on previously published cases, highlighting the rare coexistence of an extragonadal teratoma in the infant.

pmid-19946195.summary_ja: 46歳男性が右陰嚢の腫脹と疼痛、発熱で受診した。CTとMRIで陰嚢内のガス貯留と脂肪成分を含む腫瘤を認めた。抗菌薬治療に反応せず、右高位鼠径精巣摘除術を施行した。病理でセミノーマの壊死が確認され、壊死組織からClostridiumが培養された。腫瘍壊死とガス産生菌感染による急性陰嚢症として発症した精巣腫瘍の初報告としている。
pmid-19946195.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old man who presented with a painful, enlarged right scrotum with redness, fever, and elevated inflammatory markers. CT and MRI showed gas within the scrotum and a partly fatty mass. Despite antibiotics, the infection progressed, prompting right high inguinal orchiectomy. Histology revealed necrotic seminoma, and cultures of necrotic tissue grew Clostridium. The authors believe this is the first report of a testicular tumor presenting as acute scrotum from tumor necrosis and gas-producing bacterial infection.

pmid-19950746.summary_ja: 出生時から生命を脅かす呼吸窮迫を呈した新生児の症例である。右半胸郭のほぼ全体を占める巨大な前縦隔奇形腫を認めた。呼吸機能と気道の管理が重要な課題であった。多職種による連携したアプローチにより、良好な転帰が得られた。新生児における巨大縦隔奇形腫の管理の難しさと、早期の多職種連携の有用性を示している。
pmid-19950746.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a massive anterior mediastinal teratoma occupying nearly the right hemithorax. The infant presented at birth with life-threatening respiratory distress. The authors describe management that achieved a favorable outcome through a coordinated, multidisciplinary approach. The report highlights the challenges of managing respiratory compromise from a very large mediastinal germ cell tumor in a neonate, and emphasizes the value of early multidisciplinary planning.

pmid-19961257.summary_ja: 本論文は、古典的セミノーマとは臨床的・病理学的に異なる稀な胚細胞腫瘍である精母細胞性セミノーマを概説する。高齢男性に発生し、停留精巣との関連は知られていない。3種類の細胞型、細胞質グリコーゲンの欠如、リンパ球浸潤の乏しさが特徴で、第9染色体の獲得が最も一貫した遺伝子異常である。古典的セミノーマや胎児性癌との鑑別が重要で、術後に追加治療が不要な場合がある。
pmid-19961257.summary_en: This paper reviews spermatocytic seminoma, a rare germ cell tumor distinct from classical seminoma in clinical and pathological features. It affects older men, is not linked to cryptorchidism, and has no known ovarian counterpart. Histology shows three cell types, lack of cytoplasmic glycogen, and scant lymphocytes, with gain of chromosome 9 as the most consistent genetic change. Sarcomatous transformation and metastasis are rarely reported. Differentiating it from classic seminoma and embryonal carcinoma matters, since patients may not need further treatment after surgery.

pmid-19967492.summary_ja: 62歳男性の結腸に発生した、腺癌成分を伴う胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告する。診断時に広範な転移があり、右半結腸切除と化学療法を施行したが予後は不良であった。組織学的には卵黄嚢腫瘍と絨毛癌からなり、全ての転移巣が胚細胞の表現型を示した。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀であり、本症例は理解の一助となる。
pmid-19967492.summary_en: A man aged 62 with a germ cell tumor arising in the colon, combined with an adenocarcinoma component, is described. Widespread metastases were present at diagnosis, and right hemicolectomy and chemotherapy were given, but prognosis was poor. Histology showed yolk sac tumor and choriocarcinoma, and all metastatic lesions had a germ cell phenotype. The authors note that extragonadal germ cell tumors are extremely rare, with few English-language reports, and say the report adds to understanding of this neoplasm's features.

pmid-19999102.summary_ja: 胸痛を訴えた28歳男性で、巨大な縦隔腫瘤が見つかり非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を5コース施行後、外科的切除と左上葉切除を行った。最終病理では体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う胚細胞腫瘍であった。本病態の予後は極めて不良であり、早期からの集学的治療が成功の鍵と結論づけられた。
pmid-19999102.summary_en: A 28-year-old man presented with chest pain and a large mediastinal mass, diagnosed as non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. He received five cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin, followed by tumor resection with left upper lobectomy. Final pathology showed a germ cell tumor with somatic-type malignancy. The authors note this entity has an extremely poor prognosis, and that early multimodality treatment is key to successful outcomes. This is a Japanese case report published in Kyobu Geka.

pmid-19999326.summary_ja: 22歳女性が3か月の骨盤部不快感と月経困難を訴えた。MRIでは嚢胞性で一部に充実成分と脂肪液面形成を伴う腫瘤を認めた。切除標本では成熟奇形腫の成分中、50%超が甲状腺組織で、2cmの範囲に乳頭状甲状腺癌様の所見があり、卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。放射線学的特徴を考察した。
pmid-19999326.summary_en: A 22-year-old woman presented with three months of pelvic discomfort and dysmenorrhoea. Pelvic MRI showed a predominantly cystic mass with solid components and a fat-fluid level. Histology after excision revealed a mature teratoma in which more than half the lesion was mature thyroid tissue, with a 2 cm focus resembling papillary thyroid carcinoma. The diagnosis was struma ovarii. The authors discuss its radiological features, which help recognize this rare ovarian neoplasm.

pmid-19999331.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の患者が後腹膜リンパ節腫大による腹痛で受診した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で後腹膜リンパ節を評価し、MRIで腰椎骨転移を確認した。典型的な無痛性陰嚢腫瘤ではなく転移による症状で発症しうる点を画像所見とともに報告している。
pmid-19999331.summary_en: A patient with metastatic testicular tumor presented with abdominal pain caused by retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy. CT and MRI were used to evaluate the retroperitoneal nodes, and MRI demonstrated a lumbar spine osseous metastasis. The authors describe these imaging findings and note that testicular tumors can present with symptoms from metastases rather than the usual painless scrotal mass. Recognizing this pattern may prompt earlier evaluation.

pmid-20002841.summary_ja: 54歳男性で前立腺特異抗原値は低値だったが、腫大した不均一な腫瘤を認めた。針生検で免疫組織化学的にセミノーマと確定し、他部位に病変がないため前立腺原発と判断された。ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法3コースで完全奏効を得た。報告例は5例のみである。
pmid-20002841.summary_en: A 54-year-old man with a low PSA level and an enlarged prostatic mass was diagnosed by needle biopsy with seminoma, confirmed immunohistochemically. With no evidence of disease elsewhere, the lesion was classified as primary seminoma of the prostate. He received three courses of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy, achieving complete response on imaging and re-biopsy. The authors note that only five similar cases have been reported.

pmid-20003680.summary_ja: 24歳男性が木に押しつぶされ、精巣の自然破裂を生じた。手術探索で破裂した精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。本症例は鈍的陰嚢外傷が潜在する精巣腫瘍を顕在化させうることを示し、身体診察・病歴聴取・超音波検査の重要性を強調している。
pmid-20003680.summary_en: A 24-year-old man was crushed by a tree and developed spontaneous testicular rupture. Surgical exploration revealed a ruptured mixed germ cell tumor of the testicle. The case shows that blunt scrotal trauma can unmask an underlying testicular tumor. It emphasizes the roles of physical examination, clinical history and scrotal ultrasonography in managing scrotal trauma.

pmid-20006035.summary_ja: 2歳男児が腹腔内停留精巣に発生し、後腹膜リンパ節転移を伴う卵黄嚢腫瘍（ステージIII）で受診した。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は36,528 ng/mLであった。反対側の巨大精巣が絞扼していたため診断が遅れた。PEB化学療法後に外科的切除を行い、18か月間良好に経過した。
pmid-20006035.summary_en: A 2-year-old boy presented with a large yolk sac tumor with retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis arising in an intra-abdominal undescended testis. Serum AFP was 36,528 ng/mL. Diagnosis was delayed because the contralateral giant testis had strangulated. After PEB chemotherapy, complete surgical resection was performed, and the patient remained well for 18 months. The authors suggest the tumor was a coincidental association with the undescended testis.

pmid-20006261.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫、胎児水腫およびミラー症候群を有する胎児を妊娠した妊婦の麻酔管理を報告する。母体血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が著明高値となり、その後甲状腺機能亢進症を発症した。ミラー症候群では血液希釈性貧血、体液過剰、肺水腫のリスクがあり、子癇前症と区別される。
pmid-20006261.summary_en: Anesthetic management is described for a parturient carrying a fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma, hydrops fetalis and mirror syndrome. Maternal serum hCG was markedly elevated, and she later developed clinical hyperthyroidism. The report highlights the hemodilutional anemia, fluid overload and pulmonary edema risk that distinguish mirror syndrome from preeclampsia, along with perioperative considerations in this complex obstetric setting.

pmid-20006828.summary_ja: 新生児男児に、視交叉部と海綿静脈洞に及び鼻咽頭を圧排する良性の成熟眼窩奇形腫を認めた。視機能障害の恐れから外科的切除は避け、嚢胞成分を中心とした減量術を施行した。3歳時点で腫瘍の増大はなく、良好な視力を維持している。眼窩奇形腫の治療選択肢を文献的に概説している。
pmid-20006828.summary_en: A neonatal boy had a benign mature orbital teratoma involving the chiasmal area and cavernous sinus, displacing the nasopharynx. Because complete surgical resection could compromise vision, a debulking procedure targeting the cystic components was performed instead. At 3 years of age, the tumor had not grown and vision in the affected eye remained good. The report reviews management options for orbital teratomas.

pmid-20006831.summary_ja: 4歳男児の眼内卵黄嚢腫瘍を、眼球摘出後の病理組織学的検査で確定した。術後に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は速やかに正常化した。小児の悪性胚細胞腫瘍として一般的だが性腺外発生は稀である。胎生期の神経管形成時に卵黄嚢細胞が眼内へ移動するという発生機序を提唱している。
pmid-20006831.summary_en: A 4-year-old boy had an intraocular yolk sac tumor, confirmed histologically after enucleation. Serum alpha-fetoprotein normalized rapidly after surgery. Yolk sac tumor is among the most common malignant germ cell tumors in young children but rarely arises at extragonadal sites. The authors propose a pathogenesis in which yolk sac cells migrate into the eye during early embryonic neural tube formation.

pmid-20007774.summary_ja: 129Sv系マウスではDmrt1欠損により奇形腫が生じ、C57BL/6Jでは生じなかった。胎児胚細胞でのDmrt1が奇形腫形成の抑制に必要である。欠損胚細胞は有糸分裂停止に失敗し、多能性マーカーを異所性に発現した。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍でも、DMRT1発現と相関する遺伝子発現変化が認められた。
pmid-20007774.summary_en: Loss of Dmrt1 caused teratomas in 129Sv mice but not in C57BL/6J mice, and conditional targeting showed it is required in fetal germ cells. Mutant germ cells failed to arrest mitosis and ectopically expressed pluripotency markers. DMRT1 represses Sox2 and activates Ret, and similar expression changes were found in human germ cell tumors. The findings link testicular development, pluripotency regulation and dose-sensitive teratoma susceptibility to genetic background.

pmid-20009141.summary_ja: 若年女性で絨毛癌の肝転移が自然破裂し、血腹症を来した。二相性のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で典型像を認め診断に有用だった。経カテーテル的肝動脈塞栓術で治療した。症例とともに、絨毛癌由来の破裂性肝転移の画像所見と治療選択肢を文献的に考察している。
pmid-20009141.summary_en: A young woman had spontaneous rupture of a hepatic metastasis from choriocarcinoma, causing hemoperitoneum. Biphasic CT showed typical features that helped establish the diagnosis. She was treated with transcatheter hepatic artery embolization. The case is presented alongside a literature review of imaging characteristics and therapeutic options for ruptured hepatic metastases from choriocarcinoma.

pmid-20009406.summary_ja: AIDSを合併した進行精巣セミノーマの男性の症例報告。HAART継続下で左精巣摘除と化学療法3コースを行い部分奏効を得たが、胃出血により抗ウイルス薬や予防投与ができなくなり、重症肺感染症で死亡した。化学療法とHIVによるリンパ球減少が免疫不全を相乗的に悪化させた。免疫不全の厳格な管理を伴う慎重な化学療法は予後改善に寄与しうると結論づけている。
pmid-20009406.summary_en: This case report describes a man with advanced testicular seminoma and AIDS who was treated with highly active antiretroviral therapy. After left orchiectomy and three cycles of chemotherapy he achieved a partial response. Gastric bleeding then prevented antiretroviral and prophylactic medication, and he died of severe pulmonary infection. The authors attribute this to synergistic immunosuppression from chemotherapy-related and HIV-related lymphopenia. They conclude that careful chemotherapy with strict management of immunodeficiency can give a good prognosis for germ cell tumor patients with AIDS, which is increasingly important in Japan.

pmid-20014563.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の腹水細胞診の症例報告。空胞状細胞質を有する悪性細胞の集塊が粘液性腺癌様に見え、合胞体様・腺管様構造は少数、硝子様小体はまれだった。免疫細胞化学でαフェトプロテインが陽性であった。腹水中の卵黄嚢腫瘍の診断は難しく、免疫細胞化学と臨床・検査所見の照合が必要であり、他腫瘍との鑑別も重要と結論づけている。
pmid-20014563.summary_en: This case report describes the ascitic fluid cytology of an ovarian yolk sac tumor. Smears showed clusters of malignant cells with vacuolated cytoplasm that mimicked mucinous adenocarcinoma, with fewer syncytial-like and glandular structures and rare hyaline globules. Immunocytochemistry was positive for alpha-fetoprotein. The authors emphasize that diagnosing yolk sac tumor in ascitic fluid can be challenging and requires immunocytochemistry and correlation with clinical and laboratory findings. They also discuss the differential diagnosis from other neoplasms.

pmid-20015364.summary_ja: 胎児性癌幹細胞株2102Ep(未分化)とNTera2(分化)のマイクロRNA(miRNA)制御を卵巣漿液性腺癌検体と比較したqPCR研究。2102Epは生合成や成熟miRNA発現が卵巣漿液性腺癌と広く重なり、miR-17/92ファミリーや第14・19番染色体クラスターのmiRNAが特徴的だった。未分化状態を維持する機構の理解は高悪性度腫瘍の研究に寄与し、これらのmiRNAの操作により低悪性度腫瘍を生じさせられる可能性を示唆している。
pmid-20015364.summary_en: This study compares microRNA (miRNA) regulation in two embryonal carcinoma stem cell lines, NTera2 (differentiating) and 2102Ep (undifferentiated), with ovarian serous carcinoma patient samples using qPCR. 2102Ep cells overlapped substantially with ovarian serous carcinoma in miRNA biosynthesis and mature miRNA expression, notably the miR-17/92 family and clusters on chromosomes 14 and 19. Undifferentiated 2102Ep cells maintained biosynthesis gene expression and avoided differentiation, whereas tumor samples showed decreased biosynthesis and chromosome 14 clustering. The authors suggest these miRNAs could be manipulated to generate lower-grade tumors.

pmid-20016238.summary_ja: セミノーマの46歳男性が、シスプラチン併用化学療法の第2サイクル中に急性脳梗塞を発症した症例報告。脳出血を除外後に全身性血栓溶解療法を行い、左内頸動脈閉塞と中大脳動脈領域の梗塞が判明した。後遺症として失語と片麻痺が残り、後にてんかんを発症した。腫瘍は完全寛解を維持した。シスプラチン関連の虚血性脳卒中はまれだが重篤となりうるため、予防策が議論されている。
pmid-20016238.summary_en: A 46-year-old man with seminoma developed acute ischemic stroke with right hemiparesis and global aphasia during the second cycle of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. After intracerebral bleeding was excluded, systemic thrombolysis was performed, revealing acute occlusion of the left internal carotid artery with middle cerebral artery infarction. He recovered slowly but had persistent moderate aphasia and partial hemiparesis, and later developed symptomatic epilepsy, while the tumor remained in complete remission. The authors review the literature and discuss precautions to reduce this rare but potentially disabling complication.

pmid-20019899.summary_ja: ノルウェーJanus血清バンクのコホート内症例対照研究で、診断前血清中の有機塩素化合物と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクを検討。症例49例と対照51例を比較した。症例ではp,p'-DDEやクロルデン類が高値だったが、統計的に有意なオッズ比は得られなかった。セミノーマでは一部のPCB濃度に有意な差がみられた。DDEやクロルデン、一部のPCBとのリスク関連について限定的な根拠を示した。
pmid-20019899.summary_en: This nested case-control study within the Norwegian Janus Serum Bank cohort examined prediagnostic serum concentrations of organochlorine compounds and testicular germ cell tumor risk. Forty-nine cases were matched to 51 controls. Cases had elevated p,p'-DDE and chlordane levels, though no odds ratios reached statistical significance. Seminoma cases had significantly lower concentrations of PCB congeners 44, 49, and 52 and higher concentrations of several others. The authors conclude there is qualified evidence linking DDE and chlordane exposure, and possibly some PCB congeners, to testicular germ cell tumor risk.

pmid-20028501.summary_ja: 進行精巣セミノーマの49歳男性が、PEB療法2コース後に胸部下行大動脈と腎動脈下の腹部大動脈に血栓を生じた症例報告。大動脈閉塞は約30%で、四肢の虚血症状はなかった。抗凝固療法により、化学療法終了6か月後に血栓は完全に消失した。シスプラチン併用化学療法が血栓形成の強い誘因と考えられ、若年者でも動脈血栓症に注意が必要とされる。
pmid-20028501.summary_en: A 49-year-old man with advanced testicular seminoma developed thrombotic deposits in the thoracic and infrarenal abdominal aorta after two cycles of PEB chemotherapy. Aortic occlusion was about 30%, with no clinical signs of limb malperfusion. Anticoagulation was started, and the deposits had completely resolved six months after chemotherapy ended. With no other predisposing factors, the authors attribute the event to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. They describe it as the first case of endo-aortic thrombosis during chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumor and urge providers to be aware of arterial thrombosis even in young patients.

pmid-20030207.summary_ja: 本総説は、NR1/NR2 NMDA受容体に対する抗体によって生じる治療反応性脳炎である抗NMDA受容体脳炎を解説している。若年女性に多く、卵巣奇形腫との関連が強く、精神症状、けいれん、カタトニアを呈する。著者らは、この抗体がGABA作動性介在ニューロン上のNMDA受容体機能を低下させ、グルタミン酸およびドパミンの調節異常を引き起こすと提唱している。奇形腫陽性例では免疫療法と併用した早期の腫瘍摘出が推奨され、抵抗性の患者では探索的開腹術により微小な奇形腫を発見しうる。
pmid-20030207.summary_en: This review describes anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, a treatment-responsive encephalitis caused by antibodies against the NR1/NR2 NMDA receptor. It typically affects young women and is strongly associated with ovarian teratoma, presenting with psychiatric symptoms, seizures, and catatonia. The authors propose that the antibodies reduce NMDA receptor function on GABAergic interneurons, leading to glutamate and dopamine dysregulation. Early tumor resection with immunotherapy is recommended in teratoma-positive cases, and exploratory laparotomy may help find microscopic teratoma in refractory patients.

pmid-20037417.summary_ja: 73歳男性の原発性胃絨毛癌の症例報告。食欲不振で受診し、残存胃と膵臓の間に9cm大の腫瘍を認めた。内視鏡生検では低分化腺癌とされたが、切除標本で絨毛癌と診断され、hCG免疫染色が陽性であった。胃全摘を含む拡大手術後45日で皮膚転移が出現し、術後60日で死亡した。極めて稀で予後不良であり、生検のみでは診断が困難な場合があることを示す。
pmid-20037417.summary_en: A 73-year-old man presented with appetite loss and a 9 cm abdominal mass between the residual stomach and pancreas. Endoscopic biopsy suggested poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma, but resection revealed choriocarcinoma with hCG-positive immunostaining. Despite total gastrectomy with extended resection, skin metastasis appeared 45 days later, and the patient died 60 days after surgery. The report highlights the rarity and poor prognosis of primary gastric choriocarcinoma and the diagnostic pitfall of relying on biopsy alone.

pmid-20041106.summary_ja: 妊娠13週で卵巣の未熟奇形腫（grade 3）と診断された25歳初産婦の症例。妊娠21週で卵巣摘除術を行い、妊娠中にBEP療法を3コース実施した。妊娠36週で軽度の腺性尿道下裂を伴う男児を出産し、児はそれ以外は正常であった。妊娠初期以降の未熟奇形腫の管理は非妊娠例と同様に行え、母体・胎児ともに安全であると結論している。
pmid-20041106.summary_en: A 25-year-old primigravida was diagnosed with a grade 3 ovarian immature teratoma at 13 weeks of gestation. She underwent oophorectomy at 21 weeks and then received three cycles of BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) during pregnancy, until 37 weeks. She delivered a male infant with mild glandular hypospadias at 36 weeks, and the infant was otherwise normal. The authors conclude that management of immature teratoma after the first trimester is similar to that in non-pregnant patients and can be safe for both mother and fetus.

pmid-20047465.summary_ja: 順遺伝学的スクリーニングで同定されたゼブラフィッシュの変異系統を報告する。生後約7か月で高頻度に精巣腫瘍を自然発生し、常染色体優性遺伝した。精巣組織構造が破綻し、精母細胞分化が失われた原始的な精原細胞様細胞が蓄積する。放射線照射により腫瘍細胞はアポトーシスを起こし腫瘍は縮小した。胚細胞の制御機構の解析や新規治療法の検討に有用なモデルとされる。
pmid-20047465.summary_en: The authors identified a zebrafish mutant line from a forward genetic screen for cancer susceptibility. The fish develop highly penetrant, heritable testicular germ cell tumors at a median age of 7 months, with dominant inheritance. Histology shows disrupted testicular architecture and accumulation of primitive spermatogonial-like cells with loss of spermatocytic differentiation. Radiation induces apoptosis and tumor regression. The authors propose the model as a platform for understanding germ cell regulation and for testing new therapeutic approaches for germ cell tumors.

pmid-20048566.summary_ja: 47歳男性が左鼠径部の疼痛を伴う腫瘤で受診した。左精巣は陰嚢内に触知されていなかった。CTとドプラ超音波で血流の乏しい約5cmの腫瘤を認めた。精巣摘除術で、腫瘤と精索が外腹斜筋腱膜を通って脱出し捻転していた。組織学的に停留精巣由来のセミノーマと診断された。停留精巣に生じた精巣がんが鼠径管から脱出し捻転した稀な症例である。
pmid-20048566.summary_en: A 47-year-old man presented with a painful inguinal mass; he had never recognized the left testis in the scrotum. CT and Doppler ultrasound showed a 5 cm mass with inadequate blood flow. Orchiectomy revealed torsion of the mass and spermatic cord, which had prolapsed through the external oblique aponeurosis. Histology confirmed seminoma arising in an undescended testis. The report describes a rare presentation of testicular cancer in cryptorchidism, with torsion and inguinal prolapse.

pmid-20049088.summary_ja: 13歳女児の卵巣のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）で、初診時に高カルシウム血症を認めた。腫瘍切除後も中等度の高カルシウム血症が7日間持続し、その後も7日間軽度上昇が続いた。PTHrPは検出されず、腫瘍組織に1α水酸化酵素の発現を認めたが、1,25(OH)2D3の上昇はなかった。切除後に遷延する高カルシウム血症の新たな機序が示唆される。
pmid-20049088.summary_en: A 13-year-old girl with an ovarian dysgerminoma presented with hypercalcemia. After tumor resection, moderate hypercalcemia persisted for 7 days, and calcium remained mildly elevated for another 7 days, longer than typically reported. PTHrP was undetectable. Tumor tissue expressed 1alpha-hydroxylase, but 1,25(OH)2D3 was not elevated. The authors suggest a previously undescribed mechanism of persistent hypercalcemia after resection, with implications for tumor biology and therapy.

pmid-20057969.summary_ja: 精巣の混合性胚細胞腫瘍が純粋絨毛癌として転移性に発症した症例。血清β-hCGが高値で、多発肺転移を認めた。BEP療法の後、自家末梢血幹細胞救援を伴う大量化学療法を順次実施した。2年間の持続寛解が得られた。非セミノーマ型の中でも攻撃的な亜型で最適な治療は確立していないが、大量化学療法が有効な選択肢となり得ると述べている。
pmid-20057969.summary_en: A patient with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor presented with metastatic pure choriocarcinoma involving multiple lung metastases, with high serum beta-hCG. After BEP combination chemotherapy, the patient received sequential high-dose chemotherapy with autologous peripheral stem cell rescue and remained in continuous remission for 2 years. The authors note that the optimal management of this aggressive non-seminomatous variant is undefined and suggest high-dose chemotherapy as an effective option.

pmid-20061587.summary_ja: 生後1週以内の女児新生児に、発作性喘鳴・無呼吸・チアノーゼが出現した。喉頭鏡検査で咽頭上部の腫瘤が認められ、MRIで確認された。外科的切除を行い、病理組織学的検査で鼻咽頭奇形腫と診断された。フォローアップ中、患児は良好な経過をたどっている。
pmid-20061587.summary_en: This case report describes a term female neonate who presented within the first week of life with episodic stridor, apnea, and cyanosis. Laryngoscopy revealed a mass that MRI confirmed. The mass was surgically excised and diagnosed on histopathology as nasopharyngeal teratoma. The infant is doing well on follow-up. The report documents its presentation, imaging, surgical management, and favorable outcome, illustrating a rare cause of neonatal airway obstruction.

pmid-20062623.summary_ja: 32歳男性の精巣腫瘍例。セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫から成る混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、体細胞型の肉腫成分を伴っていた。高位精巣摘除術とBEP化学療法を受けたが、2コース後に治療を中断した。腫瘍マーカーは正常化したものの、後腹膜の再発と肺転移が生じた。
pmid-20062623.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor comprising seminoma, yolk sac tumor, and teratoma, with a somatic-type sarcomatous (rhabdomyosarcomatous) component. He presented with scrotal swelling, and metastases involved retroperitoneal lymph nodes and the psoas muscle. After orchidectomy and BEP chemotherapy, he discontinued treatment after two cycles. Tumor markers normalized, but retroperitoneal relapse and lung metastases subsequently developed.

pmid-20062626.summary_ja: 肝奇形腫に腹膜グリオーマ症を伴った症例の報告。腹膜グリオーマ症は奇形腫の腹膜播種の存在を示唆する所見である。壁の石灰化、均一性、明瞭な境界から、画像上は最も多い鑑別診断である包虫嚢胞が疑われた。肝奇形腫はまれだが、不明な肝嚢胞の評価では念頭に置くべきである。
pmid-20062626.summary_en: This case report describes a hepatic teratoma associated with peritoneal gliomatosis, a finding that indicates ongoing peritoneal spread of teratoma. Wall calcifications, homogeneity, and a well-defined border led radiologists toward an echinococcal cyst, the most common differential diagnosis. The authors emphasize that hepatic teratoma should be considered when evaluating unclear hepatic cysts, even though it is very rare, with only 25 cases previously published.

pmid-20126588.summary_ja: 30歳男性の5cm大の精巣腫瘍。古典型セミノーマに、8mmの紡錘形細胞からなる結節が併存していた。結節は低悪性度の核異型を示し、増殖活性は最大20%であった。胚細胞腫瘍の他の成分は認めず、低悪性度肉腫成分を伴う純粋な古典型セミノーマの初報告とされる。
pmid-20126588.summary_en: The authors describe a 30-year-old man with a 5 cm testicular tumor showing classical seminoma and a separate 8 mm nodule composed of spindle cells with low-grade atypia and up to 20% proliferative activity. The nodule was separated from the tunica albuginea by seminiferous tubules containing intratesticular germ cell neoplasia, and no other germ cell tumor components were present. This is presented as the first report of pure classical seminoma with an associated low-grade sarcomatous component.

pmid-20136036.summary_ja: 22歳女性が、風邪様症状の後に記憶障害、妄想、幻覚、精神運動興奮を呈し、統合失調症が疑われた。その後、痙攣、ジスキネジア、中枢性低換気を生じた。脳画像は正常だったが、腹部CTで卵巣奇形腫が疑われる充実性腫瘍が認められた。脳脊髄液と血清で抗NMDA受容体抗体が陽性であった。ガンマグロブリン療法と奇形腫の摘出により、後遺症なく回復した。
pmid-20136036.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman who developed short-term memory loss, delusions, hallucinations, and psychomotor excitement after a cold-like illness, initially suspected to be schizophrenia. She later developed convulsions, dyskinesias, and central hypoventilation. Brain imaging was normal, but abdominal CT revealed a solid tumor, likely an ovarian teratoma. Anti-NMDA receptor antibodies were positive in CSF and serum. Gamma globulin therapy and removal of the teratoma led to full recovery without sequelae.

pmid-20364752.summary_ja: パキスタンのNawabshah病院で2007年に治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患30例を後方視的に解析した症例集積である。胞状奇胎が70%を占め、侵入性疾患23.3%、絨毛癌6.6%であった。発生頻度は出生1000対28と高値であった。76.6%が化学療法を受け、96.7%が完全回復し、1例は脳転移により死亡した。
pmid-20364752.summary_en: This retrospective descriptive case series from Nawabshah Medical College Hospital, Pakistan, reviewed 30 gestational trophoblastic disease cases admitted in 2007. Hydatidiform mole accounted for 70%, invasive disease for 23.3%, and choriocarcinoma for 6.6%. The GTD frequency was 28 per 1000 live births, higher than national and international reports. Most patients received chemotherapy, and 96.7% recovered fully, while one patient died from brain metastasis.

pmid-20512293.summary_ja: ターナー症候群におけるY染色体の関与を総説し、性腺芽腫などの性腺腫瘍のリスク上昇との関連を検討した。性腺芽腫の約60%はディスジャーミノーマへ、他の悪性胚細胞腫瘍へも移行しうる。X・Y染色体のモザイク現象は一般的であり、核型にかかわらずY染色体配列をPCRで検出し、性腺病変を予防することが必要と結論している。
pmid-20512293.summary_en: This review examines Y-chromosome material in Turner syndrome, which is linked to increased risk of gonadal tumors, especially gonadoblastoma. Gonadoblastoma can transform into invasive dysgerminoma in about 60% of cases and into other malignant germ cell tumors. The authors note that X and Y chromosome mosaicism is common and that gonadoblastoma prevalence estimates vary. They conclude that PCR screening for Y-chromosome sequences, regardless of karyotype, is needed to prevent gonadal lesions.

pmid-20531999.summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘤、痙攣性疾患、精神遅滞を呈した症例である。CTガイド下穿刺吸引細胞診で非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。染色体解析でXXY核型が確認され、クラインフェルター症候群と縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。性染色体異常を背景に、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と神経症状が併存した点が特徴である。
pmid-20531999.summary_en: This case report describes a patient presenting with an anterior mediastinal mass, seizure disorder, and mental retardation. CT-guided fine-needle aspiration of the mass revealed a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Chromosomal analysis showed an XXY karyotype, leading to diagnoses of Klinefelter syndrome and mediastinal germ cell tumor. The case illustrates an association between a mediastinal germ cell tumor, a sex chromosome abnormality and neurological symptoms.

pmid-20596986.summary_ja: 23歳男性の副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫（SNTCS）症例である。奇形腫と癌肉腫の特徴を併せ持つ高悪性度腫瘍で、診断は3回目の生検で確定した。術前化学療法4サイクル後の切除標本では、原始神経外胚葉成分に広範な神経細胞成熟が認められ、未分化細胞は消失していた。SNTCSにおける化学療法誘発性の成熟の報告は初めてである。
pmid-20596986.summary_en: This report describes a 23-year-old man with sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma (SNTCS), a highly malignant tumor combining teratoma and carcinosarcoma features. The diagnosis was made on the third biopsy. After four cycles of neoadjuvant chemotherapy, resection showed extensive neuronal maturation in the primitive neuroectodermal component, with complete absence of undifferentiated cells. The authors describe chemotherapy-induced maturation in SNTCS, which had not previously been reported.

pmid-20640096.summary_ja: 妊娠35週の超音波検査で指摘された10 cm大の頸部奇形腫の胎児に対し、EXIT手技の麻酔管理を報告した。胎児を部分娩出して子宮-胎盤循環を維持したうえで気道確保と腫瘤切除を行い、乳児は術後7日目に合併症なく退院した。母体・胎児の安全性、子宮弛緩、胎児の不動化が重要であると結論づけている。
pmid-20640096.summary_en: This case report describes anaesthetic management of ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) for a fetus with a 10 cm cervical teratoma, detected by ultrasonography at 35 weeks. Under general anaesthesia with controlled ventilation, the fetus was partially delivered to preserve placental circulation, allowing fetal laryngoscopy and tracheal intubation before mass excision. The infant was extubated on postoperative day four and discharged without complications on day seven. The authors emphasize maternal-fetal safety, uterine relaxation, and fetal immobility as key principles for EXIT.

pmid-20668609.summary_ja: 18歳男性に発生した稀な胸腺セミノーマの症例報告である。前縦隔腫瘤を切除したが、術後8か月間フォローアップを受けなかった。その後、局所再発と肺・大動脈周囲リンパ節への転移で再来し、シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによる化学療法が行われた。術後の定期的なフォローアップの重要性を示す症例である。
pmid-20668609.summary_en: This case report describes a rare primary thymic seminoma in an 18-year-old man who presented with chest pain, dyspnea, and dysphagia. Imaging revealed an anterior mediastinal mass, which was resected and histologically diagnosed as seminoma. The patient did not attend follow-up for eight months and later presented with local recurrence and metastases to the lungs and para-aortic and peri-aortic nodes. He was treated with cisplatin, bleomycin, and etoposide, and the report highlights the importance of adherence to surveillance.

pmid-20737043.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後の難治性胚細胞腫瘍の症例に、スニチニブリンゴ酸塩を投与した報告である。文献から治療標的を同定し、本剤を選択した。胚細胞腫瘍に対するスニチニブの使用は初めての報告であり、有望な活性が示された。従来治療に抵抗性の症例に対する分子標的療法の選択肢となり得ることを示唆している。
pmid-20737043.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with refractory germ cell tumor, including disease refractory after bone marrow transplantation, treated with sunitinib malate. Targets were identified from the literature and sunitinib was selected for the patient. The authors state this is the first reported use of sunitinib in a germ cell tumor, and they observed promising activity. The report suggests that targeted agents may offer a therapeutic option for patients with refractory disease where conventional treatment has failed.

pmid-20740176.summary_ja: 妊娠後期の若年女性が喀血と呼吸不全で受診し、転移性肺絨毛癌と診断された症例報告である。胸部X線所見からの診断の難しさが論じられている。絨毛癌は化学療法への感受性が高いため、早期診断が重要である。生殖年齢の女性で非典型的な胸部X線所見を認めた場合には、絨毛癌を鑑別に含めるべきと提言されている。
pmid-20740176.summary_en: This case report describes a young woman in her third trimester who presented with hemoptysis and respiratory failure and was diagnosed with metastatic pulmonary choriocarcinoma. The authors discuss the diagnostic difficulty posed by the chest radiograph findings, which were bilateral pulmonary infiltrates, and briefly review current treatment approaches. Because choriocarcinoma is highly responsive to chemotherapy, early recognition is critical. They recommend that choriocarcinoma be considered in women of reproductive age with unusual chest radiographs.

pmid-21319013.summary_ja: 口腔底から右頸部に及ぶ新生児奇形腫が、3回の切除後に悪性転化した症例である。最終切除から3か月後にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇と、胎児性癌・卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う胚細胞腫瘍が確認された。JEB療法8コースと再発腫瘤の切除で完全寛解を得た。新生児期の頭頸部奇形腫は完全切除と多職種による管理が重要と述べられている。
pmid-21319013.summary_en: This report describes a full-term neonate with a cervicofacial teratoma of the floor of the mouth and right neck that was initially diagnosed as mature teratoma after three resections. Three months after the last surgery, the neck mass enlarged rapidly, serum alpha-fetoprotein rose, and biopsy showed a germ cell tumor with embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor components. Eight courses of JEB chemotherapy with resection of recurrent masses achieved complete regression without compromising growth or cosmesis. The authors stress multidisciplinary management and complete excision of neonatal head and neck teratomas to reduce malignant change risk.

pmid-21686482.summary_ja: 出生前超音波検査で胃に連続する腫瘤として検出された新生児の巨大胃未熟奇形腫の症例である。腫瘤は妊娠34週から37週の間に増大した。生後10日目に切除され、病理組織学的にグレードIIIの未熟奇形腫と診断された。補助療法なしで良好に回復し、9か月後も再発を認めていない。出生前診断の有用性を示す症例である。
pmid-21686482.summary_en: This case report describes a giant immature teratoma of the stomach in a neonate, first detected by prenatal ultrasonography at 34 weeks as an echogenic mass that grew from 4.5 to 7 cm. Delivery was by elective caesarean section at 37 weeks, and differential diagnosis on neonatal imaging included nephroblastoma, neuroblastoma, pancreatoblastoma, and teratoma. Surgical excision on day 10 revealed grade III immature gastric teratoma arising from the posterior stomach wall. The infant recovered well without adjuvant therapy and remained free of recurrence at nine months.

pmid-21686767.summary_ja: 12歳の女児が未熟奇形腫と腹膜神経膠腫症で発症した症例報告である。一次および二次化学療法に反応せず、経過は異常に難治であった。遺伝子検査でLi-Fraumeni症候群に関連するTP53変異（R248W）が確認され、父親にも同じ変異がみられた。典型的でない腫瘍像であっても遺伝学的検討が重要であることが強調され、同意のうえで家族の検査が提案されている。
pmid-21686767.summary_en: This case report describes a 12-year-old girl with a strong family history of malignancy who presented with immature teratoma and gliomatosis peritonei. Despite first- and second-line chemotherapy, the disease followed an unusually refractory course. Genetic testing revealed a Li-Fraumeni syndrome-associated TP53 variant (CGG>TGG, R248W), which was also found in her father. The authors emphasize that genetic study is valuable even when a tumor presentation is atypical for a familial cancer syndrome, and they recommend family screening with consent.

pmid-21686771.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う辺縁系脳炎の症例報告である。血清と脳脊髄液の両方から海馬神経細胞膜に対する抗体が検出された。血漿交換と大量静注免疫グロブリン療法により臨床症状は速やかに回復した。卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍が自己免疫性の脳炎を引き起こしうること、そして免疫抑制療法が神経症状の可逆的な改善をもたらしうることを示す症例である。
pmid-21686771.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with limbic encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma. Antibodies against the membranes of hippocampal neurons were detected in both serum and cerebrospinal fluid. Treatment with plasmapheresis and high-dose intravenous immunoglobulin led to rapid clinical recovery. The case illustrates a paraneoplastic neurological syndrome in which an ovarian germ cell tumor triggers autoimmune encephalitis, and it highlights that immunosuppressive therapy can produce rapid, reversible neurological recovery.

pmid-21686882.summary_ja: 早産児（30週）の女児に生じた、経口腔へ突出する広範な鼻咽腔奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍が気道を完全に閉塞したため、直ちに気管挿管を要した。腫瘍は外切開を用いず経口的に切除され、病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫と診断された。新生児における鼻咽腔奇形腫の稀な発症形式について、治療と鑑別診断を含めて文献的に考察している。
pmid-21686882.summary_en: This report describes a premature 30-week-old girl with an extensive nasopharyngeal teratoma protruding from the oral cavity, causing complete airway obstruction that required immediate intubation. The tumor was resected transorally without external incisions. Histology revealed a mature teratoma. The authors discuss management and differential diagnosis and review the literature on this rare neonatal presentation, noting that teratomas are otherwise the most common congenital tumors.

pmid-21687015.summary_ja: 60歳女性の胆嚢に原発した胚様奇形腫の症例報告である。病理組織学的検査で胚様体、合胞体栄養膜細胞、成熟および未熟な神経外胚葉・中胚葉成分が認められた。胆嚢上皮には内胚葉性腫瘍を示唆する上皮内変化と増殖性変化がみられた。成人臓器に原始的な腫瘍が生じる機序として、発生期に休眠していた細胞が腫瘍形成時に再活性化する可能性を提案している。
pmid-21687015.summary_en: This report describes a primary embryoid teratomatous neoplasm of the gallbladder in a 60-year-old woman. Histopathology showed embryoid bodies, syncytiotrophoblasts, and mature and immature neuroectodermal and mesodermal elements. The overlying gallbladder epithelium showed in situ and proliferative changes suggesting an endodermal tumor. Ultrasonography and MRI of other abdominal and pelvic organs were normal. The authors propose that primitive neoplasms can arise in adult organs from dormant embryonic cells reactivated during oncogenesis.

pmid-21772904.summary_ja: 30代の女性2例に発生した、純粋原発性卵巣絨毛癌の症例報告である。極めて稀な疾患で、妊娠性または非妊娠性の起源をもつ可能性がある。妊娠黄体の存在は妊娠性由来を示唆するが、確定診断には遺伝学的解析が必要とされる。本報告では、この稀な卵巣腫瘍について起源を判定することの難しさを浮き彫りにしている。
pmid-21772904.summary_en: This report describes two women in their thirties with pure primary ovarian choriocarcinoma, an extremely rare entity of gestational or nongestational origin. The authors note that a corpus luteum of pregnancy may suggest a gestational origin, but definitive diagnosis would require genetic analysis. The two cases are presented to highlight the diagnostic challenge of determining the origin of this rare ovarian tumor.

pmid-21772911.summary_ja: 流産と胞状奇胎、絨毛癌を鑑別するためにp63とKi-67の免疫組織化学染色を評価した研究である。非水腫性流産14例、部分胞状奇胎12例、完全胞状奇胎12例、絨毛癌12例を対象とした。絨毛癌では細胞性栄養膜細胞のKi-67発現が高度であり、流産および部分胞状奇胎ではびまん性の陽性所見は認められなかった。細胞性栄養膜細胞のKi-67標識指数が最も有用な指標であると結論づけている。
pmid-21772911.summary_en: This study evaluated p63 and Ki-67 immunohistochemistry to distinguish spontaneous abortion from hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinoma. Samples from 14 nonhydropic abortions, 12 partial moles, 12 complete moles, and 12 choriocarcinomas were examined. Ki-67 labeling was severe in cytotrophoblasts of all choriocarcinomas, whereas no abortion or partial mole showed diffuse Ki-67 labeling. The authors conclude that the Ki-67 labeling index in cytotrophoblastic cells is the best marker for differentiating these lesions, outperforming p63.

pmid-21789067.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんの導入化学療法後に後腹膜に残存する腫瘤の管理を概説する総説である。シスプラチン併用化学療法と化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清（PC-RPLND）の組み合わせにより、長期生存率は80%を超えている。小さな残存腫瘤の扱い、残存組織型の予測因子、郭清範囲、腫瘍マーカー上昇例での役割、陽電子放射断層撮影の位置づけなど、残された論争点を検討している。現行のガイドラインもまとめている。
pmid-21789067.summary_en: This review examines management of the residual retroperitoneal mass after induction chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer. Multidisciplinary care combining cisplatin-based chemotherapy with postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) has raised long-term survival above 80%. The authors discuss persistent controversies, including management of small residual masses, predictors of residual histology, the extent of PC-RPLND, its role with elevated tumor markers, and positron emission tomography. They summarize current guidelines.

pmid-21938149.summary_ja: 27歳男性が、精巣の胎児性癌の初発症状として胸壁皮下腫瘤を呈した細胞診症例である。穿刺吸引細胞診（FNAC）で診断され、その後に精巣原発巣が同定された。散在性の細胞や微小腺腔様のパターンなど、胎児性癌の細胞形態学的特徴が示されている。胎児性癌の皮下転移は稀で、進行した病態を示すことが多い。早期診断における細胞診の役割が強調されている。
pmid-21938149.summary_en: This cytology report describes a 27-year-old man whose first presentation of testicular embryonal carcinoma was a chest wall subcutaneous mass. Fine needle aspiration cytology established the diagnosis, and the testicular primary was identified afterward. The authors describe the cytomorphological features of embryonal carcinoma, including dispersed cells and microglandular aggregates, and emphasize the role of cytology in early diagnosis. Subcutaneous metastases of embryonal carcinoma are rare and usually indicate advanced disease.

pmid-21938161.summary_ja: 34歳の経産婦に生じた両側卵巣ディスジャーミノーマの細胞診症例である。腹部腫瘤、腹水、腹痛を呈し、尿中および血清のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が上昇していた。超音波ガイド下経腹穿刺吸引細胞診で、合胞体栄養膜巨細胞を伴うディスジャーミノーマと診断された。両側卵巣摘出術の病理組織学的検査で確定診断された。卵巣の胚細胞悪性腫瘍の術前診断におけるFNACの有用性を示している。
pmid-21938161.summary_en: This cytology report describes a 34-year-old multiparous woman with bilateral ovarian dysgerminoma presenting with an abdominal lump, ascites, abdominal pain, and elevated urinary and serum hCG. Ultrasound-guided transabdominal fine needle aspiration showed dysgerminoma with syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells. Bilateral oophorectomy confirmed the diagnosis on histopathology. The authors note that about 2% of nonpregnant patients with dysgerminoma have elevated hCG, illustrating the value of FNAC in the preoperative diagnosis of ovarian germ cell malignancy.

pmid-21938171.summary_ja: 33歳男性に生じた精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍（成熟奇形腫60%、卵黄嚢腫瘍40%）で、縦隔転移を呈した細胞診症例である。当初は悪性リンパ腫や気管支腫瘍と誤診されたが、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値を契機に精巣病変が見つかり、精巣摘除術で確定した。前縦隔からのFNAC標本の細胞形態学的特徴を記述し、胚細胞腫瘍や卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分を示唆する所見として考察している。
pmid-21938171.summary_en: This cytology report describes a 33-year-old man with a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis (60% mature teratoma, 40% yolk sac tumor) presenting with a mediastinal metastasis. Initially misdiagnosed as lymphoma or bronchial tumor, the patient was ultimately diagnosed after elevated AFP prompted scrotal ultrasonography and orchiectomy. The authors describe cytopathological features of anterior mediastinal FNAC specimens, which showed discohesive, pleomorphic small nuclei with cytoplasmic microvacuoles, suggesting germ cell and yolk sac tumor components.

pmid-22439034.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の一つである胞状奇胎の管理についてレビューしている。完全・部分胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などを含む。転移が広範囲でも治癒しうる点を強調し、経膣超音波検査とβ-hCGの定期測定の重要性に言及している。現在の化学療法により、多くの悪性例で妊孕性を温存しつつ治癒が得られると述べている。
pmid-22439034.summary_en: This review covers management of molar pregnancy within gestational trophoblastic disease, which includes complete and partial hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Although rare, GTD can be cured even with widespread metastases. The authors highlight the role of transvaginal ultrasound and routine beta-hCG monitoring, and note that current chemotherapy allows most women with malignant disease to be cured while preserving fertility.

pmid-23139473.summary_ja: 頭頸部に生じる奇形腫を総説している。多くは頸部に発生し、口咽頭(epignathus)が次いで多い部位である。臨床像、挙動、臨床的意義を解説し、歯科医や関連専門医が認識すべき点を強調している。三胚葉由来の組織から成り、成熟度にばらつきがあることも述べている。起源が不明瞭で組織像も多様なため、予測しにくい経過をたどることがある。
pmid-23139473.summary_en: This article reviews head and neck teratomas, which are most often cervical, with the oropharynx (epignathus) as the second most common site. It describes their clinical presentation, behavior, and clinical significance. Teratomas are composed of tissues from all three germ layers with variable maturity. Because of their obscure origin, bizarre histology, and unpredictable course, the authors stress that dental surgeons and specialists should recognize these lesions.

pmid-24591863.summary_ja: 三次病院で9年間に治療された異所性妊娠101例のうち、卵管破裂を伴う胞状奇胎は5例のみであった。全例が急性腹症を呈し、緊急手術を要した。組織学的には輪状の栄養膜増殖と水腫性変性がみられた。診断には厳密な組織学的基準が重要であり、悪性化を防ぐためヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の連続測定が必要と述べている。
pmid-24591863.summary_en: This report analyzes patients with ectopic gestation treated over nine years at a tertiary hospital. Of 101 ectopic pregnancies, five were ruptured tubal hydatidiform moles, all presenting with acute abdominal symptoms that required emergency surgery. Histology showed circumferential trophoblastic proliferation and hydropic degeneration. The authors stress strict histologic criteria for diagnosis and serial hCG monitoring to detect malignant trophoblastic disease early.

pmid-27582828.summary_ja: 妊娠中期に重度の血小板減少を呈した26歳の患者の症例報告で、卵巣奇形腫を合併していた。妊娠の6~7%で血小板減少症が合併することが背景として示される。妊娠中に特発性血小板減少症と卵巣奇形腫が併存する稀な症例であることを強調している。治療経過や転帰については要旨に詳細な記載はない。
pmid-27582828.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old patient with severe thrombocytopenia in the second trimester of pregnancy, associated with an ovarian teratoma. Thrombocytopenia complicates roughly 6-7% of pregnancies. The case highlights the rare coexistence of idiopathic thrombocytopenia and ovarian teratoma during pregnancy. The abstract provides limited detail on management or outcome.

pmid-18393673.summary_ja: 免疫不全マウスにおけるhESCの奇形腫形成について、移植部位とMatrigelの影響を比較した。形成率は部位により異なり、Matrigelを併用すると皮下移植で80～100%に上昇した。組織像に部位差はなかったが、皮下の奇形腫はより充実性であった。奇形腫は多能性評価の実験系として位置づけられ、臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を扱うものではない。
pmid-18393673.summary_en: This study examined how implantation site and Matrigel affect teratoma formation by human embryonic stem cells in immunodeficient mice. Teratoma formation rates were site dependent, with subcutaneous, kidney capsule, and intratesticular sites showing different efficiencies. Co-injection with Matrigel raised subcutaneous formation to 80-100%. Histology did not differ by site, but subcutaneous teratomas were more solid. A karyotypically abnormal line with trisomy 20 showed reduced differentiation. Subcutaneous implantation with Matrigel was proposed as the most reproducible teratoma assay.

pmid-19023518.summary_ja: 本研究は、13種類のがん由来42細胞株と骨髄由来間葉系幹細胞でOCT4の発現を調べたものです。胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株、異種移植片、臨床検体で検証を行いました。典型的な胎児性癌細胞を除き、体細胞由来の腫瘍細胞株では信頼できるOCT4発現は認められず、核内局在を伴う発現は多能性の確かな指標であると結論づけています。
pmid-19023518.summary_en: This study surveys OCT4 expression across 42 human tumor cell lines from 13 entities and in bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells. Germ cell tumor cell lines, xenografts and clinical samples served as validation references. Apart from typical embryonal carcinoma cells, reliable OCT4 expression was not detected in somatic tumor lines or mesenchymal stem cells. The authors conclude that nuclear OCT4 with high protein expression remains a definitive marker of embryonic pluripotent nature. Germ cell tumors are central to validation, though the paper spans many tumor types.

pmid-19133314.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来の栄養膜細胞株BeWoおよびJEG-3におけるビタミンD受容体（VDR）とRXRαの発現と活性を、単離細胞性栄養膜細胞および満期胎盤と比較した研究。細胞株ではVDR発現が低く転写活性を欠いた。脱メチル化剤とHDAC阻害剤で発現が部分的に回復し、エピジェネティックな抑制が示唆された。
pmid-19133314.summary_en: The authors examined vitamin D receptor (VDR) and RXRα expression and activity in choriocarcinoma trophoblast cell lines BeWo and JEG-3, compared with isolated cytotrophoblasts and term placenta. VDR and RXRα were present in term trophoblast and isolated cytotrophoblasts, but the choriocarcinoma lines showed low VDR expression and no transcriptional activity. DNA methylation and HDAC inhibitors partly restored VDR, suggesting epigenetic silencing. BeWo differentiation raised VDR mRNA, and 1,25(OH)2D3 activated ERK non-genomically in JEG-3 cells.

pmid-19179187.summary_ja: 予後良好な因子を有する原発不明癌の評価と治療について、現在の推奨をまとめた総説である。予後良好な群として、腹膜播種の女性、単発の腺がん転移、神経内分泌癌などが挙げられる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の特徴を示す若年男性もその一つである。各群を前向きに同定することで、最も有効な治療を選択できるとしている。
pmid-19179187.summary_en: This review summarizes management of carcinoma of unknown primary with favorable prognosis. Favorable subsets include women with peritoneal carcinomatosis or isolated axillary nodes, single metastatic adenocarcinoma, squamous carcinoma of cervical or inguinal nodes, neuroendocrine carcinoma, and young men with features of extragonadal germ cell tumor. Prospective identification of these subsets allows selection of the most effective treatment, and the authors summarize current recommendations for each subgroup.

pmid-19184054.summary_ja: 胎児内胎児は、寄生性双胎が宿主内に包まれる非常にまれな病態であり、本論文では2症例を報告している。症例1は2歳男児の後腹膜腫瘤で、椎体、四肢、消化管を含んでいた。症例2は4か月女児の腎由来と見えた腫瘤で、四つの椎体を含んでいた。両例とも完全切除により治癒した。著者らは胎児内胎児と奇形腫の鑑別の難しさを論じており、胚細胞腫瘍との関連性は境界的である。
pmid-19184054.summary_en: This paper reports two cases of fetus in fetu, a rare condition in which a parasitic twin is enclosed within a host. Case 1 was a 2-year-old boy with a retroperitoneal mass containing vertebrae, limbs and gastrointestinal tract. Case 2 was a 4-month-old girl with a mass that appeared renal in origin but contained four vertebral bodies. Complete surgical excision was curative in both cases. The authors discuss the difficulty of distinguishing fetus in fetu from teratoma, which is the basis for its borderline relevance.

pmid-19221495.summary_ja: 間葉系幹細胞、胎児性癌細胞、体細胞腫瘍細胞において、幹細胞関連遺伝子のプロモーターメチル化と発現を解析した研究である。メチル化は分化に伴う遺伝子のサイレンシングと関連し、DNAメチル化阻害剤で発現が回復した。胎児性癌は解析対象の一つであるが、論文の主題は分化過程のエピジェネティクス全般である。
pmid-19221495.summary_en: This study analyzes promoter CpG methylation and expression of seven stem cell genes (Brachyury, DPPA5, FGF4, FOXD3, LIN28, NESTIN, ZFP42) across mesenchymal stem cells, human embryonal carcinoma cells, and somatic tumor cells. Methylation of these genes is linked to their silencing during differentiation, and DNA methyltransferase inhibition reactivates expression. Embryonal carcinoma is one of three cell systems examined. The authors propose that epigenetic inactivation of stem cell genes via promoter methylation is a fundamental mechanism in normal differentiation.

pmid-19237542.summary_ja: 胎盤でのビタミンD関連遺伝子のDNAメチル化を解析した研究である。CYP24A1は胎盤、栄養膜細胞、絨毛組織でメチル化されていたが、体細胞組織では認められなかった。絨毛癌細胞株では3遺伝子すべてが高メチル化していた。プロモーターのメチル化は基礎転写活性を低下させ、ビタミンDによるフィードバック活性化を消失させた。胎児母体境界で活性型ビタミンDの利用性を高めるエピジェネティックな機構が示唆されている。
pmid-19237542.summary_en: This study examined DNA methylation of vitamin D regulatory genes (VDR, CYP27B1, CYP24A1) across human placenta and other tissues. CYP24A1 was methylated in placenta, cytotrophoblasts and chorionic villus tissue but not in somatic tissues, and methylation was also seen in marmoset and mouse placenta. All three genes were hypermethylated in choriocarcinoma cell lines. Promoter methylation reduced basal activity and abolished vitamin D-mediated feedback in reporter assays. The authors propose that epigenetic silencing of CYP24A1 maximizes active vitamin D availability at the fetomaternal interface.

pmid-19238373.summary_ja: 胎児の身体に生じる腫瘍を概説した総説である。縦隔、心膜腔、副腎、腎、肝などに発生し、リンパ管腫と奇形腫が最も多い組織型である。副腎神経芽腫が最も多い悪性腫瘍とされる。多くは出生前の超音波検査で発見され、胎児MRIは腫瘍の範囲、性状、合併症の評価に有用である。画像検査は臨床管理と両親への説明の双方に役立つと強調している。
pmid-19238373.summary_en: This review summarizes tumours of the fetal body, which are rare but occur in the mediastinum, pericardium, adrenals, kidneys and liver. Lymphangioma and teratoma are the most common histological types, followed by cardiac rhabdomyoma, and adrenal neuroblastoma is the most common malignant tumour. Antenatal ultrasound detects most lesions, while fetal MRI adds information on tumour extent, composition and complications. The authors emphasize that imaging aids both clinical management and parental counselling.

pmid-19239447.summary_ja: 非前立腺がんに対する骨盤放射線療法後に前立腺全摘術を受けた9例の転帰を報告した研究である。対象のうち6例は精巣セミノーマであった。全例で隣接組織を損傷せず手術を完遂したが、骨盤線維化が4例にみられた。勃起機能が回復した患者はいなかった。術前に禁制だった7例のうち3例は完全に乾いた状態となり、吻合部狭窄は2例であった。放射線療法歴のない患者より合併症が多い可能性があると結論している。
pmid-19239447.summary_en: This study reports perioperative and functional outcomes of nine men who underwent radical prostatectomy after prior pelvic radiotherapy for non-prostate cancers, six of which were testicular seminoma. Prostatectomy was completed without injury to adjacent structures, though four patients had significant pelvic fibrosis and three needed bilateral nerve-bundle resection. No patient regained erectile function, and of seven men continent beforehand, three were completely dry at follow-up. Anastomotic strictures occurred in two patients, and the authors conclude that morbidity appeared higher than in unirradiated men.

pmid-19246322.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3およびBeWo細胞株を用いたin vitro研究である。両細胞株はアディポネクチン受容体を発現し、AMPK活性化を介して応答し、細胞増殖を抑制した。作用は一部がMAPKおよびPI3K経路を介すると考えられた。絨毛癌株は臨床研究ではなく、胎盤栄養膜細胞の生物学を調べるモデルとして用いられている。
pmid-19246322.summary_en: This in vitro study examines the effects of adiponectin on proliferation of JEG-3 and BeWo choriocarcinoma-derived trophoblastic cell lines. Both lines express the adiponectin receptors ADIPOR1 and ADIPOR2 and respond through AMPK activation. Adiponectin reduces cell number and thymidine incorporation, partly through MAPK and PI3K pathways. The work concerns placental trophoblast biology, and the choriocarcinoma lines serve as an experimental model rather than as a clinical disease study.

pmid-19252483.summary_ja: ヒトES細胞は移植すると良性奇形腫を形成し、マウスES細胞は悪性奇形癌を形成した。サバイビンはhES細胞と奇形腫で高発現しており、その阻害はアポトーシスを誘導した。in vivo分化中のサバイビン持続発現が奇形腫形成に寄与すると考察している。
pmid-19252483.summary_en: Transplanted human embryonic stem cells formed benign teratomas without malignancy or residual embryonal carcinoma-like cells, whereas mouse ES cells formed malignant teratocarcinomas. Gene expression profiling identified survivin as highly expressed in hES cells and teratomas. Genetic or pharmacologic survivin ablation induced apoptosis in vitro and in vivo. The authors propose that persistent survivin expression during in vivo differentiation contributes to hES cell teratoma formation. The study addresses how polyclonal teratomas arise from apparently normal cells, with implications for safer cell therapies.

pmid-19252525.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞を用いて、細胞周期遺伝子の転写を担うLINC複合体の機能を解析した。Lin-9のノックダウンは有糸分裂停止を引き起こし、B-MybがLin-9をSurvivinプロモーターへ動員してG2/M期遺伝子の転写を活性化することを示した。G1/S期チェックポイントを欠く細胞での意義も論じている。
pmid-19252525.summary_en: This study examines the role of the LINC complex in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, which have a very short G1 phase. Knocking down the LINC component Lin-9 caused mitotic arrest. B-Myb recruited Lin-9 to the Survivin promoter and was required, together with Lin-9, for transcription of G2/M genes such as Cyclin B1 and Survivin. The authors suggest the B-Myb/LINC complex is vital for mitosis in cells lacking a G1/S checkpoint, relevant to undifferentiated embryonal cells and pocket-protein-deficient cancers.

pmid-19259937.summary_ja: 未分化およびレチノイン酸で分化させたヒト胎児性癌細胞の、放射線照射後の細胞周期チェックポイントを検討した基礎研究です。未分化細胞はG1期停止を示さず、S期とG2期の遅延を示しました。分化細胞はS期を速やかに抜けてG2期で停止しました。S期チェックポイントにはATR-CHK1とp21経路が関与すると考えられました。未分化細胞ではATM、CHK1、CHK2のリン酸化が高く、ゲノム安定性維持に有効と示唆されます。
pmid-19259937.summary_en: This study examines ionizing radiation-induced cell cycle checkpoints in undifferentiated and retinoic acid-differentiated human embryonal carcinoma cells. Like mouse embryonic stem cells, undifferentiated EC cells lacked G1 arrest and showed S-phase and G2-phase delays. Differentiated EC cells exited S-phase quickly and arrested in G2. The authors implicate ATR-CHK1 and p21 pathways in the S-phase checkpoint. Undifferentiated cells showed higher ATM, CHK1, and CHK2 phosphorylation, suggesting more efficient genome maintenance.

pmid-19404668.summary_ja: ヒト胎盤の栄養膜細胞浸潤におけるホスファターゼPPM1Aの役割を検討した研究。PPM1Aは胞状奇胎で低下しており、細胞株でのノックダウンは遊走と浸潤を促進した。主題は正常な胎盤形成であり、胞状奇胎は比較対象として扱われている。MMP-9の上昇とTIMP-2の低下も認められ、PPM1Aは正常な着床・胎盤形成において浸潤を抑制すると結論づけている。
pmid-19404668.summary_en: This study examines PPM1A, a phosphatase, in human placental trophoblast invasion. PPM1A expression was higher in term villi than in first-trimester placenta and lower in hydatidiform moles. In the HTR8/SVneo extravillous trophoblast line, PPM1A knockdown increased migration and invasion, raised MMP-9 and reduced TIMP-2. The authors conclude PPM1A restrains trophoblast invasion during normal placentation. Hydatidiform mole tissue is a comparison group, with the paper's focus on normal trophoblast biology.

pmid-19424576.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍におけるMIS/AMHRII受容体の発現を、良性、境界悪性、悪性で比較した研究です。発現は性索間質腫瘍で最も高く、胚細胞腫瘍がそれに続きました。非上皮性悪性腫瘍は上皮性腫瘍より強く発現していました。胚細胞腫瘍は複数の組織型のうちの一群として扱われ、主題ではありません。
pmid-19424576.summary_en: This study examined expression of MIS/AMH type II receptor (MIS/AMHRII) protein and mRNA across benign, borderline, and malignant ovarian tumors using RT-PCR, in situ hybridization, and immunohistochemistry. Expression varied by tumor type, with the highest rates in sex cord-stromal tumors, followed by germ cell tumors and epithelial tumors. Non-epithelial malignant tumors showed stronger expression than epithelial tumors. The authors suggest MIS/AMH could serve as a biological modifier or therapeutic modulator in receptor-positive ovarian tumors. Germ cell tumors are one subgroup among several histologies rather than the focus.

pmid-19455603.summary_ja: 前立腺および膀胱の間質細胞を多能性の胎児性癌細胞株NCCITと共培養し、経時的に遺伝子発現を網羅解析した。前立腺間質由来の分泌因子は胚性幹細胞マーカーの消失や間葉系・癌幹細胞関連遺伝子の変化を誘導した。膀胱間質では異なる変化を示し、癌幹細胞の応答に臓器特異性があることが示唆された。分化療法の戦略への応用が期待される。
pmid-19455603.summary_en: Prostate and bladder stromal cells were cocultured with the pluripotent embryonal carcinoma line NCCIT, and transcriptome profiling was performed. Prostate stromal secreted factors altered gene expression, causing loss of embryonic stem cell markers and upregulation of mesenchymal, epithelial, and cancer stem cell genes. Bladder stromal signaling produced a different pattern. The findings suggest that paracrine stromal signaling affects cancer stem cell responses in an organ-specific manner, which may inform differentiation therapy strategies.

pmid-19456358.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJAR栄養膜細胞株を用い、PACAP38の生存と細胞内シグナルへの影響を検討した。単独では生存率は変わらなかったが、酸化ストレスや低酸素刺激では細胞死を増強した。酸化ストレス下ではERKやJNK、Aktなどのリン酸化が低下し、Baxの発現も減少した。栄養膜細胞におけるPACAPのシグナル機構は他の細胞株と異なると結論している。
pmid-19456358.summary_en: This study examined whether PACAP38 affects survival and signaling in JAR cells, a choriocarcinoma-derived cytotrophoblast line. One-hour pretreatment did not change survival alone, but PACAP sensitized cells to oxidative stress and CoCl2-induced hypoxia. Under oxidative stress, PACAP reduced phosphorylation of ERK, JNK, Akt, p38, and GSK and decreased Bax expression. The authors conclude that PACAP signaling in trophoblast cells differs from that in other cell lines and may enhance stress-induced cell death.

pmid-19490790.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株にhTERTを導入し、栄養膜細胞の合胞体化への影響を検討した研究です。hTERTは増殖を促進し、フォルスコリン処理後の細胞融合を遅延させました。しかし効果は一過性で、安定導入は得られず72時間後にアポトーシスが生じました。主題は胎盤栄養膜細胞の分化で、絨毛癌という疾患の研究ではありません。
pmid-19490790.summary_en: The authors transfected BeWo choriocarcinoma cells with hTERT to examine whether prolonging telomerase expression delays syncytiotrophoblast differentiation. hTERT increased proliferation and cyclin expression and delayed cell-cell fusion after forskolin treatment. The effects were transient because stable transfection failed and cells underwent apoptosis after 72 hours. The work uses the cell line mainly as a model of placental trophoblast differentiation rather than as a study of gestational choriocarcinoma disease.

pmid-19491195.summary_ja: 誘導型siRNAでGata4を抑制したトランスジェニックマウスの心臓と性腺への影響を検討しました。心機能は保たれた一方、卵巣と精巣でGata4が著しく低下し、精巣では標的遺伝子が減少しました。雌の10%に卵巣奇形腫が生じ、主に外胚葉・中胚葉由来の組織から成りました。奇形腫は副次的所見であり、主題は性腺の機能と恒常性です。
pmid-19491195.summary_en: Transgenic mice expressing inducible siRNA against Gata4 were analysed for effects on heart and gonads. Cardiac function was preserved despite reduced Gata4 expression, while Gata4 was almost abolished in the ovary and testis, reducing testicular target genes Mis and Star. Ovarian teratomas developed in 10% of female transgenic mice, showing predominantly ectodermal and mesodermal structures. The main focus is gonadal function and integrity, so the teratoma is a secondary finding within a non-tumour study.

pmid-19493573.summary_ja: 栄養膜腫瘍細胞などのがん細胞で、免疫応答遺伝子がエピジェネティックに抑制される仕組みを検討した。老化を誘導するストレス経路活性化因子で前処理すると、HDACiによる免疫応答遺伝子の誘導が増強され、IFN-γ応答が回復した。新規抗がん治療への応用が示唆されている。
pmid-19493573.summary_en: This study examined why trophoblast tumor cells and certain cancer cells evade immune recognition through epigenetic silencing of MHC class I and II and CD40 genes. Histone deacetylase inhibitors induced these immune response genes only weakly. The authors found that pre-treatment with stress-pathway activators that induce cellular senescence (Ras oncogene, PMA, or H2O2) substantially enhanced HDACi-induced expression of MHC class II, CD40, MICA, and MICB. This restored a robust IFN-gamma response in trophoblast and tumor cells. The authors suggest these findings could inform novel anticancer therapeutic strategies.

pmid-19508715.summary_ja: 乳がん、正常乳腺、2種類の奇形腫細胞株の小分子RNAを次世代シーケンスで解析し、マイクロRNA(miRNA)を同定するパイプラインを開発した研究である。新規miRNA5種を見出し、乳がんと正常乳腺で発現が異なるmiRNAを示した。奇形腫は主に検体の一つとして用いられ、胚細胞腫瘍そのものの解析は主題ではない。
pmid-19508715.summary_en: This study applies 454 pyrosequencing of small RNAs from breast cancer, normal adjacent breast tissue and two teratoma cell lines to identify miRNAs. The authors develop a computational pipeline that identifies five novel miRNAs and two alternative precursors for known miRNAs. Several miRNAs are differentially expressed between breast cancer and normal breast. The sequence end variability of miRNA loci differs from that of non-miRNA loci and may serve as a discriminatory feature. Teratoma samples serve mainly as an additional sequencing source rather than as a focus of analysis.

pmid-19517060.summary_ja: 常染色体優性遺伝のCurrarino症候群が、同一家系の4名のうち3名で不完全浸透を示した症例報告である。年長の娘は仙骨前嚢胞性奇形腫を伴い、手術後は無症状である。他の家族は仙骨欠損や髄膜瘤など多彩な所見を示した。奇形腫は1例の臨床像としての記載で、研究の主題は症候群の表現型の多様性である。
pmid-19517060.summary_en: This report describes an autosomal dominant Currarino syndrome with incomplete penetrance in three of four members of one family. The mother had only a sacral bony defect. The older daughter had a fully developed syndrome with presacral cystic teratoma, a sacral defect and abdominal discomfort. The younger daughter had no clinical or imaging features, and the son had presacral meningocele, urinary stenosis and a sacral defect. The two children with developed variants were operated on and are now symptom free. The teratoma is a clinical manifestation in one patient rather than the focus of the study.

pmid-19550373.summary_ja: GPC3の免疫染色を外科病理・細胞診における診断マーカーとして概説したレビュー。肝細胞癌で有用性が高く、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やHepPar1を上回る。精巣胚細胞腫瘍では卵黄嚢腫瘍で全例陽性、セミノーマでは陰性となり鑑別に有用とされる。
pmid-19550373.summary_en: This review summarizes glypican-3 (GPC3) immunostaining as a diagnostic tool in surgical pathology and cytology. GPC3 is a reliable marker for hepatocellular carcinoma, outperforming alpha-fetoprotein and hepatocyte paraffin 1. Within germ cell tumors, GPC3 is expressed in all yolk sac tumors but not in seminomas, aiding differential diagnosis. It is also reported in some lung squamous cell carcinomas and ovarian clear cell carcinomas. The role of GPC3 in melanoma remains controversial.

pmid-19597339.summary_ja: ヒトES細胞を免疫不全マウスに移植し、細胞数と奇形腫形成の関係を生物発光イメージングで追跡しました。心筋では10万個以上、骨格筋では1万個以上で奇形腫が形成されました。細胞数が生着と腫瘍発生に強く影響することが示されています。臨床の幹細胞治療における安全性の観点からの研究で、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍を直接扱うものではありません。
pmid-19597339.summary_en: This study used a luciferase and GFP reporter to track human embryonic stem cells after transplantation into immunodeficient mice, relating the number of injected cells to teratoma formation. Injection of at least 10^5 cells into myocardium or 10^4 cells into skeletal muscle was required for teratoma development. Engraftment and tumor occurrence depended strongly on cell number. The work is framed as a safety issue for clinical stem cell therapies rather than as a study of human germ cell tumors. Bioluminescence imaging was performed over eight weeks, with follow-up to day 365.

pmid-19602592.summary_ja: PRC1構成因子CBX7がDNAメチル基転移酵素と結合し、がんで高頻度にメチル化される遺伝子の抑制を開始することを示しました。胎児性癌細胞では安定な遺伝子抑制を誘導しました。CBX7の持続発現は増殖優位性とレチノイン酸による分化への抵抗性をもたらしました。がんにおけるエピジェネティックな変化の機序を示唆する研究です。
pmid-19602592.summary_en: This study identifies CBX7, a PRC1 component, as a factor that associates with DNA methyltransferases and initiates heritable silencing of genes frequently hypermethylated in adult cancers. CBX7 knockdown failed to relieve silencing of deeply repressed genes, but in embryonal carcinoma cells CBX7 initiated stable repression. Sustained CBX7 expression conferred growth advantage and resistance to retinoic acid-induced differentiation, with increased promoter hypermethylation. The paper proposes a mechanism linking polycomb repression to aberrant DNA methylation in cancer.

pmid-19616230.summary_ja: 悪性腫瘍により下大静脈切除を試みた18例の解析。原発は腎細胞癌が多く、転移性精巣がん5例と後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍1例を含む。切除を完了した症例の80%で断端陰性となり、切除例の4/15例に局所再発がみられた。人工血管はPTFEが推奨された。
pmid-19616230.summary_en: This series of 18 patients undergoing attempted inferior vena cava resection for malignancy includes renal cell carcinoma, metastatic testicular cancer (5 patients), leiomyosarcoma and other tumors. Negative margins were achieved in 80% of completed resections. Local recurrence occurred in 4 of 15 resected patients, and survival appeared better after complete resection. Polytetrafluoroethylene was the preferred graft material.

pmid-19641646.summary_ja: 1993年から2006年に単施設で治療された原発性縦隔悪性腫瘍91例を後方視的に解析した研究である。成人では胸腺腫、リンパ腫とともに胚細胞腫瘍が多く、小児ではリンパ腫、原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍、神経芽腫が多かった。上大静脈症候群を伴う症例が多く、診断には侵襲的検査が必要な場合があった。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は55%で、転帰は組織型により異なった。
pmid-19641646.summary_en: A single-institution retrospective review of 91 patients with primary mediastinal malignancies treated between 1993 and 2006. Thymoma, lymphoma, and germ cell tumor were the most common adult histologies, while lymphoma, PNET, and neuroblastoma predominated in children. Most patients presented symptomatically, often with superior vena cava obstruction, and diagnosis frequently required invasive procedures. Five-year disease-free survival was 50% and overall survival 55%. Outcomes depended on histologic subtype. Germ cell tumors form one component of a broad mixed cohort.

pmid-19661660.summary_ja: 2000年から2007年にザリアの大学病院検査室で診断された小児（0～15歳）の悪性腫瘍189例を解析した研究です。間葉系腫瘍が最も多く、胚細胞腫瘍を含む上皮性腫瘍は39.2%でした。胚細胞腫瘍は主に卵巣に発生し、卵黄嚢腫瘍が精巣と仙尾部に認められ、未熟奇形腫6例中4例は皮膚原発でした。
pmid-19661660.summary_en: This eight-year retrospective histopathologic study of 189 malignant tumours in children aged 0 to 15 years at a Nigerian referral laboratory described tumour distribution by age group. Mesenchymal tumours were most common, while epithelial tumours including germ cell tumours made up 39.2 percent. Germ cell tumours mainly affected the ovary, with endodermal sinus tumours in the testis and sacrococcygeal region and several immature teratomas, four of which were cutaneous. Lymphomas were the most frequent overall.

pmid-19711443.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞を用いて、JNK阻害剤SP600125が細胞を用量・時間依存的に巨大化させることを示した。DNA量の増加から細胞質分裂を伴わない核内倍加が示唆され、p21発現も増加した。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の検討は含まれず、細胞周期研究が主体である。
pmid-19711443.summary_en: Using P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, a model of neurogenesis, the authors found that the JNK inhibitor SP600125 markedly enlarged cells in a time- and dose-dependent manner. Increased DNA content indicated endoreduplication with skipped cytokinesis, and p21 expression increased. Similar enlargement occurred in embryonic stem cells. The work is primarily a cell-cycle study using a cell line as a model and does not address clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-19715487.summary_ja: 大きな卵巣腫瘤(10〜27cm)を有する10例に対し、腹腔鏡補助下経腟卵巣嚢胞摘出術を施行した症例集積である。病理は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が中心であった。手術時間は中央値62分で、大量出血や開腹移行はなく、選択された患者における安全で実施可能な術式と結論されている。
pmid-19715487.summary_en: This series describes 10 women with large ovarian masses (10 to 27 cm) treated with laparoscopically assisted vaginal ovarian cystectomy through the posterior cul-de-sac. Most pathology was mature cystic teratoma, with a median operative time of 62 minutes and a 2-day hospital stay. No conversions or transfusions were needed, and one patient had low-grade fever. The authors conclude the technique is safe and feasible in selected patients.

pmid-19716605.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞において、IL-11は増殖を変えずにMatrigelへの浸潤を増加させた。IL-11はSTAT3を用量依存的に活性化・核移行させ、gp130のノックダウンで効果は消失した。栄養膜様細胞株を用いた浸潤生物学の研究であり、臨床的な絨毛性疾患の検討ではない。
pmid-19716605.summary_en: In JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells, a trophoblast-like line, IL-11 increased Matrigel invasion without changing proliferation, with dose-dependent STAT3 activation and nuclear translocation. STAT3 silencing gave a non-significant modest reduction in invasion, and gp130 silencing abolished the IL-11 effect. The study examines trophoblast invasion biology in a cell line, not clinical gestational trophoblastic disease, so its relevance to this site is limited.

pmid-19767821.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9を用い、原始内胚葉から壁側内胚葉への分化を制御するシグナル経路を解析した基礎研究である。RhoAやWnt-β-カテニン経路が原始内胚葉形成に関与し、2つの独立した経路が協調してレチノイン酸誘導性分化に必要であることを示した。臨床的な患者の転帰は扱われていない。
pmid-19767821.summary_en: This basic research study uses the F9 embryonal carcinoma cell line to model differentiation into primitive and parietal endoderm. The authors show that p115RhoGEF and constitutively active RhoA promote primitive endoderm formation, while Galpha13 signaling moves beta-catenin into the nucleus. Wnt-beta-catenin activation induces primitive endoderm even when Galpha13 or ROCK signaling is blocked. The findings show that two pathways cooperate during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. No patient or clinical outcome is addressed.

pmid-19781104.summary_ja: 10歳時に左卵巣絨毛癌と診断された早発卵巣不全（POF）患者の細胞遺伝学的・分子学的解析。核型は46,X,der(Y)t(X;Y)で、派生染色体のX不活化の偏りが認められた。性染色体領域の配置は対照と差がなく、X不活化の偏りがPOFの一因となる可能性が考察された。絨毛癌は臨床的背景であり、論文の主題はPOFの病因である。
pmid-19781104.summary_en: Cytogenetic and molecular study of a woman with premature ovarian failure who had been diagnosed with left ovarian choriocarcinoma at age 10. The karyotype was 46,X,der(Y)t(X;Y), and X inactivation favored the derivative chromosome. Chromosome territory positioning did not differ from controls. The authors propose that skewed X inactivation affecting gene expression may partly explain premature ovarian failure. The choriocarcinoma serves as clinical background, while the paper's focus is premature ovarian failure etiology.

pmid-19834060.summary_ja: 低酸素はマウス胚性幹細胞とヒト胎児性癌細胞株でCripto-1発現を増加させ、HIF-1αがそのプロモーターに結合することを示した。Cripto-1が存在する場合にのみ低酸素が心筋細胞分化を促進する。虚血性心疾患患者の心筋でも発現上昇が認められた。胎児性癌細胞株はモデル系として用いられ、臨床的主題ではない。
pmid-19834060.summary_en: This study shows that hypoxia elevates Cripto-1 expression in mouse embryonic stem cells and in human embryonal carcinoma cell lines (NTERA-2 and NCCIT). HIF-1α binds hypoxia-responsive elements in Cripto-1 promoters. Hypoxia enhances cardiomyocyte differentiation of mES cells only when Cripto-1 is expressed. Cardiac tissue from ischemic heart disease patients also showed increased Cripto-1 expression. The embryonal carcinoma lines serve as a model system rather than the study's clinical focus.

pmid-19900702.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株を用いて、ガレクチン-1が受容体型チロシンキナーゼ(RTK)のシグナルに与える影響を検討した基礎研究です。71種のRTKのうち、RET、JAK2、VEGFR3の3つのみが有意に変化しました。RETのチロシン905リン酸化は免疫細胞化学でも低下が確認されました。これらの変化が、ガレクチン-1による栄養膜細胞の分化と増殖抑制に寄与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-19900702.summary_en: This in vitro study examines how galectin-1 affects receptor tyrosine kinase signaling in BeWo choriocarcinoma cells, a trophoblast model. Using a phosphorylation antibody array covering 71 RTKs, the authors found that galectin-1 altered phosphorylation of only three: it inhibited RET and JAK2 and increased VEGFR3. Reduced phosphorylation of RET at tyrosine 905 was confirmed by immunocytochemistry. The authors suggest these changes may drive the differentiation and antiproliferative effects previously attributed to galectin-1 in trophoblast cells.

pmid-19912360.summary_ja: 15種類の組織型からなる248例のヒト腫瘍で、微小血管内皮細胞のKITと幹細胞因子(SCF)の発現を検討した研究。胎児性癌と奇形腫の混合型では33%に内皮KIT発現が認められた。膠芽腫では、内皮KIT発現は予後良好、腫瘍細胞のSCF発現は予後不良と関連した。
pmid-19912360.summary_en: KIT and stem cell factor expression were examined in tumor microvessel endothelial cells across 248 human tumors of 15 histological types. Endothelial KIT was present in 11 types, most often in glioblastoma (58%), mixed embryonal carcinoma with teratoma (33%), and renal clear cell carcinoma (29%). In glioblastoma, strong endothelial KIT expression correlated with better survival, while tumor-cell SCF expression correlated with worse outcome. The findings identify these as potential prognostic features in glioblastoma.

pmid-20019838.summary_ja: NMRを用い、多能性マウスES細胞、分化ES細胞、マウス胎児性癌F9細胞のコリン代謝物を比較した研究。多能性ES細胞とF9細胞はホスホコリン/グリセロホスホコリン比が高く、ES細胞の分化で5倍以上低下した。PI3K阻害剤はこの比を上昇させたため、PI3Kはこの代謝特性の形成に関与しないと考えられた。多能性細胞と悪性細胞に共通するこの代謝特性は、ヒトES細胞の安全な応用にも役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-20019838.summary_en: Using NMR spectroscopy, this study compares choline metabolite profiles of pluripotent murine ES cells, differentiated ES cells, and murine embryonal carcinoma F9 cells. Pluripotent ES cells and F9 cells shared a high phosphocholine/glycerophosphocholine ratio, which fell more than five-fold upon ES differentiation. Inhibiting PI3K with LY294002 raised this ratio without significantly changing phosphocholine levels, indicating PI3K is not responsible for the signature. The authors propose that this metabolic trait, shared by pluripotent and malignant cells, may inform the safe therapeutic use of human ES cells.

pmid-16685735.summary_ja: Currarino症候群の家系で、仙骨奇形腫から末梢性原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍への悪性転化を来した症例を報告する。仙骨前部腫瘤、仙骨形成不全、肛門直腸奇形の三徴が特徴である。詳細な家族歴の聴取により早期診断や過剰治療の回避が可能だったと考察している。
pmid-16685735.summary_en: This report describes Currarino syndrome, a rare genetic disorder with presacral mass, sacral agenesis, and anorectal anomalies, in a family with multigenerational teratomas and spinal abnormalities. The index patient had a sacral teratoma that showed unusual malignant transformation into a peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumour. The authors emphasise that a detailed family history at presentation could have enabled earlier diagnosis and possibly avoided intensive treatment with late sequelae.
